### C. Offline Architecture

Implement the offline functionality assigned to Person 5.

This includes:

- Offline banner.
- Synchronization status strips.
- Local persistence using Room.
- Background synchronization using WorkManager.
- Pending, failed and completed synchronization states.
- Automatic retry of failed writes with appropriate backoff.

- User feedback when a previously failed request eventually succeeds.

The implementation must fulfill the relevant reliability requirements, particularly:

**NFR-K1 – Offline Availability**

Previously retrieved groups, expenses and balances must remain accessible offline.

**NFR-K2 – Resilient Writes**

Failed writes must be queued and retried in the background without blocking the user from continuing to use the app.

**NFR-K3 – Sync Transparency**

Users must be able to distinguish pending, failed and completed operations and receive feedback when background retries succeed.

Do not implement fake synchronization that simply changes UI labels without performing actual operations.

    # AGENTS.md
    
    ## Project Overview
    This repository contains **"Get Your Money Up Not Your Funny Up"**, an Android mobile application designed to help groups track and manage shared expenses (inspired by WeShare, MobilePay groups, and Splitwise). The app enables groups of users to scan receipts or log bills offline, split items or totals with dietary rules, calculate optimal debt settlements, maintain offline resilience, and send payment reminders.
    
    ### Tech Stack
    - **Language**: Kotlin (`2.4.x`)
    - **UI Framework**: Jetpack Compose (Material 3, Compose BOM)
    - **Typography**: `Plus Jakarta Sans` (weights 400â€“800) & `JetBrains Mono` (receipts only, weights 400â€“500) via downloadable Google Fonts (`res/font/`)
    - **Architecture**: MVVM / Clean Architecture (UI -> ViewModel -> Repository -> Local/Remote Data Sources)
    - **Local Storage & Offline Caching**: Android SQLite / Room Database (`AppDatabase`)
    - **Background Tasks & Retries**: Android WorkManager (for resilient background sync/retries)
    - **Backend & Cloud**: Firebase (Firebase Auth, Cloud Firestore, Analytics)
    - **Build System**: Gradle with Kotlin DSL (`build.gradle.kts`) and Version Catalog (`gradle/libs.versions.toml`)
    - **Target Specs**: Min SDK: 24, Target SDK: 36, Compile SDK: 37 (extension 1)
    
    ---
    
    ## Functional Requirements & Domain Model
    
    1. **User Profile & Authentication**
       - Authentication via Firebase Auth (`Log in` / `Create account` with email, password, full name, and phone number).
       - User profile management (`Profile` tab & `Edit profile`): full name, email, phone number (used by friends to find and add users to groups), and profile avatar (`Green300` `#8FD6AA` for `"You"`).
       - **"Never charge me for" Dietary & Item Rules**: User-level toggles (`Alcohol`, `Meat`) that automatically exclude the user from matching scanned receipt items while allowing manual per-item override.
       - **Notification Preferences**: Granular toggles under `"Notify me about"` (`New expenses`, `Changed expenses`, `Payment reminders`, `Sync updates`).
    
    2. **Group Management**
       - Create, edit, star/favourite (`fav`), and view groups with name, optional description, **group colour** (chosen from the 9-colour non-green/non-red palette), and members.
       - Add members by email or phone number, or quick-add from `"People you've split with"` suggestions.
       - **Unregistered User Handling**: If a searched email/phone does not match an existing user (`"No one uses the app with <query> yet"`), allow sending an invite (`Send invite`) which adds the member with an `invited` badge.
       - **Member Removal Safeguard**: Removing a member with a non-zero balance triggers an inline warning (`"<Name> still owes / is still owed X kr. Removing them can leave the group unbalanced."` with `Keep <Name>` / `Remove anyway`).
    
    3. **Expense Entry, Receipt Scanning & Splitting**
       - **On-Device Receipt Scanner (`Scan` flow)**:
         - Works offline on the phone; frames and scans receipts in `JetBrains Mono` preview, extracts line items and prices, and checks whether the item sum matches the receipt total.
         - Highlights low-confidence/mismatched item prices in Amber (`#FFF4DC` fill, `#F0C870` border, `"Check this price"` tag) until corrected.
         - Supports special receipt line types: `Alcohol` (triggers dietary rule auto-exclusion), `Deposit Â· shared by share` (*pant*), and `Discount Â· shared by share` (*rabat*), which are distributed proportionally by each member's item share.
       - **Manual Entry & Item Editing**: Users can skip the camera (`Type it in manually instead`), edit item names/prices, add/remove items, select the target group, and change the payer (`Paid by`).
       - **Per-Item & Subset Splitting (`Who had what`)**:
         - Toggle members in/out of the entire expense at the top or toggle individual member avatars per item row.
         - Displays live per-member share totals at the bottom before saving (`Save expense Â· X kr`).
       - **Expense Details & Owner Removal**:
         - Tapping an expense opens the **Expense Details Bottom Sheet** displaying payer, date, total amount, sync status badge, receipt photo preview, and per-member split list.
         - Only the expense creator/payer can remove the expense via an inline confirmation (`Remove expense` -> `Keep it` / `Remove`), while non-owners see `"Only <Payer> can edit or remove this expense."`
    
    4. **Debt Calculation, Balances & Inline Settlement**
       - **Danish Currency Format**: All monetary amounts are stored in integer minor units (`amount_cents` / Ã¸re) and formatted in Danish notation (`1.240,50 kr`, always 2 decimals, `.` thousands separator, `,` decimal separator).
       - **Running Balances & Diverging Bar Chart**: Group `Balances` tab visualizes each member's net balance (`Owes` in `Red300` `#F4B9B2` left of center, `Is owed` in `GreenBar` `#9FDCB5` right of center).
       - **Minimal Debt Settlement (`Settle up`)**: Computes the minimum number of payments required to clear all balances in the group (`"N payments clear every balance in the group"`).
       - **Confirm Money in Place**: Paying a debt (`Pay` / `Pay all`) always expands into `Cancel` / `Confirm` **in place on the same card** (never navigating to a separate screen), followed by `Payingâ€¦` and `Paid Â· settled` (`Green100` / `Green700`). Creditors can `Remind` (`Reminder sent`) or `Mark as paid`.
    
    5. **Activity Feed, Notifications & Reminders**
       - Dedicated `Activity` tab grouping events into `Today`, `Yesterday`, and `Earlier` with filter pills (`All`, `Needs you Â· N`, `Expenses`, `Payments`) and `Mark all as read`.
       - Actionable feed cards allow paying a reminder (`Pay X kr` -> `Cancel` / `Confirm`) or retrying a failed sync (`Try now`) directly inside the feed.

    ## HiFi Design System, Themes & Styles (`docs/HiFi.html`)
    
    All UI screens and components must strictly adhere to the interactive High-Fidelity prototype and Style Guide in [`docs/HiFi.html`](file:///c:/Users/gusta/Documents/GitHub/Mobile-Software-Development-GetYourMoneyUpNotYourFunnyUp/docs/HiFi.html), implemented in [`ui/theme/`](file:///c:/Users/gusta/Documents/GitHub/Mobile-Software-Development-GetYourMoneyUpNotYourFunnyUp/app/src/main/java/com/example/getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup/ui/theme):
    
    ### 1. Core Semantic Colour Rules ([`Color.kt`](file:///c:/Users/gusta/Documents/GitHub/Mobile-Software-Development-GetYourMoneyUpNotYourFunnyUp/app/src/main/java/com/example/getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup/ui/theme/Color.kt))
    - **Calm, inviting, positive, intuitive**: Pastels are used for container fills; text and buttons use the deep shade of the same hue (all combinations pass 4.5:1 contrast). Dynamic wallpaper color is disabled by default (`dynamicColor = false`) to preserve semantic color meaning.
    - **Green = good (`AppColors.Green*`)**: Money in, paid, settled, synced, done, and primary actions.
      - `Green700` (`#1E6B45`): Primary buttons, links, active nav tab, positive amounts (`+145,00 kr`).
      - `Green500` (`#3FA36B`): Progress bars, scanline, unread dots, input focus ring.
      - `Green300` (`#8FD6AA`): `"You"` avatar (always), camera frame corners, dark accents.
      - `Green100` (`#DDF3E4`): Positive hero cards (`All paid up`, `You're owed`), soft buttons (`Add expense`), `Synced` and `+X to you` chips.
      - `Green50` (`#EEF9F1`): Settled/paid card backgrounds.
    - **Red = pay this (`AppColors.Red*`)**: **Strictly reserved for money you owe.** Disappears once paid.
      - `Red700` (`#A93A2F`): `Pay` buttons, amounts you owe.
      - `Red800` (`#8E3128`): Text on red fills and retry strips.
      - `Red300` (`#F4B9B2`): `Owes` bars in the group balance chart.
      - `Red100` (`#FCE4E1`): `"You owe"` hero card, `You owe X` chips.

    The application navigation flow combines the state transitions in [`docs/navigation_model.drawio.xml`](file:///c:/Users/gusta/Documents/GitHub/Mobile-Software-Development-GetYourMoneyUpNotYourFunnyUp/docs/navigation_model.drawio.xml) with the concrete screen layouts in [`docs/HiFi.html`](file:///c:/Users/gusta/Documents/GitHub/Mobile-Software-Development-GetYourMoneyUpNotYourFunnyUp/docs/HiFi.html):

    ## Non-Functional Requirements: Reliability Quality Attribute (QA)
    
    The system must satisfy strict **Reliability** requirements visible throughout the HiFi prototype:
    - **Offline Availability**:
      - All previously fetched groups, expenses, balances, and on-device receipt scanning must remain usable when disconnected from the internet.
      - Display the non-intrusive offline banner (`"You're offline Â· showing saved data from HH:MM..."`) when offline.
    - **Fault Tolerance**:
      - If a network request fails (e.g. creating an expense or updating a group), the action is saved locally in SQLite and queued in `sync_queue` for automatic background retry via `WorkManager`.
      - Failed network calls must **never** block the user from interacting with the app.
    - **User Feedback**:
      - Every expense and group surfaces its sync state clearly:
        - `Pending / Waiting to sync`: Amber badge (`#FFF4DC` / `#6E4500`) or group subtitle (`"1 expense waiting to sync"`).
        - `Failed / Retrying`: Red strip (`#FDF1EF` / `#8E3128`, `"Couldn't sync yet Â· retrying automatically"`) with an optional `"Try now"` button.
        - `Synced / Success`: Green badge (`#DDF3E4` / `#1E6B45`, `"Synced Â· <members> notified"`).

    ## Database Architecture & Setup (Local & Remote)
    
    The project uses an **offline-first dual-database architecture** combining a local relational SQLite database (`AppDatabase`) with a remote NoSQL cloud database (Firebase Cloud Firestore). Full schema diagrams and documentation are stored in [`docs/`](file:///c:/Users/gusta/Documents/GitHub/Mobile-Software-Development-GetYourMoneyUpNotYourFunnyUp/docs):
    - **Full Schema & Sync Documentation**: [`docs/database_schema.md`](file:///c:/Users/gusta/Documents/GitHub/Mobile-Software-Development-GetYourMoneyUpNotYourFunnyUp/docs/database_schema.md)
    - **Local SQLite / Room Diagram**: [`docs/local_database_schema.drawio.xml`](file:///c:/Users/gusta/Documents/GitHub/Mobile-Software-Development-GetYourMoneyUpNotYourFunnyUp/docs/local_database_schema.drawio.xml)
    - **Remote Cloud Firestore Diagram**: [`docs/remote_database_schema.drawio.xml`](file:///c:/Users/gusta/Documents/GitHub/Mobile-Software-Development-GetYourMoneyUpNotYourFunnyUp/docs/remote_database_schema.drawio.xml)
    
    ### 1. Local Database Setup (Android SQLite / Room)
    - **Role**: Acts as the **Single Source of Truth (SSOT)** for the UI. All Compose screens observe reactive Kotlin `Flow` streams emitted directly from local DAOs.
    - **Database Manager & Contract**:
      - `AppDatabase` (`data/local/AppDatabase.kt`): `SQLiteOpenHelper` singleton configured with Write-Ahead Logging (`enableWriteAheadLogging()`), foreign key enforcement (`PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON`), and a reactive table invalidation tracker (`observeTables`).
      - `DatabaseContract` (`data/local/DatabaseContract.kt`): Defines the schema version, table names, column constants, `CREATE TABLE` DDL statements, and foreign key indexes.
    - **Tables & Entities** (`data/local/entity/`):
      1. `users` (`UserEntity`): Local cache of user profiles, contact details, notification settings, and `sync_status`.
      2. `groups` (`GroupEntity`): Group metadata (`id`, `name`, `description`, `currency`, `created_by`, timestamps, and `sync_status`).
      3. `group_members` (`GroupMemberEntity`): Composite-key join table (`group_id`, `user_id`) with cascading deletes linking users to groups with their `role` (`ADMIN`, `MEMBER`) and `joined_at`.
      4. `expenses` (`ExpenseEntity`): Expense records storing monetary amounts in integer minor units (`amount_cents: Long`) to prevent floating-point rounding errors, along with `payer_id`, `receipt_local_uri`, `receipt_remote_path`, soft-delete flag (`is_deleted`), and `sync_status`.
      5. `expense_splits` (`ExpenseSplitEntity`): Individual member share allocations (`expense_id`, `user_id`, `amount_owed_cents: Long`, `share_weight: Double`) with `ON DELETE CASCADE` from `expenses`.
      6. `settlements` (`SettlementEntity`): Debt repayment records (`group_id`, `debtor_id`, `creditor_id`, `amount_cents: Long`, `payment_method`, `status`, and `sync_status`).
      7. `sync_queue` (`SyncQueueEntity`): Outbox table tracking unsynced mutations (`entity_type`, `entity_id`, `action`, `payload_json`, `retry_count`, `last_attempt_at`, `error_message`) processed by Android `WorkManager`.
    - **DAOs** (`data/local/dao/`): `UserDao`, `GroupDao`, `ExpenseDao`, `SettlementDao`, and `SyncQueueDao` providing transactional CRUD operations and reactive `Flow` queries.
    - **Type Converters** (`data/local/Converters.kt`): Maps domain enums (`SyncStatus`, `GroupRole`, `SettlementStatus`, `SyncAction`, `SyncEntityType`) to and from SQLite `TEXT` columns.
    
    ### 2. Remote Database Setup (Firebase Cloud Firestore)
    - **Role**: Provides cloud backup, cross-device persistence, and real-time multi-user collaboration across group members.
    - **Collection & Subcollection Hierarchy**:
      - `/users/{userId}`: Root collection storing user profile documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID, including nested `notificationSettings`.
      - `/groups/{groupId}`: Root collection storing group metadata. Each group document contains both a flat `memberIds: List<String>` array (enabling `whereArrayContains("memberIds", uid)` queries and single-lookup Firestore Security Rules) and a `members: List<Map>` array with embedded member display names and roles.
      - `/groups/{groupId}/expenses/{expenseId}`: Subcollection under each group containing expense documents with embedded `splits: List<Map>` arrays (`userId`, `amountOwedCents`, `shareWeight`) so an expense and its splits are fetched atomically in a single document read.
      - `/groups/{groupId}/settlements/{settlementId}`: Subcollection under each group recording debt repayments between `debtorId` and `creditorId`.
    - **Synchronization Contract**:
      - **Writes**: Repositories write to Room first (`sync_status = PENDING_INSERT` / `PENDING_UPDATE` / `PENDING_DELETE`) and append an entry to `sync_queue`. A `WorkManager` worker (`NetworkType.CONNECTED`) pushes queued changes to Firestore and updates `sync_status` to `SYNCED` (or `FAILED` on unrecoverable errors).
      - **Reads / Real-Time Updates**: Snapshot listeners on `/groups` and active group subcollections normalize incoming Firestore documents into Room entities (`users`, `groups`, `group_members`, `expenses`, `expense_splits`, `settlements`) inside a database transaction with `sync_status = SYNCED`.
      - **Balance Calculation**: Balances are never stored as mutable fields in Room or Firestore (avoiding concurrent offline write conflicts). Instead, net balances are computed deterministically from the ledger of active `expenses`, `expense_splits`, and completed `settlements`.

    ## Definition of Done (DoD)
    
    A feature or pull request is considered **Done** only when:
    1. **Compiles & Passes CI**: Code builds cleanly without warnings (`.\gradlew.bat assembleDebug`).
    2. **Automated Tests**:
       - Unit tests written for debt calculation logic and ViewModel state transitions (`.\gradlew.bat test`).
       - At least one test specifically verifying the **Reliability QA** (e.g., offline retrieval or retry mechanism).
    3. **UI / Compose & HiFi Standards**:
       - Uses semantic tokens from `AppColors`, `AppTypography`, `AppShapes`, `AppSpacing`, and `AppTouchTargets` in `ui/theme/` (never hardcoded hex values in screens).
       - Follows HiFi interaction rules: Danish amount formatting (`formatDanishAmountFromCents`), inline payment confirmation (`Pay` -> `Cancel` / `Confirm` on the same card), minimum `44dp` touch targets, and non-green/non-red group colours.
       - Screen states are hoisted, previews provided, and edge-to-edge layout supported.
       - Sync/network states (`Waiting to sync`, `Retryingâ€¦`, `Synced`, and offline banner) are visually exposed to the user.
    4. **Peer Review**: AI-assisted code enters `main` only through a PR reviewed and verified by a human team member.
    5. **AI Dossier Updated**: Log significant AI interactions in the design document Appendix A (task, prompt, tool, verification, decision, and any AI failures observed).

    ## Code Guidelines & Conventions
    
    ### Architecture & Layering
    ```
    com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup/
    â”œâ”€â”€ data/
    â”‚   â”œâ”€â”€ local/          # SQLite/Room DB, DAOs, Entities, Preferences
    â”‚   â”œâ”€â”€ remote/         # Firebase services, DTOs, network models
    â”‚   â””â”€â”€ repository/     # Repository implementations with offline-first sync
    â”œâ”€â”€ model/              # Domain models (User, Group, Expense, Balance, Settlement, SyncStatus)
    â”œâ”€â”€ ui/
    â”‚   â”œâ”€â”€ components/     # Reusable Compose widgets (cards, sync indicators, balance chips, bottom nav)
    â”‚   â”œâ”€â”€ screens/        # Feature screens (auth, home, groups, scan, activity, profile)
    â”‚   â”œâ”€â”€ theme/          # Color.kt, Type.kt, Shape.kt, Theme.kt
    â”‚   â””â”€â”€ viewmodel/      # Architecture Components ViewModels & UI state definitions
    â””â”€â”€ worker/             # WorkManager sync and retry workers
    ```
    
    ### Jetpack Compose Best Practices
    - **State Hoisting**: Stateful screens collect UI state from ViewModels; stateless composables receive immutable state and lambda event callbacks (`onAction: (Action) -> Unit`).
    - **Modifiers**: Every public composable must expose `modifier: Modifier = Modifier` as its first optional parameter.
    - **Recomposition Safety**: Use immutable data classes for UI state (`@Immutable` / `data class`). Do not run calculations directly in composables without `remember` or `derivedStateOf`.
    - **Previews**: Provide light and dark theme `@Preview` annotations for all screen components.
    
    ### Kotlin Conventions
    - Strictly prefer `val` over `var`.
    - Represent UI state using sealed interfaces (`UiState.Loading`, `UiState.Success`, `UiState.Error`).
    - Use Kotlin Coroutines (`Flow`, `StateFlow`) for asynchronous and reactive data streaming.
    
    ### Dependency Management
    - Keep all dependencies declared in `gradle/libs.versions.toml`. Never hardcode library versions inside module build scripts.

    private sealed interface AppDestination {
        data object Login : AppDestination
        data object Register : AppDestination
        data class Counter(val initialUser: User) : AppDestination
    }
    
    class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() {
        override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
            super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
            enableEdgeToEdge()
            setContent {
                GetYourMoneyUpNotYourFunnyUpTheme {
                    Scaffold(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) { innerPadding ->
                        AppRoot(
                            modifier = Modifier.padding(innerPadding)
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    fun AppRoot(modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
        val context = LocalContext.current
        val authRepository = remember {
            val database = AppDatabase.getInstance(context)
            AuthRepository(
                userDao = database.userDao,
                syncQueueDao = database.syncQueueDao
            )
        }
    
        var destination by remember { mutableStateOf<AppDestination>(AppDestination.Login) }
        var displayName by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
        var email by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
        var password by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
        var isLoading by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
        var errorMessage by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
        var statusMessage by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    
        // If a session is already active on launch, fetch the user document from Firestore
        LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
            val existingUid = authRepository.currentAuthUid
            val existingEmail = authRepository.currentAuthEmail ?: ""
            if (existingUid != null) {
                isLoading = true
                authRepository.fetchOrCreateUserDocument(
                    uid = existingUid,
                    fallbackEmail = existingEmail,
                    fallbackName = existingEmail.substringBefore("@").ifEmpty { "User" }
                ) { result ->
                    isLoading = false
                    result.onSuccess { user ->
                        statusMessage = "Loaded user from /users/${user.id}"
                        destination = AppDestination.Counter(user)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    
        when (val current = destination) {
            is AppDestination.Login -> {
                LoginScreen(
                    modifier = modifier,
                    email = email,
                    password = password,
                    isLoading = isLoading,
                    errorMessage = errorMessage,
                    onEmailChange = {
                        email = it
                        errorMessage = null
                    },
                    onPasswordChange = {
                        password = it
                        errorMessage = null
                    },
                    onLoginClick = {
                        isLoading = true
                        errorMessage = null
                        authRepository.loginUser(
                            email = email,
                            password = password
                        ) { result ->
                            isLoading = false
                            result
                                .onSuccess { user ->
                                    statusMessage = "Fetched user from /users/${user.id}"
                                    destination = AppDestination.Counter(user)
                                }
                                .onFailure { err ->
                                    errorMessage = err.localizedMessage ?: "Login failed"
                                }
                        }
                    },
                    onNavigateToRegister = {
                        errorMessage = null
                        destination = AppDestination.Register
                    }
                )
            }
    
            is AppDestination.Register -> {
                RegistrationScreen(
                    modifier = modifier,
                    displayName = displayName,
                    email = email,
                    password = password,
                    isLoading = isLoading,
                    errorMessage = errorMessage,
                    onDisplayNameChange = {
                        displayName = it
                        errorMessage = null
                    },
                    onEmailChange = {
                        email = it
                        errorMessage = null
                    },
                    onPasswordChange = {
                        password = it
                        errorMessage = null
                    },
                    onRegisterClick = {
                        isLoading = true
                        errorMessage = null
                        authRepository.registerUser(
                            displayName = displayName,
                            email = email,
                            password = password
                        ) { result ->
                            isLoading = false
                            result
                                .onSuccess { user ->
                                    statusMessage = "Created user in /users/${user.id}"
                                    destination = AppDestination.Counter(user)
                                }
                                .onFailure { err ->
                                    errorMessage = err.localizedMessage ?: "Registration failed"
                                }
                        }
                    },
                    onNavigateToLogin = {
                        errorMessage = null
                        destination = AppDestination.Login
                    }
                )
            }
    
            is AppDestination.Counter -> {
                val observedUser by authRepository
                    .observeUser(current.initialUser.id)
                    .collectAsState(initial = current.initialUser)
                val activeUser = observedUser ?: current.initialUser
    
                // Attach real-time Firestore listener to `/users/{uid}`
                DisposableEffect(activeUser.id) {
                    val registration = authRepository.listenToUserDocument(
                        uid = activeUser.id,
                        fallbackEmail = activeUser.email,
                        fallbackName = activeUser.displayName,
                        onError = { errMsg ->
                            statusMessage = "Firestore error: $errMsg"
                        }
                    )
                    onDispose {
                        registration.remove()
                    }
                }
    
                CounterScreen(
                    modifier = modifier,
                    user = activeUser,
                    statusMessage = statusMessage,
                    onIncrementClick = {
                        statusMessage = "Saving count to /users/${activeUser.id}..."
                        authRepository.incrementUserCount(activeUser) { result ->
                            result
                                .onSuccess { savedCount ->
                                    statusMessage = "Saved count ($savedCount) to /users/${activeUser.id}"
                                }
                                .onFailure { err ->
                                    statusMessage = "Offline / Failed: ${err.localizedMessage}"
                                }
                        }
                    },
                    onLogoutClick = {
                        authRepository.signOut()
                        password = ""
                        errorMessage = null
                        statusMessage = ""
                        destination = AppDestination.Login
                    }
                )
            }
        }
    }

    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.local.entity.UserEntity

    import com.google.firebase.Firebase

    import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope

    /**
     * Offline-first repository handling Firebase Authentication and `/users/{userId}`
     * synchronization between Cloud Firestore and the local SQLite database.
     */
    class AuthRepository(
        private val userDao: UserDao,
        private val syncQueueDao: SyncQueueDao,
        private val auth: FirebaseAuth = Firebase.auth,
        private val firestore: FirebaseFirestore = Firebase.firestore,
        private val ioScope: CoroutineScope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO)
    ) {
    
        val currentAuthUid: String?
            get() = auth.currentUser?.uid
    
        val currentAuthEmail: String?
            get() = auth.currentUser?.email
    
        fun observeUser(userId: String): Flow<User?> =
            userDao.observeUserById(userId).map { it?.toDomain() }
    
        /**
         * Registers a new account in Firebase Auth and inserts the user document into
         * Firestore `/users/{uid}` and local SQLite `users`.
         */
        fun registerUser(
            displayName: String,
            email: String,
            password: String,
            onResult: (Result<User>) -> Unit
        ) {
            val trimmedName = displayName.trim().ifEmpty { email.trim().substringBefore("@") }
            val trimmedEmail = email.trim()
    
            auth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(trimmedEmail, password)
                .addOnSuccessListener { authResult ->
                    val firebaseUser = authResult.user
                    val uid = firebaseUser?.uid
                    if (uid == null) {
                        onResult(Result.failure(IllegalStateException("Missing user UID after registration.")))
                        return@addOnSuccessListener
                    }
    
                    // Update Firebase Auth display name in the background
                    val profileUpdates = UserProfileChangeRequest.Builder()
                        .setDisplayName(trimmedName)
                        .build()
                    firebaseUser.updateProfile(profileUpdates)
    
                    val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
                    val newUser = User(
                        id = uid,
                        email = trimmedEmail,
                        displayName = trimmedName,
                        photoUrl = null,
                        count = 0,
                        notificationSettings = NotificationSettings(),
                        syncStatus = SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT,
                        updatedAt = now
                    )
    
                    // 1. Save locally first (SSOT)
                    ioScope.launch {
                        userDao.upsertUser(UserEntity.fromDomain(newUser))
                    }
    
                    // 2. Insert into Firestore `/users/{uid}`
                    firestore.collection(USERS_COLLECTION)
                        .document(uid)
                        .set(newUser.toFirestoreMap())
                        .addOnSuccessListener {
                            val syncedUser = newUser.copy(syncStatus = SyncStatus.SYNCED)
                            ioScope.launch {
                                userDao.upsertUser(UserEntity.fromDomain(syncedUser))
                            }
                            onResult(Result.success(syncedUser))
                        }
                        .addOnFailureListener { error ->
                            // Offline resilience: queue for background sync and still let the user proceed
                            ioScope.launch {
                                userDao.updateSyncStatus(uid, SyncStatus.FAILED)
                                syncQueueDao.enqueue(
                                    SyncQueueEntity(
                                        entityType = SyncEntityType.USER,
                                        entityId = uid,
                                        action = SyncAction.CREATE,
                                        payloadJson = """{"id":"$uid","email":"$trimmedEmail","displayName":"$trimmedName","count":0}""",
                                        errorMessage = error.localizedMessage
                                    )
                                )
                            }
                            onResult(Result.success(newUser.copy(syncStatus = SyncStatus.FAILED)))
                        }
                }
                .addOnFailureListener { error ->
                    onResult(Result.failure(error))
                }
        }
    
        /**
         * Authenticates an existing user via Firebase Auth and fetches their `/users/{uid}`
         * document (including their saved `count`) from Cloud Firestore.
         */
        fun loginUser(
            email: String,
            password: String,
            onResult: (Result<User>) -> Unit
        ) {
            val trimmedEmail = email.trim()
    
            auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(trimmedEmail, password)
                .addOnSuccessListener { authResult ->
                    val firebaseUser = authResult.user
                    val uid = firebaseUser?.uid
                    if (uid == null) {
                        onResult(Result.failure(IllegalStateException("Missing user UID after login.")))
                        return@addOnSuccessListener
                    }
    
                    fetchOrCreateUserDocument(
                        uid = uid,
                        fallbackEmail = firebaseUser.email ?: trimmedEmail,
                        fallbackName = firebaseUser.displayName ?: trimmedEmail.substringBefore("@"),
                        onResult = onResult
                    )
                }
                .addOnFailureListener { error ->
                    onResult(Result.failure(error))
                }
        }
    
        /**
         * Fetches the user document from `/users/{uid}` in Firestore, or initializes it
         * if the user authenticated before a Firestore profile document was created.
         */
        fun fetchOrCreateUserDocument(
            uid: String,
            fallbackEmail: String,
            fallbackName: String,
            onResult: (Result<User>) -> Unit
        ) {
            firestore.collection(USERS_COLLECTION)
                .document(uid)
                .get()
                .addOnSuccessListener { snapshot ->
                    if (snapshot != null && snapshot.exists()) {
                        val user = snapshot.toUserDomain(
                            uid = uid,
                            fallbackEmail = fallbackEmail,
                            fallbackName = fallbackName
                        )
                        ioScope.launch {
                            userDao.upsertUser(UserEntity.fromDomain(user))
                        }
                        onResult(Result.success(user))
                    } else {
                        // User exists in Firebase Auth but not yet in `/users/{uid}` — insert it now
                        val newUser = User(
                            id = uid,
                            email = fallbackEmail,
                            displayName = fallbackName,
                            count = 0,
                            syncStatus = SyncStatus.SYNCED,
                            updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
                        )
                        firestore.collection(USERS_COLLECTION)
                            .document(uid)
                            .set(newUser.toFirestoreMap())
                            .addOnSuccessListener {
                                ioScope.launch {
                                    userDao.upsertUser(UserEntity.fromDomain(newUser))
                                }
                                onResult(Result.success(newUser))
                            }
                            .addOnFailureListener {
                                val pendingUser = newUser.copy(syncStatus = SyncStatus.FAILED)
                                ioScope.launch {
                                    userDao.upsertUser(UserEntity.fromDomain(pendingUser))
                                }
                                onResult(Result.success(pendingUser))
                            }
                    }
                }
                .addOnFailureListener { error ->
                    // Offline fallback: check local SQLite cache
                    ioScope.launch {
                        val cached = userDao.getUserById(uid)?.toDomain()
                        if (cached != null) {
                            onResult(Result.success(cached))
                        } else {
                            val offlineUser = User(
                                id = uid,
                                email = fallbackEmail,
                                displayName = fallbackName,
                                count = 0,
                                syncStatus = SyncStatus.FAILED,
                                updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
                            )
                            userDao.upsertUser(UserEntity.fromDomain(offlineUser))
                            onResult(Result.failure(error))
                        }
                    }
                }
        }
    
        /**
         * Listens for real-time updates to `/users/{uid}` in Firestore and syncs changes into SQLite.
         */
        fun listenToUserDocument(
            uid: String,
            fallbackEmail: String,
            fallbackName: String,
            onError: (String) -> Unit
        ): ListenerRegistration {
            return firestore.collection(USERS_COLLECTION)
                .document(uid)
                .addSnapshotListener { snapshot, error ->
                    if (error != null) {
                        onError(error.localizedMessage ?: "Firestore listener error")
                        return@addSnapshotListener
                    }
                    if (snapshot != null && snapshot.exists()) {
                        val remoteUser = snapshot.toUserDomain(
                            uid = uid,
                            fallbackEmail = fallbackEmail,
                            fallbackName = fallbackName
                        )
                        ioScope.launch {
                            userDao.upsertUser(UserEntity.fromDomain(remoteUser))
                        }
                    }
                }
        }
    
        /**
         * Increments the user's counter and saves it against `/users/{uid}` in both
         * local SQLite and Cloud Firestore.
         */
        fun incrementUserCount(
            user: User,
            onResult: (Result<Int>) -> Unit
        ) {
            val nextCount = if (user.count != 67) user.count + 1 else user.count
            val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
    
            // 1. Optimistic local SQLite update with PENDING_UPDATE
            ioScope.launch {
                val existing = userDao.getUserById(user.id)
                if (existing != null) {
                    userDao.updateUserCount(user.id, nextCount, SyncStatus.PENDING_UPDATE)
                } else {
                    userDao.upsertUser(
                        UserEntity.fromDomain(
                            user.copy(
                                count = nextCount,
                                syncStatus = SyncStatus.PENDING_UPDATE,
                                updatedAt = now
                            )
                        )
                    )
                }
            }
    
            // 2. Persist count against `/users/{uid}` in Firestore
            val updates = mapOf(
                "id" to user.id,
                "email" to user.email,
                "displayName" to user.displayName,
                "count" to nextCount,
                "updatedAt" to now
            )
    
            firestore.collection(USERS_COLLECTION)
                .document(user.id)
                .set(updates, SetOptions.merge())
                .addOnSuccessListener {
                    ioScope.launch {
                        userDao.updateUserCount(user.id, nextCount, SyncStatus.SYNCED)
                    }
                    onResult(Result.success(nextCount))
                }
                .addOnFailureListener { error ->
                    ioScope.launch {
                        userDao.updateUserCount(user.id, nextCount, SyncStatus.FAILED)
                        syncQueueDao.enqueue(
                            SyncQueueEntity(
                                entityType = SyncEntityType.USER,
                                entityId = user.id,
                                action = SyncAction.UPDATE,
                                payloadJson = """{"id":"${user.id}","count":$nextCount,"updatedAt":$now}""",
                                errorMessage = error.localizedMessage
                            )
                        )
                    }
                    onResult(Result.failure(error))
                }
        }
    
        fun signOut() {
            auth.signOut()
        }
    
        private fun User.toFirestoreMap(): Map<String, Any?> = mapOf(
            "id" to id,
            "email" to email,
            "displayName" to displayName,
            "photoUrl" to photoUrl,
            "count" to count,
            "notificationSettings" to mapOf(
                "expenseAlerts" to notificationSettings.expenseAlerts,
                "paymentReminders" to notificationSettings.paymentReminders
            ),
            "updatedAt" to updatedAt
        )
    
        private fun DocumentSnapshot.toUserDomain(
            uid: String,
            fallbackEmail: String,
            fallbackName: String
        ): User {
            val notifMap = get("notificationSettings") as? Map<*, *>
            val expenseAlerts = (notifMap?.get("expenseAlerts") as? Boolean) ?: true
            val paymentReminders = (notifMap?.get("paymentReminders") as? Boolean) ?: true
    
            return User(
                id = getString("id") ?: uid,
                email = getString("email") ?: fallbackEmail,
                displayName = getString("displayName") ?: fallbackName,
                photoUrl = getString("photoUrl"),
                count = getLong("count")?.toInt() ?: 0,
                notificationSettings = NotificationSettings(
                    expenseAlerts = expenseAlerts,
                    paymentReminders = paymentReminders
                ),
                syncStatus = SyncStatus.SYNCED,
                updatedAt = getLong("updatedAt") ?: System.currentTimeMillis()
            )
        }
    
        companion object {
            const val USERS_COLLECTION = "users"
        }
    }

    /**
     * Local SQLite Database Manager for "Get Your Money Up Not Your Funny Up".
     *
     * Implements the Single Source of Truth (SSOT) for offline resilience:
     * - Enforces foreign keys (`PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON`) and Write-Ahead Logging (WAL).
     * - Creates the 7 core tables (`users`, `groups`, `group_members`, `expenses`,
     *   `expense_splits`, `settlements`, `sync_queue`) and performance indexes.
     * - Exposes reactive table invalidation streams (`observeTables`) for Compose UI flows.
     */
    class AppDatabase private constructor(
        context: Context,
        databaseName: String? = DatabaseContract.DATABASE_NAME
    ) : SQLiteOpenHelper(
        context.applicationContext,
        databaseName,
        null,
        DatabaseContract.DATABASE_VERSION
    ) {
    
        private val tableInvalidationFlow = MutableSharedFlow<Set<String>>(extraBufferCapacity = 64)
    
        val userDao: UserDao by lazy { UserDao(this) }
        val groupDao: GroupDao by lazy { GroupDao(this) }
        val expenseDao: ExpenseDao by lazy { ExpenseDao(this) }
        val settlementDao: SettlementDao by lazy { SettlementDao(this) }
        val syncQueueDao: SyncQueueDao by lazy { SyncQueueDao(this) }
    
        override fun onConfigure(db: SQLiteDatabase) {
            super.onConfigure(db)
            db.setForeignKeyConstraintsEnabled(true)
            if (!db.isReadOnly && databaseName != null) {
                db.enableWriteAheadLogging()
            }
        }
    
        override fun onCreate(db: SQLiteDatabase) {
            db.beginTransaction()
            try {
                for (statement in DatabaseContract.ALL_CREATE_STATEMENTS) {
                    db.execSQL(statement.trimIndent())
                }
                db.setTransactionSuccessful()
            } finally {
                db.endTransaction()
            }
        }
    
        override fun onUpgrade(db: SQLiteDatabase, oldVersion: Int, newVersion: Int) {
            if (oldVersion < 2) {
                runCatching {
                    db.execSQL(
                        "ALTER TABLE ${DatabaseContract.UsersTable.TABLE_NAME} " +
                            "ADD COLUMN ${DatabaseContract.UsersTable.COL_COUNT} INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"
                    )
                }
            }
            onCreate(db)
        }
    
        /**
         * Emits an initial signal and re-emits whenever any of the specified [tableNames] change.
         */
        fun observeTables(vararg tableNames: String): Flow<Set<String>> {
            val watchedSet = tableNames.toSet()
            return tableInvalidationFlow
                .filter { changed -> changed.any { it in watchedSet } }
                .onStart { emit(watchedSet) }
        }
    
        /**
         * Notifies active observers that one or more tables have been modified.
         */
        fun notifyTableChanged(vararg tableNames: String) {
            tableInvalidationFlow.tryEmit(tableNames.toSet())
        }
    
        companion object {
            @Volatile
            private var instance: AppDatabase? = null
    
            fun getInstance(context: Context): AppDatabase =
                instance ?: synchronized(this) {
                    instance ?: AppDatabase(context).also { instance = it }
                }
    
            /**
             * Creates an isolated in-memory database instance for instrumentation/reliability tests.
             */
            fun createInMemory(context: Context): AppDatabase =
                AppDatabase(context, databaseName = null)
        }
    }
    # Database Schema Documentation
    
    This document details the dual-layer database architecture for **"Get Your Money Up Not Your Funny Up"**:
    - **Local Database (Android Room / SQLite)**: Primary offline-first source of truth for the UI, enforcing relational integrity and queueing unsynced operations.
      - Draw.io diagram: [`docs/local_database_schema.drawio.xml`](file:///e:/Documents/GitHub/Mobile-Software-Development-GetYourMoneyUpNotYourFunnyUp/docs/local_database_schema.drawio.xml)
    - **Remote Database (Cloud Firestore)**: Cloud persistence and real-time multi-user synchronization engine.
      - Draw.io diagram: [`docs/remote_database_schema.drawio.xml`](file:///e:/Documents/GitHub/Mobile-Software-Development-GetYourMoneyUpNotYourFunnyUp/docs/remote_database_schema.drawio.xml)
    
    ---
    
    ## 1. Local SQLite / Room Relational Schema
    
    The local database consists of 7 relational tables designed for offline resilience, transactional integrity, and WorkManager synchronization.
    
    ```mermaid
    erDiagram
        users {
            TEXT id PK "Firebase Auth UID or UUID"
            TEXT email "NOT NULL"
            TEXT display_name "NOT NULL"
            TEXT photo_url "NULLABLE"
            INTEGER notifications_enabled "DEFAULT 1"
            TEXT sync_status "SYNCED | PENDING_INSERT | PENDING_UPDATE | PENDING_DELETE | FAILED"
            INTEGER updated_at "Epoch ms"
        }
    
        groups {
            TEXT id PK "UUID"
            TEXT name "NOT NULL"
            TEXT description "NULLABLE"
            TEXT currency "DEFAULT 'EUR'"
            TEXT created_by FK "users.id"
            INTEGER created_at "Epoch ms"
            INTEGER updated_at "Epoch ms"
            TEXT sync_status "Sync state"
        }
    
        group_members {
            TEXT group_id PK,FK "groups.id (ON DELETE CASCADE)"
            TEXT user_id PK,FK "users.id (ON DELETE CASCADE)"
            TEXT role "ADMIN | MEMBER"
            INTEGER joined_at "Epoch ms"
        }
    
        expenses {
            TEXT id PK "UUID"
            TEXT group_id FK "groups.id (ON DELETE CASCADE)"
            TEXT title "NOT NULL"
            INTEGER amount_cents "Minor currency units (Long)"
            TEXT currency "DEFAULT 'EUR'"
            TEXT payer_id FK "users.id"
            TEXT category "DEFAULT 'General'"
            TEXT notes "NULLABLE"
            TEXT receipt_local_uri "NULLABLE"
            TEXT receipt_remote_path "NULLABLE"
            INTEGER created_at "Epoch ms"
            TEXT created_by "users.id"
            INTEGER is_deleted "Soft delete flag (0 or 1)"
            TEXT sync_status "Sync state"
        }
    
        expense_splits {
            TEXT id PK "UUID"
            TEXT expense_id FK "expenses.id (ON DELETE CASCADE)"
            TEXT user_id FK "users.id"
            INTEGER amount_owed_cents "Minor currency units (Long)"
            REAL share_weight "DEFAULT 1.0"
        }
    
        settlements {
            TEXT id PK "UUID"
            TEXT group_id FK "groups.id (ON DELETE CASCADE)"
            TEXT debtor_id FK "users.id"
            TEXT creditor_id FK "users.id"
            INTEGER amount_cents "Minor currency units (Long)"
            TEXT currency "DEFAULT 'EUR'"
            TEXT payment_method "MobilePay | Cash | Bank"
            TEXT status "PENDING | COMPLETED | FAILED"
            INTEGER created_at "Epoch ms"
            TEXT sync_status "Sync state"
        }
    
        sync_queue {
            INTEGER queue_id PK "AUTOINCREMENT"
            TEXT entity_type "USER | GROUP | EXPENSE | SETTLEMENT"
            TEXT entity_id "Target row ID"
            TEXT action "CREATE | UPDATE | DELETE"
            TEXT payload_json "Serialized snapshot"
            INTEGER retry_count "DEFAULT 0"
            INTEGER last_attempt_at "Epoch ms (NULLABLE)"
            TEXT error_message "Last failure reason (NULLABLE)"
        }
    
        users ||--o{ group_members : "joins"
        groups ||--o{ group_members : "has members"
        groups ||--o{ expenses : "contains"
        users ||--o{ expenses : "pays (payer_id)"
        expenses ||--o{ expense_splits : "splits into"
        users ||--o{ expense_splits : "owes (user_id)"
        groups ||--o{ settlements : "tracks"
        users ||--o{ settlements : "pays back (debtor_id)"
        users ||--o{ settlements : "receives (creditor_id)"
    ```

    ## 2. Remote Cloud Firestore Document Hierarchy
    
    Firestore uses a hierarchical document-subcollection model under `/groups/{groupId}` so security rules can validate group membership in a single lookup (`request.auth.uid in get(/databases/$(database)/documents/groups/$(groupId)).data.memberIds`).
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
        Root["Firestore Root (/databases/(default)/documents)"]
        UsersCol["Collection: /users/{userId}"]
        GroupsCol["Collection: /groups/{groupId}"]
        ExpensesSub["Subcollection: /groups/{groupId}/expenses/{expenseId}"]
        SettlementsSub["Subcollection: /groups/{groupId}/settlements/{settlementId}"]
    
        Root --> UsersCol
        Root --> GroupsCol
        GroupsCol --> ExpensesSub
        GroupsCol --> SettlementsSub
    
        UsersDoc["User Document
        - id: String
        - email: String
        - displayName: String
        - photoUrl: String?
        - notificationSettings: Map
        - createdAt / updatedAt: Long"]
    
        GroupsDoc["Group Document
        - id: String
        - name: String
        - description: String?
        - currency: String
        - createdBy: String
        - memberIds: List&lt;String&gt;
        - members: List&lt;MemberMap&gt;
        - createdAt / updatedAt: Long"]
    
        ExpensesDoc["Expense Document
        - id: String
        - groupId: String
        - title: String
        - amountCents: Long
        - currency: String
        - payerId: String
        - category: String
        - notes: String?
        - receiptStoragePath: String?
        - splits: List&lt;SplitMap&gt;
        - createdAt: Long
        - createdBy: String
        - isDeleted: Boolean"]
    
        SettlementsDoc["Settlement Document
        - id: String
        - groupId: String
        - debtorId: String
        - creditorId: String
        - amountCents: Long
        - currency: String
        - paymentMethod: String
        - status: String
        - createdAt: Long
        - recordedBy: String"]
    
        UsersCol --- UsersDoc
        GroupsCol --- GroupsDoc
        ExpensesSub --- ExpensesDoc
        SettlementsSub --- SettlementsDoc
    ```
    
    ---
    
    ## 3. Synchronization & Offline-First Data Flow
    
    ```mermaid
    sequenceDiagram
        participant UI as Compose UI / ViewModel
        participant Repo as OfflineFirstRepository
        participant Room as Local Room SQLite DB
        participant WM as WorkManager SyncWorker
        participant FS as Remote Cloud Firestore
    
        UI->>Repo: Create Expense / Settlement
        Repo->>Room: Insert entity (sync_status = PENDING_INSERT) & enqueue sync_queue
        Room-->>UI: Emit updated Flow immediately (non-blocking)
        Repo->>WM: Enqueue OneTimeWorkRequest (NetworkType.CONNECTED)
        WM->>Room: Read pending items from sync_queue
        WM->>FS: Write document to /groups/{groupId}/expenses/{id}
        alt Network Success
            FS-->>WM: ACK
            WM->>Room: Mark entity sync_status = SYNCED & remove from sync_queue
            Room-->>UI: Emit SYNCED status badge
        else Network Failure
            FS-->>WM: Exception / Timeout
            WM->>Room: Increment retry_count & set sync_status = FAILED (or retry backoff)
            Room-->>UI: Emit Pending/Failed indicator
        end
    ```

    class ExpenseDao(private val database: AppDatabase) {
    
        fun observeExpensesForGroup(groupId: String): Flow<List<ExpenseEntity>> =
            database.observeTables(ExpensesTable.TABLE_NAME, ExpenseSplitsTable.TABLE_NAME).map {
                withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { getActiveExpensesForGroup(groupId) }
            }
    
        fun observeSplitsForExpense(expenseId: String): Flow<List<ExpenseSplitEntity>> =
            database.observeTables(ExpenseSplitsTable.TABLE_NAME).map {
                withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { getSplitsForExpense(expenseId) }
            }
    
        fun upsertExpenseWithSplits(expense: ExpenseEntity, splits: List<ExpenseSplitEntity>) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            db.beginTransaction()
            try {
                db.insertWithOnConflict(
                    ExpensesTable.TABLE_NAME,
                    null,
                    expense.toContentValues(),
                    SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_REPLACE
                )
                db.delete(
                    ExpenseSplitsTable.TABLE_NAME,
                    "${ExpenseSplitsTable.COL_EXPENSE_ID} = ?",
                    arrayOf(expense.id)
                )
                for (split in splits) {
                    db.insertWithOnConflict(
                        ExpenseSplitsTable.TABLE_NAME,
                        null,
                        split.toContentValues(),
                        SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_REPLACE
                    )
                }
                db.setTransactionSuccessful()
            } finally {
                db.endTransaction()
            }
            database.notifyTableChanged(ExpensesTable.TABLE_NAME, ExpenseSplitsTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        fun getExpenseById(expenseId: String): ExpenseEntity? {
            val db = database.readableDatabase
            db.query(
                ExpensesTable.TABLE_NAME,
                null,
                "${ExpensesTable.COL_ID} = ?",
                arrayOf(expenseId),
                null,
                null,
                null
            ).use { cursor ->
                return if (cursor.moveToFirst()) cursor.toExpenseEntity() else null
            }
        }
    
        fun getActiveExpensesForGroup(groupId: String): List<ExpenseEntity> {
            val db = database.readableDatabase
            val expenses = mutableListOf<ExpenseEntity>()
            db.query(
                ExpensesTable.TABLE_NAME,
                null,
                "${ExpensesTable.COL_GROUP_ID} = ? AND ${ExpensesTable.COL_IS_DELETED} = 0",
                arrayOf(groupId),
                null,
                null,
                "${ExpensesTable.COL_CREATED_AT} DESC"
            ).use { cursor ->
                while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                    expenses.add(cursor.toExpenseEntity())
                }
            }
            return expenses
        }
    
        fun getSplitsForExpense(expenseId: String): List<ExpenseSplitEntity> {
            val db = database.readableDatabase
            val splits = mutableListOf<ExpenseSplitEntity>()
            db.query(
                ExpenseSplitsTable.TABLE_NAME,
                null,
                "${ExpenseSplitsTable.COL_EXPENSE_ID} = ?",
                arrayOf(expenseId),
                null,
                null,
                null
            ).use { cursor ->
                while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                    splits.add(cursor.toExpenseSplitEntity())
                }
            }
            return splits
        }
    
        fun getSplitsForGroup(groupId: String): List<ExpenseSplitEntity> {
            val db = database.readableDatabase
            val splits = mutableListOf<ExpenseSplitEntity>()
            val sql = """
                SELECT s.* FROM ${ExpenseSplitsTable.TABLE_NAME} s
                INNER JOIN ${ExpensesTable.TABLE_NAME} e
                    ON s.${ExpenseSplitsTable.COL_EXPENSE_ID} = e.${ExpensesTable.COL_ID}
                WHERE e.${ExpensesTable.COL_GROUP_ID} = ? AND e.${ExpensesTable.COL_IS_DELETED} = 0
            """.trimIndent()
            db.rawQuery(sql, arrayOf(groupId)).use { cursor ->
                while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                    splits.add(cursor.toExpenseSplitEntity())
                }
            }
            return splits
        }
    
        fun markExpenseDeleted(expenseId: String, syncStatus: SyncStatus = SyncStatus.PENDING_DELETE) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            val values = ContentValues().apply {
                put(ExpensesTable.COL_IS_DELETED, 1)
                put(ExpensesTable.COL_SYNC_STATUS, Converters.fromSyncStatus(syncStatus))
            }
            db.update(
                ExpensesTable.TABLE_NAME,
                values,
                "${ExpensesTable.COL_ID} = ?",
                arrayOf(expenseId)
            )
            database.notifyTableChanged(ExpensesTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        fun updateSyncStatus(expenseId: String, status: SyncStatus) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            val values = ContentValues().apply {
                put(ExpensesTable.COL_SYNC_STATUS, Converters.fromSyncStatus(status))
            }
            db.update(
                ExpensesTable.TABLE_NAME,
                values,
                "${ExpensesTable.COL_ID} = ?",
                arrayOf(expenseId)
            )
            database.notifyTableChanged(ExpensesTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        private fun ExpenseEntity.toContentValues(): ContentValues = ContentValues().apply {
            put(ExpensesTable.COL_ID, id)
            put(ExpensesTable.COL_GROUP_ID, groupId)
            put(ExpensesTable.COL_TITLE, title)
            put(ExpensesTable.COL_AMOUNT_CENTS, amountCents)
            put(ExpensesTable.COL_CURRENCY, currency)
            put(ExpensesTable.COL_PAYER_ID, payerId)
            put(ExpensesTable.COL_CATEGORY, category)
            put(ExpensesTable.COL_NOTES, notes)
            put(ExpensesTable.COL_RECEIPT_LOCAL_URI, receiptLocalUri)
            put(ExpensesTable.COL_RECEIPT_REMOTE_PATH, receiptRemotePath)
            put(ExpensesTable.COL_CREATED_AT, createdAt)
            put(ExpensesTable.COL_CREATED_BY, createdBy)
            put(ExpensesTable.COL_IS_DELETED, if (isDeleted) 1 else 0)
            put(ExpensesTable.COL_SYNC_STATUS, Converters.fromSyncStatus(syncStatus))
        }
    
        private fun ExpenseSplitEntity.toContentValues(): ContentValues = ContentValues().apply {
            put(ExpenseSplitsTable.COL_ID, id)
            put(ExpenseSplitsTable.COL_EXPENSE_ID, expenseId)
            put(ExpenseSplitsTable.COL_USER_ID, userId)
            put(ExpenseSplitsTable.COL_AMOUNT_OWED_CENTS, amountOwedCents)
            put(ExpenseSplitsTable.COL_SHARE_WEIGHT, shareWeight)
        }
    
        private fun Cursor.toExpenseEntity(): ExpenseEntity {
            val notesIdx = getColumnIndexOrThrow(ExpensesTable.COL_NOTES)
            val localUriIdx = getColumnIndexOrThrow(ExpensesTable.COL_RECEIPT_LOCAL_URI)
            val remotePathIdx = getColumnIndexOrThrow(ExpensesTable.COL_RECEIPT_REMOTE_PATH)
            return ExpenseEntity(
                id = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(ExpensesTable.COL_ID)),
                groupId = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(ExpensesTable.COL_GROUP_ID)),
                title = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(ExpensesTable.COL_TITLE)),
                amountCents = getLong(getColumnIndexOrThrow(ExpensesTable.COL_AMOUNT_CENTS)),
                currency = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(ExpensesTable.COL_CURRENCY)),
                payerId = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(ExpensesTable.COL_PAYER_ID)),
                category = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(ExpensesTable.COL_CATEGORY)),
                notes = if (isNull(notesIdx)) null else getString(notesIdx),
                receiptLocalUri = if (isNull(localUriIdx)) null else getString(localUriIdx),
                receiptRemotePath = if (isNull(remotePathIdx)) null else getString(remotePathIdx),
                createdAt = getLong(getColumnIndexOrThrow(ExpensesTable.COL_CREATED_AT)),
                createdBy = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(ExpensesTable.COL_CREATED_BY)),
                isDeleted = getInt(getColumnIndexOrThrow(ExpensesTable.COL_IS_DELETED)) != 0,
                syncStatus = Converters.toSyncStatus(getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(ExpensesTable.COL_SYNC_STATUS)))
            )
        }
    
        private fun Cursor.toExpenseSplitEntity(): ExpenseSplitEntity = ExpenseSplitEntity(
            id = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(ExpenseSplitsTable.COL_ID)),
            expenseId = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(ExpenseSplitsTable.COL_EXPENSE_ID)),
            userId = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(ExpenseSplitsTable.COL_USER_ID)),
            amountOwedCents = getLong(getColumnIndexOrThrow(ExpenseSplitsTable.COL_AMOUNT_OWED_CENTS)),
            shareWeight = getDouble(getColumnIndexOrThrow(ExpenseSplitsTable.COL_SHARE_WEIGHT))
        )
    }

    class GroupDao(private val database: AppDatabase) {
    
        fun observeGroupsForUser(userId: String): Flow<List<GroupEntity>> =
            database.observeTables(GroupsTable.TABLE_NAME, GroupMembersTable.TABLE_NAME).map {
                withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { getGroupsForUser(userId) }
            }
    
        fun observeAllGroups(): Flow<List<GroupEntity>> =
            database.observeTables(GroupsTable.TABLE_NAME, GroupMembersTable.TABLE_NAME).map {
                withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { getAllGroups() }
            }
    
        fun observeMembersForGroup(groupId: String): Flow<List<GroupMemberEntity>> =
            database.observeTables(GroupMembersTable.TABLE_NAME).map {
                withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { getMembersForGroup(groupId) }
            }
    
        fun upsertGroupWithMembers(group: GroupEntity, members: List<GroupMemberEntity>) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            db.beginTransaction()
            try {
                db.insertWithOnConflict(
                    GroupsTable.TABLE_NAME,
                    null,
                    group.toContentValues(),
                    SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_REPLACE
                )
                for (member in members) {
                    db.insertWithOnConflict(
                        GroupMembersTable.TABLE_NAME,
                        null,
                        member.toContentValues(),
                        SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_REPLACE
                    )
                }
                db.setTransactionSuccessful()
            } finally {
                db.endTransaction()
            }
            database.notifyTableChanged(GroupsTable.TABLE_NAME, GroupMembersTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        fun upsertGroup(group: GroupEntity) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            db.insertWithOnConflict(
                GroupsTable.TABLE_NAME,
                null,
                group.toContentValues(),
                SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_REPLACE
            )
            database.notifyTableChanged(GroupsTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        fun addMember(member: GroupMemberEntity) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            db.insertWithOnConflict(
                GroupMembersTable.TABLE_NAME,
                null,
                member.toContentValues(),
                SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_REPLACE
            )
            database.notifyTableChanged(GroupMembersTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        fun removeMember(groupId: String, userId: String) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            db.delete(
                GroupMembersTable.TABLE_NAME,
                "${GroupMembersTable.COL_GROUP_ID} = ? AND ${GroupMembersTable.COL_USER_ID} = ?",
                arrayOf(groupId, userId)
            )
            database.notifyTableChanged(GroupMembersTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        fun deleteGroup(groupId: String) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            db.delete(
                GroupsTable.TABLE_NAME,
                "${GroupsTable.COL_ID} = ?",
                arrayOf(groupId)
            )
            database.notifyTableChanged(GroupsTable.TABLE_NAME, GroupMembersTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        fun getGroupById(groupId: String): GroupEntity? {
            val db = database.readableDatabase
            db.query(
                GroupsTable.TABLE_NAME,
                null,
                "${GroupsTable.COL_ID} = ?",
                arrayOf(groupId),
                null,
                null,
                null
            ).use { cursor ->
                return if (cursor.moveToFirst()) cursor.toGroupEntity() else null
            }
        }
    
        fun getAllGroups(): List<GroupEntity> {
            val db = database.readableDatabase
            val groups = mutableListOf<GroupEntity>()
            db.query(
                GroupsTable.TABLE_NAME,
                null,
                null,
                null,
                null,
                null,
                "${GroupsTable.COL_UPDATED_AT} DESC"
            ).use { cursor ->
                while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                    groups.add(cursor.toGroupEntity())
                }
            }
            return groups
        }
    
        fun getGroupsForUser(userId: String): List<GroupEntity> {
            val db = database.readableDatabase
            val groups = mutableListOf<GroupEntity>()
            val sql = """
                SELECT g.* FROM ${GroupsTable.TABLE_NAME} g
                INNER JOIN ${GroupMembersTable.TABLE_NAME} gm
                    ON g.${GroupsTable.COL_ID} = gm.${GroupMembersTable.COL_GROUP_ID}
                WHERE gm.${GroupMembersTable.COL_USER_ID} = ?
                ORDER BY g.${GroupsTable.COL_UPDATED_AT} DESC
            """.trimIndent()
            db.rawQuery(sql, arrayOf(userId)).use { cursor ->
                while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                    groups.add(cursor.toGroupEntity())
                }
            }
            return groups
        }
    
        fun getMembersForGroup(groupId: String): List<GroupMemberEntity> {
            val db = database.readableDatabase
            val members = mutableListOf<GroupMemberEntity>()
            db.query(
                GroupMembersTable.TABLE_NAME,
                null,
                "${GroupMembersTable.COL_GROUP_ID} = ?",
                arrayOf(groupId),
                null,
                null,
                "${GroupMembersTable.COL_JOINED_AT} ASC"
            ).use { cursor ->
                while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                    members.add(cursor.toGroupMemberEntity())
                }
            }
            return members
        }
    
        fun updateSyncStatus(groupId: String, status: SyncStatus) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            val values = ContentValues().apply {
                put(GroupsTable.COL_SYNC_STATUS, Converters.fromSyncStatus(status))
                put(GroupsTable.COL_UPDATED_AT, System.currentTimeMillis())
            }
            db.update(
                GroupsTable.TABLE_NAME,
                values,
                "${GroupsTable.COL_ID} = ?",
                arrayOf(groupId)
            )
            database.notifyTableChanged(GroupsTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        private fun GroupEntity.toContentValues(): ContentValues = ContentValues().apply {
            put(GroupsTable.COL_ID, id)
            put(GroupsTable.COL_NAME, name)
            put(GroupsTable.COL_DESCRIPTION, description)
            put(GroupsTable.COL_CURRENCY, currency)
            put(GroupsTable.COL_CREATED_BY, createdBy)
            put(GroupsTable.COL_CREATED_AT, createdAt)
            put(GroupsTable.COL_UPDATED_AT, updatedAt)
            put(GroupsTable.COL_SYNC_STATUS, Converters.fromSyncStatus(syncStatus))
        }
    
        private fun GroupMemberEntity.toContentValues(): ContentValues = ContentValues().apply {
            put(GroupMembersTable.COL_GROUP_ID, groupId)
            put(GroupMembersTable.COL_USER_ID, userId)
            put(GroupMembersTable.COL_ROLE, Converters.fromGroupRole(role))
            put(GroupMembersTable.COL_JOINED_AT, joinedAt)
        }
    
        private fun Cursor.toGroupEntity(): GroupEntity {
            val descIdx = getColumnIndexOrThrow(GroupsTable.COL_DESCRIPTION)
            return GroupEntity(
                id = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(GroupsTable.COL_ID)),
                name = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(GroupsTable.COL_NAME)),
                description = if (isNull(descIdx)) null else getString(descIdx),
                currency = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(GroupsTable.COL_CURRENCY)),
                createdBy = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(GroupsTable.COL_CREATED_BY)),
                createdAt = getLong(getColumnIndexOrThrow(GroupsTable.COL_CREATED_AT)),
                updatedAt = getLong(getColumnIndexOrThrow(GroupsTable.COL_UPDATED_AT)),
                syncStatus = Converters.toSyncStatus(getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(GroupsTable.COL_SYNC_STATUS)))
            )
        }
    
        private fun Cursor.toGroupMemberEntity(): GroupMemberEntity = GroupMemberEntity(
            groupId = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(GroupMembersTable.COL_GROUP_ID)),
            userId = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(GroupMembersTable.COL_USER_ID)),
            role = Converters.toGroupRole(getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(GroupMembersTable.COL_ROLE))),
            joinedAt = getLong(getColumnIndexOrThrow(GroupMembersTable.COL_JOINED_AT))
        )
    }

    class SettlementDao(private val database: AppDatabase) {

            database.observeTables(SettlementsTable.TABLE_NAME).map {
                withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { getSettlementsForGroup(groupId) }
            }
    
        fun upsertSettlement(settlement: SettlementEntity) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            db.insertWithOnConflict(
                SettlementsTable.TABLE_NAME,
                null,
                settlement.toContentValues(),
                SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_REPLACE
            )
            database.notifyTableChanged(SettlementsTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        fun getSettlementsForGroup(groupId: String): List<SettlementEntity> {
            val db = database.readableDatabase

                SettlementsTable.TABLE_NAME,
                null,
                "${SettlementsTable.COL_GROUP_ID} = ?",
                arrayOf(groupId),
                null,
                null,
                "${SettlementsTable.COL_CREATED_AT} DESC"
            ).use { cursor ->
                while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                    settlements.add(cursor.toSettlementEntity())
                }
            }
            return settlements
        }
    
        fun updateSettlementStatus(
            settlementId: String,
            status: SettlementStatus,
            syncStatus: SyncStatus
        ) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            val values = ContentValues().apply {
                put(SettlementsTable.COL_STATUS, Converters.fromSettlementStatus(status))
                put(SettlementsTable.COL_SYNC_STATUS, Converters.fromSyncStatus(syncStatus))
            }
            db.update(
                SettlementsTable.TABLE_NAME,
                values,
                "${SettlementsTable.COL_ID} = ?",
                arrayOf(settlementId)
            )
            database.notifyTableChanged(SettlementsTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        private fun SettlementEntity.toContentValues(): ContentValues = ContentValues().apply {
            put(SettlementsTable.COL_ID, id)
            put(SettlementsTable.COL_GROUP_ID, groupId)
            put(SettlementsTable.COL_DEBTOR_ID, debtorId)
            put(SettlementsTable.COL_CREDITOR_ID, creditorId)

            put(SettlementsTable.COL_CURRENCY, currency)

            put(SettlementsTable.COL_CREATED_AT, createdAt)
            put(SettlementsTable.COL_SYNC_STATUS, Converters.fromSyncStatus(syncStatus))
        }
    
        private fun Cursor.toSettlementEntity(): SettlementEntity = SettlementEntity(
            id = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SettlementsTable.COL_ID)),
            groupId = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SettlementsTable.COL_GROUP_ID)),
            debtorId = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SettlementsTable.COL_DEBTOR_ID)),
            creditorId = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SettlementsTable.COL_CREDITOR_ID)),

            currency = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SettlementsTable.COL_CURRENCY)),

            status = Converters.toSettlementStatus(getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SettlementsTable.COL_STATUS))),
            createdAt = getLong(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SettlementsTable.COL_CREATED_AT)),
            syncStatus = Converters.toSyncStatus(getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SettlementsTable.COL_SYNC_STATUS)))
        )
    }
