    import android.content.ContentValues
    import android.database.Cursor
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.local.AppDatabase
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.local.Converters
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.local.DatabaseContract.SyncQueueTable
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.local.entity.SyncQueueEntity
    import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
    import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
    
    class SyncQueueDao(private val database: AppDatabase) {
    
        fun observePendingQueue(): Flow<List<SyncQueueEntity>> =
            database.observeTables(SyncQueueTable.TABLE_NAME).map {
                withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { getAllPending() }
            }
    
        fun enqueue(item: SyncQueueEntity): Long {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            val values = ContentValues().apply {
                put(SyncQueueTable.COL_ENTITY_TYPE, Converters.fromSyncEntityType(item.entityType))
                put(SyncQueueTable.COL_ENTITY_ID, item.entityId)
                put(SyncQueueTable.COL_ACTION, Converters.fromSyncAction(item.action))
                put(SyncQueueTable.COL_PAYLOAD_JSON, item.payloadJson)
                put(SyncQueueTable.COL_RETRY_COUNT, item.retryCount)
                put(SyncQueueTable.COL_LAST_ATTEMPT_AT, item.lastAttemptAt)
                put(SyncQueueTable.COL_ERROR_MESSAGE, item.errorMessage)
            }
            val id = db.insert(SyncQueueTable.TABLE_NAME, null, values)
            database.notifyTableChanged(SyncQueueTable.TABLE_NAME)
            return id
        }
    
        fun getAllPending(): List<SyncQueueEntity> {
            val db = database.readableDatabase
            val list = mutableListOf<SyncQueueEntity>()
            db.query(
                SyncQueueTable.TABLE_NAME,
                null,
                null,
                null,
                null,
                null,
                "${SyncQueueTable.COL_QUEUE_ID} ASC"
            ).use { cursor ->
                while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                    list.add(cursor.toSyncQueueEntity())
                }
            }
            return list
        }
    
        fun recordRetryFailure(queueId: Long, errorMessage: String?) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            db.execSQL(
                """
                UPDATE ${SyncQueueTable.TABLE_NAME}
                SET ${SyncQueueTable.COL_RETRY_COUNT} = ${SyncQueueTable.COL_RETRY_COUNT} + 1,
                    ${SyncQueueTable.COL_LAST_ATTEMPT_AT} = ?,
                    ${SyncQueueTable.COL_ERROR_MESSAGE} = ?
                WHERE ${SyncQueueTable.COL_QUEUE_ID} = ?
                """.trimIndent(),
                arrayOf<Any?>(System.currentTimeMillis(), errorMessage, queueId)
            )
            database.notifyTableChanged(SyncQueueTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        fun removeById(queueId: Long) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            db.delete(
                SyncQueueTable.TABLE_NAME,
                "${SyncQueueTable.COL_QUEUE_ID} = ?",
                arrayOf(queueId.toString())
            )
            database.notifyTableChanged(SyncQueueTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        private fun Cursor.toSyncQueueEntity(): SyncQueueEntity {
            val lastAttemptIdx = getColumnIndexOrThrow(SyncQueueTable.COL_LAST_ATTEMPT_AT)
            val errorIdx = getColumnIndexOrThrow(SyncQueueTable.COL_ERROR_MESSAGE)
            return SyncQueueEntity(
                queueId = getLong(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SyncQueueTable.COL_QUEUE_ID)),
                entityType = Converters.toSyncEntityType(getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SyncQueueTable.COL_ENTITY_TYPE))),
                entityId = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SyncQueueTable.COL_ENTITY_ID)),
                action = Converters.toSyncAction(getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SyncQueueTable.COL_ACTION))),
                payloadJson = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SyncQueueTable.COL_PAYLOAD_JSON)),
                retryCount = getInt(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SyncQueueTable.COL_RETRY_COUNT)),
                lastAttemptAt = if (isNull(lastAttemptIdx)) null else getLong(lastAttemptIdx),
                errorMessage = if (isNull(errorIdx)) null else getString(errorIdx)
            )
        }

    import android.content.ContentValues
    import android.database.Cursor
    import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.local.AppDatabase
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.local.Converters
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.local.DatabaseContract.UsersTable
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.local.entity.UserEntity
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.model.SyncStatus
    import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
    import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
    
    class UserDao(private val database: AppDatabase) {
    
        fun observeUserById(userId: String): Flow<UserEntity?> =
            database.observeTables(UsersTable.TABLE_NAME).map {
                withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { getUserById(userId) }
            }
    
        fun observeAllUsers(): Flow<List<UserEntity>> =
            database.observeTables(UsersTable.TABLE_NAME).map {
                withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { getAllUsers() }
            }
    
        fun upsertUser(user: UserEntity) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            db.insertWithOnConflict(
                UsersTable.TABLE_NAME,
                null,
                user.toContentValues(),
                SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_REPLACE
            )
            database.notifyTableChanged(UsersTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        fun getUserById(userId: String): UserEntity? {
            val db = database.readableDatabase
            db.query(
                UsersTable.TABLE_NAME,
                null,
                "${UsersTable.COL_ID} = ?",
                arrayOf(userId),
                null,
                null,
                null
            ).use { cursor ->
                return if (cursor.moveToFirst()) cursor.toUserEntity() else null
            }
        }
    
        fun getUserByEmail(email: String): UserEntity? {
            val db = database.readableDatabase
            db.query(
                UsersTable.TABLE_NAME,
                null,
                "${UsersTable.COL_EMAIL} = ?",
                arrayOf(email),
                null,
                null,
                null
            ).use { cursor ->
                return if (cursor.moveToFirst()) cursor.toUserEntity() else null
            }
        }
    
        fun getAllUsers(): List<UserEntity> {
            val db = database.readableDatabase
            val users = mutableListOf<UserEntity>()
            db.query(
                UsersTable.TABLE_NAME,
                null,
                null,
                null,
                null,
                null,
                "${UsersTable.COL_DISPLAY_NAME} ASC"
            ).use { cursor ->
                while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                    users.add(cursor.toUserEntity())
                }
            }
            return users
        }
    
        fun updateUserCount(userId: String, count: Int, status: SyncStatus) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            val values = ContentValues().apply {
                put(UsersTable.COL_COUNT, count)
                put(UsersTable.COL_SYNC_STATUS, Converters.fromSyncStatus(status))
                put(UsersTable.COL_UPDATED_AT, System.currentTimeMillis())
            }
            db.update(
                UsersTable.TABLE_NAME,
                values,
                "${UsersTable.COL_ID} = ?",
                arrayOf(userId)
            )
            database.notifyTableChanged(UsersTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        fun updateSyncStatus(userId: String, status: SyncStatus) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            val values = ContentValues().apply {
                put(UsersTable.COL_SYNC_STATUS, Converters.fromSyncStatus(status))
                put(UsersTable.COL_UPDATED_AT, System.currentTimeMillis())
            }
            db.update(
                UsersTable.TABLE_NAME,
                values,
                "${UsersTable.COL_ID} = ?",
                arrayOf(userId)
            )
            database.notifyTableChanged(UsersTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        private fun UserEntity.toContentValues(): ContentValues = ContentValues().apply {
            put(UsersTable.COL_ID, id)
            put(UsersTable.COL_EMAIL, email)
            put(UsersTable.COL_DISPLAY_NAME, displayName)
            put(UsersTable.COL_PHOTO_URL, photoUrl)
            put(UsersTable.COL_COUNT, count)
            put(UsersTable.COL_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED, if (notificationsEnabled) 1 else 0)
            put(UsersTable.COL_SYNC_STATUS, Converters.fromSyncStatus(syncStatus))
            put(UsersTable.COL_UPDATED_AT, updatedAt)
        }
    
        private fun Cursor.toUserEntity(): UserEntity {
            val photoIdx = getColumnIndexOrThrow(UsersTable.COL_PHOTO_URL)
            val countIdx = getColumnIndex(UsersTable.COL_COUNT)
            return UserEntity(
                id = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(UsersTable.COL_ID)),
                email = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(UsersTable.COL_EMAIL)),
                displayName = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(UsersTable.COL_DISPLAY_NAME)),
                photoUrl = if (isNull(photoIdx)) null else getString(photoIdx),
                count = if (countIdx >= 0 && !isNull(countIdx)) getInt(countIdx) else 0,
                notificationsEnabled = getInt(getColumnIndexOrThrow(UsersTable.COL_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED)) != 0,
                syncStatus = Converters.toSyncStatus(getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(UsersTable.COL_SYNC_STATUS))),
                updatedAt = getLong(getColumnIndexOrThrow(UsersTable.COL_UPDATED_AT))
            )
        }
    }

    class LocalDatabaseSchemaTest {
    
        @Test
        fun databaseContract_containsAllRequiredTablesAndIndexes() {
            val statements = DatabaseContract.ALL_CREATE_STATEMENTS.joinToString("\n")
            assertTrue(statements.contains("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users"))
            assertTrue(statements.contains("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS groups"))
            assertTrue(statements.contains("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS group_members"))
            assertTrue(statements.contains("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS expenses"))
            assertTrue(statements.contains("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS expense_splits"))
            assertTrue(statements.contains("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settlements"))
            assertTrue(statements.contains("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_queue"))
            assertTrue(statements.contains("ON DELETE CASCADE"))
        }
    
        @Test
        fun converters_roundTripAllEnums() {
            for (status in SyncStatus.entries) {
                assertEquals(status, Converters.toSyncStatus(Converters.fromSyncStatus(status)))
            }
            for (role in GroupRole.entries) {
                assertEquals(role, Converters.toGroupRole(Converters.fromGroupRole(role)))
            }
            for (status in SettlementStatus.entries) {
                assertEquals(status, Converters.toSettlementStatus(Converters.fromSettlementStatus(status)))
            }
            for (type in SyncEntityType.entries) {
                assertEquals(type, Converters.toSyncEntityType(Converters.fromSyncEntityType(type)))
            }
            for (action in SyncAction.entries) {
                assertEquals(action, Converters.toSyncAction(Converters.fromSyncAction(action)))
            }
        }
    
        @Test
        fun entities_roundTripToDomainPreservesOfflineSyncStatus() {
            val userEntity = UserEntity(
                id = "usr_1",
                email = "alex@example.com",
                displayName = "Alex",
                count = 7,
                syncStatus = SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT
            )
            val userDomain = userEntity.toDomain()
            assertEquals(7, userDomain.count)
            assertEquals(SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT, userDomain.syncStatus)
            assertEquals(userEntity, UserEntity.fromDomain(userDomain))
    
            val memberEntity = GroupMemberEntity(
                groupId = "grp_1",
                userId = "usr_1",
                role = GroupRole.ADMIN
            )
            val groupEntity = GroupEntity(
                id = "grp_1",
                name = "Weekend Trip",
                description = "Copenhagen",
                createdBy = "usr_1",
                syncStatus = SyncStatus.PENDING_UPDATE
            )
            val groupDomain = groupEntity.toDomain(listOf(memberEntity.toDomain("Alex")))
            assertEquals("Weekend Trip", groupDomain.name)
            assertEquals(1, groupDomain.members.size)
            assertEquals(SyncStatus.PENDING_UPDATE, groupDomain.syncStatus)
    
            val splitEntity = ExpenseSplitEntity(
                id = "spl_1",
                expenseId = "exp_1",
                userId = "usr_1",
                amountOwedCents = 2500L,
                shareWeight = 1.0
            )
            val expenseEntity = ExpenseEntity(
                id = "exp_1",
                groupId = "grp_1",
                title = "Dinner",
                amountCents = 5000L,
                payerId = "usr_1",
                createdBy = "usr_1",
                syncStatus = SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT
            )
            val expenseDomain = expenseEntity.toDomain(listOf(splitEntity.toDomain()))
            assertEquals(5000L, expenseDomain.amountCents)
            assertEquals(2500L, expenseDomain.splits.first().amountOwedCents)
            assertEquals(SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT, expenseDomain.syncStatus)
    
            val settlementEntity = SettlementEntity(
                id = "stl_1",
                groupId = "grp_1",
                debtorId = "usr_2",
                creditorId = "usr_1",
                amountCents = 2500L,
                paymentMethod = "MobilePay",
                status = SettlementStatus.PENDING,
                syncStatus = SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT
            )
            val settlementDomain = settlementEntity.toDomain()
            assertEquals(SettlementStatus.PENDING, settlementDomain.status)
            assertEquals(SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT, settlementDomain.syncStatus)
    
            val queueItem = SyncQueueEntity(
                entityType = SyncEntityType.EXPENSE,
                entityId = "exp_1",
                action = SyncAction.CREATE,
                payloadJson = """{"id":"exp_1"}"""
            )
            assertEquals(0, queueItem.retryCount)
        }
    }

        @Test
        fun insertAndQueryOfflineFlow_persistsEntitiesAndCascadesDeletes() {
            val u1 = UserEntity(id = "u1", email = "u1@test.com", displayName = "Alice")
            val u2 = UserEntity(id = "u2", email = "u2@test.com", displayName = "Bob")
            database.userDao.upsertUser(u1)
            database.userDao.upsertUser(u2)
    
            val group = GroupEntity(
                id = "g1",
                name = "Ski Trip",
                description = "Alps 2026",
                createdBy = "u1",
                syncStatus = SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT
            )
            val members = listOf(
                GroupMemberEntity(groupId = "g1", userId = "u1", role = GroupRole.ADMIN),
                GroupMemberEntity(groupId = "g1", userId = "u2", role = GroupRole.MEMBER)
            )
            database.groupDao.upsertGroupWithMembers(group, members)
    
            val expense = ExpenseEntity(
                id = "e1",
                groupId = "g1",
                title = "Cabin Rental",
                amountCents = 20000L,
                payerId = "u1",
                createdBy = "u1",
                syncStatus = SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT
            )
            val splits = listOf(
                ExpenseSplitEntity(id = "s1", expenseId = "e1", userId = "u1", amountOwedCents = 10000L),
                ExpenseSplitEntity(id = "s2", expenseId = "e1", userId = "u2", amountOwedCents = 10000L)
            )
            database.expenseDao.upsertExpenseWithSplits(expense, splits)
    
            val settlement = SettlementEntity(
                id = "st1",
                groupId = "g1",
                debtorId = "u2",
                creditorId = "u1",
                amountCents = 10000L,
                paymentMethod = "MobilePay",
                status = SettlementStatus.COMPLETED,
                syncStatus = SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT
            )
            database.settlementDao.upsertSettlement(settlement)
    
            val queueId = database.syncQueueDao.enqueue(
                SyncQueueEntity(
                    entityType = SyncEntityType.EXPENSE,
                    entityId = "e1",
                    action = SyncAction.CREATE,
                    payloadJson = """{"id":"e1"}"""
                )
            )
            assertTrue(queueId > 0)
    
            assertNotNull(database.groupDao.getGroupById("g1"))
            assertEquals(2, database.groupDao.getMembersForGroup("g1").size)
            assertEquals(1, database.expenseDao.getActiveExpensesForGroup("g1").size)
            assertEquals(2, database.expenseDao.getSplitsForExpense("e1").size)
            assertEquals(1, database.settlementDao.getSettlementsForGroup("g1").size)
            assertEquals(1, database.syncQueueDao.getAllPending().size)
    
            // Verify ON DELETE CASCADE when deleting the group
            database.groupDao.deleteGroup("g1")
            assertTrue(database.groupDao.getMembersForGroup("g1").isEmpty())
            assertTrue(database.expenseDao.getActiveExpensesForGroup("g1").isEmpty())
            assertTrue(database.expenseDao.getSplitsForExpense("e1").isEmpty())
            assertTrue(database.settlementDao.getSettlementsForGroup("g1").isEmpty())
        }

    /**
     * Application color palette aligned with the HiFi Style Guide (`docs/HiFi.html`).
     *
     * Core visual rules:
     * - **Green = good**: Money in, paid, synced, done. The colour you're rewarded with.
     * - **Red = pay this**: Only for money you owe. It goes away once you pay.
     * - **Everything else**: White, ink and soft grey. Amber only for warnings and waiting-to-sync.
     * - **Pastels are fills**: Text and buttons use the deep shade of the same hue (all pass 4.5:1).
     */
    object AppColors {
        // Green – positive & primary
        val Green700 = Color(0xFF1E6B45) // Primary buttons, links, active tab, money in
        val Green800 = Color(0xFF14502F) // Hover / pressed primary state
        val Green600 = Color(0xFF2A5A3F) // Subtitle text on green fills
        val Green500 = Color(0xFF3FA36B) // Progress, unread dots, focus ring
        val Green300 = Color(0xFF8FD6AA) // "You" avatar, accents on dark
        val GreenBar = Color(0xFF9FDCB5) // "Is owed" bars in balance chart
        val Green200 = Color(0xFFC6E8D2) // Paid card border, dashed add-item border
        val Green100 = Color(0xFFDDF3E4) // Positive fills, soft buttons, chips
        val Green50  = Color(0xFFEEF9F1) // Paid / settled card background
    
        // Red – only for money you owe
        val Red700 = Color(0xFFA93A2F) // Pay buttons, amounts you owe
        val Red800 = Color(0xFF8E3128) // Text on red fills
        val Red300 = Color(0xFFF4B9B2) // "Owes" bars in balance chart
        val Red200 = Color(0xFFF6D3CE) // Payments-due dropdown border
        val Red100 = Color(0xFFFCE4E1) // "You owe" card, owe chips
        val Red50  = Color(0xFFFDF1EF) // Payments-due dropdown, error strips
    
        // Ink & surfaces

    /**
     * Application Material 3 theme configured with the HiFi color palette ([AppColors]),
     * Plus Jakarta Sans / JetBrains Mono typography ([Typography]), and rounded geometry ([Shapes]).
     *
     * Note: [dynamicColor] defaults to `false` so semantic color rules
     * (Green = positive/paid/synced, Red = only for money owed, Group colours = never green/red)
     * are preserved across all Android versions.
     */
    @Composable
    fun GetYourMoneyUpNotYourFunnyUpTheme(
        darkTheme: Boolean = isSystemInDarkTheme(),
        dynamicColor: Boolean = false,
        content: @Composable () -> Unit
    ) {
        val colorScheme = when {
            dynamicColor && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S -> {
                val context = LocalContext.current
                if (darkTheme) dynamicDarkColorScheme(context) else dynamicLightColorScheme(context)
            }
            darkTheme -> DarkColorScheme
            else -> LightColorScheme
        }
    
        MaterialTheme(
            colorScheme = colorScheme,
            typography = Typography,
            shapes = Shapes,
            content = content
        )
    }
    
    /**
     * Formats an integer amount in minor units (øre / cents) using the HiFi Danish currency format:
     * e.g., `124050L` -> `"1.240,50"` or `"1.240,50 kr"` when [includeSuffix] is `true`.
     * Always renders 2 decimal places with `.` for thousands and `,` for decimals.
     */
    fun formatDanishAmountFromCents(
        amountCents: Long,
        includeSuffix: Boolean = true,
        includePlusSign: Boolean = false
    ): String {
        val absCents = abs(amountCents)
        val whole = absCents / 100
        val decimals = absCents % 100
        val wholeFormatted = String.format(Locale.US, "%,d", whole).replace(',', '.')
        val sign = when {
            amountCents < 0 -> "−"
            amountCents > 0 && includePlusSign -> "+"
            else -> ""
        }
        val formatted = String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%s%s,%02d", sign, wholeFormatted, decimals)
        return if (includeSuffix) "$formatted kr" else formatted
    }

                  <sc-if value="{{d.isConfirm}}" hint-placeholder-val="{{ false }}">
                    <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px">
                      <button sc-camel-on-click="{{cancel}}" style="height: 44px; border: 1px solid #E6EBE8; border-radius: 14px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #17201B; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer">Cancel</button>
                      <button sc-camel-on-click="{{d.confirm}}" style="height: 44px; border: none; border-radius: 14px; background: #A93A2F; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer">Confirm</button>
                    </div>
                  </sc-if>
                  <sc-if value="{{d.isPending}}" hint-placeholder-val="{{ false }}">
                    <div style="height: 44px; border-radius: 14px; background: #F4F7F5; color: #56635B; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px">
                      <svg width="16" height="16" sc-camel-view-box="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 0 1-15.5 6.2L3 16"></path><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 0 1 15.5-6.2L21 8"></path><path d="M21 3v5h-5M3 21v-5h5"></path></svg>
                      Paying…
                    </div>
                  </sc-if>
                  <sc-if value="{{d.isPaid}}" hint-placeholder-val="{{ false }}">
                    <div style="height: 44px; border-radius: 14px; background: #DDF3E4; color: #1E6B45; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px">
                      <svg width="18" height="18" sc-camel-view-box="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg>
                      Paid · settled with {{d.to}}
                    </div>
                  </sc-if>
                </article>
              </sc-if>
            </sc-for>
    
            <sc-if value="{{clear}}" hint-placeholder-val="{{ false }}">
              <div style="background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 18px; padding: 28px 16px 26px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; text-align: center; position: relative; overflow: hidden">
                <button sc-camel-on-click="{{closeDrop}}" aria-label="Close" style="position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 6px; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: none; border-radius: 22px; background: transparent; color: #56635B; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer">
                  <svg width="18" height="18" sc-camel-view-box="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"></path></svg>
                </button>
                <span style="position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 5px; background: #EEF9F1" aria-hidden="true">
                  <span class="drain" style="display: block; height: 100%; background: #3FA36B; border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0"></span>
                </span>
                <div style="width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 28px; background: #DDF3E4; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #1E6B45">
                  <svg width="28" height="28" sc-camel-view-box="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg>
                </div>
                <span style="font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800">No payments due</span>
                <span style="font-size: 14px; color: #56635B; line-height: 1.45">You're all square with every group. We'll let you know when something new comes in.</span>
              </div>
            </sc-if>
          </section>
        </sc-if>
    
        <section style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px">
          <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between">
            <h2 style="margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em">Your groups</h2>
            <a href="CreateGroup.dc.html" style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; padding: 10px 0">New group</a>
          </div>
          <div role="tablist" aria-label="Filter groups" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 4px; padding: 4px; background: #F1F4F2; border-radius: 16px">
            <sc-for list="{{tabs}}" as="t" hint-placeholder-count="3">
              <button role="tab" sc-camel-on-click="{{t.pick}}" style="{{t.style}}">{{t.label}}</button>
            </sc-for>
          </div>
    
          <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px">
            <sc-for list="{{groups}}" as="g" hint-placeholder-count="6">
              <a href="{{g.href}}" style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #EEF1EF; border-radius: 20px; background: #FFFFFF; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; color: #17201B; text-decoration: none; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%">
                <span style="{{g.avatarStyle}}">{{g.initial}}</span>
                <span style="flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px">
                  <span style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px">
                    <span style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis">{{g.name}}</span>
                    <sc-if value="{{g.fav}}" hint-placeholder-val="{{ false }}">
                      <svg width="14" height="14" sc-camel-view-box="0 0 24 24" fill="#E8B84A" stroke="#E8B84A" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round" role="img" aria-label="Favourite" style="flex: 0 0 auto"><path d="m12 3 2.7 5.6 6.1.9-4.4 4.3 1 6.1L12 17l-5.4 2.9 1-6.1L3.2 9.5l6.1-.9z"></path></svg>
                    </sc-if>
                  </span>
                  <sc-if value="{{g.syncing}}" hint-placeholder-val="{{ false }}">
                    <span style="font-size: 13px; color: #8A5A12; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px">
                      <svg width="13" height="13" sc-camel-view-box="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 0 1-15.5 6.2L3 16"></path><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 0 1 15.5-6.2L21 8"></path><path d="M21 3v5h-5M3 21v-5h5"></path></svg>
                      1 expense waiting to sync
                    </span>
                  </sc-if>
                  <sc-if value="{{g.notSyncing}}" hint-placeholder-val="{{ true }}">
                    <span style="font-size: 13px; color: #56635B">{{g.members}} members · {{g.used}}</span>
                  </sc-if>
                </span>
                <span style="{{g.chipStyle}}">{{g.chip}}</span>
              </a>
            </sc-for>
            <sc-if value="{{groupsEmpty}}" hint-placeholder-val="{{ false }}">
              <div style="padding: 20px; border-radius: 20px; background: #F4F7F5; font-size: 14px; color: #56635B; text-align: center">No favourites yet. Star a group to pin it here.</div>
            </sc-if>
            <sc-if value="{{showSeeAll}}" hint-placeholder-val="{{ true }}">
              <a href="GroupsList.dc.html" style="height: 48px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid #E6EBE8; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none">
                See all {{groupCount}} groups
                <svg width="16" height="16" sc-camel-view-box="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"></path></svg>
              </a>
            </sc-if>
          </div>
        </section>
      </main>
    
      <nav aria-label="Main" style="flex: 0 0 auto; height: 80px; border-top: 1px solid #EEF1EF; background: #FFFFFF; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); align-items: end; padding: 0 8px 12px; box-sizing: border-box; position: relative">
        <a href="#" aria-current="page" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; text-decoration: none; color: #1E6B45; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding-top: 8px">
          <svg width="24" height="24" sc-camel-view-box="0 0 24 24" fill="#DDF3E4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 10.5 12 3l9 7.5V20a1 1 0 0 1-1 1h-5v-6H9v6H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1z"></path></svg>
          Home
        </a>
        <a href="GroupsList.dc.html" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; text-decoration: none; color: #56635B; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding-top: 8px">
          <svg width="24" height="24" sc-camel-view-box="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M16 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"></path><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"></circle><path d="M22 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"></path><path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"></path></svg>
          Groups
        </a>
        <a href="Scan.dc.html" aria-label="Scan receipt" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; text-decoration: none; color: #1E6B45; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700">
          <span style="width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 32px; background: #1E6B45; color: #FFFFFF; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-top: -30px; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(30,107,69,0.32); border: 4px solid #FFFFFF">
            <svg width="28" height="28" sc-camel-view-box="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 7V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h2"></path><path d="M17 3h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"></path><path d="M21 17v2a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-2"></path><path d="M7 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-2"></path><path d="M7 9h10M7 12.5h10M7 16h6"></path></svg>
          </span>
          Scan
        </a>
        <a href="Activity.dc.html" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; text-decoration: none; color: #56635B; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding-top: 8px">
          <svg width="24" height="24" sc-camel-view-box="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"></circle><path d="M12 7.5V12l3 2"></path></svg>
          Activity
        </a>
        <a href="Profile.dc.html" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; text-decoration: none; color: #56635B; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding-top: 8px">
          <svg width="24" height="24" sc-camel-view-box="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"></circle><path d="M4 21a8 8 0 0 1 16 0"></path></svg>
          Profile
        </a>
      </nav>
    </div>
    </x-dc>
    <script type="text/x-dc" data-dc-script="" data-props="{&quot;scenario&quot;:{&quot;editor&quot;:&quot;enum&quot;,&quot;options&quot;:[&quot;owe&quot;,&quot;payopen&quot;,&quot;slice&quot;,&quot;clear&quot;],&quot;default&quot;:&quot;owe&quot;},&quot;offline&quot;:{&quot;editor&quot;:&quot;boolean&quot;,&quot;default&quot;:false},&quot;$preview&quot;:{&quot;width&quot;:412,&quot;height&quot;:915}}">
    class Component extends DCLogic {
      fmt(n) {
        const parts = n.toFixed(2).split('.');
        return parts[0].replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, '.') + ',' + parts[1];
      }
      componentDidMount() { this.checkTimer(); }
      componentDidUpdate() { this.checkTimer(); }
      componentWillUnmount() { if (this._t) clearTimeout(this._t); }
      checkTimer() {
        if (this._clearOpen && !this._t) {
          this._t = setTimeout(() => { this._t = null; this.setState({ open: false }); }, 5000);
        } else if (!this._clearOpen && this._t) {
          clearTimeout(this._t);
          this._t = null;
        }
      }
      hrefFor(id) { return id === 'kol' ? 'GroupOwed.dc.html' : 'Group.dc.html'; }
      fmtShort(n) {
        return String(Math.round(n)).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, '.');
      }
      data() {
        const groups = [
          { id: 'kol', name: 'Kollegiet 4. sal', color: '#A9C8F5', members: 7, used: 'Today', fav: true, syncing: true, bal: 145 },
          { id: 'fri', name: 'Friday Bar crew', color: '#F7C59F', members: 9, used: 'Today', fav: true, bal: -94.5 },
          { id: 'pad', name: 'Padel Tuesdays', color: '#E2CDB0', members: 4, used: 'Yesterday', fav: false, bal: -32 },
          { id: 'ski', name: 'Ski trip Åre', color: '#C9B6F0', members: 6, used: 'Sun 1 Nov', fav: true, bal: -286 },
          { id: 'mob', name: 'Mobile Software team', color: '#F3DE8A', members: 6, used: 'Sun 1 Nov', fav: false, bal: 60 },
          { id: 'fam', name: 'Family dinners', color: '#9ED9D2', members: 4, used: 'Sun 1 Nov', fav: false, bal: 0 },
          { id: 'cph', name: 'Copenhagen weekend', color: '#B9DCEB', members: 5, used: '12 Oct', fav: false, bal: 0 },
          { id: 'book', name: 'Book club', color: '#E4CBE9', members: 6, used: '2 Oct', fav: false, bal: 0 },
          { id: 'house', name: "Sofie's housewarming", color: '#F2D7B6', members: 12, used: '20 Sep', fav: false, bal: 0 }
        ];
        const debts = [
          { id: 'ski', to: 'Mads', since: 'Since Sun 1 Nov', amount: 286 },
          { id: 'fri', to: 'Sofie', since: 'Since today', amount: 94.5 },
          { id: 'pad', to: 'Jonas', since: 'Since yesterday', amount: 32 }
        ];
        const spend = {
          today: { kol: 64, fri: 120 },
          week: { kol: 312, fri: 380, pad: 160 },
          month: { ski: 1200, kol: 620, fri: 380, fam: 340, mob: 210, pad: 160 },
          year: { kol: 11840, ski: 6900, fam: 4310, fri: 3120, pad: 1440, mob: 980 }
        };
        const last = {
          kol: '64,00 kr to Ida · Today',
          fri: '120,00 kr to Sofie · Today',
          pad: '160,00 kr to Jonas · Mon 2 Nov',
          ski: '1.200,00 kr to Mads · Sun 1 Nov',
          mob: '210,00 kr to Gustav · Sun 1 Nov',
          fam: '340,00 kr to Mum · Sun 1 Nov'
        };
        return { groups, debts, spend, last };
      }
      get(key, fallback) {
        const st = this.state || {};
        return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(st, key) ? st[key] : fallback;
      }
      renderVals() {
        const scenario = this.props.scenario ?? 'owe';
        const { groups, debts, spend, last } = this.data();
        const byId = {};
        groups.forEach((g) => { byId[g.id] = g; });
    
        const initialPay = {};
        if (scenario === 'clear') debts.forEach((d) => { initialPay[d.id] = 'paid'; });
        const pay = this.get('pay', initialPay);
        const open = this.get('open', scenario === 'payopen');
        const period = this.get('period', 'month');
        const sel = this.get('sel', scenario === 'slice' ? 'ski' : null);
        const menuOpen = this.get('menuOpen', false);
        const tab = this.get('tab', 'recent');
        const confirming = this.get('confirming', null);
    
        const unpaid = debts.filter((d) => pay[d.id] !== 'paid');
        const total = unpaid.reduce((a, d) => a + d.amount, 0);
        const owing = unpaid.length > 0;
        const allIdle = debts.every((d) => !pay[d.id]) && confirming !== 'all';
    
        const setPay = (ids, status) => {
          const next = Object.assign({}, this.get('pay', initialPay));
          ids.forEach((id) => { next[id] = status; });
          this.setState({ pay: next, confirming: null });
        };
        const runPay = (ids) => {
          setPay(ids, 'pending');
          setTimeout(() => setPay(ids, 'paid'), 1300);
        };
    
        const debtVals = debts.map((d) => {
          const g = byId[d.id];
          const status = pay[d.id];
          const isPaid = status === 'paid';
          const isPending = status === 'pending';
          const isConfirm = confirming === d.id;
          return {
            show: owing,
            name: g.name,
            to: d.to,
            sub: isPaid ? 'Settled just now' : 'To ' + d.to + ' · ' + d.since,
            amount: this.fmt(d.amount),
            initial: g.name.charAt(0),
            isIdle: !status && !isConfirm,
            isConfirm,
            isPending,
            isPaid,
            ask: () => this.setState({ confirming: d.id }),
            confirm: () => runPay([d.id]),
            cardStyle: 'background: ' + (isPaid ? '#EEF9F1' : '#FFFFFF') + '; border-radius: 18px; padding: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; border: 1px solid ' + (isPaid ? '#C6E8D2' : 'transparent'),
            avatarStyle: 'width: 44px; height: 44px; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 14px; background: ' + g.color + '; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; color: #17201B',
            amountStyle: 'font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; white-space: nowrap; color: ' + (isPaid ? '#1E6B45' : '#A93A2F')
          };
        });
    
        const periodMeta = {
          today: { short: 'Today', word: 'today' },
          week: { short: 'Week', word: 'this week' },
          month: { short: 'Month', word: 'this month' },
          year: { short: 'Year', word: 'this year' }
        };
        const periods = ['today', 'week', 'month', 'year'].map((p) => ({
          label: p === 'today' ? 'Today' : 'This ' + p,
          pick: () => this.setState({ period: p, menuOpen: false, sel: null }),
          style: 'height: 40px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; text-align: left; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: ' + (p === period ? '700' : '500') + '; background: ' + (p === period ? '#DDF3E4' : 'transparent') + '; color: ' + (p === period ? '#1E6B45' : '#17201B')
        }));
    
        const entries = Object.keys(spend[period]).map((id) => ({ id, v: spend[period][id] }));
        const sum = entries.reduce((a, e) => a + e.v, 0);
        const cx = 70, cy = 70, R = 62, Rsel = 69, r = 40, pad = 0.035;
        const pt = (a, rad) => [cx + rad * Math.sin(a), cy - rad * Math.cos(a)];
        let acc = 0;
        let bubble = null;
        const slices = entries.map((e) => {
          const a0 = (acc / sum) * Math.PI * 2 + pad;
          acc += e.v;
          const a1 = (acc / sum) * Math.PI * 2 - pad;
          const isSel = sel === e.id;
          const RR = isSel ? Rsel : R;
          const large = a1 - a0 > Math.PI ? 1 : 0;
          const o0 = pt(a0, RR), o1 = pt(a1, RR), i1 = pt(a1, r), i0 = pt(a0, r);
          const f = (n) => n.toFixed(2);
          const d = 'M' + f(o0[0]) + ' ' + f(o0[1]) + ' A' + RR + ' ' + RR + ' 0 ' + large + ' 1 ' + f(o1[0]) + ' ' + f(o1[1]) +
            ' L' + f(i1[0]) + ' ' + f(i1[1]) + ' A' + r + ' ' + r + ' 0 ' + large + ' 0 ' + f(i0[0]) + ' ' + f(i0[1]) + ' Z';
          const g = byId[e.id];
          if (isSel) {
            const mid = pt((a0 + a1) / 2, RR);
            const tailX = Math.max(18, Math.min(204 - 32, mid[0] + 64 - 7));
            bubble = {
              href: this.hrefFor(e.id),
              name: g.name,
              amount: this.fmt(e.v),
              last: last[e.id],
              dotStyle: 'width: 12px; height: 12px; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 6px; background: ' + g.color,
              tailStyle: 'position: absolute; top: -6px; left: ' + tailX + 'px; width: 14px; height: 14px; background: #FFFFFF; transform: rotate(45deg); border-radius: 3px'
            };
          }
          return {
            d,
            color: g.color,
            op: sel && !isSel ? 0.45 : 1,
            pick: () => this.setState({ sel: isSel ? null : e.id, menuOpen: false })
          };
        });
    
        const chipFor = (g) => {
          let bal = g.bal;
          if (bal < 0 && pay[g.id] === 'paid') bal = 0;
          const base = 'flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 12px; white-space: nowrap; ';
          if (bal < 0) return { chip: 'You owe ' + this.fmt(-bal), chipStyle: base + 'background: #FCE4E1; color: #A93A2F' };
          if (bal > 0) return { chip: '+' + this.fmt(bal) + ' to you', chipStyle: base + 'background: #DDF3E4; color: #1E6B45' };
          return { chip: 'Settled', chipStyle: base + 'background: #F1F4F2; color: #56635B' };
        };
        let list = groups;
        if (tab === 'fav') list = groups.filter((g) => g.fav);
        if (tab === 'all') list = groups.slice().sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
        const shown = list.slice(0, 6).map((g) => Object.assign({
          href: this.hrefFor(g.id),
          name: g.name,
          initial: g.name.charAt(0),
          fav: g.fav,
          syncing: !!g.syncing,
          notSyncing: !g.syncing,
          members: g.members,
          used: g.used === 'Today' || g.used === 'Yesterday' ? 'Active ' + g.used.toLowerCase() : 'Active ' + g.used,
          avatarStyle: 'width: 44px; height: 44px; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 14px; background: ' + g.color + '; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; color: #17201B'
        }, chipFor(g)));
    
        const tabs = [['recent', 'Recent'], ['fav', 'Favourites'], ['all', 'All']].map(([id, label]) => ({
          label,
          pick: () => this.setState({ tab: id }),
          style: 'height: 40px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: ' + (tab === id ? '700' : '600') + '; background: ' + (tab === id ? '#FFFFFF' : 'transparent') + '; color: ' + (tab === id ? '#17201B' : '#56635B') + '; box-shadow: ' + (tab === id ? '0 1px 3px rgba(23,32,27,0.10)' : 'none')
        }));
    
        const owedToYou = groups.reduce((a, g) => a + (g.bal > 0 ? g.bal : 0), 0);
        const oweWhole = this.fmt(total);
        this._clearOpen = !owing && open;
    
        return {
          closeDrop: () => this.setState({ open: false }),
          offline: !!this.props.offline,
          owing,
          clear: !owing,
          dropStyle: 'background: ' + (owing ? '#FDF1EF' : '#EEF9F1') + '; border: 1px solid ' + (owing ? '#F6D3CE' : '#C6E8D2') + '; border-radius: 24px; padding: 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; margin-top: -8px',
          open,
          oweWhole,
          oweTotal: oweWhole,
          oweSub: unpaid.length === 1 ? '1 group' : unpaid.length + ' groups',
          owedToYou: '+' + this.fmt(owedToYou) + ' kr owed to you',
          payBtnLabel: open ? 'Hide' : 'Pay now',
          chevStyle: open ? 'transform: rotate(180deg)' : '',
          toggleOpen: () => this.setState({ open: !open, confirming: null }),
          allIdle: allIdle && owing,
          confirmingAll: confirming === 'all',
          askAll: () => this.setState({ confirming: 'all' }),
          confirmAll: () => runPay(unpaid.map((d) => d.id)),
          cancel: () => this.setState({ confirming: null }),
          debts: debtVals,
          periodShort: periodMeta[period].short,
          periodWord: periodMeta[period].word,
          periods,
          menuOpen,
          toggleMenu: () => this.setState({ menuOpen: !menuOpen }),
          slices,
          totalShort: this.fmtShort(sum),
          hasSel: !!bubble,
          bubble: bubble || { name: '', amount: '', last: '', dotStyle: '', tailStyle: '' },
          clearSel: () => this.setState({ sel: null }),
          tabs,
          groups: shown,
          groupsEmpty: shown.length === 0,
          showSeeAll: list.length > 6,
          groupCount: list.length
        };
      }
    }
    </script>
    
    
    </body></html>

    class Component extends DCLogic {
      get(key, fallback) {
        const st = this.state || {};
        return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(st, key) ? st[key] : fallback;
      }
      renderVals() {

          me: ['V', '#8FD6AA'], mads: ['M', '#C9B6F0'], ida: ['I', '#F7C59F'], jonas: ['J', '#A9C8F5'],

        };
        const groups = { ski: ['Ski trip Åre', '#C9B6F0'], fri: ['Friday Bar crew', '#F7C59F'], pad: ['Padel Tuesdays', '#E2CDB0'], kol: ['Kollegiet 4. sal', '#A9C8F5'], mob: ['Mobile Software team', '#F3DE8A'] };
        const icons = {

        const feed = [
          { id: 'r1', sec: 'Today', type: 'remind', who: 'mads', actor: 'Mads', text: 'reminded you to pay for the ski trip', g: 'ski', time: '10:12', amount: 286, dir: 'out', unread: true, action: 'pay' },
          { id: 'a1', sec: 'Today', type: 'added', who: 'sofie', actor: 'Sofie', text: 'added “Bar tab” · your share', g: 'fri', time: '09:40', amount: 94.5, dir: 'out', unread: true },
          { id: 'f1', sec: 'Today', type: 'failed', who: 'app', actor: 'Fuel for the drive', text: 'couldn’t sync yet – retrying automatically', g: 'ski', time: '08:05', amount: null, unread: true, action: 'retry' },
          { id: 'a2', sec: 'Yesterday', type: 'added', who: 'jonas', actor: 'Jonas', text: 'added “Court, 2 hours” · your share', g: 'pad', time: '19:30', amount: 32, dir: 'out' },
          { id: 'a3', sec: 'Yesterday', type: 'added', who: 'ida', actor: 'Ida', text: 'added “Toilet paper & soap” · your share', g: 'kol', time: '14:02', amount: 27, dir: 'out' },
          { id: 'c1', sec: 'Earlier', type: 'changed', who: 'mads', actor: 'Mads', text: 'changed “Lift passes ×6” from 3.600 to 4.320 kr', g: 'ski', time: 'Sun 1 Nov', amount: null },
          { id: 'p1', sec: 'Earlier', type: 'paid', who: 'me', actor: 'You', text: 'paid Mads', g: 'ski', time: 'Sun 1 Nov', amount: 1200, dir: 'settle' },
          { id: 'p2', sec: 'Earlier', type: 'paid', who: 'sofie', actor: 'Sofie', text: 'paid you', g: 'kol', time: 'Sun 1 Nov', amount: 64, dir: 'in' },
          { id: 'a4', sec: 'Earlier', type: 'added', who: 'gustav', actor: 'Gustav', text: 'added “Poster printing” · your share', g: 'mob', time: 'Sun 1 Nov', amount: 35, dir: 'out' }
        ];
        const fmt = (n) => { const p = Math.abs(n).toFixed(2).split('.'); return p[0].replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, '.') + ',' + p[1]; };
        const filter = this.get('filter', 'all');
        const read = this.get('read', {});
        const st = this.get('st', {});
        const setSt = (id, v) => this.setState({ st: Object.assign({}, this.get('st', {}), { [id]: v }), read: Object.assign({}, this.get('read', {}), { [id]: true }) });
    
        const needs = (f) => (f.action === 'pay' && st[f.id] !== 'done') || (f.action === 'retry' && st[f.id] !== 'done');
        const tests = {
          all: () => true,
          action: needs,
          expenses: (f) => f.type === 'added' || f.type === 'changed' || f.type === 'failed',
          payments: (f) => f.type === 'paid' || f.type === 'remind'
        };
        const actionCount = feed.filter(needs).length;
        const filters = [['all', 'All'], ['action', 'Needs you · ' + actionCount], ['expenses', 'Expenses'], ['payments', 'Payments']].map(([id, label]) => {
          const on = id === filter;
          return {
            label,
            on: on ? 'true' : 'false',
            pick: () => this.setState({ filter: id }),
            style: 'height: 40px; flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; border: 1.5px solid ' + (on ? '#17201B' : '#E6EBE8') + '; background: ' + (on ? '#17201B' : '#FFFFFF') + '; color: ' + (on ? '#FFFFFF' : '#17201B')
          };
        });
    
        const shown = feed.filter(tests[filter]);
        const order = ['Today', 'Yesterday', 'Earlier'];
        const sections = order.map((title) => ({
          title,
          items: shown.filter((f) => f.sec === title).map((f) => {
            const s = st[f.id];
            const unread = f.unread && !read[f.id];
            const [ini, col] = people[f.who];
            const isFail = f.type === 'failed';
            const badgeBg = f.type === 'remind' ? '#A93A2F' : f.type === 'paid' ? '#1E6B45' : isFail ? '#A93A2F' : f.type === 'changed' ? '#56635B' : '#3FA36B';
            const done = s === 'done';
            let amountStr = '', amountCol = '#17201B';
            if (f.amount != null) {
              if (f.dir === 'in') { amountStr = '+' + fmt(f.amount); amountCol = '#1E6B45'; }
              else if (f.dir === 'settle') { amountStr = fmt(f.amount); amountCol = '#1E6B45'; }
              else { amountStr = fmt(f.amount); amountCol = done ? '#1E6B45' : '#A93A2F'; }
            }
            return {
              actor: f.actor,
              text: f.text,
              group: groups[f.g][0],
              time: f.time,
              initial: isFail ? '' : ini,
              unread,
              amount: amountStr,
              amountPlain: f.amount != null ? fmt(f.amount) : '',
              amountStyle: 'font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; white-space: nowrap; color: ' + amountCol,
              avStyle: 'width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 22px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; color: #17201B; background: ' + (isFail ? '#FDF1EF' : col),
              badgeStyle: 'position: absolute; right: -3px; bottom: -3px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 10px; border: 2px solid #FFFFFF; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #FFFFFF; background: ' + badgeBg,
              badgePath: icons[f.type],
              dotStyle: 'width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: ' + groups[f.g][1],
              cardStyle: 'display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 18px; background: ' + (done ? '#EEF9F1' : unread ? '#F7FBF8' : '#FFFFFF') + '; border: 1px solid ' + (done ? '#C6E8D2' : unread ? '#DCEFE3' : '#EEF1EF'),
              showPay: f.action === 'pay' && !s,
              showConfirm: f.action === 'pay' && s === 'confirm',
              showPending: s === 'pending',
              pendingText: f.action === 'pay' ? 'Paying…' : 'Syncing…',
              showDone: done,
              doneText: f.action === 'pay' ? 'Paid · settled with Mads' : 'Synced · group notified',
              showRetry: f.action === 'retry' && !s,
              askPay: () => setSt(f.id, 'confirm'),
              confirm: () => { setSt(f.id, 'pending'); setTimeout(() => setSt(f.id, 'done'), 1300); },
              retry: () => { setSt(f.id, 'pending'); setTimeout(() => setSt(f.id, 'done'), 1600); }
            };
          })
        })).filter((sec) => sec.items.length > 0);
    
        return {
          filters,
          sections,
          empty: shown.length === 0,
          hasUnread: feed.some((f) => f.unread && !read[f.id]),
          markAll: () => { const r = {}; feed.forEach((f) => { r[f.id] = true; }); this.setState({ read: r }); },
          cancel: () => {
            const cur = Object.assign({}, this.get('st', {}));
            Object.keys(cur).forEach((k) => { if (cur[k] === 'confirm') delete cur[k]; });
            this.setState({ st: cur });
          }
        };
      }
    }
    </script>

    <script type="text/x-dc" data-dc-script="" data-props="{&quot;scenario&quot;:{&quot;editor&quot;:&quot;enum&quot;,&quot;options&quot;:[&quot;owe&quot;,&quot;payopen&quot;,&quot;slice&quot;,&quot;clear&quot;],&quot;default&quot;:&quot;owe&quot;},&quot;offline&quot;:{&quot;editor&quot;:&quot;boolean&quot;,&quot;default&quot;:false},&quot;$preview&quot;:{&quot;width&quot;:412,&quot;height&quot;:915}}">
    class Component extends DCLogic {
      fmt(n) {
        const parts = n.toFixed(2).split('.');
        return parts[0].replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, '.') + ',' + parts[1];
      }
      componentDidMount() { this.checkTimer(); }
      componentDidUpdate() { this.checkTimer(); }
      componentWillUnmount() { if (this._t) clearTimeout(this._t); }
      checkTimer() {
        if (this._clearOpen && !this._t) {
          this._t = setTimeout(() => { this._t = null; this.setState({ open: false }); }, 5000);
        } else if (!this._clearOpen && this._t) {
          clearTimeout(this._t);
          this._t = null;
        }
      }
      hrefFor(id) { return id === 'kol' ? 'GroupOwed.dc.html' : 'Group.dc.html'; }
      fmtShort(n) {
        return String(Math.round(n)).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, '.');
      }
      data() {
        const groups = [
          { id: 'kol', name: 'Kollegiet 4. sal', color: '#A9C8F5', members: 7, used: 'Today', fav: true, syncing: true, bal: 145 },
          { id: 'fri', name: 'Friday Bar crew', color: '#F7C59F', members: 9, used: 'Today', fav: true, bal: -94.5 },
          { id: 'pad', name: 'Padel Tuesdays', color: '#E2CDB0', members: 4, used: 'Yesterday', fav: false, bal: -32 },
          { id: 'ski', name: 'Ski trip Åre', color: '#C9B6F0', members: 6, used: 'Sun 1 Nov', fav: true, bal: -286 },
          { id: 'mob', name: 'Mobile Software team', color: '#F3DE8A', members: 6, used: 'Sun 1 Nov', fav: false, bal: 60 },
          { id: 'fam', name: 'Family dinners', color: '#9ED9D2', members: 4, used: 'Sun 1 Nov', fav: false, bal: 0 },
          { id: 'cph', name: 'Copenhagen weekend', color: '#B9DCEB', members: 5, used: '12 Oct', fav: false, bal: 0 },
          { id: 'book', name: 'Book club', color: '#E4CBE9', members: 6, used: '2 Oct', fav: false, bal: 0 },
          { id: 'house', name: "Sofie's housewarming", color: '#F2D7B6', members: 12, used: '20 Sep', fav: false, bal: 0 }
        ];
        const debts = [
          { id: 'ski', to: 'Mads', since: 'Since Sun 1 Nov', amount: 286 },
          { id: 'fri', to: 'Sofie', since: 'Since today', amount: 94.5 },
          { id: 'pad', to: 'Jonas', since: 'Since yesterday', amount: 32 }
        ];
        const spend = {
          today: { kol: 64, fri: 120 },
          week: { kol: 312, fri: 380, pad: 160 },
          month: { ski: 1200, kol: 620, fri: 380, fam: 340, mob: 210, pad: 160 },
          year: { kol: 11840, ski: 6900, fam: 4310, fri: 3120, pad: 1440, mob: 980 }
        };
        const last = {
          kol: '64,00 kr to Ida · Today',
          fri: '120,00 kr to Sofie · Today',
          pad: '160,00 kr to Jonas · Mon 2 Nov',
          ski: '1.200,00 kr to Mads · Sun 1 Nov',
          mob: '210,00 kr to Gustav · Sun 1 Nov',
          fam: '340,00 kr to Mum · Sun 1 Nov'
        };
        return { groups, debts, spend, last };
      }
      get(key, fallback) {
        const st = this.state || {};
        return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(st, key) ? st[key] : fallback;
      }
      renderVals() {
        const scenario = this.props.scenario ?? 'owe';
        const { groups, debts, spend, last } = this.data();
        const byId = {};
        groups.forEach((g) => { byId[g.id] = g; });
    
        const initialPay = {};
        if (scenario === 'clear') debts.forEach((d) => { initialPay[d.id] = 'paid'; });
        const pay = this.get('pay', initialPay);
        const open = this.get('open', scenario === 'payopen');
        const period = this.get('period', 'month');
        const sel = this.get('sel', scenario === 'slice' ? 'ski' : null);
        const menuOpen = this.get('menuOpen', false);
        const tab = this.get('tab', 'recent');
        const confirming = this.get('confirming', null);
    
        const unpaid = debts.filter((d) => pay[d.id] !== 'paid');
        const total = unpaid.reduce((a, d) => a + d.amount, 0);
        const owing = unpaid.length > 0;
        const allIdle = debts.every((d) => !pay[d.id]) && confirming !== 'all';
    
        const setPay = (ids, status) => {
          const next = Object.assign({}, this.get('pay', initialPay));
          ids.forEach((id) => { next[id] = status; });
          this.setState({ pay: next, confirming: null });
        };
        const runPay = (ids) => {
          setPay(ids, 'pending');
          setTimeout(() => setPay(ids, 'paid'), 1300);
        };
    
        const debtVals = debts.map((d) => {
          const g = byId[d.id];
          const status = pay[d.id];
          const isPaid = status === 'paid';
          const isPending = status === 'pending';
          const isConfirm = confirming === d.id;
          return {
            show: owing,
            name: g.name,
            to: d.to,
            sub: isPaid ? 'Settled just now' : 'To ' + d.to + ' · ' + d.since,
            amount: this.fmt(d.amount),
            initial: g.name.charAt(0),
            isIdle: !status && !isConfirm,
            isConfirm,
            isPending,
            isPaid,
            ask: () => this.setState({ confirming: d.id }),
            confirm: () => runPay([d.id]),
            cardStyle: 'background: ' + (isPaid ? '#EEF9F1' : '#FFFFFF') + '; border-radius: 18px; padding: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; border: 1px solid ' + (isPaid ? '#C6E8D2' : 'transparent'),
            avatarStyle: 'width: 44px; height: 44px; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 14px; background: ' + g.color + '; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; color: #17201B',
            amountStyle: 'font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; white-space: nowrap; color: ' + (isPaid ? '#1E6B45' : '#A93A2F')
          };
        });
    
        const periodMeta = {
          today: { short: 'Today', word: 'today' },
          week: { short: 'Week', word: 'this week' },
          month: { short: 'Month', word: 'this month' },
          year: { short: 'Year', word: 'this year' }
        };
        const periods = ['today', 'week', 'month', 'year'].map((p) => ({
          label: p === 'today' ? 'Today' : 'This ' + p,
          pick: () => this.setState({ period: p, menuOpen: false, sel: null }),
          style: 'height: 40px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; text-align: left; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: ' + (p === period ? '700' : '500') + '; background: ' + (p === period ? '#DDF3E4' : 'transparent') + '; color: ' + (p === period ? '#1E6B45' : '#17201B')
        }));
    
        const entries = Object.keys(spend[period]).map((id) => ({ id, v: spend[period][id] }));
        const sum = entries.reduce((a, e) => a + e.v, 0);
        const cx = 70, cy = 70, R = 62, Rsel = 69, r = 40, pad = 0.035;
        const pt = (a, rad) => [cx + rad * Math.sin(a), cy - rad * Math.cos(a)];
        let acc = 0;
        let bubble = null;
        const slices = entries.map((e) => {
          const a0 = (acc / sum) * Math.PI * 2 + pad;
          acc += e.v;
          const a1 = (acc / sum) * Math.PI * 2 - pad;
          const isSel = sel === e.id;
          const RR = isSel ? Rsel : R;
          const large = a1 - a0 > Math.PI ? 1 : 0;
          const o0 = pt(a0, RR), o1 = pt(a1, RR), i1 = pt(a1, r), i0 = pt(a0, r);
          const f = (n) => n.toFixed(2);
          const d = 'M' + f(o0[0]) + ' ' + f(o0[1]) + ' A' + RR + ' ' + RR + ' 0 ' + large + ' 1 ' + f(o1[0]) + ' ' + f(o1[1]) +
            ' L' + f(i1[0]) + ' ' + f(i1[1]) + ' A' + r + ' ' + r + ' 0 ' + large + ' 0 ' + f(i0[0]) + ' ' + f(i0[1]) + ' Z';
          const g = byId[e.id];
          if (isSel) {
            const mid = pt((a0 + a1) / 2, RR);
            const tailX = Math.max(18, Math.min(204 - 32, mid[0] + 64 - 7));
            bubble = {
              href: this.hrefFor(e.id),
              name: g.name,
              amount: this.fmt(e.v),
              last: last[e.id],
              dotStyle: 'width: 12px; height: 12px; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 6px; background: ' + g.color,
              tailStyle: 'position: absolute; top: -6px; left: ' + tailX + 'px; width: 14px; height: 14px; background: #FFFFFF; transform: rotate(45deg); border-radius: 3px'
            };
          }
          return {
            d,
            color: g.color,
            op: sel && !isSel ? 0.45 : 1,
            pick: () => this.setState({ sel: isSel ? null : e.id, menuOpen: false })
          };
        });
    
        const chipFor = (g) => {
          let bal = g.bal;
          if (bal < 0 && pay[g.id] === 'paid') bal = 0;
          const base = 'flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 12px; white-space: nowrap; ';
          if (bal < 0) return { chip: 'You owe ' + this.fmt(-bal), chipStyle: base + 'background: #FCE4E1; color: #A93A2F' };
          if (bal > 0) return { chip: '+' + this.fmt(bal) + ' to you', chipStyle: base + 'background: #DDF3E4; color: #1E6B45' };
          return { chip: 'Settled', chipStyle: base + 'background: #F1F4F2; color: #56635B' };
        };
        let list = groups;
        if (tab === 'fav') list = groups.filter((g) => g.fav);
        if (tab === 'all') list = groups.slice().sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
        const shown = list.slice(0, 6).map((g) => Object.assign({
          href: this.hrefFor(g.id),
          name: g.name,
          initial: g.name.charAt(0),
          fav: g.fav,
          syncing: !!g.syncing,
          notSyncing: !g.syncing,
          members: g.members,
          used: g.used === 'Today' || g.used === 'Yesterday' ? 'Active ' + g.used.toLowerCase() : 'Active ' + g.used,
          avatarStyle: 'width: 44px; height: 44px; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 14px; background: ' + g.color + '; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; color: #17201B'
        }, chipFor(g)));
    
        const tabs = [['recent', 'Recent'], ['fav', 'Favourites'], ['all', 'All']].map(([id, label]) => ({
          label,
          pick: () => this.setState({ tab: id }),
          style: 'height: 40px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: ' + (tab === id ? '700' : '600') + '; background: ' + (tab === id ? '#FFFFFF' : 'transparent') + '; color: ' + (tab === id ? '#17201B' : '#56635B') + '; box-shadow: ' + (tab === id ? '0 1px 3px rgba(23,32,27,0.10)' : 'none')
        }));
    
        const owedToYou = groups.reduce((a, g) => a + (g.bal > 0 ? g.bal : 0), 0);
        const oweWhole = this.fmt(total);
        this._clearOpen = !owing && open;
    
        return {
          closeDrop: () => this.setState({ open: false }),
          offline: !!this.props.offline,
          owing,
          clear: !owing,
          dropStyle: 'background: ' + (owing ? '#FDF1EF' : '#EEF9F1') + '; border: 1px solid ' + (owing ? '#F6D3CE' : '#C6E8D2') + '; border-radius: 24px; padding: 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; margin-top: -8px',
          open,
          oweWhole,
          oweTotal: oweWhole,
          oweSub: unpaid.length === 1 ? '1 group' : unpaid.length + ' groups',
          owedToYou: '+' + this.fmt(owedToYou) + ' kr owed to you',
          payBtnLabel: open ? 'Hide' : 'Pay now',
          chevStyle: open ? 'transform: rotate(180deg)' : '',
          toggleOpen: () => this.setState({ open: !open, confirming: null }),
          allIdle: allIdle && owing,
          confirmingAll: confirming === 'all',
          askAll: () => this.setState({ confirming: 'all' }),
          confirmAll: () => runPay(unpaid.map((d) => d.id)),
          cancel: () => this.setState({ confirming: null }),
          debts: debtVals,
          periodShort: periodMeta[period].short,
          periodWord: periodMeta[period].word,
          periods,
          menuOpen,
          toggleMenu: () => this.setState({ menuOpen: !menuOpen }),
          slices,
          totalShort: this.fmtShort(sum),
          hasSel: !!bubble,
          bubble: bubble || { name: '', amount: '', last: '', dotStyle: '', tailStyle: '' },
          clearSel: () => this.setState({ sel: null }),
          tabs,
          groups: shown,
          groupsEmpty: shown.length === 0,
          showSeeAll: list.length > 6,
          groupCount: list.length
        };
      }
    }
    </script>

     Style guide
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    body{margin:0}
    a{color:#1E6B45}a:hover{color:#14502F}
    button{font-family:inherit}
    
    
    
    
    
    
           [App name] · Style guide
           Calm, inviting, positive, intuitive.
    
    
    
             Green = good
             Money in, paid, synced, done. The colour you're rewarded with.
    
    
             Red = pay this
             Only for money you owe. It goes away once you pay.
    
    
             Everything else
             White, ink and soft grey. Amber only for warnings.
    
    
    
    
    
    
           Colours
           Pastels are fills. Text and buttons use the deep shade of the same hue (all pass 4.5:1).
    
    
    
    
               {{fam.name}}
    
    
    
    
                     {{s.token}}  {{s.hex}}
                     {{s.use}}
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
             Group colours
             Each group gets one when it's created and keeps it everywhere: avatar tile, pie slice, dots in Activity. Never green or red, so a slice is never mistaken for "paid" or "owe".
    
    
    
    
                 {{c.initial}}
                 {{c.name}}  {{c.hex}}
    
    
    
           Extra shades for groups 7–9: Sky #B9DCEB · Lilac #E4CBE9 · Apricot #F2D7B6. People avatars reuse the same set; "You" is always Green 300.
    
    
    
           Type
    
             Plus Jakarta Sans
             Google Fonts, free. Weights 500 · 600 · 700 · 800. Receipts only: JetBrains Mono.
    
    
    
    
                 {{t.name}}
                 {{t.sample}}
                 {{t.spec}}
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
           Spacing &amp; shape
    
             Spacing (dp)
    
    
    
    
                   {{s.v}}
    
    
    
             Screen side padding 16 · gap between cards 8–12 · between sections 20
    
    
             Corner radius (dp)
    
    
    
    
                   {{r.v}}  {{r.use}}
    
    
    
    
            Touch targets:  nothing tappable smaller than 44 dp. Primary buttons 56, secondary 48, inline 44.
    
    
    
           Components
    
    
               Buttons
               Primary · Save expense
               Pay · only for money owed
               Soft · Add expense
               Secondary · Cancel
               Text · Scan another receipt
    
    
               Balance chips
    
                 You owe 286,00
                 +145,00 to you
                 Settled
    
               Sync status (pending · failed · done)
    
                 Waiting to sync
                 Retrying…
                 Synced
    
               Switch · Tabs
    
    
    
    
                   Recent
                   Favs
                   All
    
    
    
    
               Hero card · owe
               412,50 kr
               Turns green the moment it's paid.
    
    
               Hero card · all square
               All paid up
               Calm, rewarding, no action needed.
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
           For the Kotlin build
           Paste into  ui/theme/Color.kt  and use these names instead of hex codes in screens. Add Plus Jakarta Sans as a downloadable Google Font in  Type.kt .
    
              Amounts:  Danish format, 1.240,50 kr, always 2 decimals.
              Confirm money in place:  Pay → Cancel / Confirm on the same card, never a new screen.
              Status on every expense:  waiting, failed (retries by itself in the background, "Try now" is optional) or synced. Show an offline banner when there's no connection.
              Icons:  outline, 1.8 stroke, rounded caps (Material Symbols Rounded is a close match).
    
    
         {{kotlin}}

    /**
     * S1 Login Screen: Authenticates existing users and fetches their profile + counter from Firestore.
     */
    @Composable
    fun LoginScreen(
        modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
        email: String,
        password: String,
        isLoading: Boolean,
        errorMessage: String?,
        onEmailChange: (String) -> Unit,
        onPasswordChange: (String) -> Unit,
        onLoginClick: () -> Unit,
        onNavigateToRegister: () -> Unit
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .padding(24.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center,
            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
        ) {
            Text(
                text = "Welcome Back",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium
            )
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
            Text(
                text = "Sign in to load your profile and saved counter",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
            )
    
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(24.dp))
    
            if (!errorMessage.isNullOrBlank()) {
                Card(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(
                        containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.errorContainer
                    )
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = errorMessage,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onErrorContainer,
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(12.dp)
                    )
                }
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))
            }
    
            OutlinedTextField(
                value = email,
                onValueChange = onEmailChange,
                label = { Text("Email") },

    /**
     * S2 Registration Screen: Creates a Firebase Auth account, inserts the user into
     * `/users/{uid}` in Firestore & local SQLite, and navigates to the Counter page.
     */
    @Composable
    fun RegistrationScreen(
        modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
        displayName: String,
        email: String,
        password: String,
        isLoading: Boolean,
        errorMessage: String?,
        onDisplayNameChange: (String) -> Unit,
        onEmailChange: (String) -> Unit,
        onPasswordChange: (String) -> Unit,
        onRegisterClick: () -> Unit,
        onNavigateToLogin: () -> Unit
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .padding(24.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center,

        ) {

                text = "Create Account",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium
            )
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
            Text(
                text = "Register to create your user profile in Firestore",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
            )
    
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(24.dp))
    
            if (!errorMessage.isNullOrBlank()) {
                Card(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(
                        containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.errorContainer
                    )
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = errorMessage,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onErrorContainer,
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(12.dp)
                    )
                }
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))
            }
    
            OutlinedTextField(
                value = displayName,
                onValueChange = onDisplayNameChange,
                label = { Text("Display Name") },

                enabled = !isLoading,
                keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(
                    keyboardType = KeyboardType.Text,
                    imeAction = ImeAction.Next
                ),
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            )
    
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))
    
            OutlinedTextField(
                value = email,
                onValueChange = onEmailChange,
                label = { Text("Email") },
                singleLine = true,
                enabled = !isLoading,
                keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(
                    keyboardType = KeyboardType.Email,
                    imeAction = ImeAction.Next
                ),
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            )
    
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))
    
            OutlinedTextField(
                value = password,
                onValueChange = onPasswordChange,
                label = { Text("Password (6+ characters)") },
                singleLine = true,
                enabled = !isLoading,
                visualTransformation = PasswordVisualTransformation(),
                keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(
                    keyboardType = KeyboardType.Password,
                    imeAction = ImeAction.Done
                ),
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            )
    
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(24.dp))
    
            Button(
                onClick = onRegisterClick,

    /**
     * Counter Screen: Displays the authenticated user's profile and counter, and persists
     * counter increments against `/users/{uid}` in Cloud Firestore & local SQLite.
     */
    @Composable
    fun CounterScreen(
        modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
        user: User,
        statusMessage: String,
        onIncrementClick: () -> Unit,
        onLogoutClick: () -> Unit
    ) {
        val syncLabel = when (user.syncStatus) {
            SyncStatus.SYNCED -> "Synced / Success"
            SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT,
            SyncStatus.PENDING_UPDATE,
            SyncStatus.PENDING_DELETE -> "Pending / Syncing..."
            SyncStatus.FAILED -> "Failed / Offline (Saved locally)"
        }
    
        Column(
            modifier = modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .padding(24.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center,
            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
        ) {
            Text(
                text = "Hello ${user.displayName}!",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium
            )
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
            Text(
                text = user.email,
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
            )
    
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(20.dp))
    
            Card(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(
                    containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant
                )
            ) {
                Column(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .padding(16.dp),
                    horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = "Count: ${user.count}",
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.displaySmall
                    )
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
                    Text(
                        text = "Sync State: $syncLabel",
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                    )
                    if (statusMessage.isNotBlank()) {
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
                        Text(
                            text = statusMessage,
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
    
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(24.dp))
    
            Button(
                onClick = onIncrementClick,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            ) {
                Text("Click Me")
            }
    
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))
    
            OutlinedButton(
                onClick = onLogoutClick,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            ) {
                Text("Logout")
            }
        }
    }
