    # Database Schema Documentation
    
    This document details the dual-layer database architecture for **"Get Your Money Up Not Your Funny Up"**:
    - **Local Database (Android Room / SQLite)**: Primary offline-first source of truth for the UI, enforcing relational integrity and queueing unsynced operations.
      - Draw.io diagram: [`docs/local_database_schema.drawio.xml`](file:///e:/Documents/GitHub/Mobile-Software-Development-GetYourMoneyUpNotYourFunnyUp/docs/local_database_schema.drawio.xml)
    - **Remote Database (Cloud Firestore)**: Cloud persistence and real-time multi-user synchronization engine.
      - Draw.io diagram: [`docs/remote_database_schema.drawio.xml`](file:///e:/Documents/GitHub/Mobile-Software-Development-GetYourMoneyUpNotYourFunnyUp/docs/remote_database_schema.drawio.xml)
    
    ---
    
    ## 1. Local SQLite / Room Relational Schema
    
    The local database consists of 7 relational tables designed for offline resilience, transactional integrity, and WorkManager synchronization.
    
    ```mermaid
    erDiagram
        users {
            TEXT id PK "Firebase Auth UID or UUID"
            TEXT email "NOT NULL"
            TEXT display_name "NOT NULL"
            TEXT photo_url "NULLABLE"
            INTEGER notifications_enabled "DEFAULT 1"
            TEXT sync_status "SYNCED | PENDING_INSERT | PENDING_UPDATE | PENDING_DELETE | FAILED"
            INTEGER updated_at "Epoch ms"
        }
    
        groups {
            TEXT id PK "UUID"
            TEXT name "NOT NULL"
            TEXT description "NULLABLE"
            TEXT currency "DEFAULT 'EUR'"
            TEXT created_by FK "users.id"
            INTEGER created_at "Epoch ms"
            INTEGER updated_at "Epoch ms"
            TEXT sync_status "Sync state"
        }
    
        group_members {
            TEXT group_id PK,FK "groups.id (ON DELETE CASCADE)"
            TEXT user_id PK,FK "users.id (ON DELETE CASCADE)"
            TEXT role "ADMIN | MEMBER"
            INTEGER joined_at "Epoch ms"
        }
    
        expenses {
            TEXT id PK "UUID"
            TEXT group_id FK "groups.id (ON DELETE CASCADE)"
            TEXT title "NOT NULL"
            INTEGER amount_cents "Minor currency units (Long)"
            TEXT currency "DEFAULT 'EUR'"
            TEXT payer_id FK "users.id"
            TEXT category "DEFAULT 'General'"
            TEXT notes "NULLABLE"
            TEXT receipt_local_uri "NULLABLE"
            TEXT receipt_remote_path "NULLABLE"
            INTEGER created_at "Epoch ms"
            TEXT created_by "users.id"
            INTEGER is_deleted "Soft delete flag (0 or 1)"
            TEXT sync_status "Sync state"
        }
    
        expense_splits {
            TEXT id PK "UUID"
            TEXT expense_id FK "expenses.id (ON DELETE CASCADE)"
            TEXT user_id FK "users.id"
            INTEGER amount_owed_cents "Minor currency units (Long)"
            REAL share_weight "DEFAULT 1.0"
        }
    
        settlements {
            TEXT id PK "UUID"
            TEXT group_id FK "groups.id (ON DELETE CASCADE)"
            TEXT debtor_id FK "users.id"
            TEXT creditor_id FK "users.id"
            INTEGER amount_cents "Minor currency units (Long)"
            TEXT currency "DEFAULT 'EUR'"
            TEXT payment_method "MobilePay | Cash | Bank"
            TEXT status "PENDING | COMPLETED | FAILED"
            INTEGER created_at "Epoch ms"
            TEXT sync_status "Sync state"
        }
    
        sync_queue {
            INTEGER queue_id PK "AUTOINCREMENT"
            TEXT entity_type "USER | GROUP | EXPENSE | SETTLEMENT"
            TEXT entity_id "Target row ID"
            TEXT action "CREATE | UPDATE | DELETE"
            TEXT payload_json "Serialized snapshot"
            INTEGER retry_count "DEFAULT 0"
            INTEGER last_attempt_at "Epoch ms (NULLABLE)"
            TEXT error_message "Last failure reason (NULLABLE)"
        }
    
        users ||--o{ group_members : "joins"
        groups ||--o{ group_members : "has members"
        groups ||--o{ expenses : "contains"
        users ||--o{ expenses : "pays (payer_id)"
        expenses ||--o{ expense_splits : "splits into"
        users ||--o{ expense_splits : "owes (user_id)"
        groups ||--o{ settlements : "tracks"
        users ||--o{ settlements : "pays back (debtor_id)"
        users ||--o{ settlements : "receives (creditor_id)"
    ```
    
    ---
    
    ## 2. Remote Cloud Firestore Document Hierarchy
    
    Firestore uses a hierarchical document-subcollection model under `/groups/{groupId}` so security rules can validate group membership in a single lookup (`request.auth.uid in get(/databases/$(database)/documents/groups/$(groupId)).data.memberIds`).
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
        Root["Firestore Root (/databases/(default)/documents)"]
        UsersCol["Collection: /users/{userId}"]
        GroupsCol["Collection: /groups/{groupId}"]
        ExpensesSub["Subcollection: /groups/{groupId}/expenses/{expenseId}"]
        SettlementsSub["Subcollection: /groups/{groupId}/settlements/{settlementId}"]
    
        Root --> UsersCol
        Root --> GroupsCol
        GroupsCol --> ExpensesSub
        GroupsCol --> SettlementsSub
    
        UsersDoc["User Document
        - id: String
        - email: String
        - displayName: String
        - photoUrl: String?
        - notificationSettings: Map
        - createdAt / updatedAt: Long"]
    
        GroupsDoc["Group Document
        - id: String
        - name: String
        - description: String?
        - currency: String
        - createdBy: String
        - memberIds: List&lt;String&gt;
        - members: List&lt;MemberMap&gt;
        - createdAt / updatedAt: Long"]
    
        ExpensesDoc["Expense Document
        - id: String
        - groupId: String
        - title: String
        - amountCents: Long
        - currency: String
        - payerId: String
        - category: String
        - notes: String?
        - receiptStoragePath: String?
        - splits: List&lt;SplitMap&gt;
        - createdAt: Long
        - createdBy: String
        - isDeleted: Boolean"]
    
        SettlementsDoc["Settlement Document
        - id: String
        - groupId: String
        - debtorId: String
        - creditorId: String
        - amountCents: Long
        - currency: String
        - paymentMethod: String
        - status: String
        - createdAt: Long
        - recordedBy: String"]
    
        UsersCol --- UsersDoc
        GroupsCol --- GroupsDoc
        ExpensesSub --- ExpensesDoc
        SettlementsSub --- SettlementsDoc
    ```
    
    ---
    
    ## 3. Synchronization & Offline-First Data Flow
    
    ```mermaid
    sequenceDiagram
        participant UI as Compose UI / ViewModel
        participant Repo as OfflineFirstRepository
        participant Room as Local Room SQLite DB
        participant WM as WorkManager SyncWorker
        participant FS as Remote Cloud Firestore
    
        UI->>Repo: Create Expense / Settlement
        Repo->>Room: Insert entity (sync_status = PENDING_INSERT) & enqueue sync_queue
        Room-->>UI: Emit updated Flow immediately (non-blocking)
        Repo->>WM: Enqueue OneTimeWorkRequest (NetworkType.CONNECTED)
        WM->>Room: Read pending items from sync_queue
        WM->>FS: Write document to /groups/{groupId}/expenses/{id}
        alt Network Success
            FS-->>WM: ACK
            WM->>Room: Mark entity sync_status = SYNCED & remove from sync_queue
            Room-->>UI: Emit SYNCED status badge
        else Network Failure
            FS-->>WM: Exception / Timeout
            WM->>Room: Increment retry_count & set sync_status = FAILED (or retry backoff)
            Room-->>UI: Emit Pending/Failed indicator
        end
    ```

     What a tactic is
    
    
    
                     Stimulus                   Tactics to control the response               Response
                         a request fails                             retry with backoff, outbox, local-first writes…                     delivered later, user told
    
    
    
              Tactic                                                         Characteristics
              a design decision that influences the control of a quality                         •  they capture what architects do in practice: a catalogue of known
                                                                                    moves, not inventions              attribute response
                                                                                                                                         •   tactics may refine other tactics: “retry” refines “recover”;
                  e.g. a heartbeat to control availability; exponential backoff to                                                                                               “exponential backoff” refines “retry”
                  control availability and energy                                                                                                                                     •   tactics may influence more than one quality attribute, since
               Architectural strategy                                                           qualities are interdependent: backoff helps availability and energy,
                                                                                                 costs latency
              a collection of tactics; your reliability strategy is five tactics
                                                                                                                                         •  a tactic is not a pattern: a pattern (MVVM, repository) packages
               working together                                                                                              several tactics and their trade-offs
    
    
          A tactic modifies the response measure for a given stimulus. If you cannot say which number it moves, it is not a
               tactic, it is a feature.

    Android Project Overview.pdf PAGE 1
    Objective
    Develop a mobile application (Android) that helps groups of people track and manage their shared
    expenses, ensuring everyone is aware of their financial obligations with a friendly and intuitive user
    interface. If you’re familiar with the application WeShare or groups in MobilePay, the concept is very
    much the same.
    
    Background
    In various social and formal gatherings, expenses often occur that are typically shared among
    participants, such as meals, gifts, or travel costs. Tracking who paid what and calculating how much
    others owe can become a cumbersome task. A mobile application that alleviates this burden by
    calculating and notifying members of their respective dues can be incredibly beneficial.
    
    Functional Requirements
    User Registration & Profile Management:
    
        •   Allow users to create a profile, including essential information like name and contact details.
        •   Enable users to update their profiles and manage notification settings.
        •  You can manage users by creating a custom authentication system, using a third-party provider
           such as Firebase Authentication or by using dummy data and mocking interactions. (Database
          and security is not required, but is recommended)
    
    Group Management:
    
        •   Allow the creation of groups, adding and removing participants.
        •   Permit the naming and description of the group.
    
    Expense Entry & Management:
    
        •   Enable users to input expenses, specifying the payer and the amount.
        •   Allow attachment of receipts or invoices (optional feature).
        •   Facilitate the splitting of expenses among all or selected group members.
    
    Debt Calculation:
    
        •  Implement algorithms to calculate how much each person owes or is owed in a group.
        •   Allow users to view a summary of all transactions, and their current balance (owed/owing)
            within a group.
    
    Notifications & Communications:
    
        •   Notify group members of new expenses and updates.
        •   Allow users to send reminder notifications to those who owe them money.
    Android Project Overview.pdf PAGE 2
    Non-functional Requirements
    Reliability (Quality Attribute, QA):
    
        •   Fault Tolerance
            o    If a request fails due to temporary network unavailability, the application must retry it in
                  the background
            o   Failed requests must not prevent the user from continuing to use the app
        •   Offline Availability
            o  Previously retrieved data must remain accessible when the device is offline
        •   User feedback
            o  The application must indicate whether a request is pending, successful or failed
            o  The user must be notified when a previously failed request eventually succeeds in the
                  background
    
    Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence:
    GenAI has become a well-established tool for software development and therefore its use is accepted.
    As engineers we must know when and how to use such tools therefore we expect you to state an
    example of the following for each of your GenAI use-cases:
    
    Use case: (e.g. UX, code-completion, library integration):
    Tool: (e.g. gemini, chatGPT, Claude)
    Chat history: (link if possible)
    Evaluation: (Description of how well the LLM carried out its task and to what extent you could use its
    replies)
    
    Look up alternative solutions yourselves (not using GenAI) - why did you end up using what solution?
    
    AI policy (shared constant)
    Allowed: any AI tool in any mode, autocomplete, chat, multimodal, or agentic (e.g., Claude Code,
    Cursor, GitHub Copilot agent mode, Gemini CLI), for any part of this project, provided use is disclosed.
    Undisclosed AI use is academic misconduct. Note the asymmetry: controlled disclosed AI use that is
    verified well can earn top marks; hidden use can cost you the course.
    
    Four standing rules apply whenever AI touches your project:
    
       1. Disclose in the AI dossier. Continue the log you started in the design document's Appendix A: one
       entry per significant interaction (tool, mode, task, prompt or link, verification, decision), plus the
       failure log, at least 3 entries per project documenting AI output that was wrong or off-spec and how
      you caught it.
       2. AI code enters main only through a pull request that carries tests, is reviewed by a teammate who
       did not generate it, and passes CI. 'The model wrote it and it ran' is not verification.
       3. Maintain an agent rules file. Your repository contains a CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md describing your
       conventions, architecture, and definition of done. Evolve it as you learn what your agents get wrong;
       its git history is evidence of engineering judgment.
    Android Project Overview.pdf PAGE 3

## Assistant

**Phase 1 is complete. I reviewed all 11 PDFs—222 pages—using `py` and `pymupdf`, including rendered code examples, diagrams and tables. No project files were modified, and implementation has not started.**

There are no PDFs under `docs/`; its HTML, Markdown and XML documents were reviewed separately.

**Documents reviewed and their implications**

| Document | Pages reviewed | Relevant findings |
|---|---:|---|
| Android Project Overview, both copies | 3 each | Offline access, background retries, non-blocking interaction and recovery feedback are required. The copies are identical. |
| Ansvarsfordeling – App Projekt | 2 | Confirms Person 5’s scope and explicitly requires shared repository contracts between synchronization and the other developers. |
| Design document (2) | 6 | Defines NFR-K1/K2/K3 as Must requirements. Real money transfers are explicitly out of scope; settlement is recorded manually. |
| Android 1 – Lecture 7 | 31 | Native Compose, reusable components, modifier ordering, resources and previews with sample data independent of live services. |
| Andorid 2 | 25 | MVVM, private mutable/public immutable `StateFlow`, lifecycle-aware collection, shared ViewModel ownership and centralized theming. |
| Android 3 | 22 | Navigation callbacks, centrally defined routes, shared state and authentication back-stack boundaries. |
| Android 4 | 24 | Coroutines, Firestore listeners and repositories that hide database/network details from ViewModels. |
| Software Architecture Part 1 | 35 | Local-first writes, transactional outbox, idempotent requests, retry/backoff, connectivity detection and measurable reliability scenarios. |
| Lecture 8 – Automated UI/UX adaptation | 47 | Automate functional workflows and repeatable checks; retain human visual/usability assessment. Its adaptive-interface research does not justify changing your prescribed design. |
| Lecture 10 – Usability and Software Architecture | 24 | Status feedback, long-action feedback and retry must have clear component ownership and tests. Avoid excessive feedback mechanisms. |

I also cross-referenced `AGENTS.md`, the complete Kotlin source structure, Gradle configuration, manifest, database tests, both Hi-Fi files, database documentation, all three Draw.io XML diagrams and the navigation PNG.

The design PDF contains headings for navigation and low-fi wireframes, but no diagrams under those headings. The separate navigation files and Hi-Fi prototype therefore supply those details. It also contains no Appendix A; the required AI dossier will need a separate editable source or a Markdown record for later incorporation.

**Confirmed Person 5 scope**

- **Home:** greeting/date, notification bell, balance summary, period-based donut, slice popover, inline individual/bulk settlement confirmation, group filters, empty states and offline feedback.
- **Activity:** documented event types, Today/Yesterday/Earlier sections, four filters, unread state, mark-all-read, inline settlement and actual sync retry.
- **Offline architecture:** Room persistence, durable queued writes, WorkManager retries, offline reads and pending/failed/success feedback.

Person 4 remains responsible for balance and settlement calculations, recording settlement behavior and reminders. Person 5 displays those results and invokes the agreed actions.

**What already exists**

| Existing code | Reuse and limitations |
|---|---|
| `AppDatabase`, `DatabaseContract` | Seven-table SQLite database, version 2, named `get_your_money_up.db`; currently uses `SQLiteOpenHelper`, not Room. |
| `UserDao`, `GroupDao`, `ExpenseDao`, `SettlementDao`, `SyncQueueDao` | Existing queries, transactions and reactive flows provide a useful migration foundation. |
| Existing entity/domain classes | Reuse their identities, integer monetary amounts, mappings and sync enums. |
| `MemberBalance`, `DebtTransfer` | Suitable Person 4 integration models, but need group context supplied alongside them. |
| `AuthRepository` | Working Firebase Auth/Firestore implementation for users; preserve it while correcting necessary persistence/scheduling integration. |
| `ui/theme/` | Existing semantic colours, typography, spacing, shapes, touch targets and Danish amount formatter. |
| Database tests | Useful starting coverage, but they do not establish background synchronization or migration correctness. |

Home, Activity, their ViewModels, group remote repositories and WorkManager processing are absent. `MainActivity` currently navigates between authentication and a counter demonstration; Person 1’s five-tab shell is absent.

**Conflicts and proposed resolutions**

1. **Room versus the existing shared database**

   Your instructions and responsibility document explicitly require Room. The existing implementation does not meet that requirement.

   I recommend migrating the **same database file**, preserving records, identifiers, relationships, existing outbox entries and useful DAO method signatures. Room mappings must match the actual SQL schema, including defaults, nullability and indexes—not merely the diagrams.

   This affects all seven entity mappings, five DAOs, converters, database construction and database tests. It is a significant shared change requiring your approval. Android’s migration guidance supports replacing the helper with a Room database and an explicit migration path. [SQLite-to-Room migration guidance](https://developer.android.com/training/data-storage/room/sqlite-room-migration)

2. **Manual settlement versus real payment**

   The design document, page 6, explicitly excludes real money transfers. The `Pay` interaction should call Person 4’s manual settlement operation.

   “Paid” must mean the settlement was successfully recorded. “Synced” separately means Firestore acknowledged it. A locally recorded settlement can therefore remain visibly waiting to sync.

3. **Missing Person 4 implementation**

   There are models but no calculation/payment service. I propose one small contract supplying:

   - Group-keyed `MemberBalance` and `DebtTransfer` results.
   - Stable identifiers and information needed for outstanding-payment cards.
   - A confirmed-settlement operation implemented by Person 4.

   Sample financial results belong in previews/tests or a clearly separate development adapter. Missing calculations must never appear as a genuine zero balance or “All paid up.”

4. **Missing navigation shell**

   Implement Home and Activity as screens receiving callbacks for Activity, Groups, Create group and Open group. Person 1 connects those callbacks to the shared shell.

   S3-pay, S3-slice and S6-action remain inline states. I would not build replacement tabs or another navigation system.

   The invite-link action has no implemented destination, and the prototype uses a placeholder link. It needs Person 1/2 integration rather than an invented flow.

5. **Missing group display metadata**

   `Group` and its persistence currently lack the chosen group colour and favourite information. These are necessary for consistent tiles, chart slices, activity dots and favourites filtering.

   Their shared representation must be agreed with Person 2. I would not silently introduce unsupported Firestore fields.

6. **Activity history and reminders are not represented**

   Existing ledger snapshots cannot reconstruct historical expense changes, previous prices, delivered reminders or durable read state.

   A small local activity/read-state extension is needed. However, complete cross-device history and reminder delivery require an agreed remote event source. No activity/reminder collection or delivery implementation currently exists; I would not invent one or claim members were notified merely because an expense synchronized.

7. **Currency mismatch**

   The design uses DKK, while models and SQL default to EUR. New DKK records should use DKK explicitly. Existing EUR records must retain their currency and must not be combined into a total labelled `kr`.

8. **Prototype inconsistencies**

   Some controls are smaller than the stated 44dp minimum, and the donut centre rounds amounts despite the style guide requiring two decimals. My proposed resolution is to retain the visual layout, provide minimum interaction areas, and follow the explicit two-decimal formatting rule.

   The prototype’s payment/retry timers will not be copied as production behavior.

9. **Lecture examples need practical qualification**

   The architecture lecture’s timing numbers are worked examples, not guarantees supplied by WorkManager. WorkManager delays are inexact and execution depends on constraints and system scheduling. We should define and measure a realistic foreground reconnection scenario separately from eventual background execution. [WorkManager scheduling and retries](https://developer.android.com/develop/background-work/background-tasks/persistent/getting-started/define-work)

   Similarly, ordinary ViewModel state survives configuration changes; process recovery needs persisted data and appropriate saved state. [ViewModel persistence guidance](https://developer.android.com/topic/libraries/architecture/viewmodel)

The documentation mentions overdue payments, but supplies no due-date model or lateness rules. I would implement the prototype’s outstanding-payment cards and “Since…” information without adding overdue calculations.

**Reliability issues that affect the implementation**

The current code needs focused corrections within the approved offline work:

- Entity writes and outbox insertion are not consistently one transaction.
- Some failure paths leave failed records without queued operations.
- Firestore listeners can overwrite pending local changes.
- Replacement inserts on parent rows can interact destructively with cascading relationships.
- Outbox entries lack explicit account ownership.
- No worker processes the queue or persists recovery feedback.

The proposed pipeline is:

1. Save the entity change and outbox entry in one local transaction.
2. Let Room flows update the screen immediately.
3. Schedule network-constrained WorkManager processing.
4. Write to the documented Firestore path using stable identifiers.
5. Acknowledge the specific queued mutation, preserving any newer local edit.
6. Persist success/recovery feedback before removing completed queue work.

Transient failures retry with backoff. Permanent failures remain visible and retained. Repeated taps, worker restarts and reconnects must not create duplicate settlements or expenses.

**Implementation plan after approval**

| Phase | Proposed files/work | Verification before proceeding |
|---|---|---|
| **2 — Home** | `ui/screens/home/`, `HomeViewModel`, dashboard state/repository and minimal Person 4 contract | Summary aggregation, periods, donut selection, group filters and inline settlement states using test adapters |
| **3 — Activity** | `ui/screens/activity/`, `ActivityViewModel`, activity model/repository | Exact filter membership/counts, date sections, unread behavior and inline actions |
| **4 — Offline** | Approved Room migration; existing entities/DAOs/converters; Firestore adapters; `SyncWorker`, scheduler and connectivity monitor | Migration preservation, atomic queueing, retries, restart recovery and server acknowledgement |
| **5 — Integration** | Minimal shell attachment, shared `OfflineBanner`/`SyncStatusStrip`, dependency catalog/Gradle/manifest changes | Navigation, real service integration, builds, tests and Android-versus-Hi-Fi visual comparison |

Likely additional files include local activity/read-state persistence, sync recovery metadata, migration tests, worker tests and dashboard/feed state tests. Shared schema additions will be explicit.

Dependencies will be declared through the version catalog: Room/compiler support, WorkManager, lifecycle ViewModel/Compose support and relevant testing libraries. Firebase remains the remote service. No additional dependency-injection framework or REST backend is needed.

**Acceptance and testing**

The verification will cover:

- Cached groups/expenses remaining readable after going offline and reopening the database.
- Person 4’s results remaining available from locally persisted ledger data.
- Failed writes surviving process restart.
- Repeated failure followed by genuine Firestore success.
- Correct pending → failed/retrying → synced feedback.
- Recovery feedback surviving completion while the screen is closed.
- Account isolation, duplicate prevention and incoming snapshots during pending edits.
- Individual and bulk settlement behavior, including partial failures.
- Rotation, lifecycle collection, empty states and Danish formatting.

    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.dashboard
    
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.model.SettlementStatus
    import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
    import java.util.Calendar
    import java.util.Date
    import java.util.Locale
    import java.util.TimeZone
    import kotlin.math.atan2
    import kotlin.math.hypot
    
    enum class GroupFilter(val label: String) { Recent("Recent"), Favourites("Favourites"), All("All") }
    
    enum class SpendPeriod(val label: String, val shortLabel: String, val caption: String) {
        Today("Today", "Today", "today"),
        Week("This week", "Week", "this week"),
        Month("This month", "Month", "this month"),
        Year("This year", "Year", "this year")
    }
    
    data class SpendSlice(
        val groupId: String,
        val amountCents: Long,
        val lastPayment: PaidOutPayment,
        val startDegrees: Float,
        val sweepDegrees: Float
    )
    
    fun filterGroups(groups: List<DashboardGroup>, filter: GroupFilter): List<DashboardGroup> =
        when (filter) {
            GroupFilter.Recent -> groups.sortedByDescending { it.lastActivityAt }
            GroupFilter.Favourites -> groups.filter { it.isFavourite }.sortedByDescending { it.lastActivityAt }
            GroupFilter.All -> groups.sortedBy { it.group.name.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) }
        }
    
    fun periodBounds(
        period: SpendPeriod,
        nowMillis: Long,
        timeZone: TimeZone = TimeZone.getDefault()
    ): LongRange {
        val start = Calendar.getInstance(timeZone).apply {
            timeInMillis = nowMillis
            set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0)
            set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0)
            set(Calendar.SECOND, 0)
            set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0)
            when (period) {
                SpendPeriod.Today -> Unit
                SpendPeriod.Week -> add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, -((get(Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK) + 5) % 7))
                SpendPeriod.Month -> set(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1)
                SpendPeriod.Year -> { set(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR, 1) }
            }
        }
        val end = (start.clone() as Calendar).apply {
            when (period) {
                SpendPeriod.Today -> add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1)
                SpendPeriod.Week -> add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 7)
                SpendPeriod.Month -> add(Calendar.MONTH, 1)
                SpendPeriod.Year -> add(Calendar.YEAR, 1)
            }
        }
        return start.timeInMillis until end.timeInMillis
    }
    
    fun spendSlices(data: HomeData, period: SpendPeriod): List<SpendSlice> {
        val bounds = periodBounds(period, data.nowMillis)
        val groupIds = data.groups.map { it.group.id }.toSet()
        val payments = data.paidOutPayments.orEmpty().filter {
            val payment = it.settlement
            payment.debtorId == data.user.id && payment.currency == "DKK" &&
                payment.status == SettlementStatus.COMPLETED && payment.amountCents > 0 &&
                payment.groupId in groupIds && payment.createdAt in bounds && payment.createdAt <= data.nowMillis
        }.distinctBy { it.settlement.id }
        val byGroup = payments.groupBy { it.settlement.groupId }
        val total = payments.sumOf { it.settlement.amountCents }.toDouble()
        var start = 0f
        return byGroup.map { (id, entries) ->
            val amount = entries.sumOf { it.settlement.amountCents }
            val sweep = (amount / total * 360.0).toFloat()
            SpendSlice(id, amount, entries.maxBy { it.settlement.createdAt }, start, sweep).also { start += sweep }
        }
    }
    
    fun hitTestSlice(x: Float, y: Float, slices: List<SpendSlice>, selectedGroupId: String?): String? {
        val radius = hypot(x - 0.5f, y - 0.5f)
        val angle = ((Math.toDegrees(atan2((y - 0.5f).toDouble(), (x - 0.5f).toDouble())) + 450) % 360).toFloat()
        return slices.firstOrNull {
            val outer = if (it.groupId == selectedGroupId) 69f / 140f else 62f / 140f
            radius in (40f / 140f)..outer && angle >= it.startDegrees + 1f &&
                angle <= it.startDegrees + it.sweepDegrees - 1f
        }?.groupId
    }
    
    fun dateText(millis: Long, pattern: String): String =
        SimpleDateFormat(pattern, Locale.ENGLISH).format(Date(millis))
    
    fun activityDay(millis: Long, nowMillis: Long): String {
        if (millis in periodBounds(SpendPeriod.Today, nowMillis)) return "Today"
        val yesterday = Calendar.getInstance().apply { timeInMillis = nowMillis; add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, -1) }
        return if (millis in periodBounds(SpendPeriod.Today, yesterday.timeInMillis)) "Yesterday" else "Earlier"
    }
    
    fun relativeDate(millis: Long, nowMillis: Long): String = when (val day = activityDay(millis, nowMillis)) {
        "Earlier" -> dateText(millis, "EEE d MMM")
        else -> day
    }

    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.viewmodel
    
    import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
    import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.dashboard.*
    import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
    import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
    
    sealed interface HomeUiState {
        data object Loading : HomeUiState
        data class Error(val message: String) : HomeUiState
        data class Success(
            val data: HomeData,
            val filter: GroupFilter = GroupFilter.Recent,
            val period: SpendPeriod = SpendPeriod.Month,
            val selectedGroupId: String? = null,
            val paymentsExpanded: Boolean = false,
            val confirmingAll: Boolean = false,
            val paymentStates: Map<String, InlineActionState> = emptyMap(),
            val canSettle: Boolean = false
        ) : HomeUiState {
            val payments: List<OutstandingPayment>
                get() = data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().filter {
                    it.transfer.debtorId == data.user.id && it.transfer.currency == "DKK" && it.transfer.amountCents > 0
                }.distinctBy { it.id }
            val unpaid: List<OutstandingPayment>
                get() = payments.filter { paymentStates[it.id] !is InlineActionState.Done }
            val isWorking: Boolean get() = paymentStates.values.any { it == InlineActionState.Working }
        }
    }
    
    class HomeViewModel(
        source: Flow<HomeData>,
        private val settlements: SettlementActions? = null
    ) : ViewModel() {
        private val mutableState = MutableStateFlow<HomeUiState>(HomeUiState.Loading)
        val state = mutableState.asStateFlow()
    
        init {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    source.collect { data ->
                        val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success
                        mutableState.value = if (current == null || current.data.user.id != data.user.id) {
                            HomeUiState.Success(data, canSettle = settlements != null)
                        } else current.copy(data = data)
                    }
                } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                    throw error
                } catch (error: Exception) {
                    mutableState.value = HomeUiState.Error(error.message ?: "Couldn't load your dashboard")
                }
            }
        }
    
        private fun update(change: (HomeUiState.Success) -> HomeUiState.Success) {
            mutableState.update { if (it is HomeUiState.Success) change(it) else it }
        }
    
        fun selectFilter(filter: GroupFilter) = update { it.copy(filter = filter) }
        fun selectPeriod(period: SpendPeriod) = update { it.copy(period = period, selectedGroupId = null) }
        fun selectSlice(groupId: String?) = update { it.copy(selectedGroupId = groupId) }
        fun togglePayments() = update { it.copy(paymentsExpanded = !it.paymentsExpanded, confirmingAll = false) }
        fun closePayments() = update { it.copy(paymentsExpanded = false, confirmingAll = false) }
    
        fun cancelPayment() = update {
            it.copy(confirmingAll = false, paymentStates = it.paymentStates.filterValues { value -> value != InlineActionState.Confirming })
        }
    
        fun askPayment(id: String) {
            cancelPayment()
            update {
                if (!it.canSettle || it.isWorking || it.unpaid.none { payment -> payment.id == id }) it
                else it.copy(paymentStates = it.paymentStates + (id to InlineActionState.Confirming))
            }
        }
    
        fun askAll() {
            cancelPayment()
            update { if (it.canSettle && !it.isWorking && it.unpaid.isNotEmpty()) it.copy(confirmingAll = true) else it }
        }
    
        fun confirmPayment(id: String) {
            val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return
            if (current.paymentStates[id] != InlineActionState.Confirming || current.isWorking) return
            record(current.unpaid.filter { it.id == id })
        }
    
        fun confirmAll() {
            val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return
            if (current.confirmingAll && !current.isWorking) record(current.unpaid)
        }
    
        private fun record(payments: List<OutstandingPayment>) {
            val actions = settlements ?: return
            val userId = (mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success)?.data?.user?.id ?: return
            update { it.copy(confirmingAll = false, paymentStates = it.paymentStates + payments.associate { p -> p.id to InlineActionState.Working }) }
            viewModelScope.launch {
                for (payment in payments) {
                    val latest = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return@launch
                    if (latest.data.user.id != userId) return@launch
                    val result = try {
                        check(latest.payments.any { it == payment }) { "This balance changed. Check the latest payment." }
                        InlineActionState.Done(actions.recordSettlement(payment))
                    } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                        throw error
                    } catch (error: Exception) {
                        InlineActionState.Failed(error.message ?: "Couldn't record this payment. Try again.")
                    }
                    update { if (it.data.user.id == userId) it.copy(paymentStates = it.paymentStates + (payment.id to result)) else it }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Composable
    fun DashboardSymbol(
        icon: DashboardIcon,
        modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
        colour: Color = AppColors.Ink900,
        description: String? = null
    ) {
        val vector = remember(icon, colour) {
            ImageVector.Builder(icon.name, 24.dp, 24.dp, 24f, 24f).addPath(
                pathData = addPathNodes(icon.path),
                fill = if (icon == DashboardIcon.Star) SolidColor(colour) else null,
                stroke = SolidColor(colour),
                strokeLineWidth = 1.8f,
                strokeLineCap = StrokeCap.Round,
                strokeLineJoin = StrokeJoin.Round
            ).build()
        }
        Icon(vector, contentDescription = description, modifier = modifier.size(24.dp), tint = colour)
    }

    @Composable
    fun SyncStatusStrip(status: SyncStatus, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
        val failed = status == SyncStatus.FAILED
        val synced = status == SyncStatus.SYNCED
        Surface(
            modifier,
            color = if (synced) AppColors.Green100 else if (failed) AppColors.Red50 else AppColors.Amber100,
            shape = AppShapes.Chip
        ) {
            Text(
                if (synced) "Synced" else if (failed) "Couldn't sync yet · retrying automatically" else "Saved on your phone · waiting to sync",
                Modifier.padding(horizontal = AppSpacing.Space12, vertical = AppSpacing.Space8),
                style = AppTypography.Label,
                color = if (synced) AppColors.Green700 else if (failed) AppColors.Red800 else AppColors.Amber800
            )
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    fun InlinePaymentActions(
        state: InlineActionState,
        amount: String,
        creditor: String,
        onAsk: () -> Unit,
        onCancel: () -> Unit,
        onConfirm: () -> Unit,
        modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
        enabled: Boolean = true,
        soft: Boolean = false
    ) {
        Column(modifier, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space8)) {
            when (state) {
                InlineActionState.Confirming -> Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space8)) {
                    DashboardButton("Cancel", onCancel, Modifier.weight(1f), AppColors.White, AppColors.Ink900, outlined = true)
                    DashboardButton("Confirm", onConfirm, Modifier.weight(1f), AppColors.Red700, AppColors.White)
                }
                InlineActionState.Working -> ActionStatus("Paying…", working = true)
                is InlineActionState.Done -> {
                    ActionStatus("Paid · settled with $creditor")
                    state.syncStatus?.takeIf { it != SyncStatus.SYNCED }?.let { SyncStatusStrip(it) }
                }
                else -> {
                    if (state is InlineActionState.Failed) {
                        Text(state.message, style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Amber800)
                    }
                    DashboardButton(
                        "Pay $amount", onAsk, Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        if (soft) AppColors.Red100 else AppColors.Red700,
                        if (soft) AppColors.Red700 else AppColors.White, enabled
                    )
                    if (!enabled) Text("Settlement service unavailable", style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun ActionStatus(text: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, working: Boolean = false) {
        Row(
            modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = AppTouchTargets.InlineButtonHeight)
                .background(if (working) AppColors.SurfaceSoft else AppColors.Green100, AppShapes.InlineButton)
                .padding(AppSpacing.Space8),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space8, Alignment.CenterHorizontally),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            if (working) CircularProgressIndicator(Modifier.size(16.dp), color = AppColors.Ink600, strokeWidth = 2.dp)
            else DashboardSymbol(DashboardIcon.Check, Modifier.size(18.dp), colour = AppColors.Green700)
            Text(text, style = AppTypography.ButtonInline, color = if (working) AppColors.Ink600 else AppColors.Green700)
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    fun BalanceChip(balanceCents: Long?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
        val colour = when {
            balanceCents == null -> AppColors.Ink600
            balanceCents < 0 -> AppColors.Red700
            balanceCents > 0 -> AppColors.Green700
            else -> AppColors.Ink600
        }
        val fill = when {
            balanceCents == null -> AppColors.Surface
            balanceCents < 0 -> AppColors.Red100
            balanceCents > 0 -> AppColors.Green100
            else -> AppColors.Surface
        }
        val text = when {
            balanceCents == null -> "Balance unavailable"
            balanceCents < 0 -> "You owe ${formatDanishAmountFromCents(-balanceCents, false)}"
            balanceCents > 0 -> "${formatDanishAmountFromCents(balanceCents, false, true)} to you"
            else -> "Settled"
        }
        Text(text, modifier.background(fill, AppShapes.Chip).padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 6.dp), style = AppTypography.Label, color = colour, maxLines = 2, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
    }

    @Composable
    fun PaidOutChart(
        data: HomeData,
        period: SpendPeriod,
        selectedGroupId: String?,
        onPeriod: (SpendPeriod) -> Unit,
        onSelect: (String?) -> Unit,
        onOpenGroup: (String) -> Unit,
        modifier: Modifier = Modifier
    ) {
        var menuOpen by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
        val slices = remember(data, period) { spendSlices(data, period) }
        val groups = remember(data.groups) { data.groups.associateBy { it.group.id } }
        val selected = slices.firstOrNull { it.groupId == selectedGroupId }
        Column(modifier, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space8)) {
            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                Text("Paid out", Modifier.weight(1f), style = AppTypography.CaptionStrong, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                Box {
                    TextButton(onClick = { menuOpen = true }, contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 4.dp)) {
                        Text(period.shortLabel, style = AppTypography.CaptionStrong, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                        DashboardSymbol(DashboardIcon.Chevron, Modifier.size(16.dp))
                    }
                    DropdownMenu(expanded = menuOpen, onDismissRequest = { menuOpen = false }, containerColor = AppColors.White) {
                        SpendPeriod.entries.forEach { item ->
                            DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text(item.label, style = AppTypography.CaptionStrong) }, onClick = { menuOpen = false; onPeriod(item) })
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Box(Modifier.size(140.dp).align(Alignment.CenterHorizontally), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                Canvas(
                    Modifier.fillMaxSize().semantics {
                        contentDescription = if (data.paidOutPayments == null) "Paid out data unavailable" else "Paid out ${formatDanishAmountFromCents(slices.sumOf { it.amountCents })} ${period.caption}"
                        customActions = slices.map { slice ->
                            CustomAccessibilityAction("${groups[slice.groupId]?.group?.name}: ${formatDanishAmountFromCents(slice.amountCents)}") { onSelect(slice.groupId); true }
                        }
                    }.pointerInput(slices, selectedGroupId) {
                        detectTapGestures { position ->
                            val id = hitTestSlice(position.x / size.width, position.y / size.height, slices, selectedGroupId)
                            onSelect(if (id == selectedGroupId) null else id)
                        }
                    }
                ) {
                    if (slices.isEmpty()) {
                        drawCircle(AppColors.Surface, radius = size.width * 62f / 140f)
                        drawCircle(AppColors.White, radius = size.width * 40f / 140f)
                    }
                    slices.forEach { slice ->
                        val centre = size.width / 2f
                        val outer = size.width * (if (slice.groupId == selectedGroupId) 69f else 62f) / 140f
                        val inner = size.width * 40f / 140f
                        val gap = minOf(2f, slice.sweepDegrees / 3f)
                        val start = slice.startDegrees - 90f + gap / 2
                        val sweep = slice.sweepDegrees - gap
                        val path = Path().apply {
                            arcTo(Rect(centre - outer, centre - outer, centre + outer, centre + outer), start, sweep, true)
                            arcTo(Rect(centre - inner, centre - inner, centre + inner, centre + inner), start + sweep, -sweep, false)
                            close()
                        }
                        drawPath(path, AppColors.groupColorAt(groups.getValue(slice.groupId).colourIndex), alpha = if (selected != null && slice.groupId != selectedGroupId) 0.45f else 1f)
                    }
                }
                Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally, modifier = Modifier.width(80.dp)) {
                    Text(if (data.paidOutPayments == null) "—" else formatDanishAmountFromCents(slices.sumOf { it.amountCents }, false), style = AppTypography.ItemTitle, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                    Text(if (data.paidOutPayments == null) "Unavailable" else "kr ${period.caption}", style = AppTypography.Tag, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                }
                if (selected != null) {
                    val group = groups.getValue(selected.groupId)
                    Popup(
                        alignment = Alignment.BottomEnd,
                        offset = IntOffset(0, 150),
                        onDismissRequest = { onSelect(null) },
                        properties = PopupProperties(focusable = true)
                    ) {
                        Surface(Modifier.width(232.dp), shape = AppShapes.ListCard, color = AppColors.White, shadowElevation = 12.dp) {
                            Column(Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                                    Box(Modifier.size(12.dp).background(AppColors.groupColorAt(group.colourIndex), AppShapes.Circle))
                                    Spacer(Modifier.width(AppSpacing.Space8))
                                    Text(group.group.name, Modifier.weight(1f), style = AppTypography.ItemTitle)
                                    IconButton(onClick = { onSelect(null) }, modifier = Modifier.size(AppTouchTargets.MinTouchTarget)) {
                                        DashboardSymbol(DashboardIcon.Close, description = "Close payment details")
                                    }
                                }
                                Text("Paid ${period.caption}", style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                                Text(formatDanishAmountFromCents(selected.amountCents), style = AppTypography.TopBarTitle)
                                Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().background(AppColors.SurfaceSoft, AppShapes.Chip).padding(10.dp)) {
                                    Text("Last payment", style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                                    Text("${formatDanishAmountFromCents(selected.lastPayment.settlement.amountCents)} to ${selected.lastPayment.creditorName} · ${relativeDate(selected.lastPayment.settlement.createdAt, data.nowMillis)}", style = AppTypography.CaptionStrong)
                                }
                                DashboardButton("Open group →", { onSelect(null); onOpenGroup(group.group.id) }, Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    sealed interface HomeAction {
        data class Filter(val filter: GroupFilter) : HomeAction
        data class Period(val period: SpendPeriod) : HomeAction
        data class Slice(val groupId: String?) : HomeAction
        data class Ask(val paymentId: String) : HomeAction
        data class Confirm(val paymentId: String) : HomeAction
        data object TogglePayments : HomeAction
        data object ClosePayments : HomeAction
        data object Cancel : HomeAction
        data object AskAll : HomeAction
        data object ConfirmAll : HomeAction
    }
    
    @Composable
    fun HomeRoute(
        viewModel: HomeViewModel,
        onOpenActivity: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroups: () -> Unit,
        onCreateGroup: () -> Unit,
        onJoinGroup: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroup: (String) -> Unit,
        modifier: Modifier = Modifier
    ) {
        val state by viewModel.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
        HomeScreen(state, { action ->
            when (action) {
                is HomeAction.Filter -> viewModel.selectFilter(action.filter)
                is HomeAction.Period -> viewModel.selectPeriod(action.period)
                is HomeAction.Slice -> viewModel.selectSlice(action.groupId)
                is HomeAction.Ask -> viewModel.askPayment(action.paymentId)
                is HomeAction.Confirm -> viewModel.confirmPayment(action.paymentId)
                HomeAction.TogglePayments -> viewModel.togglePayments()
                HomeAction.ClosePayments -> viewModel.closePayments()
                HomeAction.Cancel -> viewModel.cancelPayment()
                HomeAction.AskAll -> viewModel.askAll()
                HomeAction.ConfirmAll -> viewModel.confirmAll()
            }
        }, onOpenActivity, onOpenGroups, onCreateGroup, onJoinGroup, onOpenGroup, modifier)
    }
    
    @Composable
    fun HomeScreen(
        state: HomeUiState,
        onAction: (HomeAction) -> Unit,
        onOpenActivity: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroups: () -> Unit,
        onCreateGroup: () -> Unit,
        onJoinGroup: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroup: (String) -> Unit,
        modifier: Modifier = Modifier
    ) {
        when (state) {
            HomeUiState.Loading -> Box(modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) { CircularProgressIndicator(color = AppColors.Green700) }
            is HomeUiState.Error -> Box(modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(AppSpacing.Space16), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) { Text(state.message, style = AppTypography.Body, color = AppColors.Ink600) }
            is HomeUiState.Success -> HomeContent(state, onAction, onOpenActivity, onOpenGroups, onCreateGroup, onJoinGroup, onOpenGroup, modifier)
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    private fun HomeContent(
        state: HomeUiState.Success,
        onAction: (HomeAction) -> Unit,
        onOpenActivity: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroups: () -> Unit,
        onCreateGroup: () -> Unit,
        onJoinGroup: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroup: (String) -> Unit,
        modifier: Modifier
    ) {
        val data = state.data
        val groups = remember(data.groups, state.filter) { filterGroups(data.groups, state.filter) }
        LazyColumn(
            modifier.fillMaxSize().background(AppColors.White),
            contentPadding = PaddingValues(start = AppSpacing.Space16, end = AppSpacing.Space16, top = AppSpacing.Space20, bottom = AppSpacing.Space24),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space8)
        ) {
            item("header") {
                Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(top = AppSpacing.Space8, bottom = AppSpacing.Space12), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                        Text(dateText(data.nowMillis, "EEEE d MMMM"), style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                        Text("Hi, ${data.user.displayName.substringBefore(' ')}", style = AppTypography.ScreenTitle, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                    }
                    Surface(shape = AppShapes.Circle, border = BorderStroke(1.dp, AppColors.Line), color = AppColors.White) {
                        IconButton(onClick = onOpenActivity, modifier = Modifier.size(AppTouchTargets.MinTouchTarget)) {
                            Box {
                                DashboardSymbol(DashboardIcon.Bell, description = if (data.hasUnreadActivity) "Activity, unread notifications" else "Activity")
                                if (data.hasUnreadActivity) Box(Modifier.align(Alignment.TopEnd).size(8.dp).background(AppColors.Green500, AppShapes.Circle))
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            data.offlineSavedAt?.let { savedAt -> item("offline") { OfflineBanner(dateText(savedAt, "HH:mm"), Modifier.padding(bottom = AppSpacing.Space12)) } }
            if (data.groups.isEmpty()) {
                item("empty") {
                    Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(top = 56.dp), horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space12)) {
                        DashboardAvatar(data.user.displayName, AppColors.Green300, Modifier.size(80.dp), round = true)
                        Text("No groups yet", style = AppTypography.ScreenTitleLarge, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                        Text("Make a group for your flat, a trip or Friday bar. Add an expense and we'll keep track of who owes what.", style = AppTypography.Body, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                        DashboardButton("Create a group", onCreateGroup, Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = AppTouchTargets.PrimaryButtonHeight), AppColors.Green700, AppColors.White)
                        TextButton(onClick = onJoinGroup) { Text("Join with an invite link", style = AppTypography.ButtonSecondary, color = AppColors.Green700) }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                item("summary") {
                    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(bottom = AppSpacing.Space12), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space12)) {
                        BalanceHero(state, { onAction(HomeAction.TogglePayments) }, Modifier.weight(1f))
                        Surface(Modifier.weight(1f).heightIn(min = 212.dp), shape = AppShapes.HeroCard, border = BorderStroke(1.dp, AppColors.Line), color = AppColors.White) {
                            PaidOutChart(data, state.period, state.selectedGroupId, { onAction(HomeAction.Period(it)) }, { onAction(HomeAction.Slice(it)) }, onOpenGroup, Modifier.padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = AppSpacing.Space8))
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (state.paymentsExpanded) item("payments") { PaymentsDue(state, onAction, Modifier.padding(bottom = AppSpacing.Space12)) }
                item("group-heading") {
                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        Text("Your groups", Modifier.weight(1f), style = AppTypography.Section, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                        TextButton(onClick = onCreateGroup) { Text("New group", style = AppTypography.ButtonInline, color = AppColors.Green700) }
                    }
                }
                item("group-filter") {
                    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().background(AppColors.Surface, AppShapes.SegmentedBar).padding(AppSpacing.Space4), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space4)) {
                        GroupFilter.entries.forEach { filter ->
                            Surface(Modifier.weight(1f), shape = AppShapes.Chip, color = if (state.filter == filter) AppColors.White else AppColors.Surface) {
                                TextButton(onClick = { onAction(HomeAction.Filter(filter)) }) {
                                    Text(filter.label, style = AppTypography.ButtonInline, color = if (state.filter == filter) AppColors.Ink900 else AppColors.Ink600)
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                items(groups.take(6), key = { "group-${it.group.id}" }) { group ->
                    GroupRow(group, state, { onOpenGroup(group.group.id) })
                }
                if (groups.isEmpty()) item("no-favourites") {
                    Text("No favourites yet. Star a group to pin it here.", Modifier.fillMaxWidth().background(AppColors.SurfaceSoft, AppShapes.ListCard).padding(AppSpacing.Space20), style = AppTypography.Body, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                }
                if (groups.size > 6) item("see-all") {
                    DashboardButton("See all ${groups.size} groups →", onOpenGroups, Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = AppTouchTargets.SecondaryButtonHeight), AppColors.White, AppColors.Green700, outlined = true)
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    private fun BalanceHero(state: HomeUiState.Success, onToggle: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier) {
        val finances = state.data.finances
        val available = finances != null && state.data.groups.all { group ->
            finances.balancesByGroup[group.group.id]?.let { it.currency == "DKK" && it.userId == state.data.user.id } == true
        }
        val owes = state.unpaid.sumOf { it.transfer.amountCents }
        val owed = finances?.balancesByGroup?.values?.filter { it.currency == "DKK" && it.userId == state.data.user.id && it.netBalanceCents > 0 }?.sumOf { it.netBalanceCents } ?: 0
        val owing = available && owes > 0
        Surface(modifier.heightIn(min = 212.dp), shape = AppShapes.HeroCard, color = if (!available) AppColors.Surface else if (owing) AppColors.Red100 else AppColors.Green100) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = AppSpacing.Space16), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space8)) {
                if (!available) {
                    Text("Balance unavailable", style = AppTypography.Section, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                    Text("Waiting for balance information", style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                } else if (owing) {
                    Text("You owe", style = AppTypography.CaptionStrong, color = AppColors.Red800)
                    Text(formatDanishAmountFromCents(owes), style = AppTypography.Amount, color = AppColors.Red700)
                    Text("${state.unpaid.map { it.groupId }.distinct().size} groups", style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Red800)
                    DashboardButton(if (state.paymentsExpanded) "Hide ⌃" else "Pay now ⌄", onToggle, Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), AppColors.Red700, AppColors.White)
                } else {
                    Box(Modifier.size(44.dp).background(AppColors.White, AppShapes.Circle), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) { DashboardSymbol(DashboardIcon.Check, colour = AppColors.Green700) }
                    Text("All paid up", style = AppTypography.ScreenTitle, color = AppColors.Green700)
                    Text("You don't owe anyone right now. Nice work.", style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Green600)
                    Text("${formatDanishAmountFromCents(owed, includePlusSign = true)} owed to you", style = AppTypography.CaptionStrong, color = AppColors.Green700)
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    private fun PaymentsDue(state: HomeUiState.Success, onAction: (HomeAction) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier) {
        val clear = state.unpaid.isEmpty()
        Surface(modifier.fillMaxWidth(), color = if (clear) AppColors.Green50 else AppColors.Red50, shape = AppShapes.HeroCard, border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (clear) AppColors.Green200 else AppColors.Red200)) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                if (clear) {
                    val progress = remember { Animatable(1f) }
                    val close by rememberUpdatedState(onAction)
                    LaunchedEffect(Unit) { progress.animateTo(0f, tween(5000)); close(HomeAction.ClosePayments) }
                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        Text("No payments due", Modifier.weight(1f), style = AppTypography.Section, color = AppColors.Green700)
                        IconButton(onClick = { onAction(HomeAction.ClosePayments) }) { DashboardSymbol(DashboardIcon.Close, description = "Close payments") }
                    }
                    Text("You're all square with every group. We'll let you know when something new comes in.", style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                    LinearProgressIndicator(progress = { progress.value }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), color = AppColors.Green500, trackColor = AppColors.Green100)
                } else {
                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                            Text("Payments due", style = AppTypography.Subsection, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                            Text("${state.unpaid.map { it.groupId }.distinct().size} groups · ${formatDanishAmountFromCents(state.unpaid.sumOf { it.transfer.amountCents })}", style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Red800)
                        }
                        if (!state.confirmingAll) DashboardButton("Pay all", { onAction(HomeAction.AskAll) }, container = AppColors.Red700, content = AppColors.White, enabled = state.canSettle && !state.isWorking)
                    }
                    if (state.confirmingAll) {
                        Surface(color = AppColors.White, shape = AppShapes.BigButton) {
                            Column(Modifier.padding(AppSpacing.Space12), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                                Text("Pay ${formatDanishAmountFromCents(state.unpaid.sumOf { it.transfer.amountCents })} to ${state.unpaid.map { it.groupId }.distinct().size} groups?", style = AppTypography.BodyStrong)
                                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space8)) {
                                    DashboardButton("Cancel", { onAction(HomeAction.Cancel) }, Modifier.weight(1f), AppColors.White, AppColors.Ink900, outlined = true)
                                    DashboardButton("Confirm", { onAction(HomeAction.ConfirmAll) }, Modifier.weight(1f), AppColors.Red700, AppColors.White)
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                state.payments.forEach { payment ->
                    val action = state.paymentStates[payment.id] ?: InlineActionState.Idle
                    if (!clear || action is InlineActionState.Done) {
                        val group = state.data.groups.firstOrNull { it.group.id == payment.groupId }
                        Surface(color = if (action is InlineActionState.Done) AppColors.Green50 else AppColors.White, shape = AppShapes.BigButton) {
                            Column(Modifier.padding(AppSpacing.Space12), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space12)) {
                                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space12)) {
                                    DashboardAvatar(group?.group?.name ?: "?", AppColors.groupColorAt(group?.colourIndex ?: 0))
                                    Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                                        Text(group?.group?.name ?: "Group unavailable", style = AppTypography.ItemTitle, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                                        Text("To ${payment.creditorName} · Since ${relativeDate(payment.since, state.data.nowMillis).lowercase()}", style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                                    }
                                    Text(formatDanishAmountFromCents(payment.transfer.amountCents), style = AppTypography.BodyStrong, color = if (action is InlineActionState.Done) AppColors.Green700 else AppColors.Red700)
                                }
                                InlinePaymentActions(action, formatDanishAmountFromCents(payment.transfer.amountCents), payment.creditorName, { onAction(HomeAction.Ask(payment.id)) }, { onAction(HomeAction.Cancel) }, { onAction(HomeAction.Confirm(payment.id)) }, enabled = state.canSettle && (!state.isWorking || action == InlineActionState.Working), soft = true)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    private fun GroupRow(group: DashboardGroup, state: HomeUiState.Success, onClick: () -> Unit) {
        val balance = state.data.finances?.balancesByGroup?.get(group.group.id)?.takeIf { it.currency == "DKK" && it.userId == state.data.user.id }?.netBalanceCents
        val groupPayments = state.payments.filter { it.groupId == group.group.id }
        val shownBalance = if (balance != null && balance < 0 && groupPayments.isNotEmpty()) -state.unpaid.filter { it.groupId == group.group.id }.sumOf { it.transfer.amountCents } else balance
        Surface(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clickable(onClick = onClick), shape = AppShapes.ListCard, border = BorderStroke(1.dp, AppColors.LineSoft), color = AppColors.White) {
            Row(Modifier.padding(AppSpacing.Space12), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space12)) {
                DashboardAvatar(group.group.name, AppColors.groupColorAt(group.colourIndex))
                Column(Modifier.weight(1f), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        Text(group.group.name, Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false), style = AppTypography.ItemTitle, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                        if (group.isFavourite) DashboardSymbol(DashboardIcon.Star, Modifier.padding(start = AppSpacing.Space4).size(14.dp), AppColors.StarGold, "Favourite")
                    }
                    if (group.pendingExpenseCount > 0) {
                        Text("${group.pendingExpenseCount} expense${if (group.pendingExpenseCount == 1) "" else "s"} waiting to sync", style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Amber700)
                    } else Text("${group.group.members.size} members · Active ${relativeDate(group.lastActivityAt, state.data.nowMillis).lowercase()}", style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                }
                BalanceChip(shownBalance, Modifier.widthIn(max = 126.dp))
            }
        }
    }

    import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable

    private const val PreviewNow = 1793703600000L
    
    private fun previewHomeData(): HomeData {
        val user = User("you", "preview@example.com", "Victor")
        val definitions = listOf(
            Triple("ski", "Ski trip Åre", 1), Triple("friday", "Friday Bar crew", 2),
            Triple("padel", "Padel Tuesdays", 5), Triple("flat", "Kollegiet 4. sal", 0)
        )
        val groups = definitions.mapIndexed { index, (id, name, colour) ->
            DashboardGroup(Group(id, name, currency = "DKK", createdBy = "you", members = listOf(GroupMember(id, "you"))), colour, index != 2, PreviewNow - index * 86400000L, if (id == "flat") 1 else 0)
        }
        val payments = listOf(
            OutstandingPayment("ski-mads", "ski", "Mads", PreviewNow - 2 * 86400000L, DebtTransfer("you", "mads", 28600, "DKK")),
            OutstandingPayment("friday-sofie", "friday", "Sofie", PreviewNow, DebtTransfer("you", "sofie", 9450, "DKK")),
            OutstandingPayment("padel-jonas", "padel", "Jonas", PreviewNow - 86400000L, DebtTransfer("you", "jonas", 3200, "DKK"))
        )
        val balances = mapOf("ski" to -28600L, "friday" to -9450L, "padel" to -3200L, "flat" to 14500L).mapValues { MemberBalance("you", it.value, "DKK") }
        val spend = listOf("ski" to 120000L, "flat" to 62000L, "friday" to 38000L, "padel" to 16000L).map { (id, amount) ->
            PaidOutPayment(Settlement("paid-$id", id, "you", "mads", amount, "DKK", "Cash", createdAt = PreviewNow - 86400000L), "Mads")
        }
        return HomeData(user, groups, FinancialSummary(balances, payments), spend, true, nowMillis = PreviewNow)
    }

    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.dashboard
    
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.model.*
    import org.junit.Assert.*
    import org.junit.Test
    import java.util.Calendar
    import java.util.TimeZone
    
    class HomePresentationTest {
        private val zone = TimeZone.getTimeZone("Europe/Copenhagen")
        private fun time(year: Int, month: Int, day: Int, hour: Int = 12): Long =
            Calendar.getInstance(zone).apply { clear(); set(year, month - 1, day, hour, 0) }.timeInMillis
    
        @Test fun weekStartsMondayAndEndsBeforeNextMonday() {
            val bounds = periodBounds(SpendPeriod.Week, time(2026, 11, 8), zone)
            assertEquals(time(2026, 11, 2, 0), bounds.first)
            assertEquals(time(2026, 11, 9, 0) - 1, bounds.last)
        }
    
        @Test fun todayHandlesDaylightSavingWithoutAssumingTwentyFourHours() {
            val bounds = periodBounds(SpendPeriod.Today, time(2026, 10, 25), zone)
            assertEquals(25 * 60 * 60 * 1000L, bounds.last - bounds.first + 1)
        }
    
        @Test fun favouritesAreFilteredAndAllIsAlphabetical() {
            val groups = listOf(
                DashboardGroup(Group("b", "Beta", createdBy = "u"), 0, lastActivityAt = 2),
                DashboardGroup(Group("a", "Alpha", createdBy = "u"), 1, isFavourite = true, lastActivityAt = 1)
            )
            assertEquals(listOf("b", "a"), filterGroups(groups, GroupFilter.Recent).map { it.group.id })
            assertEquals(listOf("a"), filterGroups(groups, GroupFilter.Favourites).map { it.group.id })
            assertEquals(listOf("a", "b"), filterGroups(groups, GroupFilter.All).map { it.group.id })
        }
    
        @Test fun donutExcludesOtherUsersCurrenciesPendingAndDuplicateRecords() {
            val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
            val payment = PaidOutPayment(Settlement("p", "g", "u", "c", 12345, "DKK", "Cash", createdAt = now), "Creditor")
            val data = HomeData(User("u", "u@test", "User"), listOf(DashboardGroup(Group("g", "Group", createdBy = "u"), 0)), paidOutPayments = listOf(
                payment, payment,
                payment.copy(settlement = payment.settlement.copy(id = "other", debtorId = "someone")),
                payment.copy(settlement = payment.settlement.copy(id = "euro", currency = "EUR")),
                payment.copy(settlement = payment.settlement.copy(id = "pending", status = SettlementStatus.PENDING))
            ), nowMillis = now)
            val slices = spendSlices(data, SpendPeriod.Today)
            assertEquals(12345L, slices.single().amountCents)
            assertEquals(360f, slices.single().sweepDegrees)
            assertNull(hitTestSlice(0.5f, 0.5f, slices, null))
            assertEquals("g", hitTestSlice(0.9f, 0.5f, slices, null))
            assertNull(hitTestSlice(1f, 0.5f, slices, null))
        }
    
        @Test fun emptySpendDoesNotProduceInvalidSlices() {
            val data = HomeData(User("u", "u@test", "User"), emptyList(), paidOutPayments = emptyList())
            assertTrue(spendSlices(data, SpendPeriod.Month).isEmpty())
            assertNull(hitTestSlice(0.9f, 0.5f, emptyList(), null))
        }
    }

    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.dashboard
    
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.model.*
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.viewmodel.HomeUiState
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.viewmodel.HomeViewModel
    import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
    import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
    import kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.test.*
    import org.junit.After
    import org.junit.Assert.*
    import org.junit.Before
    import org.junit.Test
    
    @OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
    class HomeViewModelTest {
        private val dispatcher = UnconfinedTestDispatcher()
        private val payment = OutstandingPayment("p", "g", "Mads", 1, DebtTransfer("u", "m", 1234, "DKK"))
        private fun data() = HomeData(User("u", "u@test", "User"), listOf(DashboardGroup(Group("g", "Group", createdBy = "u"), 0)), FinancialSummary(mapOf("g" to MemberBalance("u", -1234, "DKK")), listOf(payment)))
        @Before fun setUp() = Dispatchers.setMain(dispatcher)
        @After fun tearDown() = Dispatchers.resetMain()
        private fun HomeViewModel.current() = state.value as HomeUiState.Success
    
        @Test fun confirmationDoesNotRecordUntilConfirmedAndDoubleTapIsIgnored() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            var calls = 0
            val result = CompletableDeferred<SyncStatus>()
            val vm = HomeViewModel(MutableStateFlow(data()), SettlementActions { calls++; result.await() })
            vm.askPayment("p")
            assertEquals(0, calls)
            vm.cancelPayment()
            vm.confirmPayment("p")
            assertEquals(0, calls)
            vm.askPayment("p")
            vm.confirmPayment("p")
            vm.confirmPayment("p")
            assertEquals(1, calls)
            assertEquals(InlineActionState.Working, vm.current().paymentStates["p"])
            result.complete(SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT)
            assertEquals(InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT), vm.current().paymentStates["p"])
            assertTrue(vm.current().unpaid.isEmpty())
        }
    
        @Test fun failedOperationKeepsDebtAndCanBeRetried() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            var calls = 0
            val vm = HomeViewModel(MutableStateFlow(data()), SettlementActions { calls++; if (calls == 1) error("Not saved") else SyncStatus.SYNCED })
            vm.askPayment("p"); vm.confirmPayment("p")
            assertTrue(vm.current().paymentStates["p"] is InlineActionState.Failed)
            assertEquals(1, vm.current().unpaid.size)
            vm.askPayment("p"); vm.confirmPayment("p")
            assertEquals(2, calls)
            assertTrue(vm.current().unpaid.isEmpty())
        }
    
        @Test fun missingServiceDoesNotPretendPaymentWorked() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val vm = HomeViewModel(MutableStateFlow(data()))
            vm.askAll(); vm.confirmAll(); vm.askPayment("p"); vm.confirmPayment("p")
            assertFalse(vm.current().canSettle)
            assertEquals(1, vm.current().unpaid.size)
            assertTrue(vm.current().paymentStates.isEmpty())
        }
    
        @Test fun payAllKeepsIndependentResultsWhenOneOperationFails() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val other = payment.copy(id = "p2", transfer = payment.transfer.copy(creditorId = "other"))
            val input = data().copy(finances = data().finances!!.copy(outstandingPayments = listOf(payment, other)))
            val vm = HomeViewModel(MutableStateFlow(input), SettlementActions { if (it.id == "p2") error("Not saved") else SyncStatus.SYNCED })
            vm.askAll(); vm.confirmAll()
            assertTrue(vm.current().paymentStates["p"] is InlineActionState.Done)
            assertTrue(vm.current().paymentStates["p2"] is InlineActionState.Failed)
            assertEquals(listOf(other), vm.current().unpaid)
        }
    
        @Test fun cachedSnapshotCanRenderWithOfflineMarkerWithoutAnyRemoteCall() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val cached = data().copy(offlineSavedAt = 123L)
            val vm = HomeViewModel(MutableStateFlow(cached))
            assertEquals(cached, vm.current().data)
            assertEquals(123L, vm.current().data.offlineSavedAt)
        }
    }
