    def version_key(path):
        return tuple(int(x) for x in re.findall(r'\d+', path.name))
    
    def files(group, artifact, preferred=None):
        base = cache / group / artifact
        if not base.exists():
            return []
        versions = sorted(base.iterdir(), key=version_key, reverse=True)
        selected = base / preferred if preferred and (base / preferred).exists() else versions[0]
        return list(selected.rglob('*.jar')) + list(selected.rglob('*.aar'))
    
    classpath = []
    for group in cache.iterdir():
        if group.name.startswith(('androidx.compose.', 'androidx.lifecycle', 'androidx.savedstate', 'androidx.activity', 'androidx.annotation', 'androidx.collection', 'androidx.core', 'androidx.arch.core')):
            for artifact in group.iterdir():
                preferred = '1.9.0' if group.name.startswith('androidx.compose.') and group.name != 'androidx.compose.material3' else '2.10.0'
                for item in files(group.name, artifact.name, preferred):
                    if item.suffix == '.aar':
                        target = out / ('jars/' + group.name + '-' + artifact.name + '-' + item.parent.parent.name + '.jar')
                        target.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
                        with zipfile.ZipFile(item) as archive:
                            if 'classes.jar' not in archive.namelist():
                                continue
                            target.write_bytes(archive.read('classes.jar'))
                        classpath.append(target)
                    else:
                        classpath.append(item)
    for group, artifact, preferred in [
        ('org.jetbrains.kotlin', 'kotlin-stdlib', '2.2.10'),

        ('junit', 'junit', '4.13.2'), ('org.hamcrest', 'hamcrest-core', '1.3')

    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.dashboard
    
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.model.SyncStatus
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.model.User
    
    enum class ActivityType { ExpenseAdded, ExpenseChanged, Payment, Reminder, SyncFailure }
    enum class AmountDirection { Owed, Received, Settled, Neutral }
    enum class ActivityFilter(val label: String) { All("All"), NeedsYou("Needs you"), Expenses("Expenses"), Payments("Payments") }
    
    data class ActivityEvent(
        val id: String,
        val type: ActivityType,
        val actor: User?,
        val actorColourIndex: Int,
        val description: String,
        val group: DashboardGroup,
        val occurredAt: Long,
        val amountCents: Long? = null,
        val currency: String = "DKK",
        val direction: AmountDirection = AmountDirection.Neutral,
        val unread: Boolean = false,
        val payment: OutstandingPayment? = null,
        val syncStatus: SyncStatus? = null,
        val expenseTitle: String? = null
    )
    
    data class ActivityData(
        val userId: String,
        val events: List<ActivityEvent>? = null,
        val nowMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    )
    
    fun interface SyncRetryActions {
        suspend fun retry(event: ActivityEvent): SyncStatus
    }
    
    fun ActivityEvent.canPay(userId: String): Boolean = type == ActivityType.Reminder && payment?.let {
        it.groupId == group.group.id && it.transfer.debtorId == userId &&
            it.transfer.currency == "DKK" && it.transfer.amountCents > 0
    } == true
    
    fun ActivityEvent.needsAction(userId: String, state: InlineActionState): Boolean = when {
        canPay(userId) -> state !is InlineActionState.Done
        type == ActivityType.SyncFailure -> syncStatus != SyncStatus.SYNCED &&
            !(state is InlineActionState.Done && state.syncStatus == SyncStatus.SYNCED)
        else -> false
    }
    
    fun filterActivities(
        events: List<ActivityEvent>,
        userId: String,
        filter: ActivityFilter,
        actions: Map<String, InlineActionState>
    ): List<ActivityEvent> = events.distinctBy { it.id }.filter {
        when (filter) {
            ActivityFilter.All -> true
            ActivityFilter.NeedsYou -> it.needsAction(userId, actions[it.id] ?: InlineActionState.Idle)
            ActivityFilter.Expenses -> it.type in listOf(ActivityType.ExpenseAdded, ActivityType.ExpenseChanged, ActivityType.SyncFailure)
            ActivityFilter.Payments -> it.type == ActivityType.Payment || it.type == ActivityType.Reminder
        }
    }.sortedByDescending { it.occurredAt }

    sealed interface ActivityAction {
        data class Filter(val filter: ActivityFilter) : ActivityAction
        data class Ask(val eventId: String) : ActivityAction
        data class Confirm(val eventId: String) : ActivityAction
        data class Retry(val eventId: String) : ActivityAction
        data object Cancel : ActivityAction
        data object MarkAllRead : ActivityAction
    }
    
    @Composable
    fun ActivityRoute(viewModel: ActivityViewModel, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
        val state by viewModel.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
        ActivityScreen(state, { action ->
            when (action) {
                is ActivityAction.Filter -> viewModel.selectFilter(action.filter)
                is ActivityAction.Ask -> viewModel.askPayment(action.eventId)
                is ActivityAction.Confirm -> viewModel.confirmPayment(action.eventId)
                is ActivityAction.Retry -> viewModel.retry(action.eventId)
                ActivityAction.Cancel -> viewModel.cancelPayment()
                ActivityAction.MarkAllRead -> viewModel.markAllRead()
            }
        }, modifier)
    }
    
    @Composable
    fun ActivityScreen(state: ActivityUiState, onAction: (ActivityAction) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
        when (state) {
            ActivityUiState.Loading -> Box(modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) { CircularProgressIndicator(color = AppColors.Green700) }
            is ActivityUiState.Error -> Box(modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(AppSpacing.Space16), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) { Text(state.message, style = AppTypography.Body, color = AppColors.Ink600) }
            is ActivityUiState.Success -> ActivityContent(state, onAction, modifier)
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    private fun ActivityContent(state: ActivityUiState.Success, onAction: (ActivityAction) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier) {
        val shown = remember(state.data, state.filter, state.actions) { filterActivities(state.events, state.data.userId, state.filter, state.actions) }
        val sections = remember(shown, state.data.nowMillis) { shown.groupBy { activityDay(it.occurredAt, state.data.nowMillis) } }
        Column(modifier.fillMaxSize().background(AppColors.White)) {
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(start = AppSpacing.Space16, end = AppSpacing.Space16, top = 28.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                Text("Activity", Modifier.weight(1f), style = AppTypography.ScreenTitleLarge, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                if (state.hasUnread) TextButton(onClick = { onAction(ActivityAction.MarkAllRead) }) { Text("Mark all as read", style = AppTypography.ButtonInline, color = AppColors.Green700) }
            }
            LazyRow(contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = AppSpacing.Space16, vertical = AppSpacing.Space12), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space8)) {
                items(ActivityFilter.entries) { filter ->
                    val selected = state.filter == filter
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = selected,
                        onClick = { onAction(ActivityAction.Filter(filter)) },
                        label = { Text(if (filter == ActivityFilter.NeedsYou) "Needs you · ${state.needsCount}" else filter.label, style = AppTypography.ButtonInline) },
                        shape = AppShapes.Pill,
                        modifier = Modifier.heightIn(min = AppTouchTargets.MinTouchTarget),
                        colors = FilterChipDefaults.filterChipColors(containerColor = AppColors.White, labelColor = AppColors.Ink900, selectedContainerColor = AppColors.Ink900, selectedLabelColor = AppColors.White),
                        border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (selected) AppColors.Ink900 else AppColors.Line)
                    )
                }
            }
            LazyColumn(
                Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(),
                contentPadding = PaddingValues(start = AppSpacing.Space16, end = AppSpacing.Space16, bottom = AppSpacing.Space24),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
            ) {
                if (state.data.events == null) item("unavailable") {
                    Text("Activity history unavailable", Modifier.padding(AppSpacing.Space20), style = AppTypography.Body, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                } else if (shown.isEmpty()) item("empty") {
                    Surface(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(top = AppSpacing.Space24), color = AppColors.Green50, shape = AppShapes.ListCard) {
                        Column(Modifier.padding(horizontal = AppSpacing.Space20, vertical = 32.dp), horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                            Text(if (state.filter == ActivityFilter.NeedsYou) "Nothing needs you right now" else "No activity yet", style = AppTypography.Subsection, color = AppColors.Green700)
                            Text(if (state.filter == ActivityFilter.NeedsYou) "No payments due and everything is synced." else "Activity will appear here when there's something to show.", style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Green600)
                        }
                    }
                }
                listOf("Today", "Yesterday", "Earlier").forEach { day ->
                    val events = sections[day].orEmpty()
                    if (events.isNotEmpty()) {
                        item("section-$day") { Text(day, Modifier.padding(start = AppSpacing.Space4, top = AppSpacing.Space12, bottom = 2.dp), style = AppTypography.CaptionStrong, color = AppColors.Ink600) }
                        items(events, key = { it.id }) { event -> ActivityCard(event, state, onAction) }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    private fun ActivityCard(event: ActivityEvent, state: ActivityUiState.Success, onAction: (ActivityAction) -> Unit) {
        val action = state.actionFor(event)
        val unread = event.unread && event.id !in state.readIds
        val done = action is InlineActionState.Done && (event.type != ActivityType.SyncFailure || action.syncStatus == SyncStatus.SYNCED)
        Surface(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), shape = AppShapes.BigButton,
            color = if (done) AppColors.Green50 else if (unread) AppColors.Green50.copy(alpha = 0.55f) else AppColors.White,
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (done || unread) AppColors.Green200 else AppColors.LineSoft)
        ) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(AppSpacing.Space12), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space12)) {
                    EventAvatar(event, state.data.userId)
                    Column(Modifier.weight(1f), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp)) {
                        val actor = if (event.actor?.id == state.data.userId) "You" else event.actor?.displayName ?: event.expenseTitle.orEmpty()
                        Text(buildAnnotatedString {
                            withStyle(SpanStyle(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)) { append(actor) }
                            if (actor.isNotEmpty()) append(" ")
                            append(if (event.type == ActivityType.SyncFailure && done) "synced" else event.description)
                        }, style = AppTypography.BodyStrong, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                            Box(Modifier.size(8.dp).background(AppColors.groupColorAt(event.group.colourIndex), AppShapes.Circle))
                            Text("${event.group.group.name} · ${if (activityDay(event.occurredAt, state.data.nowMillis) == "Earlier") dateText(event.occurredAt, "EEE d MMM") else dateText(event.occurredAt, "HH:mm")}", style = AppTypography.Label, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                        }
                    }
                    Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                        event.amountCents?.let { amount ->
                            val colour = when {
                                done || event.direction == AmountDirection.Received || event.direction == AmountDirection.Settled -> AppColors.Green700
                                event.direction == AmountDirection.Owed -> AppColors.Red700
                                else -> AppColors.Ink900
                            }
                            Text(formatDanishAmountFromCents(amount, false, event.direction == AmountDirection.Received) + if (event.currency == "DKK") "" else " ${event.currency}", style = AppTypography.ItemTitle, color = colour)
                        }
                        if (unread) Box(Modifier.size(8.dp).background(AppColors.Green500, AppShapes.Circle).semantics { contentDescription = "Unread" })
                    }
                }
                if (event.canPay(state.data.userId)) {
                    val payment = event.payment!!
                    InlinePaymentActions(action, formatDanishAmountFromCents(payment.transfer.amountCents), payment.creditorName, { onAction(ActivityAction.Ask(event.id)) }, { onAction(ActivityAction.Cancel) }, { onAction(ActivityAction.Confirm(event.id)) }, Modifier.padding(start = 56.dp), enabled = state.canSettle)
                }
                if (event.type == ActivityType.SyncFailure) Column(Modifier.padding(start = 56.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space8)) {
                    when (action) {
                        InlineActionState.Working -> ActionStatus("Syncing…", working = true)
                        is InlineActionState.Done -> {
                            if (action.syncStatus == SyncStatus.SYNCED) ActionStatus("Synced")
                            else SyncStatusStrip(action.syncStatus ?: SyncStatus.PENDING_UPDATE)
                        }
                        else -> {
                            if (action is InlineActionState.Failed) Text(action.message, style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Amber800)
                            DashboardButton("Try now", { onAction(ActivityAction.Retry(event.id)) }, Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), AppColors.White, AppColors.Red800, state.canRetry, outlined = true)
                            if (!state.canRetry) Text("Sync service unavailable", style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    private fun EventAvatar(event: ActivityEvent, userId: String) {
        val failed = event.type == ActivityType.SyncFailure
        val colour = if (failed) AppColors.Red50 else if (event.actor?.id == userId) AppColors.Green300 else AppColors.groupColorAt(event.actorColourIndex)
        val badgeColour: Color = when (event.type) {
            ActivityType.Reminder, ActivityType.SyncFailure -> AppColors.Red700
            ActivityType.Payment -> AppColors.Green700
            ActivityType.ExpenseChanged -> AppColors.Ink600
            ActivityType.ExpenseAdded -> AppColors.Green500
        }
        val icon = when (event.type) {
            ActivityType.Reminder -> DashboardIcon.Bell
            ActivityType.SyncFailure -> DashboardIcon.Warning
            ActivityType.Payment -> DashboardIcon.Check
            ActivityType.ExpenseChanged -> DashboardIcon.Edit
            ActivityType.ExpenseAdded -> DashboardIcon.Plus
        }
        Box(Modifier.size(44.dp)) {
            DashboardAvatar(if (failed) "" else event.actor?.displayName.orEmpty(), colour, round = true)
            Surface(Modifier.size(20.dp).align(Alignment.BottomEnd).offset(3.dp, 3.dp), color = badgeColour, shape = AppShapes.Circle, border = BorderStroke(2.dp, AppColors.White)) {
                DashboardSymbol(icon, Modifier.padding(4.dp), colour = AppColors.White)
            }
        }
    }

    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.viewmodel
    
    import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
    import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.model.SyncStatus
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.dashboard.*
    import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
    import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
    
    sealed interface ActivityUiState {
        data object Loading : ActivityUiState
        data class Error(val message: String) : ActivityUiState
        data class Success(
            val data: ActivityData,
            val filter: ActivityFilter = ActivityFilter.All,
            val readIds: Set<String> = emptySet(),
            val actions: Map<String, InlineActionState> = emptyMap(),
            val canSettle: Boolean = false,
            val canRetry: Boolean = false
        ) : ActivityUiState {
            val events: List<ActivityEvent> get() = data.events.orEmpty().distinctBy { it.id }
            val needsCount: Int get() = events.count { it.needsAction(data.userId, actionFor(it)) }
            val hasUnread: Boolean get() = events.any { it.unread && it.id !in readIds }
            fun actionFor(event: ActivityEvent): InlineActionState =
                if (event.type == ActivityType.SyncFailure && event.syncStatus == SyncStatus.SYNCED) InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.SYNCED)
                else actions[event.id] ?: InlineActionState.Idle
        }
    }
    
    class ActivityViewModel(
        source: Flow<ActivityData>,
        private val settlements: SettlementActions? = null,
        private val retries: SyncRetryActions? = null
    ) : ViewModel() {
        private val mutableState = MutableStateFlow<ActivityUiState>(ActivityUiState.Loading)
        val state = mutableState.asStateFlow()
        private val activeIds = mutableSetOf<String>()
    
        init {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    source.collect { data ->
                        val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success
                        mutableState.value = if (current == null || current.data.userId != data.userId) {
                            ActivityUiState.Success(data, canSettle = settlements != null, canRetry = retries != null)
                        } else {
                            val unchangedIds = data.events.orEmpty().filter { next -> current.events.any { it.id == next.id && it.payment == next.payment } }.map { it.id }.toSet()
                            current.copy(data = data, actions = current.actions.filterKeys { it in unchangedIds })
                        }
                    }
                } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                    throw error
                } catch (error: Exception) {
                    mutableState.value = ActivityUiState.Error(error.message ?: "Couldn't load activity")
                }
            }
        }
    
        private fun update(change: (ActivityUiState.Success) -> ActivityUiState.Success) {
            mutableState.update { if (it is ActivityUiState.Success) change(it) else it }
        }
    
        fun selectFilter(filter: ActivityFilter) = update { it.copy(filter = filter) }
        fun markAllRead() = update { it.copy(readIds = it.readIds + it.events.map { event -> event.id }) }
    
        fun askPayment(id: String) = update {
            val event = it.events.firstOrNull { event -> event.id == id }
            if (event == null || !it.canSettle || !event.canPay(it.data.userId) || id in activeIds || it.actionFor(event) is InlineActionState.Done) it
            else it.copy(
                actions = it.actions.filterValues { value -> value != InlineActionState.Confirming } + (id to InlineActionState.Confirming),
                readIds = it.readIds + id
            )
        }
    
        fun cancelPayment() = update { it.copy(actions = it.actions.filterValues { value -> value != InlineActionState.Confirming }) }
    
        fun confirmPayment(id: String) {
            val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success ?: return
            val event = current.events.firstOrNull { it.id == id } ?: return
            val service = settlements ?: return
            if (current.actions[id] != InlineActionState.Confirming || !event.canPay(current.data.userId)) return
            runAction(event) { service.recordSettlement(event.payment!!) }
        }
    
        fun retry(id: String) {
            val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success ?: return
            val event = current.events.firstOrNull { it.id == id } ?: return
            val service = retries ?: return
            if (event.type != ActivityType.SyncFailure || !event.needsAction(current.data.userId, current.actionFor(event))) return
            runAction(event) {
                val status = service.retry(event)
                check(status != SyncStatus.FAILED) { "Couldn't sync yet. Try again." }
                status
            }
        }
    
        private fun runAction(event: ActivityEvent, action: suspend () -> SyncStatus) {
            if (!activeIds.add(event.id)) return
            val userId = (mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success)?.data?.userId ?: return
            update { it.copy(actions = it.actions + (event.id to InlineActionState.Working), readIds = it.readIds + event.id) }
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    val result = try {
                        InlineActionState.Done(action())
                    } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                        throw error
                    } catch (error: Exception) {
                        InlineActionState.Failed(error.message ?: "Couldn't complete this action. Try again.")
                    }
                    update {
                        if (it.data.userId == userId && it.events.any { current -> current.id == event.id && current.payment == event.payment }) {
                            it.copy(actions = it.actions + (event.id to result))
                        } else it
                    }
                } finally { activeIds.remove(event.id) }
            }
        }
    }

    import org.junit.Assert.*

    class ActivityPresentationTest {
        private val group = DashboardGroup(Group("g", "Group", createdBy = "u"), 0)
        private fun event(type: ActivityType, time: Long) = ActivityEvent(type.name, type, null, 0, "Description", group, time)
    
        @Test fun expenseAndPaymentFiltersIncludeExactlyTheDocumentedTypes() {
            val events = ActivityType.entries.mapIndexed { index, type -> event(type, index.toLong()) }
            assertEquals(listOf(ActivityType.SyncFailure, ActivityType.ExpenseChanged, ActivityType.ExpenseAdded), filterActivities(events, "u", ActivityFilter.Expenses, emptyMap()).map { it.type })
            assertEquals(listOf(ActivityType.Reminder, ActivityType.Payment), filterActivities(events, "u", ActivityFilter.Payments, emptyMap()).map { it.type })
        }
    
        @Test fun needsYouDoesNotTreatUnreadExpensesAsRequiredActions() {
            val expense = event(ActivityType.ExpenseAdded, 1).copy(unread = true)
            val payment = OutstandingPayment("p", "g", "Mads", 1, DebtTransfer("u", "m", 100, "DKK"))
            val reminder = event(ActivityType.Reminder, 2).copy(payment = payment)
            val failure = event(ActivityType.SyncFailure, 3).copy(syncStatus = SyncStatus.FAILED)
            val events = listOf(expense, reminder, failure)
            assertEquals(listOf(failure, reminder), filterActivities(events, "u", ActivityFilter.NeedsYou, emptyMap()))
            assertEquals(listOf(failure), filterActivities(events, "u", ActivityFilter.NeedsYou, mapOf(reminder.id to InlineActionState.Done())))
            assertEquals(listOf(failure), filterActivities(events, "someone", ActivityFilter.NeedsYou, emptyMap()))
        }
    
        @Test fun duplicateEventIdsDoNotProduceDuplicateCards() {
            val expense = event(ActivityType.ExpenseAdded, 1)
            assertEquals(listOf(expense), filterActivities(listOf(expense, expense), "u", ActivityFilter.All, emptyMap()))
        }
    
        @Test fun dateSectionsUseCalendarDaysAcrossMonthBoundary() {
            val now = Calendar.getInstance().apply { clear(); set(2026, Calendar.NOVEMBER, 1, 12, 0) }
            val yesterday = (now.clone() as Calendar).apply { add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, -1) }
            val earlier = (now.clone() as Calendar).apply { add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, -2) }
            assertEquals("Today", activityDay(now.timeInMillis, now.timeInMillis))
            assertEquals("Yesterday", activityDay(yesterday.timeInMillis, now.timeInMillis))
            assertEquals("Earlier", activityDay(earlier.timeInMillis, now.timeInMillis))
        }
    }

    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.dashboard
    
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.model.*
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.viewmodel.ActivityUiState
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.viewmodel.ActivityViewModel
    import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
    import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
    import kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.test.*
    import org.junit.After
    import org.junit.Assert.*
    import org.junit.Before
    import org.junit.Test
    
    @OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
    class ActivityViewModelTest {
        private val dispatcher = UnconfinedTestDispatcher()
        private val group = DashboardGroup(Group("g", "Group", createdBy = "u"), 0)
        private val payment = OutstandingPayment("p", "g", "Mads", 1, DebtTransfer("u", "m", 1234, "DKK"))
        private val reminder = ActivityEvent("reminder", ActivityType.Reminder, User("m", "m@test", "Mads"), 1, "reminded you", group, 1, unread = true, payment = payment)
        private val failure = ActivityEvent("failure", ActivityType.SyncFailure, null, 0, "couldn't sync", group, 2, unread = true, syncStatus = SyncStatus.FAILED)
        private val expense = ActivityEvent("expense", ActivityType.ExpenseAdded, null, 0, "added an expense", group, 3, unread = true)
        private fun input() = ActivityData("u", listOf(reminder, failure, expense))
        private fun ActivityViewModel.current() = state.value as ActivityUiState.Success
        @Before fun setUp() = Dispatchers.setMain(dispatcher)
        @After fun tearDown() = Dispatchers.resetMain()
    
        @Test fun readStateIsIndependentOfNeedsYouAndAppliesAcrossFilters() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(MutableStateFlow(input()))
            vm.selectFilter(ActivityFilter.Payments)
            vm.markAllRead()
            assertFalse(vm.current().hasUnread)
            assertEquals(3, vm.current().readIds.size)
            assertEquals(2, vm.current().needsCount)
        }
    
        @Test fun retryOnlyShowsSyncedAfterActualSuccessfulResultAndIgnoresDoubleTap() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            var calls = 0
            val response = CompletableDeferred<SyncStatus>()
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(MutableStateFlow(input()), retries = SyncRetryActions { calls++; response.await() })
            vm.retry("failure"); vm.retry("failure")
            assertEquals(1, calls)
            assertEquals(InlineActionState.Working, vm.current().actionFor(failure))
            assertEquals(2, vm.current().needsCount)
            response.complete(SyncStatus.SYNCED)
            assertEquals(InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.SYNCED), vm.current().actionFor(failure))
            assertEquals(1, vm.current().needsCount)
        }
    
        @Test fun queueAcceptanceIsNotMisrepresentedAsSyncSuccess() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val source = MutableStateFlow(input())
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(source, retries = SyncRetryActions { SyncStatus.PENDING_UPDATE })
            vm.retry("failure")
            assertEquals(2, vm.current().needsCount)
            assertEquals(InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.PENDING_UPDATE), vm.current().actionFor(failure))
            val synced = failure.copy(syncStatus = SyncStatus.SYNCED)
            source.value = input().copy(events = listOf(reminder, synced, expense))
            assertEquals(1, vm.current().needsCount)
            assertEquals(InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.SYNCED), vm.current().actionFor(synced))
        }
    
        @Test fun retryFailureStaysActionableAndDoesNotHideFeed() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(MutableStateFlow(input()), retries = SyncRetryActions { error("No connection") })
            vm.retry("failure")
            assertTrue(vm.current().actionFor(failure) is InlineActionState.Failed)
            assertEquals(3, vm.current().events.size)
            assertEquals(2, vm.current().needsCount)
        }
    
        @Test fun paymentRequiresConfirmationAndCancellationMakesNoCall() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            var calls = 0
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(MutableStateFlow(input()), SettlementActions { calls++; SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT })
            vm.askPayment("reminder")
            assertEquals(0, calls)
            vm.cancelPayment(); vm.confirmPayment("reminder")
            assertEquals(0, calls)
            vm.askPayment("reminder"); vm.confirmPayment("reminder")
            assertEquals(1, calls)
            assertEquals(InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT), vm.current().actionFor(reminder))
            assertEquals(1, vm.current().needsCount)
        }
    
        @Test fun missingServicesLeaveActionsUnresolved() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(MutableStateFlow(input()))
            vm.askPayment("reminder"); vm.confirmPayment("reminder"); vm.retry("failure")
            assertEquals(2, vm.current().needsCount)
            assertTrue(vm.current().actions.isEmpty())
            assertFalse(vm.current().canRetry)
            assertFalse(vm.current().canSettle)
        }
    
        @Test fun accountChangeResetsSessionReadStateAndIgnoresOldCompletion() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val response = CompletableDeferred<SyncStatus>()
            val source = MutableStateFlow(input())
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(source, retries = SyncRetryActions { response.await() })
            vm.markAllRead(); vm.retry("failure")
            source.value = ActivityData("other", listOf(failure))
            response.complete(SyncStatus.SYNCED)
            assertTrue(vm.current().hasUnread)
            assertTrue(vm.current().readIds.isEmpty())
            assertTrue(vm.current().actions.isEmpty())
        }
    
        @Test fun changedPaymentIsNotSettledByAnOlderInFlightResult() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val response = CompletableDeferred<SyncStatus>()
            val source = MutableStateFlow(input())
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(source, SettlementActions { response.await() })
            vm.askPayment("reminder"); vm.confirmPayment("reminder")
            val changed = reminder.copy(payment = payment.copy(transfer = payment.transfer.copy(amountCents = 9999)))
            source.value = input().copy(events = listOf(changed))
            response.complete(SyncStatus.SYNCED)
            assertEquals(1, vm.current().needsCount)
            assertFalse(vm.current().actionFor(changed) is InlineActionState.Done)
        }
    }

    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.viewmodel
    
    import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
    import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.dashboard.*

    sealed interface HomeUiState {
        data object Loading : HomeUiState
        data class Error(val message: String) : HomeUiState
        data class Success(
            val data: HomeData,
            val filter: GroupFilter = GroupFilter.Recent,
            val period: SpendPeriod = SpendPeriod.Month,
            val selectedGroupId: String? = null,
            val paymentsExpanded: Boolean = false,
            val confirmingAll: Boolean = false,
            val paymentStates: Map<String, InlineActionState> = emptyMap(),
            val canSettle: Boolean = false,
            val sourceError: String? = null
        ) : HomeUiState {
            val hasFinancialSummary: Boolean
                get() = data.finances?.let { finances ->
                    finances.outstandingPayments.all {
                        it.transfer.currency == "DKK" && it.transfer.debtorId == data.user.id &&
                            it.transfer.amountCents > 0 && data.groups.any { group -> group.group.id == it.groupId }
                    } && data.groups.all { group ->
                        val balance = finances.balancesByGroup[group.group.id]
                        balance != null && balance.currency == "DKK" && balance.userId == data.user.id &&
                            payments.filter { it.groupId == group.group.id }.sumOf { it.transfer.amountCents } == maxOf(0L, -balance.netBalanceCents)
                    }
                } == true
            val payments: List<OutstandingPayment>
                get() = data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().filter {
                    it.transfer.debtorId == data.user.id && it.transfer.currency == "DKK" && it.transfer.amountCents > 0
                }.distinctBy { it.id }
            val unpaid: List<OutstandingPayment>
                get() = payments.filter { paymentStates[it.id] !is InlineActionState.Done }
            val isWorking: Boolean get() = paymentStates.values.any { it == InlineActionState.Working }
        }
    }
    
    class HomeViewModel(
        source: Flow<HomeData>,
        private val settlements: SettlementActions? = null
    ) : ViewModel() {
        private val mutableState = MutableStateFlow<HomeUiState>(HomeUiState.Loading)
        val state = mutableState.asStateFlow()
        private var recording = false
    
        init {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    source.collect { data ->
                        val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success
                        mutableState.value = if (current == null || current.data.user.id != data.user.id) {
                            HomeUiState.Success(data, canSettle = settlements != null)
                        } else {
                            val unchangedIds = data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().filter { payment ->
                                current.data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().any { it == payment }
                            }.map { it.id }.toSet()
                            current.copy(data = data, sourceError = null, paymentStates = current.paymentStates.filterKeys { it in unchangedIds })
                        }
                    }
                } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                    throw error
                } catch (error: Exception) {
                    val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success
                    mutableState.value = current?.copy(sourceError = "Couldn't refresh. Showing the last dashboard.")
                        ?: HomeUiState.Error(error.message ?: "Couldn't load your dashboard")
                }
            }
        }
    
        private fun update(change: (HomeUiState.Success) -> HomeUiState.Success) {
            mutableState.update { if (it is HomeUiState.Success) change(it) else it }
        }
    
        fun selectFilter(filter: GroupFilter) = update { it.copy(filter = filter) }
        fun selectPeriod(period: SpendPeriod) = update { it.copy(period = period, selectedGroupId = null) }
        fun selectSlice(groupId: String?) = update { it.copy(selectedGroupId = groupId) }
        fun togglePayments() = update { it.copy(paymentsExpanded = !it.paymentsExpanded, confirmingAll = false) }
        fun closePayments() = update { it.copy(paymentsExpanded = false, confirmingAll = false) }
    
        fun cancelPayment() = update {
            it.copy(confirmingAll = false, paymentStates = it.paymentStates.filterValues { value -> value != InlineActionState.Confirming })
        }
    
        fun askPayment(id: String) {
            cancelPayment()
            update {
                if (!it.canSettle || !it.hasFinancialSummary || recording || it.unpaid.none { payment -> payment.id == id }) it
                else it.copy(paymentStates = it.paymentStates + (id to InlineActionState.Confirming))
            }
        }
    
        fun askAll() {
            cancelPayment()
            update { if (it.canSettle && it.hasFinancialSummary && !recording && it.unpaid.isNotEmpty()) it.copy(confirmingAll = true) else it }
        }
    
        fun confirmPayment(id: String) {
            val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return
            if (current.paymentStates[id] != InlineActionState.Confirming || recording) return
            record(current.unpaid.filter { it.id == id })
        }
    
        fun confirmAll() {
            val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return
            if (current.confirmingAll && !recording) record(current.unpaid)
        }
    
        private fun record(payments: List<OutstandingPayment>) {
            val actions = settlements ?: return
            val userId = (mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success)?.data?.user?.id ?: return
            recording = true
            update { it.copy(confirmingAll = false, paymentStates = it.paymentStates + payments.associate { p -> p.id to InlineActionState.Working }) }
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try { for (payment in payments) {
                    val latest = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return@launch
                    if (latest.data.user.id != userId) return@launch
                    val result = try {
                        check(latest.payments.any { it == payment }) { "This balance changed. Check the latest payment." }
                        InlineActionState.Done(actions.recordSettlement(payment))
                    } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                        throw error
                    } catch (error: Exception) {
                        InlineActionState.Failed(error.message ?: "Couldn't record this payment. Try again.")
                    }
                    update {
                        if (it.data.user.id == userId && it.payments.any { current -> current == payment }) {
                            it.copy(paymentStates = it.paymentStates + (payment.id to result))
                        } else it
                    }
                } } finally { recording = false }
            }
        }
    }

    sealed interface ActivityUiState {
        data object Loading : ActivityUiState
        data class Error(val message: String) : ActivityUiState
        data class Success(
            val data: ActivityData,
            val filter: ActivityFilter = ActivityFilter.All,
            val readIds: Set<String> = emptySet(),
            val actions: Map<String, InlineActionState> = emptyMap(),
            val canSettle: Boolean = false,
            val canRetry: Boolean = false,
            val sourceError: String? = null
        ) : ActivityUiState {
            val events: List<ActivityEvent> get() = data.events.orEmpty().distinctBy { it.id }
            val needsCount: Int get() = events.count { it.needsAction(data.userId, actionFor(it)) }
            val hasUnread: Boolean get() = events.any { it.unread && it.id !in readIds }
            fun actionFor(event: ActivityEvent): InlineActionState =
                if (event.type == ActivityType.SyncFailure && event.syncStatus == SyncStatus.SYNCED) InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.SYNCED)
                else actions[event.id] ?: InlineActionState.Idle
        }
    }
    
    class ActivityViewModel(
        source: Flow<ActivityData>,
        private val settlements: SettlementActions? = null,
        private val retries: SyncRetryActions? = null
    ) : ViewModel() {
        private val mutableState = MutableStateFlow<ActivityUiState>(ActivityUiState.Loading)

                        val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success
                        mutableState.value = if (current == null || current.data.userId != data.userId) {
                            ActivityUiState.Success(data, canSettle = settlements != null, canRetry = retries != null)
                        } else {
                            val unchangedIds = data.events.orEmpty().filter { next ->
                                current.events.any {
                                    it.id == next.id && it.payment == next.payment &&
                                        (it.syncStatus == next.syncStatus || current.actions[next.id] == InlineActionState.Working)
                                }
                            }.map { it.id }.toSet()
                            current.copy(data = data, sourceError = null, actions = current.actions.filterKeys { it in unchangedIds })
                        }
                    }
                } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                    throw error
                } catch (error: Exception) {
                    val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success
                    mutableState.value = current?.copy(sourceError = "Couldn't refresh. Showing the last activity.")
                        ?: ActivityUiState.Error(error.message ?: "Couldn't load activity")
                }
            }
        }
    
        private fun update(change: (ActivityUiState.Success) -> ActivityUiState.Success) {
            mutableState.update { if (it is ActivityUiState.Success) change(it) else it }
        }

         if len(line)<=130: return [line]
         quoted=False; escaped=False; stack=[]; options=[]
         for i,c in enumerate(line):
          if quoted:
           if escaped: escaped=False
           elif c=='\\': escaped=True
           elif c=='"': quoted=False
           continue
          if c=='"': quoted=True;continue
          if c in '([{': stack.append([c,i,[]])
          elif c==',' and stack and stack[-1][0]=='(': stack[-1][2].append(i)

           opening,start,commas=stack.pop()
           if opening=='(' and c==')' and commas: options.append((start,i,commas))
         if not options:return [line]
         start,end,commas=min(options,key=lambda item:item[0])
         indent=line[:len(line)-len(line.lstrip())]
         pieces=[]; last=start+1
         for comma in commas:
          pieces.append(line[last:comma].strip()+',');last=comma+1
         pieces.append(line[last:end].strip())
         return [line[:start+1]]+[indent+'    '+piece for piece in pieces]+[indent+line[end:]]
        for path in paths:

         for _ in range(3):

    sealed interface HomeAction {
        data class Filter(val filter: GroupFilter) : HomeAction
        data class Period(val period: SpendPeriod) : HomeAction
        data class Slice(val groupId: String?) : HomeAction
        data class Ask(val paymentId: String) : HomeAction
        data class Confirm(val paymentId: String) : HomeAction
        data object TogglePayments : HomeAction
        data object ClosePayments : HomeAction
        data object Cancel : HomeAction
        data object AskAll : HomeAction
        data object ConfirmAll : HomeAction
    }
    
    @Composable
    fun HomeRoute(
        viewModel: HomeViewModel,
        onOpenActivity: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroups: () -> Unit,
        onCreateGroup: () -> Unit,
        onJoinGroup: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroup: (String) -> Unit,
        modifier: Modifier = Modifier
    ) {
        val state by viewModel.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
        HomeScreen(state, { action ->
            when (action) {
                is HomeAction.Filter -> viewModel.selectFilter(action.filter)
                is HomeAction.Period -> viewModel.selectPeriod(action.period)
                is HomeAction.Slice -> viewModel.selectSlice(action.groupId)
                is HomeAction.Ask -> viewModel.askPayment(action.paymentId)
                is HomeAction.Confirm -> viewModel.confirmPayment(action.paymentId)
                HomeAction.TogglePayments -> viewModel.togglePayments()
                HomeAction.ClosePayments -> viewModel.closePayments()
                HomeAction.Cancel -> viewModel.cancelPayment()
                HomeAction.AskAll -> viewModel.askAll()
                HomeAction.ConfirmAll -> viewModel.confirmAll()
            }
        }, onOpenActivity, onOpenGroups, onCreateGroup, onJoinGroup, onOpenGroup, modifier)
    }
    
    @Composable
    fun HomeScreen(
        state: HomeUiState,
        onAction: (HomeAction) -> Unit,
        onOpenActivity: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroups: () -> Unit,
        onCreateGroup: () -> Unit,
        onJoinGroup: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroup: (String) -> Unit,
        modifier: Modifier = Modifier
    ) {
        CompositionLocalProvider(LocalContentColor provides AppColors.Ink900) {
        when (state) {
            HomeUiState.Loading -> Box(
                modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) { CircularProgressIndicator(color = AppColors.Green700) }
            is HomeUiState.Error -> Box(
                modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(AppSpacing.Space16),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) { Text(state.message, style = AppTypography.Body, color = AppColors.Ink600) }
            is HomeUiState.Success -> HomeContent(
                state,
                onAction,
                onOpenActivity,
                onOpenGroups,
                onCreateGroup,
                onJoinGroup,
                onOpenGroup,
                modifier
            )
        }
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    private fun HomeContent(
        state: HomeUiState.Success,
        onAction: (HomeAction) -> Unit,
        onOpenActivity: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroups: () -> Unit,
        onCreateGroup: () -> Unit,
        onJoinGroup: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroup: (String) -> Unit,
        modifier: Modifier

        fun selectFilter(filter: GroupFilter) = update { it.copy(filter = filter) }
        fun selectPeriod(period: SpendPeriod) = update { it.copy(period = period, selectedGroupId = null) }
        fun selectSlice(groupId: String?) = update { it.copy(selectedGroupId = groupId) }
        fun togglePayments() = update { it.copy(paymentsExpanded = !it.paymentsExpanded, confirmingAll = false) }
        fun closePayments() = update { it.copy(paymentsExpanded = false, confirmingAll = false) }
    
        fun cancelPayment() = update {
            it.copy(
                confirmingAll = false,
                paymentStates = it.paymentStates.filterValues { value -> value != InlineActionState.Confirming }
            )
        }
    
        fun askPayment(id: String) {
            cancelPayment()
            update {
                if (!it.canSettle || !it.hasFinancialSummary || recording || it.unpaid.none { payment -> payment.id == id }) it
                else it.copy(paymentStates = it.paymentStates + (id to InlineActionState.Confirming))
            }
        }
    
        fun askAll() {
            cancelPayment()
            update { if (it.canSettle && it.hasFinancialSummary && !recording && it.unpaid.isNotEmpty()) it.copy(confirmingAll = true) else it }
        }
    
        fun confirmPayment(id: String) {
            val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return
            if (current.paymentStates[id] != InlineActionState.Confirming || recording) return
            record(current.unpaid.filter { it.id == id })
        }
    
        fun confirmAll() {
            val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return
            if (current.confirmingAll && !recording) record(current.unpaid)
        }
    
        private fun record(payments: List<OutstandingPayment>) {
            val actions = settlements ?: return
            val userId = (mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success)?.data?.user?.id ?: return
            recording = true
            update { it.copy(
                    confirmingAll = false,
                    paymentStates = it.paymentStates + payments.associate { p -> p.id to InlineActionState.Working }
            ) }
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    for (payment in payments) {
                        val latest = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return@launch
                        if (latest.data.user.id != userId) return@launch
                        val result = try {
                            check(latest.payments.any { it == payment }) { "This balance changed. Check the latest payment." }
                            InlineActionState.Done(actions.recordSettlement(payment))
                        } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                            throw error
                        } catch (error: Exception) {
                            InlineActionState.Failed(error.message ?: "Couldn't record this payment. Try again.")
                        }
                        update {
                            if (it.data.user.id == userId && it.payments.any { current -> current == payment }) {
                                it.copy(paymentStates = it.paymentStates + (payment.id to result))
                            } else it
                        }
                    }
                } finally {
                    recording = false
                }
            }
        }
    }

    # Person 5 — Home and Activity integration
    
    ## Approved boundary
    
    This change implements independent native Compose screens for S3, S3-pay, S3-slice,
    S6 and S6-action. It does not attach them to MainActivity or implement the shared
    bottom navigation. SQLiteOpenHelper, the schema, entities, DAOs, repositories and
    Firebase behavior are unchanged. Room and WorkManager remain Phase 4 work.
    
    ## Entry points
    
    - `HomeRoute(viewModel, onOpenActivity, onOpenGroups, onCreateGroup, onJoinGroup,
      onOpenGroup, modifier)` collects state with lifecycle awareness.
    - `ActivityRoute(viewModel, modifier)` collects the feed state.
    - `HomeScreen` and `ActivityScreen` are stateless entry points for previews and
      UI tests. They receive immutable state and an action callback.
    
    Person 1 should create each ViewModel with a normal ViewModel factory at the
    authenticated destination's scope, then pass it into the route. Do not construct
    a new ViewModel on every recomposition. The host shell owns system/window insets
    and the 80dp navigation bar; pass the shell's padded modifier to each route.
    The screen previews use a 412 × 835dp content area, leaving the navigation bar to
    its owner. Destroy the account-scoped ViewModels on logout/account switch.
    
    ## Data and operation contracts
    
    `HomeViewModel` accepts a `Flow<HomeData>` and optional `SettlementActions`.
    `ActivityViewModel` accepts a `Flow<ActivityData>`, optional `SettlementActions`
    and optional `SyncRetryActions`. There are no default sample sources or default
    successful operations. The existing repositories can be connected by their owners
    without changing the screen APIs.
    
    | Owner | Supplies |
    |---|---|
    | Person 1 | Current user, account scope and navigation callbacks |
    | Person 2 | Existing Group objects plus chosen colour index, favourite flag and last activity |
    | Person 4 | Group-keyed MemberBalance values and OutstandingPayment objects wrapping DebtTransfer; the manual settlement operation |
    | Database/sync owner | Group/ledger flows, pending counts, actual saved-data timestamp, event history and sync retry operations |
    
    An `OutstandingPayment.id` identifies a particular outstanding obligation, not
    merely a group. Reuse the same identity between Home and reminder events. The
    settlement implementation must revalidate the obligation and record it
    idempotently, including concurrent calls from another screen/device. An error
    must mean no successful local recording; uncertain outcomes need reconciliation
    before permitting a duplicate operation. This guarantee belongs in Person 4's
    service, not in the screen's button state.
    
    `SettlementActions.recordSettlement` returns the recorded settlement's real
    SyncStatus. It records a manual settlement; it does not transfer money. A return
    of PENDING_INSERT or FAILED can mean a locally recorded settlement still awaiting
    synchronization, which is displayed separately from Paid. The owner must emit
    updated financial snapshots after recording. Screen-level duplicate taps are
    guarded; they do not replace database idempotency.
    
    `SyncRetryActions.retry` receives the supplied event so its owner can resolve the
    real queued operation. Return SYNCED only after remote acknowledgement. Returning
    a pending status displays waiting feedback and keeps the event in Needs you.
    Throwing or returning FAILED displays a failed attempt. Later source emissions
    update its real synchronization state. No WorkManager job or backend event is
    created by these screens.
    
    Home rejects incomplete/inconsistent DKK summaries instead of presenting them as
    All paid up. FinancialSummary must include a balance for every supplied group;
    the current user's outgoing transfers must match each negative group balance.
    This checks a supplied result; it does not calculate balances or settlements.
    An absent paid-out source is unavailable, while an explicitly empty source means
    zero recorded payments. The donut counts completed DKK settlements paid by the
    current user, within the selected calendar period. It does not count expenses or
    mix currencies. Weeks start Monday; date boundaries use the device timezone.
    
    Feed events must be supplied by an actual history/reminder source. The five event
    types correspond to the prototype; the screen does not infer historical changes
    from current ledger rows. `ActivityData.events = null` means history is unavailable;
    an empty list means the source has supplied an empty history. Event IDs must be
    unique and stable. `nowMillis` is injectable for tests; the source should refresh
    it when the screen resumes or the calendar day changes.
    
    Unread changes are held only in the ActivityViewModel's session. Mark all as read
    applies across filters, and does not resolve unpaid reminders or failed syncs.
    There is no persistent or cross-device mark-read claim. Home's unread indicator
    must be supplied by the eventual shared feed/read-state source.
    
    The flows should handle recoverable refresh failures and continue emitting local
    data. If a flow throws after emitting, the screen retains its last snapshot and
    reports the refresh failure; that closed flow requires its owner to reconnect.
    This is in-memory presentation resilience, not database-backed offline support.
    
    ## Implemented interactions
    
    - Home Recent/Favourites/All filtering, six-row limit, conditional See all link,
      no-group and no-favourites states, date/greeting and bell callback.
    - Supplied balance summary, period menu, native annular chart with hit testing,
      selected-slice emphasis, outside/back dismissal and Open group callback.
    - Individual and bulk inline confirmation, pending/success/failure states,
      partial bulk failure and a five-second all-clear drain/collapse.
    - Global feed sections and the four documented filters. Needs you counts
      unresolved actionable reminders and failed-sync events independently of unread.
    - Inline manual settlement and retry controls whose outcomes follow the injected
      operation results. Missing services disable controls and explain availability.
    - Offline banner and pending/failed/synced feedback components render supplied
      state. No connectivity monitoring or automatic background retry is claimed.
    
    ## Design checks and limits
    
    The HTML templates and scripts were checked against the native implementation:
    16dp side padding, semantic colours, the existing typography scale, 24dp hero
    cards, 18dp payment/feed cards, group colours, Danish amounts, and inline actions.
    The two added unread tokens and retry-border token match the prototype.
    Controls retain at least 44dp interaction areas. Chart segments also expose named
    accessibility actions, including tiny segments that are difficult to tap.
    
    The donut centre retains two decimals per the explicit style-guide requirement,
    whereas the HTML's `fmtShort` rounds it. Loading, missing-integration and operation
    failure states explain unavailable functionality rather than displaying fixtures.
    The standalone screens retain the reference's light semantic surfaces even in
    dark-mode previews. No alternative dark design was invented.
    
    No Android screenshots were rendered or compared. Pixel-perfect verification is
    not claimed. Popover positioning, font loading, narrow screens, large font scales
    and the final shell/inset integration require device/emulator review. The slice
    popover has the reference information and dismissal behavior but does not yet
    draw the HTML's small triangular pointer.
    
    ## Verification
    
    The Gradle wrapper's `assembleDebug` and `test` commands were attempted but stopped
    before compilation: Gradle 9.5.0 needs downloading and the session denies network
    sockets. No wrapper build or wrapper test success is claimed.
    
    Supplementary verification uses locally cached Kotlin 2.2.10, its Compose compiler,
    cached AndroidX libraries and the installed Android SDK. It compiles the new main
    sources, existing domain/theme sources and unit tests, then runs JUnit. A temporary
    resource-ID stub supplies font IDs solely to this source check. This does not
    validate Android resource packaging, manifest merging, the configured Kotlin
    2.4.21 toolchain, or exact declared dependency resolution. The disposable harness
    and logs are under ignored `build/person5-verification/`.
    
    The unit tests cover calendar/DST boundaries, chart filtering and hit testing,
    group/feed filters, confirmations, duplicate taps, partial bulk failures,
    unavailable services, actual versus queued retry outcomes, account changes,
    changed obligations and preservation of the last supplied data after refresh
    failure. Compose instrumentation tests are included for callbacks, inline
    confirmation and the five-second collapse, but have not been executed.
    
    ## Phase 4 and remaining integration
    
    Room coordination, durable read/history state, WorkManager scheduling/backoff,
    transactional outbox writes, Firestore normalization/conflict handling, recovery
    notifications and actual offline availability must be implemented and verified
    with the database owner after separate approval. The existing database is not
    changed or supplemented here. Do not display “group notified” without an actual
    notification/reminder delivery result.

    sealed interface HomeUiState {
        data object Loading : HomeUiState
        data class Error(val message: String) : HomeUiState
        data class Success(
            val data: HomeData,
            val filter: GroupFilter = GroupFilter.Recent,
            val period: SpendPeriod = SpendPeriod.Month,
            val selectedGroupId: String? = null,
            val paymentsExpanded: Boolean = false,
            val confirmingAll: Boolean = false,
            val paymentStates: Map<String, InlineActionState> = emptyMap(),
            val canSettle: Boolean = false,
            val sourceError: String? = null
        ) : HomeUiState {
            val payments: List<OutstandingPayment> = data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().filter {
                it.transfer.debtorId == data.user.id && it.transfer.currency == "DKK" && it.transfer.amountCents > 0
            }.distinctBy { it.id }
            val unpaid: List<OutstandingPayment> = payments.filter { paymentStates[it.id] !is InlineActionState.Done }
            val isWorking: Boolean = paymentStates.values.any { it == InlineActionState.Working }
            val oweCents: Long = unpaid.sumOf { it.transfer.amountCents }
            val owingGroupCount: Int = unpaid.map { it.groupId }.distinct().size
            val owedCents: Long = data.groups.sumOf { group ->
                data.finances?.balancesByGroup?.get(group.group.id)?.takeIf {
                    it.currency == "DKK" && it.userId == data.user.id
                }?.netBalanceCents?.coerceAtLeast(0L) ?: 0L
            }
            val hasFinancialSummary: Boolean = data.finances?.let { finances ->
                finances.outstandingPayments.all {
                    it.transfer.currency == "DKK" && it.transfer.debtorId == data.user.id &&
                    it.transfer.amountCents > 0 && data.groups.any { group -> group.group.id == it.groupId }
                } && data.groups.all { group ->
                    val balance = finances.balancesByGroup[group.group.id]
                    balance != null && balance.currency == "DKK" && balance.userId == data.user.id &&
                    payments.filter { it.groupId == group.group.id }.sumOf { it.transfer.amountCents } == maxOf(
                        0L,
                        -balance.netBalanceCents
                    )
                }
            } == true
        }
    }

    @Composable
    private fun HomeContent(
        state: HomeUiState.Success,
        onAction: (HomeAction) -> Unit,
        onOpenActivity: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroups: () -> Unit,
        onCreateGroup: () -> Unit,
        onJoinGroup: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroup: (String) -> Unit,
        modifier: Modifier
    ) {
        val data = state.data
        val groups = remember(data.groups, state.filter) { filterGroups(data.groups, state.filter) }
        LazyColumn(
            modifier.fillMaxSize().background(AppColors.White),
            contentPadding = PaddingValues(
                start = AppSpacing.Space16,
                end = AppSpacing.Space16,
                top = AppSpacing.Space20,
                bottom = AppSpacing.Space24
            ),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space8)
        ) {
            item("header") {
                Row(
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(top = AppSpacing.Space8, bottom = AppSpacing.Space12),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {
                    Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                        Text(dateText(data.nowMillis, "EEEE d MMMM"), style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                        Text(
                            "Hi, ${data.user.displayName.substringBefore(' ')}",
                            style = AppTypography.ScreenTitle,
                            color = AppColors.Ink900
                        )
                    }
                    Surface(shape = AppShapes.Circle, border = BorderStroke(1.dp, AppColors.Line), color = AppColors.White) {
                        IconButton(onClick = onOpenActivity, modifier = Modifier.size(AppTouchTargets.MinTouchTarget)) {
                            Box {
                                DashboardSymbol(
                                    DashboardIcon.Bell,
                                    description = if (data.hasUnreadActivity) "Activity, unread notifications" else "Activity"
                                )
                                if (data.hasUnreadActivity) Box(Modifier.align(Alignment.TopEnd).size(8.dp).background(
                                        AppColors.Green500,
                                        AppShapes.Circle
                                ))
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            state.sourceError?.let { message ->
                item("source-error") {
                    Text(message, style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                }
            }
            data.offlineSavedAt?.let { savedAt -> item("offline") { OfflineBanner(
                        dateText(savedAt, "HH:mm"),
                        Modifier.padding(bottom = AppSpacing.Space12)
            ) } }
            if (data.groups.isEmpty()) {
                item("empty") {
                    Column(
                        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(top = 56.dp),
                        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space12)
                    ) {
                        EmptyGroupIllustration(data.user.displayName)
                        Text("No groups yet", style = AppTypography.ScreenTitleLarge, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                        Text(
                            "Make a group for your flat, a trip or Friday bar. Add an expense and we'll keep track of who owes what.",
                            style = AppTypography.Body,
                            color = AppColors.Ink600,
                            textAlign = TextAlign.Center
                        )
                        DashboardButton(
                            "Create a group",
                            onCreateGroup,
                            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = AppTouchTargets.PrimaryButtonHeight),
                            AppColors.Green700,
                            AppColors.White
                        )
                        TextButton(onClick = onJoinGroup) { Text(
                                "Join with an invite link",
                                style = AppTypography.ButtonSecondary,
                                color = AppColors.Green700
                        ) }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                item("summary") {
                    Row(
                        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(bottom = AppSpacing.Space12),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space12)
                    ) {
                        BalanceHero(state, { onAction(HomeAction.TogglePayments) }, Modifier.weight(1f))
                        Surface(
                            Modifier.weight(1f).heightIn(min = 212.dp),
                            shape = AppShapes.HeroCard,
                            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, AppColors.Line),
                            color = AppColors.White
                        ) {
                            PaidOutChart(
                                data,
                                state.period,
                                state.selectedGroupId,
                                { onAction(HomeAction.Period(it)) },
                                { onAction(HomeAction.Slice(it)) },
                                onOpenGroup,
                                Modifier.padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = AppSpacing.Space8)
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (state.paymentsExpanded && state.hasFinancialSummary) item("payments") { PaymentsDue(
                        state,
                        onAction,
                        Modifier.padding(bottom = AppSpacing.Space12)
                ) }
                item("group-heading") {
                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        Text("Your groups", Modifier.weight(1f), style = AppTypography.Section, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                        TextButton(onClick = onCreateGroup) { Text(
                                "New group",
                                style = AppTypography.ButtonInline,
                                color = AppColors.Green700
                        ) }
                    }
                }
                item("group-filter") {
                    Row(
                        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().background(AppColors.Surface, AppShapes.SegmentedBar).padding(AppSpacing.Space4),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space4)
                    ) {
                        GroupFilter.entries.forEach { filter ->
                            Surface(
                                Modifier.weight(1f),
                                shape = AppShapes.Chip,
                                color = if (state.filter == filter) AppColors.White else AppColors.Surface
                            ) {
                                TextButton(onClick = { onAction(HomeAction.Filter(filter)) }) {
                                    Text(
                                        filter.label,
                                        style = AppTypography.ButtonInline,
                                        color = if (state.filter == filter) AppColors.Ink900 else AppColors.Ink600
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                items(groups.take(6), key = { "group-${it.group.id}" }) { group ->
                    GroupRow(group, state, { onOpenGroup(group.group.id) })
                }
                if (groups.isEmpty()) item("no-favourites") {
                    Text(

    @Composable
    private fun HomeHeader(data: HomeData, onOpenActivity: () -> Unit) {
        Row(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(top = AppSpacing.Space8, bottom = AppSpacing.Space12),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                Text(dateText(data.nowMillis, "EEEE d MMMM"), style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                Text(
                    "Hi, ${data.user.displayName.substringBefore(' ')}",
                    style = AppTypography.ScreenTitle,
                    color = AppColors.Ink900
                )
            }
            Surface(shape = AppShapes.Circle, border = BorderStroke(1.dp, AppColors.Line), color = AppColors.White) {
                IconButton(onClick = onOpenActivity, modifier = Modifier.size(AppTouchTargets.MinTouchTarget)) {
                    Box {
                        DashboardSymbol(
                            DashboardIcon.Bell,
                            description = if (data.hasUnreadActivity) "Activity, unread notifications" else "Activity"
                        )
                        if (data.hasUnreadActivity) Box(Modifier.align(Alignment.TopEnd).size(8.dp).background(
                                AppColors.Green500,
                                AppShapes.Circle
                        ))
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    private fun EmptyHomeContent(
        state: HomeUiState.Success,
        onOpenActivity: () -> Unit,
        onCreateGroup: () -> Unit,
        onJoinGroup: () -> Unit,
        modifier: Modifier
    ) {
        val data = state.data
        Column(
            modifier.fillMaxSize().background(AppColors.White).padding(
                start = AppSpacing.Space16,
                end = AppSpacing.Space16,
                top = AppSpacing.Space20,
                bottom = AppSpacing.Space24
            )
        ) {
            HomeHeader(data, onOpenActivity)
            state.sourceError?.let { Text(it, style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600) }
            data.offlineSavedAt?.let { OfflineBanner(dateText(it, "HH:mm")) }
            Box(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                Column(
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(horizontal = AppSpacing.Space12),
                    horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space12)
                ) {
                    EmptyGroupIllustration(data.user.displayName)
                    Text("No groups yet", style = AppTypography.ScreenTitleLarge, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                    Text(
                        "Make a group for your flat, a trip or Friday bar. Add an expense and we'll keep track of who owes what.",
                        style = AppTypography.Body,
                        color = AppColors.Ink600,
                        textAlign = TextAlign.Center
                    )
                    DashboardButton(
                        "Create a group",
                        onCreateGroup,
                        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = AppTouchTargets.PrimaryButtonHeight),
                        AppColors.Green700,
                        AppColors.White
                    )
                    TextButton(onClick = onJoinGroup) { Text(
                            "Join with an invite link",
                            style = AppTypography.ButtonSecondary,
                            color = AppColors.Green700
                    ) }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Creating ViewModels
    
    • ViewModel for displaying a name
    • _name is mutable and private
       • MutableStateFlow holds a value that
        can be changed, and sends new value
        to observers
    
    • name is read-only and public
       • asStateFlow() creates read-only copy
    
    • _name can only be changed using the
      public function setName()
    Documentation/Lectures/Andorid 2.pdf PAGE 17
    Using ViewModels
    
    • ViewModel is passed to the screen that uses it
       • = viewModel() means that an instance is created if one is not passed
       • If multiple screens use the same VM, the same instance should be
        passed between them
    
    • collectAsStateWithLifeCycle() observes a StateFlow and converts it
      to Compose State
       • In this example, it
       becomes a String that
        can be displayed in
        the UI

       Mechanism                         In the expense app                                        Lives in

        Retry                            “Tap to retry” on a failed expense after the last automatic attempt    re-enqueue the outbox row; worker
