    DOCUMENT Documentation/Lectures/Software Architecture Part 1.pdf PAGE 15
     The contribution of Bass, Clements and Kazman
    A quality framework
    Three families of qualities: system
    qualities (availability, performance, …),
    business qualities (time to market, cost,
    …) and architectural qualities
    (conceptual integrity, buildability, …).
    next slide
    A uniform measurement template
    The quality attribute scenario (QAS): the
    same six-part template for radically
    different qualities, performance as well
    as security, energy as well as privacy.
    slide 18
    Quality anchored in context
    No quality is globally achievable. A
    scenario says who, under which
    conditions, with which response,
    measured how; “reliable” on its own
    means nothing, “reliable during a 30-
    second outage in a lift” does.
    slide 19
    Software Architecture in Practice, 2nd ed. 2003 (the edition the original deck cites); 3rd ed. 2012; 4th ed. 2021. The scenario template is unchanged across
    editions; the tactic catalogues grew.
    Key point: the template is the same whether you are specifying a search latency or a privacy breach. Learn it once,

    Stimulus

    Source of stimulus
    Some entity (a human, a computer system,

    timer
    Stimulus
    A condition that needs to be considered
    when it arrives at the system.

    Environment
    The conditions under which the stimulus
    occurs: normal operation, overload,
    degraded mode, …
    e.g. foreground use; brief outage; low battery;
    metered network
    Artifact
    The part that is stimulated: the whole
    system or some piece of it.
    e.g. ExpenseRepository and SyncWorker;
    GroupScreen; the Room database
    Response
    The activity undertaken after the arrival of
    the stimulus.
    e.g. write locally, show pending, enqueue, retry,
    notify
    Response measure
    How the response is measured, so that the
    requirement can be tested.
    e.g. delivered within 60 s of reconnect; UI thread
    never blocked; 100 percent of queued requests
    delivered
    If you cannot write the response measure, you do not have a requirement yet; you have a hope. The measure is what the test
    asserts.

    From the brief to the scenario
    •
    “provide contextual feedback on successful and failed transactions” → the response’s first clause, measured by the 100 ms and 5 s numbers
    •
    “retry in the background without affecting the user’s continued usage” → the response’s second and third clauses, measured by “UI thread never
    blocked”
    •
    “time between retries with decreasing frequency” → the backoff series in the measure; WorkManager’s exponential policy gives it for free

The plan will therefore need a database-owner-provided sync integration rather than a new Firebase writer inside Person 5’s worker.

    # Person 5 â€” Home and Activity integration
    
    ## Approved boundary
    
    This change implements independent native Compose screens for S3, S3-pay, S3-slice,
    S6 and S6-action. It does not attach them to MainActivity or implement the shared
    bottom navigation. SQLiteOpenHelper, the schema, entities, DAOs, repositories and
    Firebase behavior are unchanged. Room and WorkManager remain Phase 4 work.
    
    ## Entry points
    
    - `HomeRoute(viewModel, onOpenActivity, onOpenGroups, onCreateGroup, onJoinGroup,
      onOpenGroup, modifier)` collects state with lifecycle awareness.
    - `ActivityRoute(viewModel, modifier)` collects the feed state.
    - `HomeScreen` and `ActivityScreen` are stateless entry points for previews and
      UI tests. They receive immutable state and an action callback.
    
    Person 1 should create each ViewModel with a normal ViewModel factory at the
    authenticated destination's scope, then pass it into the route. Do not construct
    a new ViewModel on every recomposition. The host shell owns system/window insets
    and the 80dp navigation bar; pass the shell's padded modifier to each route.
    The screen previews use a 412 Ã— 835dp content area, leaving the navigation bar to
    its owner. Destroy the account-scoped ViewModels on logout/account switch.
    
    ## Data and operation contracts
    
    `HomeViewModel` accepts a `Flow<HomeData>` and optional `SettlementActions`.
    `ActivityViewModel` accepts a `Flow<ActivityData>`, optional `SettlementActions`
    and optional `SyncRetryActions`. There are no default sample sources or default
    successful operations. The existing repositories can be connected by their owners
    without changing the screen APIs.
    
    | Owner | Supplies |
    |---|---|
    | Person 1 | Current user, account scope and navigation callbacks |
    | Person 2 | Existing Group objects plus chosen colour index, favourite flag and last activity |
    | Person 4 | Group-keyed MemberBalance values and OutstandingPayment objects wrapping DebtTransfer; the manual settlement operation |
    | Database/sync owner | Group/ledger flows, pending counts, actual saved-data timestamp, event history and sync retry operations |
    
    An `OutstandingPayment.id` identifies a particular outstanding obligation, not
    merely a group. Reuse the same identity between Home and reminder events. The
    settlement implementation must revalidate the obligation and record it
    idempotently, including concurrent calls from another screen/device. An error
    must mean no successful local recording; uncertain outcomes need reconciliation
    before permitting a duplicate operation. This guarantee belongs in Person 4's
    service, not in the screen's button state.
    
    `SettlementActions.recordSettlement` returns the recorded settlement's real
    SyncStatus. It records a manual settlement; it does not transfer money. A return
    of PENDING_INSERT or FAILED can mean a locally recorded settlement still awaiting
    synchronization, which is displayed separately from Paid. The owner must emit
    updated financial snapshots after recording. Screen-level duplicate taps are
    guarded; they do not replace database idempotency.
    
    `SyncRetryActions.retry` receives the supplied event so its owner can resolve the
    real queued operation. Return SYNCED only after remote acknowledgement. Returning
    a pending status displays waiting feedback and keeps the event in Needs you.
    Throwing or returning FAILED displays a failed attempt. Later source emissions
    update its real synchronization state. No WorkManager job or backend event is
    created by these screens.
    
    Home rejects incomplete/inconsistent DKK summaries instead of presenting them as
    All paid up. FinancialSummary must include a balance for every supplied group;
    the current user's outgoing transfers must match each negative group balance.
    This checks a supplied result; it does not calculate balances or settlements.
    An absent paid-out source is unavailable, while an explicitly empty source means
    zero recorded payments. The donut counts completed DKK settlements paid by the
    current user, within the selected calendar period. It does not count expenses or
    mix currencies. Weeks start Monday; date boundaries use the device timezone.
    
    Feed events must be supplied by an actual history/reminder source. The five event
    types correspond to the prototype; the screen does not infer historical changes
    from current ledger rows. `ActivityData.events = null` means history is unavailable;
    an empty list means the source has supplied an empty history. Event IDs must be
    unique and stable. `nowMillis` is injectable for tests; the source should refresh
    it when the screen resumes or the calendar day changes.
    
    Unread changes are held only in the ActivityViewModel's session. Mark all as read
    applies across filters, and does not resolve unpaid reminders or failed syncs.
    There is no persistent or cross-device mark-read claim. Home's unread indicator
    must be supplied by the eventual shared feed/read-state source.
    
    The flows should handle recoverable refresh failures and continue emitting local
    data. If a flow throws after emitting, the screen retains its last snapshot and
    reports the refresh failure; that closed flow requires its owner to reconnect.
    This is in-memory presentation resilience, not database-backed offline support.
    
    ## Implemented interactions
    
    - Home Recent/Favourites/All filtering, six-row limit, conditional See all link,
      no-group and no-favourites states, date/greeting and bell callback.
    - Supplied balance summary, period menu, native annular chart with hit testing,
      selected-slice emphasis, outside/back dismissal and Open group callback.
    - Individual and bulk inline confirmation, pending/success/failure states,
      partial bulk failure and a five-second all-clear drain/collapse.
    - Global feed sections and the four documented filters. Needs you counts
      unresolved actionable reminders and failed-sync events independently of unread.
    - Inline manual settlement and retry controls whose outcomes follow the injected
      operation results. Missing services disable controls and explain availability.
    - Offline banner and pending/failed/synced feedback components render supplied
      state. No connectivity monitoring or automatic background retry is claimed.
    
    ## Design checks and limits
    
    The HTML templates and scripts were checked against the native implementation:
    16dp side padding, semantic colours, the existing typography scale, 24dp hero
    cards, 18dp payment/feed cards, group colours, Danish amounts, and inline actions.
    The added unread, retry-border and empty-illustration tokens match the prototype.
    Controls retain at least 44dp interaction areas. Chart segments also expose named
    accessibility actions, including tiny segments that are difficult to tap.
    
    The donut centre retains two decimals per the explicit style-guide requirement,
    whereas the HTML's `fmtShort` rounds it. Loading, missing-integration and operation
    failure states explain unavailable functionality rather than displaying fixtures.
    The standalone screens retain the reference's light semantic surfaces even in

    data class DashboardGroup(
        val group: Group,
        val colourIndex: Int,
        val isFavourite: Boolean = false,
        val lastActivityAt: Long = group.updatedAt,
        val pendingExpenseCount: Int = 0
    )
    
    data class OutstandingPayment(
        val id: String,
        val groupId: String,
        val creditorName: String,
        val since: Long,
        val transfer: DebtTransfer
    )
    
    data class FinancialSummary(
        val balancesByGroup: Map<String, MemberBalance>,
        val outstandingPayments: List<OutstandingPayment>
    )
    
    data class PaidOutPayment(val settlement: Settlement, val creditorName: String)
    
    data class HomeData(
        val user: User,
        val groups: List<DashboardGroup>,
        val finances: FinancialSummary? = null,
        val paidOutPayments: List<PaidOutPayment>? = null,
        val hasUnreadActivity: Boolean = false,
        val offlineSavedAt: Long? = null,
        val nowMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    )
    
    fun interface SettlementActions {
        suspend fun recordSettlement(payment: OutstandingPayment): SyncStatus
    }
    
    sealed interface InlineActionState {
        data object Idle : InlineActionState
        data object Confirming : InlineActionState
        data object Working : InlineActionState
        data class Done(val syncStatus: SyncStatus? = null) : InlineActionState
        data class Failed(val message: String) : InlineActionState
    }
    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.dashboard
    
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.model.SyncStatus
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.model.User
    
    enum class ActivityType { ExpenseAdded, ExpenseChanged, Payment, Reminder, SyncFailure }
    enum class AmountDirection { Owed, Received, Settled, Neutral }
    enum class ActivityFilter(val label: String) { All("All"), NeedsYou("Needs you"), Expenses("Expenses"), Payments("Payments") }
    
    data class ActivityEvent(
        val id: String,
        val type: ActivityType,
        val actor: User?,
        val actorColourIndex: Int,
        val description: String,
        val group: DashboardGroup,
        val occurredAt: Long,
        val amountCents: Long? = null,
        val currency: String = "DKK",
        val direction: AmountDirection = AmountDirection.Neutral,
        val unread: Boolean = false,
        val payment: OutstandingPayment? = null,
        val syncStatus: SyncStatus? = null,
        val expenseTitle: String? = null
    )
    
    data class ActivityData(
        val userId: String,
        val events: List<ActivityEvent>? = null,
        val nowMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    )
    
    fun interface SyncRetryActions {
        suspend fun retry(event: ActivityEvent): SyncStatus
    }
    
    fun ActivityEvent.canPay(userId: String): Boolean = type == ActivityType.Reminder && payment?.let {
        it.groupId == group.group.id && it.transfer.debtorId == userId &&
        it.transfer.currency == "DKK" && it.transfer.amountCents > 0
    } == true
    
    fun ActivityEvent.needsAction(userId: String, state: InlineActionState): Boolean = when {
        canPay(userId) -> state !is InlineActionState.Done
        type == ActivityType.SyncFailure -> syncStatus != SyncStatus.SYNCED &&
        !(state is InlineActionState.Done && state.syncStatus == SyncStatus.SYNCED)
        else -> false
    }
    
    fun filterActivities(
        events: List<ActivityEvent>,
        userId: String,
        filter: ActivityFilter,
        actions: Map<String, InlineActionState>
    ): List<ActivityEvent> = events.distinctBy { it.id }.filter {
        when (filter) {
            ActivityFilter.All -> true
            ActivityFilter.NeedsYou -> it.needsAction(userId, actions[it.id] ?: InlineActionState.Idle)
            ActivityFilter.Expenses -> it.type in listOf(
                ActivityType.ExpenseAdded,
                ActivityType.ExpenseChanged,
                ActivityType.SyncFailure
            )
            ActivityFilter.Payments -> it.type == ActivityType.Payment || it.type == ActivityType.Reminder
        }
    }.sortedByDescending { it.occurredAt }

    @RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
    class AppDatabaseTest {
    
        private lateinit var database: AppDatabase
    
        @Before
        fun setUp() {
            val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
            database = AppDatabase.createInMemory(context)
        }
    
        @After
        fun tearDown() {
            database.close()
        }
    
        @Test
        fun insertAndQueryOfflineFlow_persistsEntitiesAndCascadesDeletes() {
            val u1 = UserEntity(id = "u1", email = "u1@test.com", displayName = "Alice")
            val u2 = UserEntity(id = "u2", email = "u2@test.com", displayName = "Bob")
            database.userDao.upsertUser(u1)
            database.userDao.upsertUser(u2)
    
            val group = GroupEntity(
                id = "g1",
                name = "Ski Trip",
                description = "Alps 2026",
                createdBy = "u1",
                syncStatus = SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT
            )
            val members = listOf(
                GroupMemberEntity(groupId = "g1", userId = "u1", role = GroupRole.ADMIN),
                GroupMemberEntity(groupId = "g1", userId = "u2", role = GroupRole.MEMBER)
            )
            database.groupDao.upsertGroupWithMembers(group, members)
    
            val expense = ExpenseEntity(
                id = "e1",
                groupId = "g1",
                title = "Cabin Rental",
                amountCents = 20000L,
                payerId = "u1",
                createdBy = "u1",
                syncStatus = SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT
            )
            val splits = listOf(
                ExpenseSplitEntity(id = "s1", expenseId = "e1", userId = "u1", amountOwedCents = 10000L),
                ExpenseSplitEntity(id = "s2", expenseId = "e1", userId = "u2", amountOwedCents = 10000L)
            )
            database.expenseDao.upsertExpenseWithSplits(expense, splits)
    
            val settlement = SettlementEntity(
                id = "st1",
                groupId = "g1",
                debtorId = "u2",
                creditorId = "u1",
                amountCents = 10000L,
                paymentMethod = "MobilePay",
                status = SettlementStatus.COMPLETED,
                syncStatus = SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT
            )
            database.settlementDao.upsertSettlement(settlement)
    
            val queueId = database.syncQueueDao.enqueue(
                SyncQueueEntity(
                    entityType = SyncEntityType.EXPENSE,
                    entityId = "e1",
                    action = SyncAction.CREATE,
                    payloadJson = """{"id":"e1"}"""
                )
            )
            assertTrue(queueId > 0)
    
            assertNotNull(database.groupDao.getGroupById("g1"))
            assertEquals(2, database.groupDao.getMembersForGroup("g1").size)
            assertEquals(1, database.expenseDao.getActiveExpensesForGroup("g1").size)
            assertEquals(2, database.expenseDao.getSplitsForExpense("e1").size)
            assertEquals(1, database.settlementDao.getSettlementsForGroup("g1").size)
            assertEquals(1, database.syncQueueDao.getAllPending().size)
    
            // Verify ON DELETE CASCADE when deleting the group
            database.groupDao.deleteGroup("g1")
            assertTrue(database.groupDao.getMembersForGroup("g1").isEmpty())
            assertTrue(database.expenseDao.getActiveExpensesForGroup("g1").isEmpty())
            assertTrue(database.expenseDao.getSplitsForExpense("e1").isEmpty())
            assertTrue(database.settlementDao.getSettlementsForGroup("g1").isEmpty())
        }
    }

        import re,json,base64,pymupdf
        from pathlib import Path
        for path in ['docs/local_database_schema.drawio.xml','docs/remote_database_schema.drawio.xml','docs/navigation_model.drawio.xml']:
            import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
            root=ET.parse(path).getroot()
            labels=[re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',x.attrib['value']) for x in root.iter() if x.attrib.get('value')]
            print('\nDIAGRAM',path,'\n','\n'.join(labels))
        p=Path('docs/HiFi.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        m=re.search(r'<script[^>]*type="__bundler/manifest"[^>]*>(.*?)</script>',p,re.S)
        if not m: m=re.search(r'<script[^>]*id="__bundler/manifest"[^>]*>(.*?)</script>',p,re.S)
        if m:
            data=json.loads(m.group(1));print('MANIFEST TYPE',type(data).__name__);print(str(data)[:500])
        else:
            print('Manifest script tags',re.findall(r'<script[^>]*>',p)[:10])
        with pymupdf.open('Documentation/Lectures/Software Architecture Part 1.pdf') as d:
            print('Architecture lecture page 35:',d[-1].get_text())
        '@ | py -X utf8 -

    $ @'
        from pathlib import Path
        import re,json,base64,gzip,pymupdf
        p=Path('docs/HiFi.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        m=re.search(r'<script[^>]*(?:type|id)="__bundler/manifest"[^>]*>(.*?)</script>',p,re.S)
        manifest=json.loads(m.group(1))
        for item in manifest.values():
            if item.get('mime') != 'text/html':continue
            b=base64.b64decode(item['data'])
            h=(gzip.decompress(b) if item.get('compressed') else b).decode('utf-8')
            lines=h.splitlines()
            hits=[i for i,line in enumerate(lines) if any(s in line.lower() for s in ['offline','retry','sync','notify'])]
            print('HIFI OFFLINE/SYNC REFERENCES')
            for i in hits:
                print(str(i+1)+': '+lines[i][:800])
        with pymupdf.open('Documentation/Lectures/Software Architecture Part 1.pdf') as d:
            print('\nARCHITECTURE PAGE 3\n',d[2].get_text())
        with pymupdf.open('Documentation/Lectures/Lecture 8 - Automated UI-UXadaptation.pdf') as d:
            print('\nADAPTATION LECTURE TITLES')
            for i,p in enumerate(d): print(i+1, ' | '.join(p.get_text().splitlines()[:3]))
        '@ | py -X utf8 -

    ARCHITECTURE PAGE 3
     Bass’ definition of software architecture
    “The software architecture of a computing system is the structures of the system, which comprise
    software elements, the externally visible properties of those elements, and the relationships among them.”
    Bass, Clements and Kazman, Software Architecture in Practice
    Software elements
    Elements depend on the structure:
    •
    In the code structure the elements
    are packages and classes.
    •
    In the run-time structure they are
    instances, processes and threads
    •
    In the deployment structure they are
    devices and servers.
    Externally visible properties
    •
    A property of an element is externally
    visible if another element can rely on it
    without reading the first element's
    code.
    Relationships
    •
    Who calls whom, who observes whom,
    who depends on whom.
    •
    In the code structure, relationships are
    imports and inheritance.
    •
    In the run-time structure they are calls,
    messages and subscriptions.
    •
    In the deployment structure they are
    network links.
    Views define what the elements and relations are: the same app has several structures, and each view picks one of
    them.

    @Composable
    fun SyncStatusStrip(status: SyncStatus, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
        val failed = status == SyncStatus.FAILED
        val synced = status == SyncStatus.SYNCED
        Surface(
            modifier,
            color = if (synced) AppColors.Green100 else if (failed) AppColors.Red50 else AppColors.Amber100,
            shape = AppShapes.Chip
        ) {
            Text(
                if (synced) "Synced" else if (failed) "Couldn't sync yet Â· retrying automatically" else "Saved on your phone Â· waiting to sync",
                Modifier.padding(horizontal = AppSpacing.Space12, vertical = AppSpacing.Space8),
                style = AppTypography.Label,
                color = if (synced) AppColors.Green700 else if (failed) AppColors.Red800 else AppColors.Amber800
            )
        }
    }

     Cloud Firestore – Listening to Collections
    Firestore can listen for changes to a
    collection instead of fetching data over
    and over, allowing for live updates in our
    app when data changes.
    
    
    DOCUMENT Documentation/Lectures/Android 4.pdf PAGE 22
     Cloud Firestore – Repository Pattern
    To access the database, we should introduce a
    Repository.
    The repository is responsible for:
    • Accessing and modifying data
    • Hiding database/API details from the
    ViewModel
    • Providing a single place for
    data-related operations
    ViewModel should not communicate directly
    with the database, but should instead use the
    repository as an intermediary

    DOCUMENT Documentation/Lectures/Andorid 2.pdf PAGE 16
     Creating ViewModels
    • ViewModel for displaying a name
    • _name is mutable and private
    • MutableStateFlow holds a value that
    can be changed, and sends new value
    to observers
    • name is read-only and public
    • asStateFlow() creates read-only copy
    • _name can only be changed using the
    public function setName()
    
    
    DOCUMENT Documentation/Lectures/Andorid 2.pdf PAGE 17
     Using ViewModels
    • ViewModel is passed to the screen that uses it
    • = viewModel() means that an instance is created if one is not passed
    • If multiple screens use the same VM, the same instance should be
    passed between them
    • collectAsStateWithLifeCycle() observes a StateFlow and converts it
    to Compose State
    • In this example, it
    becomes a String that
    can be displayed in
    the UI
    
    
    DOCUMENT Documentation/Lectures/Andorid 2.pdf PAGE 23
     Why ViewModels over remember(Saveable?)
    When to use ViewModels
    • Complex business logic
    • State shared across multiple screens
    • Background operations (Networks calls)
    • State that needs to survive process death
    When remember(Saveable) is enough
    • Simple UI state (toggle, text input)
    • State only used within a single composable
    • No business logic involved
    • Primitive types only
    The problem with remember(Saveable) everywhere
    • Prop drilling nightmare
    • No separation between UI and potential business logic
    • Awkward for complex objects
    • No lifecycle-aware coroutine scope
    Further reading:ViewModel

## Assistant

I found three integration risks to resolve before enabling synchronization: local writes and queue inserts are separate transactions; queue rows have no account owner or operation version; and Firestore listeners currently mark user snapshots synced without checking pending-write metadata. There is also no durable record of completed retries. I’m treating these as shared-contract decisions and leaving the code unchanged.

    sealed interface HomeUiState {
        data object Loading : HomeUiState
        data class Error(val message: String) : HomeUiState
        data class Success(
            val data: HomeData,
            val filter: GroupFilter = GroupFilter.Recent,
            val period: SpendPeriod = SpendPeriod.Month,
            val selectedGroupId: String? = null,
            val paymentsExpanded: Boolean = false,
            val confirmingAll: Boolean = false,
            val paymentStates: Map<String, InlineActionState> = emptyMap(),
            val recordedPayments: Map<String, OutstandingPayment> = emptyMap(),
            val canSettle: Boolean = false,
            val sourceError: String? = null
        ) : HomeUiState {
            val outstanding: List<OutstandingPayment> = data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().filter {
                it.transfer.debtorId == data.user.id && it.transfer.currency == "DKK" && it.transfer.amountCents > 0
            }.distinctBy { it.id }
            val payments: List<OutstandingPayment> = (outstanding + recordedPayments.values).distinctBy { it.id }
            val unpaid: List<OutstandingPayment> = outstanding.filter { paymentStates[it.id] !is InlineActionState.Done }
            val isWorking: Boolean = paymentStates.values.any { it == InlineActionState.Working }
            val oweCents: Long = unpaid.sumOf { it.transfer.amountCents }
            val owingGroupCount: Int = unpaid.map { it.groupId }.distinct().size
            val owedCents: Long = data.groups.sumOf { group ->
                data.finances?.balancesByGroup?.get(group.group.id)?.takeIf {
                    it.currency == "DKK" && it.userId == data.user.id
                }?.netBalanceCents?.coerceAtLeast(0L) ?: 0L
            }
            val hasFinancialSummary: Boolean = data.finances?.let { finances ->
                finances.outstandingPayments.all {
                    it.transfer.currency == "DKK" && it.transfer.debtorId == data.user.id &&
                    it.transfer.amountCents > 0 && data.groups.any { group -> group.group.id == it.groupId }
                } && data.groups.all { group ->
                    val balance = finances.balancesByGroup[group.group.id]
                    balance != null && balance.currency == "DKK" && balance.userId == data.user.id &&
                    outstanding.filter { it.groupId == group.group.id }.sumOf { it.transfer.amountCents } == maxOf(
                        0L,
                        -balance.netBalanceCents
                    )
                }
            } == true
        }
    }
    
    class HomeViewModel(
        source: Flow<HomeData>,
        private val settlements: SettlementActions? = null
    ) : ViewModel() {
        private val mutableState = MutableStateFlow<HomeUiState>(HomeUiState.Loading)
        val state = mutableState.asStateFlow()
        private var recording = false
    
        init {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    source.collect { data ->
                        val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success
                        mutableState.value = if (current == null || current.data.user.id != data.user.id) {
                            HomeUiState.Success(data, canSettle = settlements != null)
                        } else {
                            val unchangedIds = data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().filter { payment ->
                                current.data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().any { it == payment }
                            }.map { it.id }.toSet()
                            val recorded = current.recordedPayments.filterValues { payment ->
                                val next = data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().firstOrNull { it.id == payment.id }
                                next == null || next == payment
                            }
                            current.copy(
                                data = data,
                                sourceError = null,
                                confirmingAll = current.confirmingAll &&
                                    current.data.finances?.outstandingPayments == data.finances?.outstandingPayments,
                                paymentStates = current.paymentStates.filterKeys { it in unchangedIds || it in recorded },
                                recordedPayments = recorded
                            )
                        }
                    }
                } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                    throw error
                } catch (error: Exception) {
                    val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success
                    mutableState.value = current?.copy(sourceError = "Couldn't refresh. Showing the last dashboard.")
                    ?: HomeUiState.Error(error.message ?: "Couldn't load your dashboard")
                }
            }
        }
    
        private fun update(change: (HomeUiState.Success) -> HomeUiState.Success) {
            mutableState.update { if (it is HomeUiState.Success) change(it) else it }
        }
    
        fun selectFilter(filter: GroupFilter) = update { it.copy(filter = filter) }
        fun selectPeriod(period: SpendPeriod) = update { it.copy(period = period, selectedGroupId = null) }
        fun selectSlice(groupId: String?) = update { it.copy(selectedGroupId = groupId) }
        fun togglePayments() = update {
            it.copy(
                paymentsExpanded = !it.paymentsExpanded,
                confirmingAll = false,
                recordedPayments = if (it.paymentsExpanded) emptyMap() else it.recordedPayments
            )
        }
        fun closePayments() = update {
            it.copy(paymentsExpanded = false, confirmingAll = false, recordedPayments = emptyMap())
        }
    
        fun cancelPayment() = update {
            it.copy(
                confirmingAll = false,
                paymentStates = it.paymentStates.filterValues { value -> value != InlineActionState.Confirming }
            )
        }
    
        fun askPayment(id: String) {
            cancelPayment()
            update {
                if (!it.canSettle || !it.hasFinancialSummary || recording || it.unpaid.none { payment -> payment.id == id }) it
                else it.copy(paymentStates = it.paymentStates + (id to InlineActionState.Confirming))
            }
        }
    
        fun askAll() {
            cancelPayment()
            update { if (it.canSettle && it.hasFinancialSummary && !recording && it.unpaid.isNotEmpty()) it.copy(confirmingAll = true) else it }
        }
    
        fun confirmPayment(id: String) {
            val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return
            if (current.paymentStates[id] != InlineActionState.Confirming || recording) return
            record(current.unpaid.filter { it.id == id })
        }
    
        fun confirmAll() {
            val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return
            if (current.confirmingAll && !recording) record(current.unpaid)
        }
    
        private fun record(payments: List<OutstandingPayment>) {
            val actions = settlements ?: return
            val userId = (mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success)?.data?.user?.id ?: return
            recording = true
            update { it.copy(
                    confirmingAll = false,
                    paymentStates = it.paymentStates + payments.associate { p -> p.id to InlineActionState.Working }
            ) }
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    for (payment in payments) {
                        val latest = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return@launch
                        if (latest.data.user.id != userId) return@launch
                        val result = try {
                            check(latest.payments.any { it == payment }) { "This balance changed. Check the latest payment." }
                            InlineActionState.Done(actions.recordSettlement(payment))
                        } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                            throw error
                        } catch (error: Exception) {
                            InlineActionState.Failed(error.message ?: "Couldn't record this payment. Try again.")
                        }
                        update {
                            val next = it.outstanding.firstOrNull { current -> current.id == payment.id }
                            if (it.data.user.id == userId && (next == payment || (next == null && result is InlineActionState.Done))) {
                                it.copy(
                                    paymentStates = it.paymentStates + (payment.id to result),
                                    recordedPayments = if (result is InlineActionState.Done) {
                                        it.recordedPayments + (payment.id to payment)
                                    } else it.recordedPayments
                                )
                            } else it
                        }
                    }
                } finally {
                    recording = false
                }
            }
        }
    }

    sealed interface ActivityUiState {
        data object Loading : ActivityUiState
        data class Error(val message: String) : ActivityUiState
        data class Success(
            val data: ActivityData,
            val filter: ActivityFilter = ActivityFilter.All,
            val readIds: Set<String> = emptySet(),
            val actions: Map<String, InlineActionState> = emptyMap(),
            val canSettle: Boolean = false,
            val canRetry: Boolean = false,
            val sourceError: String? = null
        ) : ActivityUiState {
            val events: List<ActivityEvent> = data.events.orEmpty().distinctBy { it.id }
            val needsCount: Int = events.count { it.needsAction(data.userId, actionFor(it)) }
            val hasUnread: Boolean = events.any { it.unread && it.id !in readIds }
            fun actionFor(event: ActivityEvent): InlineActionState =
            if (event.type == ActivityType.SyncFailure && event.syncStatus == SyncStatus.SYNCED) InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.SYNCED)
            else actions[event.id] ?: InlineActionState.Idle
        }
    }
    
    class ActivityViewModel(
        source: Flow<ActivityData>,
        private val settlements: SettlementActions? = null,
        private val retries: SyncRetryActions? = null
    ) : ViewModel() {
        private val mutableState = MutableStateFlow<ActivityUiState>(ActivityUiState.Loading)
        val state = mutableState.asStateFlow()
        private val activeIds = mutableSetOf<String>()
    
        init {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    source.collect { data ->
                        val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success
                        mutableState.value = if (current == null || current.data.userId != data.userId) {
                            ActivityUiState.Success(data, canSettle = settlements != null, canRetry = retries != null)
                        } else {
                            val unchangedIds = data.events.orEmpty().filter { next ->
                                current.events.any {
                                    it.id == next.id && it.payment == next.payment &&
                                    (it.syncStatus == next.syncStatus || current.actions[next.id] == InlineActionState.Working)
                                }
                            }.map { it.id }.toSet()
                            current.copy(data = data, sourceError = null, actions = current.actions.filterKeys { it in unchangedIds })
                        }
                    }
                } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                    throw error
                } catch (error: Exception) {
                    val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success
                    mutableState.value = current?.copy(sourceError = "Couldn't refresh. Showing the last activity.")
                    ?: ActivityUiState.Error(error.message ?: "Couldn't load activity")
                }
            }
        }
    
        private fun update(change: (ActivityUiState.Success) -> ActivityUiState.Success) {
            mutableState.update { if (it is ActivityUiState.Success) change(it) else it }
        }
    
        fun selectFilter(filter: ActivityFilter) = update { it.copy(filter = filter) }
        fun markAllRead() = update { it.copy(readIds = it.readIds + it.events.map { event -> event.id }) }
    
        fun askPayment(id: String) = update {
            val event = it.events.firstOrNull { event -> event.id == id }
            if (event == null || !it.canSettle || !event.canPay(it.data.userId) || id in activeIds || it.actionFor(event) is InlineActionState.Done) it
            else it.copy(
                actions = it.actions.filterValues { value -> value != InlineActionState.Confirming } + (id to InlineActionState.Confirming),
                readIds = it.readIds + id
            )
        }
    
        fun cancelPayment() = update { it.copy(actions = it.actions.filterValues { value -> value != InlineActionState.Confirming }) }
    
        fun confirmPayment(id: String) {
            val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success ?: return
            val event = current.events.firstOrNull { it.id == id } ?: return
            val service = settlements ?: return
            if (current.actions[id] != InlineActionState.Confirming || !event.canPay(current.data.userId)) return
            runAction(event) { service.recordSettlement(event.payment!!) }
        }
    
        fun retry(id: String) {
            val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success ?: return
            val event = current.events.firstOrNull { it.id == id } ?: return
            val service = retries ?: return
            if (event.type != ActivityType.SyncFailure || !event.needsAction(current.data.userId, current.actionFor(event))) return
            runAction(event) {
                val status = service.retry(event)
                check(status != SyncStatus.FAILED) { "Couldn't sync yet. Try again." }
                status
            }
        }
    
        private fun runAction(event: ActivityEvent, action: suspend () -> SyncStatus) {
            if (!activeIds.add(event.id)) return
            val userId = (mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success)?.data?.userId ?: return
            update { it.copy(actions = it.actions + (event.id to InlineActionState.Working), readIds = it.readIds + event.id) }
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    val result = try {
                        InlineActionState.Done(action())
                    } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                        throw error
                    } catch (error: Exception) {
                        InlineActionState.Failed(error.message ?: "Couldn't complete this action. Try again.")
                    }
                    update {
                        if (it.data.userId == userId && it.events.any { current -> current.id == event.id && current.payment == event.payment }) {
                            it.copy(actions = it.actions + (event.id to result))
                        } else it
                    }
                } finally { activeIds.remove(event.id) }
            }
        }
    }

## Assistant

**Phase 4 is feasible without replacing SQLiteOpenHelper, but reliable end-to-end synchronization needs coordination with the database owner.** The existing queue is a useful foundation; it is not yet a working synchronization system.

This review was read-only. No project files were changed, and no implementation or Git history operations were performed.

**1. What currently exists**

I re-inspected the database, all five DAOs, entities/converters, synchronization models, `AuthRepository`, manifest/dependencies, MainActivity, Home/Activity contracts and ViewModels, and existing database tests.

I also revisited the project overview, responsibility distribution, design requirements, relevant Android and architecture lecture pages—including rendered diagrams/code examples—and the database/navigation documents and bundled Hi-Fi synchronization states.

| Area | Current implementation |
|---|---|
| Local database | One persistent SQLiteOpenHelper database, schema version 2, seven tables, foreign-key enforcement and WAL. |
| Reactive reads | DAOs expose `Flow` queries through `AppDatabase.observeTables()`, including an initial query when observation starts. |
| Queue | `SyncQueueDao` supports enqueueing, FIFO reading, recording retry failures and removing rows. |
| Queue metadata | Entity/action, JSON payload, retry count, last attempt and error message are persisted. |
| Entity status | `SYNCED`, three pending states and `FAILED` already exist. |
| Firebase | Authentication and `/users/{uid}` reads/writes/listening are implemented in `AuthRepository`. |
| Financial synchronization | Group, expense and settlement remote synchronization is documented, but no implementation was found. |
| Home | Accepts supplied data, an offline timestamp, pending expense counts and settlement actions. |
| Activity | Accepts supplied events and injected settlement/retry actions. Read state remains session-only. |
| Background work | No WorkManager dependency, worker, scheduler or connectivity monitor was found. |
| Tests | Local schema/database tests exist, but the database instrumentation test uses an in-memory database and does not demonstrate restart recovery or remote retries. |

The current production entry point still contains authentication/counter navigation. I will leave it unchanged; Person 1 must connect the authenticated screens and lifecycle hooks.

**2. Missing functionality and important risks**

These are the main issues to resolve before real synchronization is enabled:

- **Local mutation and queue insertion are not atomic.** Existing authentication writes launch local persistence separately and enqueue on some remote failures. A crash between those steps can leave an unsynchronized mutation without a queue entry.
- **Firestore already has its own offline behavior.** Android persistence is enabled by default, and listeners can emit local writes before server acknowledgement. The existing listener maps user snapshots to `SYNCED` without checking pending-write metadata. Adding a second writer without coordinating acknowledgement handling could produce misleading status or stale replays. [Firebase offline behavior](https://firebase.google.com/docs/firestore/manage-data/enable-offline), [snapshot metadata](https://firebase.google.com/docs/reference/android/com/google/firebase/firestore/SnapshotMetadata).
- **Queue rows have no explicit account owner.** Naming a worker after a UID does not establish ownership of its queue entries. Group membership alone is insufficient to identify who submitted an operation.
- **Operation ordering and acknowledgement are undefined.** Multiple updates can exist for one entity. Completing an older operation must not mark a newer pending edit synced.
- **Queue payloads have no agreed serialization contract.** Existing registration payloads use string interpolation, which can produce invalid JSON for names containing quotes or special characters.
- **Remote refreshes can overwrite pending local values.** The owner needs a rule for reconciling snapshots against outstanding mutations.
- **Parent upserts need review.** `CONFLICT_REPLACE` on users/groups can invoke delete/cascade behavior affecting child rows. That is a risk when implementing repeated remote normalization.
- **No durable completion history exists.** Removing a queue row loses its retry history. The UI cannot subsequently establish that a previously failed operation succeeded.
- **No trustworthy cache-refresh timestamp exists.** Entity `updatedAt` values are not equivalent to “this saved dataset was refreshed at HH:MM.”

These findings do **not** authorize changes to the shared implementation. They are coordination items for the database owner.

**3. Proposed architecture**

Use the lecture’s straightforward structure: Compose → ViewModel → repository/data adapter → the existing SQLite database, with WorkManager processing the existing outbox.

Proposed runtime flow:

```text
Feature action
    ↓
Owner's repository
    ↓ one local transaction
Entity + splits/members + existing sync_queue
    ├── DAO Flow → Home/Activity data → ViewModels → Compose
    └── schedule background work
                     ↓
                SyncWorker
                     ↓
        Owner-provided queue processor
                     ↓
          Owner's Firestore integration
                     ↓ server acknowledgement
       Reconcile entity status + queue entry
                     ↓
           Updated flows + recovery feedback
```

**The worker will not define Firestore collections, serialize financial documents or implement settlement calculations.** Those responsibilities remain with the existing owners.

Only one new integration boundary is needed: a small queue processor supplied by the database owner. Its responsibilities would be:

- Validate the authenticated account and operation ownership.
- Read and process the existing queue.
- Preserve operation ordering.
- Perform supported remote operations.
- Distinguish acknowledged, retryable and blocked outcomes.
- Update local status/queue consistently.
- Provide identifiers for successfully recovered operations.

These are proposed responsibilities, not APIs that currently exist.

**4. Scheduling, retry and restart behavior**

My proposed Person 5 implementation is:

- A `CoroutineWorker`, using `NetworkType.CONNECTED`.
- Unique automatic work per account with `KEEP`, preventing repeated scheduling from creating parallel drains.
- Exponential backoff starting at 10 seconds.
- Bounded processing; no long-running loop or coroutine sleep inside the worker.
- `Result.retry()` for temporary failures, preserving the original queue row.
- No automatic deletion of malformed, unauthorized or unsupported operations.
- A lightweight periodic reconciliation trigger to recover missed scheduling, plus reconciliation at authenticated startup. It checks/schedules the existing queue; it is not another outbox.
- Re-check authentication before processing and between operations. Account changes stop further processing without deleting pending data.

WorkManager supports constraints, persistent work and retry backoff, but execution timing is inexact. Periodic work has a minimum interval of 15 minutes. [Work requests](https://developer.android.com/develop/background-work/background-tasks/persistent/getting-started/define-work), [periodic work](https://developer.android.com/reference/kotlin/androidx/work/PeriodicWorkRequest).

For **Try now**, I recommend a separately named, unique immediate request using the **same worker and serialized processor**. This allows a user-requested attempt while automatic work is waiting for backoff, without cancelling an in-flight remote write. Repeated taps coalesce.

That requires the owner’s processor to serialize all entry points. Unique WorkManager names alone do not guarantee that remote operations cannot be duplicated. [Unique work](https://developer.android.com/develop/background-work/background-tasks/persistent/how-to/manage-work).

The processing contract must assume **at-least-once execution**:

- Reuse stable document/operation identities.
- Never generate a fresh settlement ID merely because an upload retries.
- Handle a crash after remote success but before local acknowledgement.
- Remove only the acknowledged operation.
- Preserve any newer pending mutation.

Normal process death/reboot recovery must be tested separately from Android **Force stop**. The plan will not promise background execution while the application is force-stopped.

**Lecture timing conflict:** the architecture example specifies a five-minute backoff ceiling and delivery within 60 seconds after reconnection. Standard WorkManager exponential backoff does not enforce that custom ceiling, and Android scheduling cannot guarantee that delivery deadline. I recommend standard backoff initially, measuring foreground reconnection performance and reporting the limitation. A strict custom retry ceiling would need an explicitly agreed scheduling policy. [WorkRequest limits](https://developer.android.com/reference/androidx/work/WorkRequest).

**5. Home, Activity and recovery feedback**

Reuse the existing components and extend only Person 5’s presentation contracts where necessary.

- Add one shared connectivity observer using `ConnectivityManager` callbacks; do not poll or treat Wi-Fi availability as proof that Firebase is reachable. [Network-state guidance](https://developer.android.com/develop/connectivity/network-ops/reading-network-state).
- Feed actual local snapshots into Home, with Person 4 supplying balances calculated from the locally available ledger.
- Use an owner-supplied saved-data timestamp. If unavailable, show an honest timestamp-free offline message.
- Add optional offline metadata to Activity and reuse the banner where appropriate, preserving its documented layout.
- Show pending counts from actual persisted operations/entities.
- Return a pending status when Try now merely schedules work. Show success only after acknowledgement arrives through the data source.
- Reconcile inline settlement feedback with subsequent persisted status changes. The current action result alone cannot track a pending settlement through restart and eventual synchronization.
- Keep **manual settlement completion** distinct from **cloud synchronization completion**.
- Never display “group notified” without an actual notification-delivery result.

For NFR-K3 recovery feedback:

- Foreground: a short success message for a previously failed operation.
- Background: a local notification, coordinated with Person 1’s preferences and Android notification permission.
- Use stable operation identifiers to avoid duplicate recovery messages.

**Durable recovery feedback remains a shared integration gap.** Queue disappearance and a transient ViewModel event are insufficient after restart. The owner must agree how to retain completion/acknowledgement information. I will not introduce another database or silently add a history table.

**7. Dependencies and teammate coordination**

Use WorkManager runtime plus `work-testing`, declared through the version catalog. Select a compatible stable version during implementation; no Room, Hilt, Retrofit, additional database or replacement Firebase layer is needed.

| Owner | Required agreement/deliverable |
|---|---|
| Database/Firebase owner | Atomic outbox writes; supported payloads/actions; account ownership; ordered/idempotent processing; acknowledgement/conflict rules; durable recovery information. |

| Person 2 | Group/member mutations use the agreed local transaction and scheduling path. |
| Person 3 | Expense/split saves use that path, including offline scanning results. |

**8. Room requirement**

**Room is explicitly named in the team responsibility document**, page 2: Person 5’s offline architecture includes Room DB and WorkManager, and the shared agreement describes repositories accessing Room locally.

However, the original project overview requires reliability behavior without mandating Room. The schema documentation uses “Room / SQLite,” while the actual implementation uses SQLiteOpenHelper.

Room is an abstraction over SQLite; using SQLiteOpenHelper does not itself constitute using Room. [Android Room documentation](https://developer.android.com/training/data-storage/room).

Therefore:

- SQLite can support NFR-K1–K3.
- The explicit team-level Room deliverable remains unresolved.
- WorkManager does not require Room for the application’s business database.
- Any eventual Room adoption needs the database owner’s migration/data-preservation plan and approval, or an agreed/documented change to the responsibility requirement.
- No Room implementation or second business database belongs in the proposed independent work.

WorkManager maintains its own internal scheduling storage; that does not replace or duplicate the application’s financial database.

**9. Verification strategy**

After Phase 4B approval, test these scenarios:

| Scenario | Required evidence |
|---|---|
| Airplane mode after fetching data | Previously retrieved groups, expenses and Person 4 balances remain readable. |
| Save while offline | Local mutation and queue entry commit together; UI remains usable and shows pending. |
| Fail twice, then succeed | Retry metadata/backoff advance; exactly one logical remote operation results. |
| Restore connectivity | Queue progresses and actual acknowledged status reaches both screens. |
| Manual retry during automatic retry | Serialized processing; no duplicate settlement/upload. |
| Edit during an in-flight upload | Older acknowledgement does not clear the newer pending edit. |
| Restart before work is scheduled | Startup/reconciliation discovers the durable queue. |
| Kill after remote success | Replay/reconciliation does not duplicate the operation. |
| Switch accounts/logout | Another account’s operations are neither uploaded nor displayed. |
| Permanent error | Operation remains inspectable with truthful feedback; no silent loss. |
| Recovery notification denied | Foreground/durable feedback remains available through the agreed source. |
| Parent refresh | Existing members, expenses, splits and settlements remain intact. |

Use WorkManager’s test utilities and a fake processor for deterministic unit tests, file-backed SQLite instrumentation tests for restart persistence, and Firebase Emulator tests for the owner’s actual adapter. Finish with real emulator airplane-mode/restart tests and recorded timing measurements.

The previously verified Home/Activity tests remain regression coverage; they do not prove offline synchronization.

**Approval boundary**

Person 5 can independently build the scheduling/connectivity foundation and UI behavior against tested contracts. **Complete NFR-K1, NFR-K2 and NFR-K3 cannot yet be claimed** without the owner’s real local-first write/read integration, safe queue processing and recovery metadata.

I have stopped at Phase 4A. Phase 4B requires your explicit approval; shared architecture changes remain separately subject to approval.

    @Composable
    fun ActivityRoute(viewModel: ActivityViewModel, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
        val state by viewModel.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
        ActivityScreen(state, { action ->
                when (action) {
                    is ActivityAction.Filter -> viewModel.selectFilter(action.filter)
                    is ActivityAction.Ask -> viewModel.askPayment(action.eventId)
                    is ActivityAction.Confirm -> viewModel.confirmPayment(action.eventId)
                    is ActivityAction.Retry -> viewModel.retry(action.eventId)
                    ActivityAction.Cancel -> viewModel.cancelPayment()
                    ActivityAction.MarkAllRead -> viewModel.markAllRead()
                }
            }, modifier)
    }

    @Composable
    private fun ActivityCard(event: ActivityEvent, state: ActivityUiState.Success, onAction: (ActivityAction) -> Unit) {
        val action = state.actionFor(event)
        val unread = event.unread && event.id !in state.readIds
        val done = action is InlineActionState.Done && (event.type != ActivityType.SyncFailure || action.syncStatus == SyncStatus.SYNCED)
        Surface(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), shape = AppShapes.BigButton,
            color = if (done) AppColors.Green50 else if (unread) AppColors.ActivityUnread else AppColors.White,
            border = BorderStroke(
                1.dp,
                if (done) AppColors.Green200 else if (unread) AppColors.ActivityUnreadBorder else AppColors.LineSoft
            )
        ) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(AppSpacing.Space12), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space12)) {
                    EventAvatar(event, state.data.userId, done)
                    Column(Modifier.weight(1f), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp)) {
                        val actor = if (event.actor?.id == state.data.userId) "You" else event.actor?.displayName ?: event.expenseTitle.orEmpty()
                        Text(buildAnnotatedString {
                                withStyle(SpanStyle(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)) { append(actor) }
                                if (actor.isNotEmpty()) append(" ")
                                append(if (event.type == ActivityType.SyncFailure && done) "synced" else event.description)
                            }, style = AppTypography.BodyStrong, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                            Box(Modifier.size(8.dp).background(AppColors.groupColorAt(event.group.colourIndex), AppShapes.Circle))
                            Text(
                                "${event.group.group.name} Â· ${if (activityDay(event.occurredAt, state.data.nowMillis) == "Earlier") dateText(event.occurredAt, "EEE d MMM") else dateText(event.occurredAt, "HH:mm")}",
                                style = AppTypography.Label,
                                color = AppColors.Ink600
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                        event.amountCents?.let { amount ->
                            val colour = when {
                                done || event.direction == AmountDirection.Received || event.direction == AmountDirection.Settled -> AppColors.Green700
                                event.direction == AmountDirection.Owed -> AppColors.Red700
                                else -> AppColors.Ink900
                            }
                            Text(
                                formatDanishAmountFromCents(
                                    amount,
                                    false,
                                    event.direction == AmountDirection.Received
                                ) + if (event.currency == "DKK") "" else " ${event.currency}",
                                style = AppTypography.ItemTitle,
                                color = colour
                            )
                        }
                        if (unread) Box(Modifier.size(8.dp).background(
                                AppColors.Green500,
                                AppShapes.Circle
                            ).semantics { contentDescription = "Unread" })
                    }
                }
                if (event.canPay(state.data.userId)) {
                    val payment = event.payment!!
                    InlinePaymentActions(
                        action,
                        formatDanishAmountFromCents(payment.transfer.amountCents),
                        payment.creditorName,
                        { onAction(ActivityAction.Ask(event.id)) },
                        { onAction(ActivityAction.Cancel) },
                        { onAction(ActivityAction.Confirm(event.id)) },
                        Modifier.padding(start = 56.dp),
                        enabled = state.canSettle
                    )
                }
                if (event.type == ActivityType.SyncFailure) Column(
                    Modifier.padding(start = 56.dp),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space8)
                ) {
                    when (action) {
                        InlineActionState.Working -> ActionStatus("Syncingâ€¦", working = true)
                        is InlineActionState.Done -> {
                            if (action.syncStatus == SyncStatus.SYNCED) ActionStatus("Synced")
                            else SyncStatusStrip(action.syncStatus ?: SyncStatus.PENDING_UPDATE)
                        }
                        else -> {
                            if (action is InlineActionState.Failed) Text(
                                action.message,
                                style = AppTypography.Caption,
                                color = AppColors.Amber800
                            )
                            DashboardButton(
                                "Try now",
                                { onAction(ActivityAction.Retry(event.id)) },
                                Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                                AppColors.White,
                                AppColors.Red800,
                                state.canRetry,
                                outlined = true,
                                borderColour = AppColors.RetryBorder
                            )
                            if (!state.canRetry) Text(
                                "Sync service unavailable",
                                style = AppTypography.Caption,
                                color = AppColors.Ink600
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    private fun EventAvatar(event: ActivityEvent, userId: String, done: Boolean) {
        val failed = event.type == ActivityType.SyncFailure
        val colour = if (failed) { if (done) AppColors.Green100 else AppColors.Red50 } else if (event.actor?.id == userId) AppColors.Green300 else AppColors.groupColorAt(event.actorColourIndex)
        val badgeColour: Color = if (done) AppColors.Green700 else when (event.type) {
            ActivityType.Reminder, ActivityType.SyncFailure -> AppColors.Red700
            ActivityType.Payment -> AppColors.Green700
            ActivityType.ExpenseChanged -> AppColors.Ink600
            ActivityType.ExpenseAdded -> AppColors.Green500
        }
        val icon = if (done) DashboardIcon.Check else when (event.type) {
            ActivityType.Reminder -> DashboardIcon.Bell
            ActivityType.SyncFailure -> DashboardIcon.Warning
            ActivityType.Payment -> DashboardIcon.Check
            ActivityType.ExpenseChanged -> DashboardIcon.Edit
            ActivityType.ExpenseAdded -> DashboardIcon.Plus
        }
        Box(Modifier.size(44.dp)) {
            DashboardAvatar(if (failed) "" else event.actor?.displayName.orEmpty(), colour, round = true)
            Surface(
                Modifier.size(20.dp).align(Alignment.BottomEnd).offset(3.dp, 3.dp),
                color = badgeColour,
                shape = AppShapes.Circle,
                border = BorderStroke(2.dp, AppColors.White)
            ) {
                DashboardSymbol(icon, Modifier.padding(4.dp), colour = AppColors.White)
            }
        }
    }

    sealed interface HomeAction {
        data class Filter(val filter: GroupFilter) : HomeAction
        data class Period(val period: SpendPeriod) : HomeAction
        data class Slice(val groupId: String?) : HomeAction
        data class Ask(val paymentId: String) : HomeAction
        data class Confirm(val paymentId: String) : HomeAction
        data object TogglePayments : HomeAction
        data object ClosePayments : HomeAction
        data object Cancel : HomeAction
        data object AskAll : HomeAction
        data object ConfirmAll : HomeAction
    }
    
    @Composable
    fun HomeRoute(
        viewModel: HomeViewModel,
        onOpenActivity: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroups: () -> Unit,
        onCreateGroup: () -> Unit,
        onJoinGroup: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroup: (String) -> Unit,
        modifier: Modifier = Modifier
    ) {
        val state by viewModel.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
        HomeScreen(state, { action ->
                when (action) {
                    is HomeAction.Filter -> viewModel.selectFilter(action.filter)
                    is HomeAction.Period -> viewModel.selectPeriod(action.period)
                    is HomeAction.Slice -> viewModel.selectSlice(action.groupId)
                    is HomeAction.Ask -> viewModel.askPayment(action.paymentId)
                    is HomeAction.Confirm -> viewModel.confirmPayment(action.paymentId)
                    HomeAction.TogglePayments -> viewModel.togglePayments()
                    HomeAction.ClosePayments -> viewModel.closePayments()
                    HomeAction.Cancel -> viewModel.cancelPayment()
                    HomeAction.AskAll -> viewModel.askAll()
                    HomeAction.ConfirmAll -> viewModel.confirmAll()
                }
            }, onOpenActivity, onOpenGroups, onCreateGroup, onJoinGroup, onOpenGroup, modifier)
    }

    sealed interface ActivityUiState {
        data object Loading : ActivityUiState
        data class Error(val message: String) : ActivityUiState
        data class Success(
            val data: ActivityData,
            val filter: ActivityFilter = ActivityFilter.All,
            val readIds: Set<String> = emptySet(),
            val actions: Map<String, InlineActionState> = emptyMap(),
            val canSettle: Boolean = false,
            val canRetry: Boolean = false,
            val sourceError: String? = null
        ) : ActivityUiState {
            val events: List<ActivityEvent> = data.events.orEmpty().distinctBy { it.id }
            val needsCount: Int = events.count { it.needsAction(data.userId, actionFor(it)) }
            val hasUnread: Boolean = events.any { it.unread && it.id !in readIds }
            fun actionFor(event: ActivityEvent): InlineActionState =
            if (event.type == ActivityType.SyncFailure && event.syncStatus == SyncStatus.SYNCED) InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.SYNCED)
            else actions[event.id] ?: InlineActionState.Idle
        }
    }
    
    class ActivityViewModel(
        source: Flow<ActivityData>,
        private val settlements: SettlementActions? = null,
        private val retries: SyncRetryActions? = null
    ) : ViewModel() {
        private val mutableState = MutableStateFlow<ActivityUiState>(ActivityUiState.Loading)
        val state = mutableState.asStateFlow()
        private val activeIds = mutableSetOf<String>()
    
        init {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    source.collect { data ->
                        val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success
                        mutableState.value = if (current == null || current.data.userId != data.userId) {
                            ActivityUiState.Success(data, canSettle = settlements != null, canRetry = retries != null)
                        } else {
                            val unchangedIds = data.events.orEmpty().filter { next ->
                                current.events.any {
                                    it.id == next.id && it.payment == next.payment &&
                                    (it.syncStatus == next.syncStatus || current.actions[next.id] == InlineActionState.Working)
                                }
                            }.map { it.id }.toSet()
                            current.copy(data = data, sourceError = null, actions = current.actions.filterKeys { it in unchangedIds })
                        }
                    }
                } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                    throw error
                } catch (error: Exception) {
                    val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success
                    mutableState.value = current?.copy(sourceError = "Couldn't refresh. Showing the last activity.")
                    ?: ActivityUiState.Error(error.message ?: "Couldn't load activity")
                }
            }
        }
    
        private fun update(change: (ActivityUiState.Success) -> ActivityUiState.Success) {
            mutableState.update { if (it is ActivityUiState.Success) change(it) else it }
        }
    
        fun selectFilter(filter: ActivityFilter) = update { it.copy(filter = filter) }
        fun markAllRead() = update { it.copy(readIds = it.readIds + it.events.map { event -> event.id }) }
    
        fun askPayment(id: String) = update {
            val event = it.events.firstOrNull { event -> event.id == id }
            if (event == null || !it.canSettle || !event.canPay(it.data.userId) || id in activeIds || it.actionFor(event) is InlineActionState.Done) it
            else it.copy(
                actions = it.actions.filterValues { value -> value != InlineActionState.Confirming } + (id to InlineActionState.Confirming),
                readIds = it.readIds + id
            )
        }
    
        fun cancelPayment() = update { it.copy(actions = it.actions.filterValues { value -> value != InlineActionState.Confirming }) }

    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.sync
    
    import android.content.Context
    import android.net.ConnectivityManager
    import android.net.Network
    import android.net.NetworkCapabilities
    import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.awaitClose
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.callbackFlow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.distinctUntilChanged
    
    enum class ConnectionState { Unknown, Online, Offline }
    
    class ConnectivityObserver(context: Context) {
        private val manager = context.applicationContext.getSystemService(ConnectivityManager::class.java)
    
        fun observe() = callbackFlow {
            if (manager == null) {
                trySend(ConnectionState.Unknown)
                awaitClose { }
                return@callbackFlow
            }
            fun publish() {
                val capabilities = manager.getNetworkCapabilities(manager.activeNetwork)
                trySend(if (capabilities?.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET) == true &&
                    capabilities.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_VALIDATED)) {
                    ConnectionState.Online
                } else ConnectionState.Offline)
            }
            val callback = object : ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback() {
                override fun onAvailable(network: Network) = publish()
                override fun onLost(network: Network) = publish()
                override fun onCapabilitiesChanged(network: Network, capabilities: NetworkCapabilities) = publish()
            }
            try {
                manager.registerDefaultNetworkCallback(callback)
                publish()
            } catch (error: SecurityException) {
                trySend(ConnectionState.Unknown)
                close()
                return@callbackFlow
            }
            awaitClose { manager.unregisterNetworkCallback(callback) }
        }.distinctUntilChanged()
    }

    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.sync
    
    fun interface SyncQueueProcessor {
        suspend fun processNext(accountId: String): SyncStep
    }
    
    sealed interface SyncStep {
        data object Empty : SyncStep
        data class Acknowledged(val accountId: String) : SyncStep
        data object RetryLater : SyncStep
        data object NeedsAttention : SyncStep
    }
    
    enum class SyncRunResult { Complete, Retry, Unavailable, AccountChanged, NeedsAttention }

    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.sync
    
    import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
    import kotlinx.coroutines.TimeoutCancellationException
    import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
    import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
    import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeout
    
    class SyncRunner(
        private val processor: SyncQueueProcessor?,
        private val currentAccount: () -> String?,
        private val timeoutMillis: Long = 30_000,
        private val maxOperations: Int = 20
    ) {
        init {
            require(timeoutMillis > 0 && maxOperations > 0)
        }
    
        suspend fun run(accountId: String): SyncRunResult {
            if (processor == null) return SyncRunResult.Unavailable
            if (accountId.isBlank() || currentAccount() != accountId) return SyncRunResult.AccountChanged
            return try {
                withTimeout(timeoutMillis) {
                    processingLock.withLock {
                        repeat(maxOperations) {
                            if (currentAccount() != accountId) return@withLock SyncRunResult.AccountChanged
                            val step = processor.processNext(accountId)
                            if (currentAccount() != accountId) return@withLock SyncRunResult.AccountChanged
                            when (step) {
                                SyncStep.Empty -> return@withLock SyncRunResult.Complete
                                SyncStep.RetryLater -> return@withLock SyncRunResult.Retry
                                SyncStep.NeedsAttention -> return@withLock SyncRunResult.NeedsAttention
                                is SyncStep.Acknowledged -> if (step.accountId != accountId) {
                                    return@withLock SyncRunResult.NeedsAttention
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        SyncRunResult.Retry
                    }
                }
            } catch (error: TimeoutCancellationException) {
                SyncRunResult.Retry
            } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                throw error
            } catch (error: Exception) {
                SyncRunResult.NeedsAttention
            }
        }
    
        companion object {
            private val processingLock = Mutex()
        }
    }

    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.worker
    
    import androidx.work.BackoffPolicy
    import androidx.work.Constraints
    import androidx.work.ExistingWorkPolicy
    import androidx.work.NetworkType
    import androidx.work.OneTimeWorkRequest
    import androidx.work.OneTimeWorkRequestBuilder
    import androidx.work.WorkManager
    import androidx.work.workDataOf
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.sync.SyncRunner
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.sync.SyncRunResult
    import java.security.MessageDigest
    import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
    
    enum class ScheduleResult { Pending, Unavailable, AccountChanged }
    
    class SyncScheduler(private val workManager: WorkManager, private val runner: SyncRunner) {
        fun scheduleAutomatic(accountId: String): ScheduleResult = schedule(accountId, manual = false)
        fun scheduleManual(accountId: String): ScheduleResult = schedule(accountId, manual = true)
        fun recoverAfterRestart(accountId: String): ScheduleResult = scheduleAutomatic(accountId)
    
        private fun schedule(accountId: String, manual: Boolean): ScheduleResult {
            when (runner.readiness(accountId)) {
                SyncRunResult.Unavailable -> return ScheduleResult.Unavailable
                SyncRunResult.AccountChanged -> return ScheduleResult.AccountChanged
                else -> Unit
            }
            workManager.enqueueUniqueWork(workName(accountId, manual), ExistingWorkPolicy.KEEP, request(accountId))
            return ScheduleResult.Pending
        }
    
        companion object {
            fun workName(accountId: String, manual: Boolean = false): String {
                require(accountId.isNotBlank())
                val hash = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(accountId.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
                    .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
                return "person5-sync-${if (manual) "manual" else "automatic"}-$hash"
            }
    
            fun request(accountId: String): OneTimeWorkRequest {
                require(accountId.isNotBlank())
                return OneTimeWorkRequestBuilder<SyncWorker>()
                    .setInputData(workDataOf(SyncWorker.AccountKey to accountId))
                    .setConstraints(Constraints.Builder().setRequiredNetworkType(NetworkType.CONNECTED).build())
                    .setBackoffCriteria(BackoffPolicy.EXPONENTIAL, 10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                    .build()
            }
        }
    }
