    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.worker
    
    import android.content.Context
    import androidx.work.CoroutineWorker
    import androidx.work.ListenableWorker
    import androidx.work.WorkerFactory
    import androidx.work.WorkerParameters
    import androidx.work.workDataOf
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.sync.SyncQueueProcessor
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.sync.SyncRunner
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.sync.SyncRunResult
    
    class SyncWorker(
        context: Context,
        parameters: WorkerParameters,
        private val runner: SyncRunner = SyncRunner(null, { null })
    ) : CoroutineWorker(context, parameters) {
        constructor(context: Context, parameters: WorkerParameters) : this(context, parameters, SyncRunner(null, { null }))
    
        override suspend fun doWork(): Result {
            val accountId = inputData.getString(AccountKey).orEmpty()
            val outcome = runner.run(accountId)
            return when (outcome) {
                SyncRunResult.Complete -> Result.success()
                SyncRunResult.Retry -> Result.retry()
                else -> Result.failure(workDataOf("reason" to outcome.name))
            }
        }
    
        companion object { const val AccountKey = "account_id" }
    }
    
    class SyncWorkerFactory(processor: SyncQueueProcessor?, currentAccount: () -> String?) : WorkerFactory() {
        val runner = SyncRunner(processor, currentAccount)
    
        override fun createWorker(context: Context, workerClassName: String, parameters: WorkerParameters): ListenableWorker? =
            if (workerClassName == SyncWorker::class.java.name) SyncWorker(context, parameters, runner) else null
    }

    @OptIn(kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
    class SyncRunnerTest {
        @Test fun missingProcessorIsUnavailable() = runTest {
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.Unavailable, SyncRunner(null, { "u" }).run("u"))
        }
    
        @Test fun wrongOrMissingAccountDoesNotInvokeProcessor() = runTest {
            var calls = 0
            val runner = SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { calls++; SyncStep.Empty }, { "u" })
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.AccountChanged, runner.run("other"))
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.AccountChanged, runner.run(""))
            assertEquals(0, calls)
        }
    
        @Test fun acknowledgesThenDrains() = runTest {
            var calls = 0
            val runner = SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor {
                if (calls++ == 0) SyncStep.Acknowledged(it) else SyncStep.Empty
            }, { "u" })
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.Complete, runner.run("u"))
            assertEquals(2, calls)
        }
    
        @Test fun temporaryFailureRequiresRetry() = runTest {
            val runner = SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { SyncStep.RetryLater }, { "u" })
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.Retry, runner.run("u"))
        }
    
        @Test fun blockedOrUnexpectedFailureNeedsAttention() = runTest {
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.NeedsAttention,
                SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { SyncStep.NeedsAttention }, { "u" }).run("u"))
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.NeedsAttention,
                SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { error("Unsupported payload") }, { "u" }).run("u"))
        }
    
        @Test fun timeoutLeavesWorkRetryable() = runTest {
            val runner = SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { awaitCancellation() }, { "u" }, timeoutMillis = 100)
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.Retry, runner.run("u"))
        }
    
        @Test fun operationLimitEndsTheRun() = runTest {
            var calls = 0
            val runner = SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { calls++; SyncStep.Acknowledged(it) }, { "u" }, maxOperations = 2)
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.Retry, runner.run("u"))
            assertEquals(2, calls)
        }
    
        @Test fun accountChangeStopsBeforeAnotherOperation() = runTest {
            var account: String? = "u"
            var calls = 0
            val runner = SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor {
                calls++
                account = null
                SyncStep.Acknowledged(it)
            }, { account })
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.AccountChanged, runner.run("u"))
            assertEquals(1, calls)
        }
    
        @Test fun wrongOwnerAcknowledgementIsRejected() = runTest {

            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.NeedsAttention, runner.run("u"))
        }

    import android.content.Context

    import androidx.work.*

    import androidx.work.testing.WorkManagerTestInitHelper
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.sync.*
    import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
    import org.junit.Assert.*
    import org.junit.Before
    import org.junit.Test
    import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
    
    class SyncWorkTest {
        private val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>()
        private lateinit var workManager: WorkManager
    
        @Before fun initialize() {
            WorkManagerTestInitHelper.initializeTestWorkManager(context,
                Configuration.Builder().setExecutor(SynchronousExecutor()).build())
            workManager = WorkManager.getInstance(context)
        }
    
        @Test fun automaticWorkIsUniqueAndUsesNetworkConstraintAndBackoff() {
            val first = SyncScheduler.request("u")
            val second = SyncScheduler.request("u")
            val name = SyncScheduler.workName("u")
            workManager.enqueueUniqueWork(name, ExistingWorkPolicy.KEEP, first).result.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            workManager.enqueueUniqueWork(name, ExistingWorkPolicy.KEEP, second).result.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            val work = workManager.getWorkInfosForUniqueWork(name).get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            assertEquals(1, work.size)
            assertEquals(first.id, work.single().id)
            assertEquals(NetworkType.CONNECTED, first.workSpec.constraints.requiredNetworkType)
            assertEquals(BackoffPolicy.EXPONENTIAL, first.workSpec.backoffPolicy)
            assertEquals(10000L, first.workSpec.backoffDelayDuration)
            assertEquals(WorkInfo.State.ENQUEUED, work.single().state)
        }
    
        @Test fun accountAndManualWorkNamesAreDistinct() {
            assertNotEquals(SyncScheduler.workName("u"), SyncScheduler.workName("other"))
            assertNotEquals(SyncScheduler.workName("u"), SyncScheduler.workName("u", manual = true))
            assertEquals(SyncScheduler.workName("u"), SyncScheduler.workName("u"))
        }
    
        @Test fun unavailableProcessorAndWrongAccountDoNotScheduleWork() {
            assertEquals(ScheduleResult.Unavailable,
                SyncScheduler(workManager, SyncRunner(null, { "u" })).scheduleAutomatic("u"))
            assertEquals(ScheduleResult.AccountChanged, SyncScheduler(workManager,
                SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { SyncStep.Empty }, { "other" })).scheduleManual("u"))
            assertTrue(workManager.getWorkInfosForUniqueWork(SyncScheduler.workName("u")).get().isEmpty())
            assertTrue(workManager.getWorkInfosForUniqueWork(SyncScheduler.workName("u", true)).get().isEmpty())
        }
    
        @Test fun restartHookSchedulesPendingWorkWithoutClaimingSync() {
            val scheduler = SyncScheduler(workManager, SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { SyncStep.Empty }, { "u" }))
            assertEquals(ScheduleResult.Pending, scheduler.recoverAfterRestart("u"))
            assertEquals(ScheduleResult.Pending, scheduler.recoverAfterRestart("u"))
            assertEquals(1, workManager.getWorkInfosForUniqueWork(SyncScheduler.workName("u")).get().size)
        }

    import androidx.work.BackoffPolicy
    import androidx.work.Constraints
    import androidx.work.ExistingWorkPolicy
    import androidx.work.NetworkType

    import java.security.MessageDigest
    import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
    
    enum class ScheduleResult { Pending, Unavailable, AccountChanged }
    
    class SyncScheduler(private val workManager: WorkManager, private val runner: SyncRunner) {
        fun scheduleAutomatic(accountId: String): ScheduleResult = schedule(accountId, manual = false)
        fun scheduleManual(accountId: String): ScheduleResult = schedule(accountId, manual = true)
        fun recoverAfterRestart(accountId: String): ScheduleResult = scheduleAutomatic(accountId)
    
        private fun schedule(accountId: String, manual: Boolean): ScheduleResult {
            when (runner.readiness(accountId)) {
                SyncRunResult.Unavailable -> return ScheduleResult.Unavailable
                SyncRunResult.AccountChanged -> return ScheduleResult.AccountChanged
                else -> Unit
            }
            workManager.enqueueUniqueWork(workName(accountId, manual), ExistingWorkPolicy.KEEP, request(accountId))
            return ScheduleResult.Pending
        }
    
        companion object {
            fun workName(accountId: String, manual: Boolean = false): String {
                require(accountId.isNotBlank())
                val hash = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(accountId.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
                    .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
                return "person5-sync-${if (manual) "manual" else "automatic"}-$hash"
            }
    
            fun request(accountId: String): OneTimeWorkRequest {
                require(accountId.isNotBlank())
                return OneTimeWorkRequestBuilder<SyncWorker>()
                    .setInputData(workDataOf(SyncWorker.AccountKey to accountId))
                    .setConstraints(Constraints.Builder().setRequiredNetworkType(NetworkType.CONNECTED).build())
                    .setBackoffCriteria(BackoffPolicy.EXPONENTIAL, 10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                    .build()
            }
        }
    }

    class SyncWorker(
        context: Context,
        parameters: WorkerParameters,
        private val runner: SyncRunner = SyncRunner(null, { null })
    ) : CoroutineWorker(context, parameters) {
        constructor(context: Context, parameters: WorkerParameters) : this(context, parameters, SyncRunner(null, { null }))
    
        override suspend fun doWork(): Result {
            val accountId = inputData.getString(AccountKey).orEmpty()
            val outcome = runner.run(accountId)
            return when (outcome) {
                SyncRunResult.Complete -> Result.success()
                SyncRunResult.Retry -> Result.retry()
                else -> Result.failure(workDataOf("reason" to outcome.name))
            }
        }
    
        companion object { const val AccountKey = "account_id" }
    }
    
    class SyncWorkerFactory(processor: SyncQueueProcessor?, currentAccount: () -> String?) : WorkerFactory() {
        val runner = SyncRunner(processor, currentAccount)
    
        override fun createWorker(context: Context, workerClassName: String, parameters: WorkerParameters): ListenableWorker? =
            if (workerClassName == SyncWorker::class.java.name) SyncWorker(context, parameters, runner) else null
    }
    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.sync
    
    import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
    import kotlinx.coroutines.TimeoutCancellationException
    import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
    import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
    import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeout
    import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
    import kotlinx.coroutines.ensureActive
    
    class SyncRunner(
        private val processor: SyncQueueProcessor?,
        private val currentAccount: () -> String?,
        private val timeoutMillis: Long = 30_000,
        private val maxOperations: Int = 20
    ) {
        init {
            require(timeoutMillis > 0 && maxOperations > 0)
        }
    
        fun readiness(accountId: String): SyncRunResult? = when {
            processor == null -> SyncRunResult.Unavailable
            accountId.isBlank() || currentAccount() != accountId -> SyncRunResult.AccountChanged
            else -> null
        }
    
        suspend fun run(accountId: String): SyncRunResult {
            readiness(accountId)?.let { return it }
            return try {
                withTimeout(timeoutMillis) {
                    processingLock.withLock {
                        repeat(maxOperations) {
                            if (currentAccount() != accountId) return@withLock SyncRunResult.AccountChanged
                            val step = processor!!.processNext(accountId)
                            if (currentAccount() != accountId) return@withLock SyncRunResult.AccountChanged
                            when (step) {
                                SyncStep.Empty -> return@withLock SyncRunResult.Complete
                                SyncStep.RetryLater -> return@withLock SyncRunResult.Retry
                                SyncStep.NeedsAttention -> return@withLock SyncRunResult.NeedsAttention
                                is SyncStep.Acknowledged -> if (step.accountId != accountId) {
                                    return@withLock SyncRunResult.NeedsAttention
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        SyncRunResult.Retry
                    }
                }
            } catch (error: TimeoutCancellationException) {
                currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
                SyncRunResult.Retry
            } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                throw error
            } catch (error: Exception) {
                SyncRunResult.NeedsAttention
            }
        }
    
        companion object {
            private val processingLock = Mutex()
        }
    }

    import android.content.Context
    import android.net.ConnectivityManager
    import android.net.Network
    import android.net.NetworkCapabilities
    import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.awaitClose
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.callbackFlow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.distinctUntilChanged
    
    enum class ConnectionState { Unknown, Online, Offline }
    
    class ConnectivityObserver(context: Context) {
        private val manager = context.applicationContext.getSystemService(ConnectivityManager::class.java)
    
        fun observe() = callbackFlow {
            if (manager == null) {
                trySend(ConnectionState.Unknown)
                awaitClose { }
                return@callbackFlow
            }
            fun publish() {
                val capabilities = manager.getNetworkCapabilities(manager.activeNetwork)
                trySend(if (capabilities?.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET) == true &&
                    capabilities.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_VALIDATED)) {
                    ConnectionState.Online
                } else ConnectionState.Offline)
            }
            val callback = object : ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback() {
                override fun onAvailable(network: Network) = publish()
                override fun onLost(network: Network) = publish()
                override fun onCapabilitiesChanged(network: Network, capabilities: NetworkCapabilities) = publish()
            }
            try {
                manager.registerDefaultNetworkCallback(callback)
                publish()
            } catch (error: SecurityException) {
                trySend(ConnectionState.Unknown)
                close()
                return@callbackFlow
            }
            awaitClose { manager.unregisterNetworkCallback(callback) }
        }.distinctUntilChanged()
    }

    class SyncWorkTest {
        private val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>()
        private lateinit var workManager: WorkManager
    
        @Before fun initialize() {
            WorkManagerTestInitHelper.initializeTestWorkManager(context,
                Configuration.Builder().setExecutor(SynchronousExecutor()).build())
            workManager = WorkManager.getInstance(context)
        }
    
        @Test fun automaticWorkIsUniqueAndUsesNetworkConstraintAndBackoff() {
            val first = SyncScheduler.request("u")
            val second = SyncScheduler.request("u")
            val name = SyncScheduler.workName("u")
            workManager.enqueueUniqueWork(name, ExistingWorkPolicy.KEEP, first).result.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            workManager.enqueueUniqueWork(name, ExistingWorkPolicy.KEEP, second).result.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            val work = workManager.getWorkInfosForUniqueWork(name).get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            assertEquals(1, work.size)
            assertEquals(first.id, work.single().id)
            assertEquals(NetworkType.CONNECTED, first.workSpec.constraints.requiredNetworkType)
            assertEquals(BackoffPolicy.EXPONENTIAL, first.workSpec.backoffPolicy)
            assertEquals(10000L, first.workSpec.backoffDelayDuration)
            assertEquals(WorkInfo.State.ENQUEUED, work.single().state)
        }
    
        @Test fun accountAndManualWorkNamesAreDistinct() {
            assertNotEquals(SyncScheduler.workName("u"), SyncScheduler.workName("other"))
            assertNotEquals(SyncScheduler.workName("u"), SyncScheduler.workName("u", manual = true))
            assertEquals(SyncScheduler.workName("u"), SyncScheduler.workName("u"))
        }
    
        @Test fun unavailableProcessorAndWrongAccountDoNotScheduleWork() {
            assertEquals(ScheduleResult.Unavailable,
                SyncScheduler(workManager, SyncRunner(null, { "u" })).scheduleAutomatic("u"))
            assertEquals(ScheduleResult.AccountChanged, SyncScheduler(workManager,
                SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { SyncStep.Empty }, { "other" })).scheduleManual("u"))
            assertTrue(workManager.getWorkInfosForUniqueWork(SyncScheduler.workName("u")).get().isEmpty())
            assertTrue(workManager.getWorkInfosForUniqueWork(SyncScheduler.workName("u", true)).get().isEmpty())
        }
    
        @Test fun restartHookSchedulesPendingWorkWithoutClaimingSync() {
            val scheduler = SyncScheduler(workManager, SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { SyncStep.Empty }, { "u" }))
            assertEquals(ScheduleResult.Pending, scheduler.recoverAfterRestart("u"))
            assertEquals(ScheduleResult.Pending, scheduler.recoverAfterRestart("u"))
            assertEquals(1, workManager.getWorkInfosForUniqueWork(SyncScheduler.workName("u")).get().size)
        }
    
        @Test fun noFactoryFailsClosed() = runBlocking {
            val worker = TestListenableWorkerBuilder<SyncWorker>(context)
                .setInputData(workDataOf(SyncWorker.AccountKey to "u")).build()
            assertEquals(ListenableWorker.Result.failure(workDataOf("reason" to "Unavailable")), worker.doWork())
        }
    
        @Test fun transientFailureProducesWorkManagerRetry() = runBlocking {
            val worker = TestListenableWorkerBuilder<SyncWorker>(context)
                .setInputData(workDataOf(SyncWorker.AccountKey to "u"))
                .setWorkerFactory(SyncWorkerFactory(SyncQueueProcessor { SyncStep.RetryLater }, { "u" })).build()
            assertEquals(ListenableWorker.Result.retry(), worker.doWork())
        }
    
        @Test fun unsupportedOperationProducesFailure() = runBlocking {
            val worker = TestListenableWorkerBuilder<SyncWorker>(context)
                .setInputData(workDataOf(SyncWorker.AccountKey to "u"))
                .setWorkerFactory(SyncWorkerFactory(SyncQueueProcessor { SyncStep.NeedsAttention }, { "u" })).build()
            assertEquals(ListenableWorker.Result.failure(workDataOf("reason" to "NeedsAttention")), worker.doWork())
        }
    
        @Test fun emptyQueueIsWorkerSuccessWithoutASyncedUiMessage() = runBlocking {
            val worker = TestListenableWorkerBuilder<SyncWorker>(context)
                .setInputData(workDataOf(SyncWorker.AccountKey to "u"))
                .setWorkerFactory(SyncWorkerFactory(SyncQueueProcessor { SyncStep.Empty }, { "u" })).build()
            assertEquals(ListenableWorker.Result.success(), worker.doWork())
        }
    }

    @OptIn(kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
    class SyncRunnerTest {
        @Test fun missingProcessorIsUnavailable() = runTest {
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.Unavailable, SyncRunner(null, { "u" }).run("u"))
        }
    
        @Test fun wrongOrMissingAccountDoesNotInvokeProcessor() = runTest {
            var calls = 0
            val runner = SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { calls++; SyncStep.Empty }, { "u" })
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.AccountChanged, runner.run("other"))
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.AccountChanged, runner.run(""))
            assertEquals(0, calls)
        }
    
        @Test fun acknowledgesThenDrains() = runTest {
            var calls = 0
            val runner = SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor {
                if (calls++ == 0) SyncStep.Acknowledged(it) else SyncStep.Empty
            }, { "u" })
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.Complete, runner.run("u"))
            assertEquals(2, calls)
        }
    
        @Test fun temporaryFailureRequiresRetry() = runTest {
            val runner = SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { SyncStep.RetryLater }, { "u" })
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.Retry, runner.run("u"))
        }
    
        @Test fun blockedOrUnexpectedFailureNeedsAttention() = runTest {
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.NeedsAttention,
                SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { SyncStep.NeedsAttention }, { "u" }).run("u"))
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.NeedsAttention,
                SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { error("Unsupported payload") }, { "u" }).run("u"))
        }
    
        @Test fun timeoutLeavesWorkRetryable() = runTest {
            val runner = SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { awaitCancellation() }, { "u" }, timeoutMillis = 100)
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.Retry, runner.run("u"))
        }
    
        @Test fun operationLimitEndsTheRun() = runTest {
            var calls = 0
            val runner = SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { calls++; SyncStep.Acknowledged(it) }, { "u" }, maxOperations = 2)
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.Retry, runner.run("u"))
            assertEquals(2, calls)
        }
    
        @Test fun accountChangeStopsBeforeAnotherOperation() = runTest {
            var account: String? = "u"
            var calls = 0
            val runner = SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor {
                calls++
                account = null
                SyncStep.Acknowledged(it)
            }, { account })
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.AccountChanged, runner.run("u"))
            assertEquals(1, calls)
        }
    
        @Test fun wrongOwnerAcknowledgementIsRejected() = runTest {
            val runner = SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { SyncStep.Acknowledged("other") }, { "u" })
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.NeedsAttention, runner.run("u"))
        }
    
        @Test fun automaticAndManualRunnersCannotProcessConcurrently() = runTest {
            var active = 0
            var maximum = 0
            val processor = SyncQueueProcessor {
                active++
                maximum = maxOf(maximum, active)
                delay(100)
                active--
                SyncStep.Empty
            }
            val first = async { SyncRunner(processor, { "u" }).run("u") }
            val second = async { SyncRunner(processor, { "u" }).run("u") }
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.Complete, first.await())
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.Complete, second.await())
            assertEquals(1, maximum)
        }
    
        @Test fun accountIsRecheckedAfterWaitingForLock() = runTest {
            val entered = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
            val release = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
            val first = launch {
                SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { entered.complete(Unit); release.await(); SyncStep.Empty }, { "u" }).run("u")
            }
            entered.await()
            var account: String? = "u"
            var calls = 0
            val second = async { SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { calls++; SyncStep.Empty }, { account }).run("u") }
            runCurrent()
            account = "other"
            release.complete(Unit)
            first.join()
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.AccountChanged, second.await())
            assertEquals(0, calls)
        }
    
        @Test fun cancellationReleasesLockWithoutRetrying() = runTest {
            val entered = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
            val job = launch {
                SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { entered.complete(Unit); awaitCancellation() }, { "u" }).run("u")
            }
            entered.await()
            job.cancelAndJoin()
            assertTrue(job.isCancelled)
            assertEquals(SyncRunResult.Complete, SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { SyncStep.Empty }, { "u" }).run("u"))
        }
    }

    @Composable
    fun rememberConnectionState(): ConnectionState {
        val context = LocalContext.current.applicationContext
        val flow = remember(context) { ConnectivityObserver(context).observe() }
        val state by flow.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(ConnectionState.Unknown)
        return state
    }
    
    @Composable
    fun SyncFeedback(sync: SyncPresentation, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
        Column(modifier, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space8)) {
            if (sync.connection == ConnectionState.Offline) {
                OfflineBanner(sync.savedAt?.let { dateText(it, "HH:mm") })
            }
            sync.pendingCount?.takeIf { it > 0 }?.let { count ->
                FeedbackMessage("$count ${if (count == 1) "change" else "changes"} waiting to sync")
            }
            sync.failureMessage?.let { FeedbackMessage(it) }
            sync.acknowledgedRecovery?.let { FeedbackMessage(it) }
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    private fun FeedbackMessage(message: String) {
        Surface(color = AppColors.Surface, shape = AppShapes.SecondaryButton) {
            Text(message, Modifier.padding(AppSpacing.Space12), style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink700)
        }
    }

    data class SyncPresentation(
        val connection: ConnectionState = ConnectionState.Unknown,
        val savedAt: Long? = null,
        val pendingCount: Int? = null,
        val failureMessage: String? = null,
        val acknowledgedRecovery: String? = null
    ) {
        init { require(pendingCount == null || pendingCount >= 0) }
        val hasFeedback: Boolean get() = connection == ConnectionState.Offline || (pendingCount ?: 0) > 0 ||
            failureMessage != null || acknowledgedRecovery != null
    }

    private class SampleSession : ViewModel() {
        val home = MutableStateFlow(sampleHome())
        val activity = MutableStateFlow(sampleActivity(home.value))
        var showActivity by mutableStateOf(false)
        var outcome by mutableStateOf("Success")
        var outcomeMenu by mutableStateOf(false)
    
        suspend fun simulate(): SyncStatus {
            val selected = outcome
            delay(800)
            return when (selected) {
                "Success" -> SyncStatus.SYNCED
                "Pending" -> SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT
                else -> error("Simulated failure. Choose Success and try again.")
            }
        }
    
        fun toggleOffline() {
            home.value = home.value.copy(offlineSavedAt =
                if (home.value.offlineSavedAt == null) home.value.nowMillis else null)
        }
    }

        private val reminder = ActivityEvent("reminder", ActivityType.Reminder, User("m", "m@test", "Mads"), 1, "reminded you", group, 1, unread = true, payment = payment)
        private val failure = ActivityEvent("failure", ActivityType.SyncFailure, null, 0, "couldn't sync", group, 2, unread = true, syncStatus = SyncStatus.FAILED)
        private val expense = ActivityEvent("expense", ActivityType.ExpenseAdded, null, 0, "added an expense", group, 3, unread = true)

        @After fun tearDown() = Dispatchers.resetMain()
    
        @Test fun readStateIsIndependentOfNeedsYouAndAppliesAcrossFilters() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(MutableStateFlow(input()))
            vm.selectFilter(ActivityFilter.Payments)
            vm.markAllRead()
            assertFalse(vm.current().hasUnread)
            assertEquals(3, vm.current().readIds.size)
            assertEquals(2, vm.current().needsCount)
        }
    
        @Test fun retryOnlyShowsSyncedAfterActualSuccessfulResultAndIgnoresDoubleTap() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            var calls = 0
            val response = CompletableDeferred<SyncStatus>()
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(MutableStateFlow(input()), retries = SyncRetryActions { calls++; response.await() })
            vm.retry("failure"); vm.retry("failure")
            assertEquals(1, calls)
            assertEquals(InlineActionState.Working, vm.current().actionFor(failure))
            assertEquals(2, vm.current().needsCount)
            response.complete(SyncStatus.SYNCED)
            assertEquals(InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.SYNCED), vm.current().actionFor(failure))
            assertEquals(1, vm.current().needsCount)
        }
    
        @Test fun queueAcceptanceIsNotMisrepresentedAsSyncSuccess() = runTest(dispatcher) {

            vm.retry("failure")
            assertEquals(2, vm.current().needsCount)
            assertEquals(InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.PENDING_UPDATE), vm.current().actionFor(failure))
            val synced = failure.copy(syncStatus = SyncStatus.SYNCED)
            source.value = input().copy(events = listOf(reminder, synced, expense))
            assertEquals(1, vm.current().needsCount)

            vm.retry("failure")
            assertTrue(vm.current().actionFor(failure) is InlineActionState.Failed)
            assertEquals(3, vm.current().events.size)
            assertEquals(2, vm.current().needsCount)
        }
    
        @Test fun paymentRequiresConfirmationAndCancellationMakesNoCall() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            var calls = 0
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(MutableStateFlow(input()), SettlementActions { calls++; SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT })
            vm.askPayment("reminder")
            assertEquals(0, calls)
            vm.cancelPayment(); vm.confirmPayment("reminder")
            assertEquals(0, calls)
            vm.askPayment("reminder"); vm.confirmPayment("reminder")
            assertEquals(1, calls)
            assertEquals(InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT), vm.current().actionFor(reminder))
            assertEquals(1, vm.current().needsCount)
        }
    
        @Test fun missingServicesLeaveActionsUnresolved() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(MutableStateFlow(input()))
            vm.askPayment("reminder"); vm.confirmPayment("reminder"); vm.retry("failure")
            assertEquals(2, vm.current().needsCount)
            assertTrue(vm.current().actions.isEmpty())
            assertFalse(vm.current().canRetry)
            assertFalse(vm.current().canSettle)
        }
    
        @Test fun accountChangeResetsSessionReadStateAndIgnoresOldCompletion() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val response = CompletableDeferred<SyncStatus>()
            val source = MutableStateFlow(input())
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(source, retries = SyncRetryActions { response.await() })
            vm.markAllRead(); vm.retry("failure")
            source.value = ActivityData("other", listOf(failure))
            response.complete(SyncStatus.SYNCED)
            assertTrue(vm.current().hasUnread)
            assertTrue(vm.current().readIds.isEmpty())
            assertTrue(vm.current().actions.isEmpty())
        }
    
        @Test fun changedPaymentIsNotSettledByAnOlderInFlightResult() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val response = CompletableDeferred<SyncStatus>()
            val source = MutableStateFlow(input())

            vm.askPayment("reminder"); vm.confirmPayment("reminder")
            val changed = reminder.copy(payment = payment.copy(transfer = payment.transfer.copy(amountCents = 9999)))
            source.value = input().copy(events = listOf(changed))
            response.complete(SyncStatus.SYNCED)
            assertEquals(1, vm.current().needsCount)
            assertFalse(vm.current().actionFor(changed) is InlineActionState.Done)
        }
    
        @Test fun refreshFailureRetainsTheLastDeliveredEvents() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val cached = input()

            assertNotNull(vm.current().sourceError)

    @Composable
    private fun ActivityCard(event: ActivityEvent, state: ActivityUiState.Success, onAction: (ActivityAction) -> Unit) {
        val action = state.actionFor(event)
        val unread = event.unread && event.id !in state.readIds
        val done = action is InlineActionState.Done && (event.type != ActivityType.SyncFailure || action.syncStatus == SyncStatus.SYNCED)
        Surface(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), shape = AppShapes.BigButton,
            color = if (done) AppColors.Green50 else if (unread) AppColors.ActivityUnread else AppColors.White,
            border = BorderStroke(
                1.dp,
                if (done) AppColors.Green200 else if (unread) AppColors.ActivityUnreadBorder else AppColors.LineSoft
            )
        ) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(AppSpacing.Space12), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space12)) {
                    EventAvatar(event, state.data.userId, done)
                    Column(Modifier.weight(1f), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp)) {
                        val actor = if (event.actor?.id == state.data.userId) "You" else event.actor?.displayName ?: event.expenseTitle.orEmpty()
                        Text(buildAnnotatedString {
                                withStyle(SpanStyle(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)) { append(actor) }
                                if (actor.isNotEmpty()) append(" ")
                                append(if (event.type == ActivityType.SyncFailure && done) "synced" else event.description)
                            }, style = AppTypography.BodyStrong, color = AppColors.Ink900)

    # Person 5: independent offline foundation
    
    ## Scope and activation boundary
    
    This stage adds independent scheduling/processing code, connectivity observation,
    and honest status presentation. It does not implement Firebase queue processing,
    write to any DAO, change the schema/version, introduce Room or another outbox,
    change MainActivity/navigation, or implement financial algorithms. No real
    processor or authenticated startup hook is registered. The debug sandbox's
    payments/retries remain explicitly simulated and are not connected to WorkManager.
    
    The design follows Android 2's StateFlow/lifecycle guidance, Android 4's repository
    boundary, Software Architecture Part 1's outbox/worker/feedback diagram (page 9),
    and the usability lecture's status/retry mechanisms (page 10). The team's design
    document page 5 defines NFR-K1–K3; the responsibility document page 2 explicitly
    names Room and WorkManager. Room remains a separate unresolved team deliverable.
    
    ## Current dependency approval boundary
    
    The user requires separate approval for manifest-affecting changes. A question
    was raised during the interrupted turn and again on resumption about adding the
    standard WorkManager runtime. Its library merges RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED and
    FOREGROUND_SERVICE permissions, its startup initializer, services and receivers.
    The existing merged debug manifest already has INTERNET, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
    and WAKE_LOCK. No main manifest/Application/navigation change has been made.
    Runtime dependency activation remains pending that specific approval.
    
    ## Classes and data flow
    
    `SyncQueueProcessor.processNext(accountId)` is the only new owner-facing
    processing interface. It returns one of:
    
    | Result | Meaning |
    |---|---|
    | `Empty` | No eligible operation remains for this account; not proof that everything synchronized. |
    | `Acknowledged(accountId)` | One operation was remotely acknowledged and locally reconciled by its owner. |
    | `RetryLater` | A temporary failure; retain the mutation and its original queue row. |
    | `NeedsAttention` | A blocked/unsupported operation requires attention; retain it. |
    
    `SyncRunner` calls that interface sequentially under a process-wide coroutine
    mutex, shared even between different runner instances. This serializes the
    automatic and manual worker lanes in the current single-process app. Each run
    has a cooperative 30-second timeout and at most 20 acknowledged operations. The
    bound includes time waiting for the mutex. Exhausting a bound returns retry.
    Cancellation propagates and releases the lock; an unexpected exception fails
    closed as NeedsAttention. The processor must classify transient exceptions as
    RetryLater rather than relying on the runner to guess Firebase error semantics.
    
    The account is checked before starting, after obtaining the lock, before each
    operation and after its result. A mismatched acknowledgement is rejected. These
    checks cannot undo a remote side effect already performed by an incorrect owner
    implementation. Authentication/ownership must also be checked inside that
    implementation at dispatch and reconciliation, including logout/login during a
    suspension. A UID check alone does not distinguish two successive sessions for
    the same account.
    
    `SyncWorker` maps Complete to WorkManager success, Retry to retry, and unavailable,
    account-changed or needs-attention outcomes to failure with a reason. WorkManager
    success is never mapped to a screen's Synced state. The public two-argument
    constructor has no processor and therefore fails closed. `SyncWorkerFactory`
    accepts the owner processor and a current-account callback, and exposes the same
    runner for constructing `SyncScheduler`. Neither factory nor processor is
    registered in production during this stage.
    
    `SyncScheduler` offers suspend functions `scheduleAutomatic`, `scheduleManual`
    and `recoverAfterRestart`. Automatic/manual requests have separate unique names
    per account and both use KEEP. Names contain a SHA-256 account digest; worker
    input contains the UID only, never a password/token/financial payload. Manual
    retry can request a new opportunity while the automatic lane waits for backoff,
    without cancelling an in-flight operation. Both lanes use the shared runner lock.
    
    Requests require NetworkType.CONNECTED and exponential backoff starting at ten
    seconds. The suspend scheduler waits for WorkManager's enqueue operation off the
    main thread and returns Pending, Unavailable, AccountChanged or Rejected. Pending
    means accepted/coalesced scheduling, not a completed upload. A scheduling timeout
    can have an uncertain enqueue outcome; repeating the same unique request is safe
    at the scheduling level. OS scheduling is inexact and not a delivery deadline.
    
    The restart method is an explicit future lifecycle hook, not an installed startup
    listener. There is no periodic watchdog or automatic queue observer in this
    independent stage. The owner must address the transaction-to-scheduling crash gap
    and the KEEP/worker-finishing race by reconciling persisted pending work at
    authenticated startup and after work completion, or agreeing a recovery trigger.
    
    ## Ownership contract required before activation
    
    The database/Firebase owner must supply an implementation that:
    
    1. Uses the existing queue and processes only operations belonging to the supplied
       authenticated account. The current schema does not encode ownership explicitly.
    2. Saves local mutations and their queue entries atomically, with notification of
       flows after commit, and preserves FIFO/dependency order where necessary.
    3. Reuses stable remote IDs/idempotency identifiers. A crash after remote success
       but before local acknowledgement must not create another settlement/expense.
    4. Changes status/removes only the acknowledged queue operation and does not clear
       a newer pending edit of the same entity.
    5. Defines valid JSON payloads, supported actions, authorization checks, Firestore
       acknowledgement semantics, and pending-local versus remote-refresh rules.
    6. Cooperates with coroutine cancellation/timeouts. Cancelling a suspended Firebase
       wait does not necessarily cancel the remote SDK write; reconcile uncertain
       results before replaying. The in-process mutex is not cross-device idempotency.
    7. Supplies authoritative status, pending counts, cache timestamp and durable
       recovery information to the screen sources.
    
    Person 1 must later install the WorkerFactory in the application's agreed
    WorkManager configuration, recreate those dependencies on every process start,
    provide the current authenticated UID, and connect startup/logout hooks. Do not
    call WorkManager.initialize a second time after its default initializer. No
    Application class or initializer replacement has been introduced here.
    
    Person 4 still owns manual settlement recording, its stable operation reference,
    and balances calculated from the locally available ledger. An operation's local
    recording is distinct from remote synchronization. All existing integration
    requirements in `person5_phase2_phase3.md` continue to apply.
    
    ## Screen behavior
    
    `ConnectivityObserver` observes the default network with ConnectivityManager,
    including validated internet capability. It emits Unknown/Online/Offline and
    unregisters its callback when collection stops. Unknown is neutral, including
    when permission/service access is unavailable. Online does not prove Firebase is
    reachable and is never used to set Synced.
    
    The Home and Activity routes collect connectivity with lifecycle awareness and
    pass it through the existing immutable screen state. Stateless screen tests and
    previews can supply a connection value directly. No network operation is started
    by observing connectivity.
    
    `SyncPresentation` adds optional source-supplied pending count, saved timestamp,
    failure and acknowledged-recovery text. Its defaults produce no status strip or
    extra list spacing. Both screens reuse `SyncFeedback`. A missing saved timestamp
    produces “You're offline · showing available data.” A known timestamp is displayed
    only when actually supplied. The banner does not promise that an unavailable
    processor will automatically upload changes.
    
    Pending is amber, failure uses the prototype's retry colours, and a supplied
    acknowledged recovery uses green. Zero pending operations does not produce a
    synthetic Synced message. Recovery text is a display contract, not a durable event
    store: only emit it after a real acknowledgement, and clear it in the source when
    appropriate. No recovery notification or cross-restart acknowledgement history
    is implemented here.
    
    The failed-state strip defaults to “Couldn't sync · needs attention”; automatic
    retry wording requires explicit availability. Inline settlement feedback says
    “Settlement recorded · synchronization pending” for queued results. Paid/green
    completion requires SYNCED. The existing Activity fake/deferred-result regression
    test verifies that queue acceptance remains unresolved until the source emits an
    acknowledged result.
    
    ## Verification in Android Studio
    
    1. Sync Gradle after the WorkManager dependency approval is resolved.
    2. Run `assembleDebug` and `testDebugUnitTest`, or run the JVM test classes with
       their gutter icons. These tests do not require an emulator.
    3. Select an emulator and run `SyncWorkTest` and `SyncFeedbackTest` with their
       instrumentation gutter icons. They use fakes/test WorkManager, not Firebase.
       Alternatively run `connectedDebugAndroidTest` to include existing UI/database
       instrumentation regressions. Instrumentation must run separately from JVM tests.
    4. Launch the existing specified Activity `debug.Person5TestActivity`, as described
       in `person5_debug_testing.md`. With Show offline disabled, switch airplane mode
       on/off and check the neutral banner on both Home and Activity. This tests real
       connectivity presentation over sample data, not offline financial persistence.
    5. Use its Pending/Failure/Success simulation controls for inline feedback, then
       Reset. Do not interpret sandbox completion as a real upload. Instrumentation
       covers supplied pending-count/recovery messages without creating an event store.
    
    No production setup step should register a real processor or connect authenticated
    startup until the team approves activation. No emulator verification is claimed
    for Phase 4B in this session.
    
    ## Requirements still incomplete
    
    - NFR-K1: reading previously fetched groups/expenses/balances depends on owner-side

            workManager.enqueueUniqueWork(name, ExistingWorkPolicy.KEEP, second).result.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            val work = workManager.getWorkInfosForUniqueWork(name).get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            assertEquals(1, work.size)
            assertEquals(first.id, work.single().id)
            assertEquals(NetworkType.CONNECTED, first.workSpec.constraints.requiredNetworkType)
            assertEquals(BackoffPolicy.EXPONENTIAL, first.workSpec.backoffPolicy)
            assertEquals(10000L, first.workSpec.backoffDelayDuration)
            assertEquals(WorkInfo.State.ENQUEUED, work.single().state)
        }
    
        @Test fun accountAndManualWorkNamesAreDistinct() {
            assertNotEquals(SyncScheduler.workName("u"), SyncScheduler.workName("other"))
            assertNotEquals(SyncScheduler.workName("u"), SyncScheduler.workName("u", manual = true))
            assertEquals(SyncScheduler.workName("u"), SyncScheduler.workName("u"))
        }
    
        @Test fun workRunsOnlyAfterTheNetworkConstraintIsReleased() = runBlocking {
            val request = SyncScheduler.request("u")
            workManager.enqueue(request).result.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            assertEquals(WorkInfo.State.ENQUEUED, workManager.getWorkInfoById(request.id).get()!!.state)
            WorkManagerTestInitHelper.getTestDriver(context)!!.setAllConstraintsMet(request.id)
            val finished = withTimeout(5000) {
                workManager.getWorkInfoByIdFlow(request.id).first { it?.state?.isFinished == true }!!
            }
            assertEquals(WorkInfo.State.FAILED, finished.state)
            assertEquals("Unavailable", finished.outputData.getString("reason"))
        }
    
        @Test fun unavailableProcessorAndWrongAccountDoNotScheduleWork() = runBlocking {
            assertEquals(ScheduleResult.Unavailable,
                SyncScheduler(workManager, SyncRunner(null, { "u" })).scheduleAutomatic("u"))
            assertEquals(ScheduleResult.AccountChanged, SyncScheduler(workManager,
                SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { SyncStep.Empty }, { "other" })).scheduleManual("u"))
            assertTrue(workManager.getWorkInfosForUniqueWork(SyncScheduler.workName("u")).get().isEmpty())
            assertTrue(workManager.getWorkInfosForUniqueWork(SyncScheduler.workName("u", true)).get().isEmpty())
        }
    
        @Test fun restartHookSchedulesPendingWorkWithoutClaimingSync() = runBlocking {
            val scheduler = SyncScheduler(workManager, SyncRunner(SyncQueueProcessor { SyncStep.Empty }, { "u" }))
            assertEquals(ScheduleResult.Pending, scheduler.recoverAfterRestart("u"))
            assertEquals(ScheduleResult.Pending, scheduler.recoverAfterRestart("u"))
            assertEquals(1, workManager.getWorkInfosForUniqueWork(SyncScheduler.workName("u")).get().size)
        }
    
        @Test fun noFactoryFailsClosed() = runBlocking {
            val worker = TestListenableWorkerBuilder<SyncWorker>(context)
                .setInputData(workDataOf(SyncWorker.AccountKey to "u")).build()
            assertEquals(ListenableWorker.Result.failure(workDataOf("reason" to "Unavailable")), worker.doWork())
        }
    
        @Test fun transientFailureProducesWorkManagerRetry() = runBlocking {
            val worker = TestListenableWorkerBuilder<SyncWorker>(context)
                .setInputData(workDataOf(SyncWorker.AccountKey to "u"))
                .setWorkerFactory(SyncWorkerFactory(SyncQueueProcessor { SyncStep.RetryLater }, { "u" })).build()
            assertEquals(ListenableWorker.Result.retry(), worker.doWork())
        }
    
        @Test fun unsupportedOperationProducesFailure() = runBlocking {
            val worker = TestListenableWorkerBuilder<SyncWorker>(context)
                .setInputData(workDataOf(SyncWorker.AccountKey to "u"))
                .setWorkerFactory(SyncWorkerFactory(SyncQueueProcessor { SyncStep.NeedsAttention }, { "u" })).build()
            assertEquals(ListenableWorker.Result.failure(workDataOf("reason" to "NeedsAttention")), worker.doWork())
        }
    
        @Test fun emptyQueueIsWorkerSuccessWithoutASyncedUiMessage() = runBlocking {
            val worker = TestListenableWorkerBuilder<SyncWorker>(context)
                .setInputData(workDataOf(SyncWorker.AccountKey to "u"))
                .setWorkerFactory(SyncWorkerFactory(SyncQueueProcessor { SyncStep.Empty }, { "u" })).build()
            assertEquals(ListenableWorker.Result.success(), worker.doWork())
        }
    }
    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.worker
    
    import androidx.work.BackoffPolicy
    import androidx.work.Constraints
    import androidx.work.ExistingWorkPolicy
    import androidx.work.NetworkType
    import androidx.work.OneTimeWorkRequest
    import androidx.work.OneTimeWorkRequestBuilder
    import androidx.work.WorkManager
    import androidx.work.workDataOf
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.sync.SyncRunner
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.sync.SyncRunResult
    import java.security.MessageDigest
    import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
    import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
    import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
    import kotlinx.coroutines.runInterruptible
    
    enum class ScheduleResult { Pending, Unavailable, AccountChanged, Rejected }
    
    class SyncScheduler(private val workManager: WorkManager, private val runner: SyncRunner) {
        suspend fun scheduleAutomatic(accountId: String): ScheduleResult = schedule(accountId, manual = false)
        suspend fun scheduleManual(accountId: String): ScheduleResult = schedule(accountId, manual = true)
        suspend fun recoverAfterRestart(accountId: String): ScheduleResult = scheduleAutomatic(accountId)
    
        private suspend fun schedule(accountId: String, manual: Boolean): ScheduleResult {
            when (runner.readiness(accountId)) {
                SyncRunResult.Unavailable -> return ScheduleResult.Unavailable
                SyncRunResult.AccountChanged -> return ScheduleResult.AccountChanged
                else -> Unit
            }
            return try {
                runInterruptible(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    workManager.enqueueUniqueWork(workName(accountId, manual), ExistingWorkPolicy.KEEP, request(accountId))
                        .result.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                }
                ScheduleResult.Pending
            } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                throw error
            } catch (error: Exception) {
                ScheduleResult.Rejected
            }
        }
    
        companion object {
            fun workName(accountId: String, manual: Boolean = false): String {
                require(accountId.isNotBlank())
                val hash = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(accountId.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
                    .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
                return "person5-sync-${if (manual) "manual" else "automatic"}-$hash"
            }
    
            fun request(accountId: String): OneTimeWorkRequest {
                require(accountId.isNotBlank())
                return OneTimeWorkRequestBuilder<SyncWorker>()
                    .setInputData(workDataOf(SyncWorker.AccountKey to accountId))
                    .setConstraints(Constraints.Builder().setRequiredNetworkType(NetworkType.CONNECTED).build())
                    .setBackoffCriteria(BackoffPolicy.EXPONENTIAL, 10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                    .build()
            }
        }
    }
    # Person 5: independent offline foundation
    
    ## Scope and activation boundary
    
    This stage adds independent scheduling/processing code, connectivity observation,
    and honest status presentation. It does not implement Firebase queue processing,
    write to any DAO, change the schema/version, introduce Room or another outbox,
    change MainActivity/navigation, or implement financial algorithms. No real
    processor or authenticated startup hook is registered. The debug sandbox's
    payments/retries remain explicitly simulated and are not connected to WorkManager.
    
    The design follows Android 2's StateFlow/lifecycle guidance, Android 4's repository
    boundary, Software Architecture Part 1's outbox/worker/feedback diagram (page 9),
    and the usability lecture's status/retry mechanisms (page 10). The team's design
    document page 5 defines NFR-K1â€“K3; the responsibility document page 2 explicitly
    names Room and WorkManager. Room remains a separate unresolved team deliverable.
    
    ## Current dependency approval boundary
    
    The user requires separate approval for manifest-affecting changes. A question
    was raised during the interrupted turn and again on resumption about adding the
    standard WorkManager runtime. Its library merges RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED and
    FOREGROUND_SERVICE permissions, its startup initializer, services and receivers.
    The existing merged debug manifest already has INTERNET, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
    and WAKE_LOCK. No main manifest/Application/navigation change has been made.
    Runtime dependency activation remains pending that specific approval.
    
    The concrete remaining build change is a version-catalog entry for WorkManager
    2.12.0 (`androidx.work:work-runtime` and `androidx.work:work-testing`), followed by
    one runtime implementation dependency and one androidTestImplementation
    dependency in the app module. The worker/scheduler source and their tests are
    already reviewable but cannot compile in the full app until those dependencies
    are added. This stage must not be called build-ready or complete while that
    approval remains unresolved.
    
    ## Classes and data flow
    
    `SyncQueueProcessor.processNext(accountId)` is the only new owner-facing
    processing interface. It returns one of:
    
    | Result | Meaning |
    |---|---|
    | `Empty` | No eligible operation remains for this account; not proof that everything synchronized. |
    | `Acknowledged(accountId)` | One operation was remotely acknowledged and locally reconciled by its owner. |
    | `RetryLater` | A temporary failure; retain the mutation and its original queue row. |

    sealed interface HomeUiState {
        data object Loading : HomeUiState
        data class Error(val message: String) : HomeUiState
        data class Success(
            val data: HomeData,
            val filter: GroupFilter = GroupFilter.Recent,
            val period: SpendPeriod = SpendPeriod.Month,
            val selectedGroupId: String? = null,
            val paymentsExpanded: Boolean = false,
            val confirmingAll: Boolean = false,
            val paymentStates: Map<String, InlineActionState> = emptyMap(),
            val recordedPayments: Map<String, OutstandingPayment> = emptyMap(),
            val canSettle: Boolean = false,
            val sourceError: String? = null
        ) : HomeUiState {
            val outstanding: List<OutstandingPayment> = data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().filter {
                it.transfer.debtorId == data.user.id && it.transfer.currency == "DKK" && it.transfer.amountCents > 0
            }.distinctBy { it.id }
            val payments: List<OutstandingPayment> = (outstanding + recordedPayments.values).distinctBy { it.id }
            val unpaid: List<OutstandingPayment> = outstanding.filter { paymentStates[it.id] !is InlineActionState.Done }
            val isWorking: Boolean = paymentStates.values.any { it == InlineActionState.Working }
            val oweCents: Long = unpaid.sumOf { it.transfer.amountCents }
            val owingGroupCount: Int = unpaid.map { it.groupId }.distinct().size
            val owedCents: Long = data.groups.sumOf { group ->
                data.finances?.balancesByGroup?.get(group.group.id)?.takeIf {
                    it.currency == "DKK" && it.userId == data.user.id
                }?.netBalanceCents?.coerceAtLeast(0L) ?: 0L
            }
            val hasFinancialSummary: Boolean = data.finances?.let { finances ->
                finances.outstandingPayments.all {
                    it.transfer.currency == "DKK" && it.transfer.debtorId == data.user.id &&
                    it.transfer.amountCents > 0 && data.groups.any { group -> group.group.id == it.groupId }
                } && data.groups.all { group ->
                    val balance = finances.balancesByGroup[group.group.id]
                    balance != null && balance.currency == "DKK" && balance.userId == data.user.id &&
                    outstanding.filter { it.groupId == group.group.id }.sumOf { it.transfer.amountCents } == maxOf(
                        0L,
                        -balance.netBalanceCents
                    )
                }
            } == true
        }
    }
    
    class HomeViewModel(
        source: Flow<HomeData>,
        private val settlements: SettlementActions? = null
    ) : ViewModel() {
        private val mutableState = MutableStateFlow<HomeUiState>(HomeUiState.Loading)
        val state = mutableState.asStateFlow()
        private var recording = false
    
        init {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    source.collect { data ->
                        val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success
                        mutableState.value = if (current == null || current.data.user.id != data.user.id) {
                            HomeUiState.Success(data, canSettle = settlements != null)
                        } else {
                            val unchangedIds = data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().filter { payment ->
                                current.data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().any { it == payment }
                            }.map { it.id }.toSet()
                            val recorded = current.recordedPayments.filterValues { payment ->
                                val next = data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().firstOrNull { it.id == payment.id }
                                next == null || next == payment
                            }
                            current.copy(
                                data = data,
                                sourceError = null,
                                confirmingAll = current.confirmingAll &&
                                    current.data.finances?.outstandingPayments == data.finances?.outstandingPayments,
                                paymentStates = current.paymentStates.filterKeys { it in unchangedIds || it in recorded },
                                recordedPayments = recorded
                            )
                        }
                    }
                } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                    throw error
                } catch (error: Exception) {
                    val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success
                    mutableState.value = current?.copy(sourceError = "Couldn't refresh. Showing the last dashboard.")
                    ?: HomeUiState.Error(error.message ?: "Couldn't load your dashboard")
                }
            }
        }
    
        private fun update(change: (HomeUiState.Success) -> HomeUiState.Success) {
            mutableState.update { if (it is HomeUiState.Success) change(it) else it }
        }
    
        fun selectFilter(filter: GroupFilter) = update { it.copy(filter = filter) }
        fun selectPeriod(period: SpendPeriod) = update { it.copy(period = period, selectedGroupId = null) }
        fun selectSlice(groupId: String?) = update { it.copy(selectedGroupId = groupId) }
        fun togglePayments() = update {
            it.copy(
                paymentsExpanded = !it.paymentsExpanded,
                confirmingAll = false,
                recordedPayments = if (it.paymentsExpanded) emptyMap() else it.recordedPayments
            )
        }
        fun closePayments() = update {
            it.copy(paymentsExpanded = false, confirmingAll = false, recordedPayments = emptyMap())
        }
    
        fun cancelPayment() = update {
            it.copy(
                confirmingAll = false,
                paymentStates = it.paymentStates.filterValues { value -> value != InlineActionState.Confirming }
            )
        }
    
        fun askPayment(id: String) {
            cancelPayment()
            update {
                if (!it.canSettle || !it.hasFinancialSummary || recording || it.unpaid.none { payment -> payment.id == id }) it
                else it.copy(paymentStates = it.paymentStates + (id to InlineActionState.Confirming))
            }
        }
    
        fun askAll() {
            cancelPayment()
            update { if (it.canSettle && it.hasFinancialSummary && !recording && it.unpaid.isNotEmpty()) it.copy(confirmingAll = true) else it }
        }
    
        fun confirmPayment(id: String) {
            val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return
            if (current.paymentStates[id] != InlineActionState.Confirming || recording) return
            record(current.unpaid.filter { it.id == id })
        }
    
        fun confirmAll() {
            val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return
            if (current.confirmingAll && !recording) record(current.unpaid)
        }
    
        private fun record(payments: List<OutstandingPayment>) {
            val actions = settlements ?: return
            val userId = (mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success)?.data?.user?.id ?: return
            recording = true
            update { it.copy(
                    confirmingAll = false,
                    paymentStates = it.paymentStates + payments.associate { p -> p.id to InlineActionState.Working }
            ) }
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    for (payment in payments) {
                        val latest = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return@launch
                        if (latest.data.user.id != userId) return@launch
                        val result = try {
                            check(latest.payments.any { it == payment }) { "This balance changed. Check the latest payment." }
                            InlineActionState.Done(actions.recordSettlement(payment))
                        } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                            throw error
                        } catch (error: Exception) {
                            InlineActionState.Failed(error.message ?: "Couldn't record this payment. Try again.")
                        }
                        update {
                            val next = it.outstanding.firstOrNull { current -> current.id == payment.id }
                            if (it.data.user.id == userId && (next == payment || (next == null && result is InlineActionState.Done))) {
                                it.copy(
                                    paymentStates = it.paymentStates + (payment.id to result),
                                    recordedPayments = if (result is InlineActionState.Done) {
                                        it.recordedPayments + (payment.id to payment)
                                    } else it.recordedPayments
                                )
                            } else it
                        }
                    }
                } finally {
                    recording = false
                }
            }
        }
    }

    sealed interface ActivityUiState {
        data object Loading : ActivityUiState
        data class Error(val message: String) : ActivityUiState
        data class Success(
            val data: ActivityData,
            val filter: ActivityFilter = ActivityFilter.All,
            val readIds: Set<String> = emptySet(),
            val actions: Map<String, InlineActionState> = emptyMap(),
            val canSettle: Boolean = false,
            val canRetry: Boolean = false,
            val sourceError: String? = null
        ) : ActivityUiState {
            val events: List<ActivityEvent> = data.events.orEmpty().distinctBy { it.id }
            val needsCount: Int = events.count { it.needsAction(data.userId, actionFor(it)) }
            val hasUnread: Boolean = events.any { it.unread && it.id !in readIds }
            fun actionFor(event: ActivityEvent): InlineActionState =
            if (event.type == ActivityType.SyncFailure && event.syncStatus == SyncStatus.SYNCED) InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.SYNCED)
            else actions[event.id] ?: InlineActionState.Idle
        }
    }
    
    class ActivityViewModel(
        source: Flow<ActivityData>,
        private val settlements: SettlementActions? = null,
        private val retries: SyncRetryActions? = null
    ) : ViewModel() {
        private val mutableState = MutableStateFlow<ActivityUiState>(ActivityUiState.Loading)
        val state = mutableState.asStateFlow()
        private val activeIds = mutableSetOf<String>()
    
        init {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    source.collect { data ->
                        val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success
                        mutableState.value = if (current == null || current.data.userId != data.userId) {
                            ActivityUiState.Success(data, canSettle = settlements != null, canRetry = retries != null)
                        } else {
                            val unchangedIds = data.events.orEmpty().filter { next ->
                                current.events.any {
                                    it.id == next.id && it.payment == next.payment &&
                                    (it.syncStatus == next.syncStatus || current.actions[next.id] == InlineActionState.Working)
                                }
                            }.map { it.id }.toSet()
                            current.copy(data = data, sourceError = null, actions = current.actions.filterKeys { it in unchangedIds })
                        }
                    }
                } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                    throw error
                } catch (error: Exception) {
                    val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success
                    mutableState.value = current?.copy(sourceError = "Couldn't refresh. Showing the last activity.")
                    ?: ActivityUiState.Error(error.message ?: "Couldn't load activity")
                }
            }
        }
    
        private fun update(change: (ActivityUiState.Success) -> ActivityUiState.Success) {
            mutableState.update { if (it is ActivityUiState.Success) change(it) else it }
        }
    
        fun selectFilter(filter: ActivityFilter) = update { it.copy(filter = filter) }
        fun markAllRead() = update { it.copy(readIds = it.readIds + it.events.map { event -> event.id }) }
    
        fun askPayment(id: String) = update {
            val event = it.events.firstOrNull { event -> event.id == id }
            if (event == null || !it.canSettle || !event.canPay(it.data.userId) || id in activeIds || it.actionFor(event) is InlineActionState.Done) it
            else it.copy(
                actions = it.actions.filterValues { value -> value != InlineActionState.Confirming } + (id to InlineActionState.Confirming),
                readIds = it.readIds + id
            )
        }
    
        fun cancelPayment() = update { it.copy(actions = it.actions.filterValues { value -> value != InlineActionState.Confirming }) }
    
        fun confirmPayment(id: String) {
            val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success ?: return
            val event = current.events.firstOrNull { it.id == id } ?: return
            val service = settlements ?: return
            if (current.actions[id] != InlineActionState.Confirming || !event.canPay(current.data.userId)) return
            runAction(event) { service.recordSettlement(event.payment!!) }
        }
    
        fun retry(id: String) {
            val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success ?: return
            val event = current.events.firstOrNull { it.id == id } ?: return
            val service = retries ?: return
            if (event.type != ActivityType.SyncFailure || !event.needsAction(current.data.userId, current.actionFor(event))) return
            runAction(event) {
                val status = service.retry(event)
                check(status != SyncStatus.FAILED) { "Couldn't sync yet. Try again." }
                status
            }
        }
    
        private fun runAction(event: ActivityEvent, action: suspend () -> SyncStatus) {
            if (!activeIds.add(event.id)) return
            val userId = (mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success)?.data?.userId ?: return
            update { it.copy(actions = it.actions + (event.id to InlineActionState.Working), readIds = it.readIds + event.id) }
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    val result = try {
                        InlineActionState.Done(action())
                    } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                        throw error
                    } catch (error: Exception) {
                        InlineActionState.Failed(error.message ?: "Couldn't complete this action. Try again.")
                    }
                    update {
                        if (it.data.userId == userId && it.events.any { current -> current.id == event.id && current.payment == event.payment }) {
                            it.copy(actions = it.actions + (event.id to result))
                        } else it
                    }
                } finally { activeIds.remove(event.id) }
            }
        }
    }

    sealed interface InlineActionState {
        data object Idle : InlineActionState
        data object Confirming : InlineActionState
        data object Working : InlineActionState

    enum class ActivityType { ExpenseAdded, ExpenseChanged, Payment, Reminder, SyncFailure }
    enum class AmountDirection { Owed, Received, Settled, Neutral }
    enum class ActivityFilter(val label: String) { All("All"), NeedsYou("Needs you"), Expenses("Expenses"), Payments("Payments") }
    
    data class ActivityEvent(
        val id: String,
        val type: ActivityType,
        val actor: User?,
        val actorColourIndex: Int,
        val description: String,
        val group: DashboardGroup,
        val occurredAt: Long,
        val amountCents: Long? = null,
        val currency: String = "DKK",
        val direction: AmountDirection = AmountDirection.Neutral,
        val unread: Boolean = false,
        val payment: OutstandingPayment? = null,
        val syncStatus: SyncStatus? = null,
        val expenseTitle: String? = null
    )
    
    data class ActivityData(
        val userId: String,
        val events: List<ActivityEvent>? = null,
        val nowMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
        val sync: SyncPresentation = SyncPresentation()
    )
    
    fun interface SyncRetryActions {
        suspend fun retry(event: ActivityEvent): SyncStatus
    }
    
    fun ActivityEvent.canPay(userId: String): Boolean = type == ActivityType.Reminder && payment?.let {
        it.groupId == group.group.id && it.transfer.debtorId == userId &&
        it.transfer.currency == "DKK" && it.transfer.amountCents > 0
    } == true
    
    fun ActivityEvent.needsAction(userId: String, state: InlineActionState): Boolean = when {
        canPay(userId) -> state !is InlineActionState.Done
        type == ActivityType.SyncFailure -> syncStatus != SyncStatus.SYNCED &&
        !(state is InlineActionState.Done && state.syncStatus == SyncStatus.SYNCED)
        else -> false
    }
    
    fun filterActivities(
        events: List<ActivityEvent>,
        userId: String,
        filter: ActivityFilter,
        actions: Map<String, InlineActionState>
    ): List<ActivityEvent> = events.distinctBy { it.id }.filter {
        when (filter) {
            ActivityFilter.All -> true
            ActivityFilter.NeedsYou -> it.needsAction(userId, actions[it.id] ?: InlineActionState.Idle)
            ActivityFilter.Expenses -> it.type in listOf(
                ActivityType.ExpenseAdded,
                ActivityType.ExpenseChanged,
                ActivityType.SyncFailure
            )
            ActivityFilter.Payments -> it.type == ActivityType.Payment || it.type == ActivityType.Reminder
        }
    }.sortedByDescending { it.occurredAt }

    data class SyncPresentation(
        val connection: ConnectionState = ConnectionState.Unknown,
        val savedAt: Long? = null,
        val pendingCount: Int? = null,
        val failureMessage: String? = null,
        val acknowledgedRecovery: String? = null
    ) {
        init { require(pendingCount == null || pendingCount >= 0) }
        val hasFeedback: Boolean get() = connection == ConnectionState.Offline || (pendingCount ?: 0) > 0 ||
            failureMessage != null || acknowledgedRecovery != null
    }

    enum class ScheduleResult { Pending, Unavailable, AccountChanged, Rejected }
    
    class SyncScheduler(private val workManager: WorkManager, private val runner: SyncRunner) {
        suspend fun scheduleAutomatic(accountId: String): ScheduleResult = schedule(accountId, manual = false)
        suspend fun scheduleManual(accountId: String): ScheduleResult = schedule(accountId, manual = true)
        suspend fun recoverAfterRestart(accountId: String): ScheduleResult = scheduleAutomatic(accountId)
    
        private suspend fun schedule(accountId: String, manual: Boolean): ScheduleResult {
            when (runner.readiness(accountId)) {
                SyncRunResult.Unavailable -> return ScheduleResult.Unavailable
                SyncRunResult.AccountChanged -> return ScheduleResult.AccountChanged
                else -> Unit
            }
            return try {
                runInterruptible(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    workManager.enqueueUniqueWork(workName(accountId, manual), ExistingWorkPolicy.KEEP, request(accountId))
                        .result.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                }
                ScheduleResult.Pending
            } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                throw error
            } catch (error: Exception) {
                ScheduleResult.Rejected
            }
        }
    
        companion object {
            fun workName(accountId: String, manual: Boolean = false): String {
                require(accountId.isNotBlank())
                val hash = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(accountId.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
                    .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
                return "person5-sync-${if (manual) "manual" else "automatic"}-$hash"
            }
    
            fun request(accountId: String): OneTimeWorkRequest {
                require(accountId.isNotBlank())
                return OneTimeWorkRequestBuilder<SyncWorker>()
                    .setInputData(workDataOf(SyncWorker.AccountKey to accountId))
                    .setConstraints(Constraints.Builder().setRequiredNetworkType(NetworkType.CONNECTED).build())
                    .setBackoffCriteria(BackoffPolicy.EXPONENTIAL, 10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                    .build()
            }
        }
    }

    import android.content.Context
    import androidx.work.CoroutineWorker
    import androidx.work.ListenableWorker
    import androidx.work.WorkerFactory
    import androidx.work.WorkerParameters
    import androidx.work.workDataOf
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.sync.SyncQueueProcessor
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.sync.SyncRunner
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.sync.SyncRunResult
    
    class SyncWorker(
        context: Context,
        parameters: WorkerParameters,
        private val runner: SyncRunner
    ) : CoroutineWorker(context, parameters) {
        constructor(context: Context, parameters: WorkerParameters) : this(context, parameters, SyncRunner(null, { null }))
    
        override suspend fun doWork(): Result {
            val accountId = inputData.getString(AccountKey).orEmpty()
            val outcome = runner.run(accountId)
            return when (outcome) {
                SyncRunResult.Complete -> Result.success()
                SyncRunResult.Retry -> Result.retry()
                else -> Result.failure(workDataOf("reason" to outcome.name))
            }
        }
    
        companion object { const val AccountKey = "account_id" }
    }
    
    class SyncWorkerFactory(processor: SyncQueueProcessor?, currentAccount: () -> String?) : WorkerFactory() {
        val runner = SyncRunner(processor, currentAccount)
    
        override fun createWorker(context: Context, workerClassName: String, parameters: WorkerParameters): ListenableWorker? =
            if (workerClassName == SyncWorker::class.java.name) SyncWorker(context, parameters, runner) else null
    }
