    import android.content.Context
    import android.net.ConnectivityManager
    import android.net.Network
    import android.net.NetworkCapabilities
    import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.awaitClose
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.callbackFlow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.distinctUntilChanged
    
    enum class ConnectionState { Unknown, Online, Offline }
    
    class ConnectivityObserver(context: Context) {
        private val manager = context.applicationContext.getSystemService(ConnectivityManager::class.java)
    
        fun observe() = callbackFlow {
            if (manager == null) {
                trySend(ConnectionState.Unknown)
                awaitClose { }
                return@callbackFlow
            }
            fun publish() {
                val capabilities = try {
                    manager.getNetworkCapabilities(manager.activeNetwork)
                } catch (error: SecurityException) {
                    trySend(ConnectionState.Unknown)
                    return
                }
                trySend(if (capabilities?.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET) == true &&
                    capabilities.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_VALIDATED)) {
                    ConnectionState.Online
                } else ConnectionState.Offline)
            }
            val callback = object : ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback() {
                override fun onAvailable(network: Network) = publish()
                override fun onLost(network: Network) = publish()
                override fun onCapabilitiesChanged(network: Network, capabilities: NetworkCapabilities) = publish()
            }
            try {
                manager.registerDefaultNetworkCallback(callback)
                publish()
            } catch (error: SecurityException) {
                trySend(ConnectionState.Unknown)
                close()
                return@callbackFlow
            }
            awaitClose { manager.unregisterNetworkCallback(callback) }
        }.distinctUntilChanged()
    }
    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.sync
    
    fun interface SyncQueueProcessor {
        suspend fun processNext(accountId: String): SyncStep
    }
    
    sealed interface SyncStep {
        data object Empty : SyncStep
        data class Acknowledged(val accountId: String) : SyncStep
        data object RetryLater : SyncStep
        data object NeedsAttention : SyncStep
    }
    
    enum class SyncRunResult { Complete, Retry, Unavailable, AccountChanged, NeedsAttention }
    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.sync
    
    import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
    import kotlinx.coroutines.TimeoutCancellationException
    import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
    import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
    import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeout
    import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
    import kotlinx.coroutines.ensureActive
    
    class SyncRunner(
        private val processor: SyncQueueProcessor?,
        private val currentAccount: () -> String?,
        private val timeoutMillis: Long = 30_000,
        private val maxOperations: Int = 20
    ) {
        init {
            require(timeoutMillis > 0 && maxOperations > 0)
        }
    
        fun readiness(accountId: String): SyncRunResult? = when {
            processor == null -> SyncRunResult.Unavailable
            accountId.isBlank() || currentAccount() != accountId -> SyncRunResult.AccountChanged
            else -> null
        }
    
        suspend fun run(accountId: String): SyncRunResult {
            readiness(accountId)?.let { return it }
            return try {
                withTimeout(timeoutMillis) {
                    processingLock.withLock {
                        repeat(maxOperations) {
                            if (currentAccount() != accountId) return@withLock SyncRunResult.AccountChanged
                            val step = processor!!.processNext(accountId)
                            if (currentAccount() != accountId) return@withLock SyncRunResult.AccountChanged
                            when (step) {
                                SyncStep.Empty -> return@withLock SyncRunResult.Complete
                                SyncStep.RetryLater -> return@withLock SyncRunResult.Retry
                                SyncStep.NeedsAttention -> return@withLock SyncRunResult.NeedsAttention
                                is SyncStep.Acknowledged -> if (step.accountId != accountId) {
                                    return@withLock SyncRunResult.NeedsAttention
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        SyncRunResult.Retry
                    }
                }
            } catch (error: TimeoutCancellationException) {
                currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
                SyncRunResult.Retry
            } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                throw error
            } catch (error: Exception) {
                SyncRunResult.NeedsAttention
            }
        }
    
        companion object {
            private val processingLock = Mutex()
        }
    }

    private sealed interface AppDestination {
        data object Login : AppDestination
        data object Register : AppDestination
        data class Counter(val initialUser: User) : AppDestination
    }
    
    class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() {
        override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
            super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
            enableEdgeToEdge()
            setContent {
                GetYourMoneyUpNotYourFunnyUpTheme {
                    Scaffold(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) { innerPadding ->
                        AppRoot(
                            modifier = Modifier.padding(innerPadding)
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    fun AppRoot(modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
        val context = LocalContext.current
        val authRepository = remember {
            val database = AppDatabase.getInstance(context)
            AuthRepository(
                userDao = database.userDao,
                syncQueueDao = database.syncQueueDao
            )
        }
    
        var destination by remember { mutableStateOf<AppDestination>(AppDestination.Login) }
        var displayName by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
        var email by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
        var password by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
        var isLoading by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
        var errorMessage by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
        var statusMessage by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    
        // If a session is already active on launch, fetch the user document from Firestore
        LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
            val existingUid = authRepository.currentAuthUid
            val existingEmail = authRepository.currentAuthEmail ?: ""
            if (existingUid != null) {
                isLoading = true
                authRepository.fetchOrCreateUserDocument(
                    uid = existingUid,
                    fallbackEmail = existingEmail,
                    fallbackName = existingEmail.substringBefore("@").ifEmpty { "User" }
                ) { result ->
                    isLoading = false
                    result.onSuccess { user ->
                        statusMessage = "Loaded user from /users/${user.id}"
                        destination = AppDestination.Counter(user)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    
        when (val current = destination) {
            is AppDestination.Login -> {
                LoginScreen(
                    modifier = modifier,
                    email = email,
                    password = password,
                    isLoading = isLoading,
                    errorMessage = errorMessage,
                    onEmailChange = {
                        email = it
                        errorMessage = null
                    },
                    onPasswordChange = {
                        password = it
                        errorMessage = null
                    },
                    onLoginClick = {
                        isLoading = true
                        errorMessage = null
                        authRepository.loginUser(
                            email = email,
                            password = password
                        ) { result ->
                            isLoading = false
                            result
                                .onSuccess { user ->
                                    statusMessage = "Fetched user from /users/${user.id}"
                                    destination = AppDestination.Counter(user)
                                }
                                .onFailure { err ->
                                    errorMessage = err.localizedMessage ?: "Login failed"
                                }
                        }
                    },
                    onNavigateToRegister = {
                        errorMessage = null
                        destination = AppDestination.Register
                    }
                )
            }
    
            is AppDestination.Register -> {
                RegistrationScreen(
                    modifier = modifier,
                    displayName = displayName,
                    email = email,
                    password = password,
                    isLoading = isLoading,
                    errorMessage = errorMessage,
                    onDisplayNameChange = {
                        displayName = it
                        errorMessage = null
                    },
                    onEmailChange = {
                        email = it
                        errorMessage = null
                    },
                    onPasswordChange = {
                        password = it
                        errorMessage = null
                    },
                    onRegisterClick = {
                        isLoading = true
                        errorMessage = null
                        authRepository.registerUser(
                            displayName = displayName,
                            email = email,
                            password = password
                        ) { result ->
                            isLoading = false
                            result
                                .onSuccess { user ->
                                    statusMessage = "Created user in /users/${user.id}"
                                    destination = AppDestination.Counter(user)
                                }
                                .onFailure { err ->
                                    errorMessage = err.localizedMessage ?: "Registration failed"
                                }
                        }
                    },
                    onNavigateToLogin = {
                        errorMessage = null
                        destination = AppDestination.Login
                    }
                )
            }
    
            is AppDestination.Counter -> {
                val observedUser by authRepository
                    .observeUser(current.initialUser.id)
                    .collectAsState(initial = current.initialUser)
                val activeUser = observedUser ?: current.initialUser
    
                // Attach real-time Firestore listener to `/users/{uid}`
                DisposableEffect(activeUser.id) {
                    val registration = authRepository.listenToUserDocument(
                        uid = activeUser.id,
                        fallbackEmail = activeUser.email,
                        fallbackName = activeUser.displayName,
                        onError = { errMsg ->
                            statusMessage = "Firestore error: $errMsg"
                        }
                    )
                    onDispose {
                        registration.remove()
                    }
                }
    
                CounterScreen(
                    modifier = modifier,
                    user = activeUser,
                    statusMessage = statusMessage,
                    onIncrementClick = {
                        statusMessage = "Saving count to /users/${activeUser.id}..."
                        authRepository.incrementUserCount(activeUser) { result ->
                            result
                                .onSuccess { savedCount ->
                                    statusMessage = "Saved count ($savedCount) to /users/${activeUser.id}"
                                }
                                .onFailure { err ->
                                    statusMessage = "Offline / Failed: ${err.localizedMessage}"
                                }
                        }
                    },
                    onLogoutClick = {
                        authRepository.signOut()
                        password = ""
                        errorMessage = null
                        statusMessage = ""
                        destination = AppDestination.Login
                    }
                )
            }
        }
    }

    import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteOpenHelper

    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableSharedFlow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.filter
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.onStart
    
    /**
     * Local SQLite Database Manager for "Get Your Money Up Not Your Funny Up".
     *
     * Implements the Single Source of Truth (SSOT) for offline resilience:
     * - Enforces foreign keys (`PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON`) and Write-Ahead Logging (WAL).
     * - Creates the 7 core tables (`users`, `groups`, `group_members`, `expenses`,
     *   `expense_splits`, `settlements`, `sync_queue`) and performance indexes.
     * - Exposes reactive table invalidation streams (`observeTables`) for Compose UI flows.
     */
    class AppDatabase private constructor(
        context: Context,
        databaseName: String? = DatabaseContract.DATABASE_NAME
    ) : SQLiteOpenHelper(
        context.applicationContext,
        databaseName,
        null,
        DatabaseContract.DATABASE_VERSION
    ) {
    
        private val tableInvalidationFlow = MutableSharedFlow<Set<String>>(extraBufferCapacity = 64)
    
        val userDao: UserDao by lazy { UserDao(this) }
        val groupDao: GroupDao by lazy { GroupDao(this) }
        val expenseDao: ExpenseDao by lazy { ExpenseDao(this) }
        val settlementDao: SettlementDao by lazy { SettlementDao(this) }
        val syncQueueDao: SyncQueueDao by lazy { SyncQueueDao(this) }
    
        override fun onConfigure(db: SQLiteDatabase) {
            super.onConfigure(db)
            db.setForeignKeyConstraintsEnabled(true)
            if (!db.isReadOnly && databaseName != null) {
                db.enableWriteAheadLogging()
            }
        }
    
        override fun onCreate(db: SQLiteDatabase) {
            db.beginTransaction()
            try {
                for (statement in DatabaseContract.ALL_CREATE_STATEMENTS) {
                    db.execSQL(statement.trimIndent())
                }
                db.setTransactionSuccessful()
            } finally {
                db.endTransaction()
            }
        }
    
        override fun onUpgrade(db: SQLiteDatabase, oldVersion: Int, newVersion: Int) {
            if (oldVersion < 2) {
                runCatching {
                    db.execSQL(
                        "ALTER TABLE ${DatabaseContract.UsersTable.TABLE_NAME} " +
                            "ADD COLUMN ${DatabaseContract.UsersTable.COL_COUNT} INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"
                    )
                }
            }
            onCreate(db)
        }
    
        /**
         * Emits an initial signal and re-emits whenever any of the specified [tableNames] change.
         */
        fun observeTables(vararg tableNames: String): Flow<Set<String>> {
            val watchedSet = tableNames.toSet()
            return tableInvalidationFlow
                .filter { changed -> changed.any { it in watchedSet } }
                .onStart { emit(watchedSet) }
        }
    
        /**
         * Notifies active observers that one or more tables have been modified.
         */
        fun notifyTableChanged(vararg tableNames: String) {
            tableInvalidationFlow.tryEmit(tableNames.toSet())
        }
    
        companion object {
            @Volatile
            private var instance: AppDatabase? = null
    
            fun getInstance(context: Context): AppDatabase =
                instance ?: synchronized(this) {
                    instance ?: AppDatabase(context).also { instance = it }
                }
    
            /**
             * Creates an isolated in-memory database instance for instrumentation/reliability tests.
             */
            fun createInMemory(context: Context): AppDatabase =
                AppDatabase(context, databaseName = null)
        }
    }

    class SyncQueueDao(private val database: AppDatabase) {
    
        fun observePendingQueue(): Flow<List<SyncQueueEntity>> =
            database.observeTables(SyncQueueTable.TABLE_NAME).map {
                withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { getAllPending() }
            }
    
        fun enqueue(item: SyncQueueEntity): Long {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            val values = ContentValues().apply {
                put(SyncQueueTable.COL_ENTITY_TYPE, Converters.fromSyncEntityType(item.entityType))
                put(SyncQueueTable.COL_ENTITY_ID, item.entityId)
                put(SyncQueueTable.COL_ACTION, Converters.fromSyncAction(item.action))
                put(SyncQueueTable.COL_PAYLOAD_JSON, item.payloadJson)
                put(SyncQueueTable.COL_RETRY_COUNT, item.retryCount)
                put(SyncQueueTable.COL_LAST_ATTEMPT_AT, item.lastAttemptAt)
                put(SyncQueueTable.COL_ERROR_MESSAGE, item.errorMessage)
            }
            val id = db.insert(SyncQueueTable.TABLE_NAME, null, values)
            database.notifyTableChanged(SyncQueueTable.TABLE_NAME)
            return id
        }
    
        fun getAllPending(): List<SyncQueueEntity> {
            val db = database.readableDatabase
            val list = mutableListOf<SyncQueueEntity>()
            db.query(
                SyncQueueTable.TABLE_NAME,
                null,
                null,
                null,
                null,
                null,
                "${SyncQueueTable.COL_QUEUE_ID} ASC"
            ).use { cursor ->
                while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                    list.add(cursor.toSyncQueueEntity())
                }
            }
            return list
        }
    
        fun recordRetryFailure(queueId: Long, errorMessage: String?) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            db.execSQL(
                """
                UPDATE ${SyncQueueTable.TABLE_NAME}
                SET ${SyncQueueTable.COL_RETRY_COUNT} = ${SyncQueueTable.COL_RETRY_COUNT} + 1,
                    ${SyncQueueTable.COL_LAST_ATTEMPT_AT} = ?,
                    ${SyncQueueTable.COL_ERROR_MESSAGE} = ?
                WHERE ${SyncQueueTable.COL_QUEUE_ID} = ?
                """.trimIndent(),
                arrayOf<Any?>(System.currentTimeMillis(), errorMessage, queueId)
            )
            database.notifyTableChanged(SyncQueueTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        fun removeById(queueId: Long) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            db.delete(
                SyncQueueTable.TABLE_NAME,
                "${SyncQueueTable.COL_QUEUE_ID} = ?",
                arrayOf(queueId.toString())
            )
            database.notifyTableChanged(SyncQueueTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        private fun Cursor.toSyncQueueEntity(): SyncQueueEntity {
            val lastAttemptIdx = getColumnIndexOrThrow(SyncQueueTable.COL_LAST_ATTEMPT_AT)
            val errorIdx = getColumnIndexOrThrow(SyncQueueTable.COL_ERROR_MESSAGE)
            return SyncQueueEntity(
                queueId = getLong(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SyncQueueTable.COL_QUEUE_ID)),
                entityType = Converters.toSyncEntityType(getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SyncQueueTable.COL_ENTITY_TYPE))),
                entityId = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SyncQueueTable.COL_ENTITY_ID)),
                action = Converters.toSyncAction(getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SyncQueueTable.COL_ACTION))),
                payloadJson = getString(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SyncQueueTable.COL_PAYLOAD_JSON)),
                retryCount = getInt(getColumnIndexOrThrow(SyncQueueTable.COL_RETRY_COUNT)),
                lastAttemptAt = if (isNull(lastAttemptIdx)) null else getLong(lastAttemptIdx),
                errorMessage = if (isNull(errorIdx)) null else getString(errorIdx)
            )
        }
    }

    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.dashboard
    
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.model.SettlementStatus
    import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
    import java.util.Calendar
    import java.util.Date
    import java.util.Locale
    import java.util.TimeZone
    import kotlin.math.atan2
    import kotlin.math.hypot
    
    enum class GroupFilter(val label: String) { Recent("Recent"), Favourites("Favourites"), All("All") }
    
    enum class SpendPeriod(val label: String, val shortLabel: String, val caption: String) {
        Today("Today", "Today", "today"),
        Week("This week", "Week", "this week"),
        Month("This month", "Month", "this month"),
        Year("This year", "Year", "this year")
    }
    
    data class SpendSlice(
        val groupId: String,
        val amountCents: Long,
        val lastPayment: PaidOutPayment,
        val startDegrees: Float,
        val sweepDegrees: Float
    )
    
    fun filterGroups(groups: List<DashboardGroup>, filter: GroupFilter): List<DashboardGroup> =
    when (filter) {
        GroupFilter.Recent -> groups.sortedByDescending { it.lastActivityAt }
        GroupFilter.Favourites -> groups.filter { it.isFavourite }.sortedByDescending { it.lastActivityAt }
        GroupFilter.All -> groups.sortedBy { it.group.name.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) }
    }
    
    fun periodBounds(
        period: SpendPeriod,
        nowMillis: Long,
        timeZone: TimeZone = TimeZone.getDefault()
    ): LongRange {
        val start = Calendar.getInstance(timeZone).apply {
            timeInMillis = nowMillis
            set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0)
            set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0)
            set(Calendar.SECOND, 0)
            set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0)
            when (period) {
                SpendPeriod.Today -> Unit
                SpendPeriod.Week -> add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, -((get(Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK) + 5) % 7))
                SpendPeriod.Month -> set(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1)
                SpendPeriod.Year -> { set(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR, 1) }
            }
        }
        val end = (start.clone() as Calendar).apply {
            when (period) {
                SpendPeriod.Today -> add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1)
                SpendPeriod.Week -> add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 7)
                SpendPeriod.Month -> add(Calendar.MONTH, 1)
                SpendPeriod.Year -> add(Calendar.YEAR, 1)
            }
        }
        return start.timeInMillis until end.timeInMillis
    }
    
    fun spendSlices(data: HomeData, period: SpendPeriod): List<SpendSlice> {
        val bounds = periodBounds(period, data.nowMillis)
        val groupIds = data.groups.map { it.group.id }.toSet()
        val payments = data.paidOutPayments.orEmpty().filter {
            val payment = it.settlement
            payment.debtorId == data.user.id && payment.currency == "DKK" &&
            payment.status == SettlementStatus.COMPLETED && payment.amountCents > 0 &&
            payment.groupId in groupIds && payment.createdAt in bounds && payment.createdAt <= data.nowMillis
        }.distinctBy { it.settlement.id }
        val byGroup = payments.groupBy { it.settlement.groupId }
        val total = payments.sumOf { it.settlement.amountCents }.toDouble()
        var start = 0f
        return byGroup.map { (id, entries) ->
            val amount = entries.sumOf { it.settlement.amountCents }
            val sweep = (amount / total * 360.0).toFloat()
            SpendSlice(id, amount, entries.maxBy { it.settlement.createdAt }, start, sweep).also { start += sweep }
        }
    }
    
    fun hitTestSlice(x: Float, y: Float, slices: List<SpendSlice>, selectedGroupId: String?): String? {
        val radius = hypot(x - 0.5f, y - 0.5f)
        val angle = ((Math.toDegrees(atan2((y - 0.5f).toDouble(), (x - 0.5f).toDouble())) + 450) % 360).toFloat()
        return slices.firstOrNull {
            val outer = if (it.groupId == selectedGroupId) 69f / 140f else 62f / 140f
            val halfGap = minOf(2f, it.sweepDegrees / 3f) / 2f
            radius in (40f / 140f)..outer && angle >= it.startDegrees + halfGap &&
            angle <= it.startDegrees + it.sweepDegrees - halfGap
        }?.groupId
    }
    
    fun dateText(millis: Long, pattern: String): String =
    SimpleDateFormat(pattern, Locale.ENGLISH).format(Date(millis))
    
    fun activityDay(millis: Long, nowMillis: Long): String {
        if (millis in periodBounds(SpendPeriod.Today, nowMillis)) return "Today"
        val yesterday = Calendar.getInstance().apply { timeInMillis = nowMillis; add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, -1) }
        return if (millis in periodBounds(SpendPeriod.Today, yesterday.timeInMillis)) "Yesterday" else "Earlier"
    }
    
    fun relativeDate(millis: Long, nowMillis: Long): String = when (val day = activityDay(millis, nowMillis)) {
        "Earlier" -> dateText(millis, "EEE d MMM")
        else -> day
    }

    # Person 5 â€” Home and Activity integration
    
    ## Approved boundary
    
    This change implements independent native Compose screens for S3, S3-pay, S3-slice,
    S6 and S6-action. It does not attach them to MainActivity or implement the shared
    bottom navigation. SQLiteOpenHelper, the schema, entities, DAOs, repositories and
    Firebase behavior are unchanged. Room remains deferred. The independent Phase 4B
    connectivity/scheduling work and its activation limitations are described in
    `person5_phase4b.md`; it does not provide a real queue processor.
    
    ## Entry points
    
    - `HomeRoute(viewModel, onOpenActivity, onOpenGroups, onCreateGroup, onJoinGroup,
      onOpenGroup, modifier)` collects state with lifecycle awareness.
    - `ActivityRoute(viewModel, modifier)` collects the feed state.
    - `HomeScreen` and `ActivityScreen` are stateless entry points for previews and
      UI tests. They receive immutable state and an action callback.
    
    Person 1 should create each ViewModel with a normal ViewModel factory at the
    authenticated destination's scope, then pass it into the route. Do not construct
    a new ViewModel on every recomposition. The host shell owns system/window insets
    and the 80dp navigation bar; pass the shell's padded modifier to each route.
    The screen previews use a 412 Ã— 835dp content area, leaving the navigation bar to
    its owner. Destroy the account-scoped ViewModels on logout/account switch.
    
    ## Data and operation contracts
    
    `HomeViewModel` accepts a `Flow<HomeData>` and optional `SettlementActions`.
    `ActivityViewModel` accepts a `Flow<ActivityData>`, optional `SettlementActions`
    and optional `SyncRetryActions`. There are no default sample sources or default
    successful operations. The existing repositories can be connected by their owners
    without changing the screen APIs.
    
    | Owner | Supplies |
    |---|---|
    | Person 1 | Current user, account scope and navigation callbacks |
    | Person 2 | Existing Group objects plus chosen colour index, favourite flag and last activity |
    | Person 4 | Group-keyed MemberBalance values and OutstandingPayment objects wrapping DebtTransfer; the manual settlement operation |
    | Database/sync owner | Group/ledger flows, pending counts, actual saved-data timestamp, event history and sync retry operations |
    
    An `OutstandingPayment.id` identifies a particular outstanding obligation, not
    merely a group. Reuse the same identity between Home and reminder events. The
    settlement implementation must revalidate the obligation and record it
    idempotently, including concurrent calls from another screen/device. An error
    must mean no successful local recording; uncertain outcomes need reconciliation
    before permitting a duplicate operation. This guarantee belongs in Person 4's
    service, not in the screen's button state.
    
    `SettlementActions.recordSettlement` returns the recorded settlement's real
    SyncStatus. It records a manual settlement; it does not transfer money. A return
    of PENDING_INSERT or FAILED can mean a locally recorded settlement still awaiting
    synchronization, which is displayed separately from Paid. The owner must emit
    updated financial snapshots after recording. Screen-level duplicate taps are
    guarded; they do not replace database idempotency.
    
    `SyncRetryActions.retry` receives the supplied event so its owner can resolve the
    real queued operation. Return SYNCED only after remote acknowledgement. Returning
    a pending status displays waiting feedback and keeps the event in Needs you.
    Throwing or returning FAILED displays a failed attempt. Later source emissions
    update its real synchronization state. No WorkManager job or backend event is
    created by these screens.
    
    Home rejects incomplete/inconsistent DKK summaries instead of presenting them as
    All paid up. FinancialSummary must include a balance for every supplied group;
    the current user's outgoing transfers must match each negative group balance.
    This checks a supplied result; it does not calculate balances or settlements.
    An absent paid-out source is unavailable, while an explicitly empty source means
    zero recorded payments. The donut counts completed DKK settlements paid by the
    current user, within the selected calendar period. It does not count expenses or
    mix currencies. Weeks start Monday; date boundaries use the device timezone.
    
    Feed events must be supplied by an actual history/reminder source. The five event
    types correspond to the prototype; the screen does not infer historical changes
    from current ledger rows. `ActivityData.events = null` means history is unavailable;
    an empty list means the source has supplied an empty history. Event IDs must be
    unique and stable. `nowMillis` is injectable for tests; the source should refresh
    it when the screen resumes or the calendar day changes.
    
    Unread changes are held only in the ActivityViewModel's session. Mark all as read
    applies across filters, and does not resolve unpaid reminders or failed syncs.
    There is no persistent or cross-device mark-read claim. Home's unread indicator
    must be supplied by the eventual shared feed/read-state source.
    
    The flows should handle recoverable refresh failures and continue emitting local
    data. If a flow throws after emitting, the screen retains its last snapshot and
    reports the refresh failure; that closed flow requires its owner to reconnect.
    This is in-memory presentation resilience, not database-backed offline support.
    
    ## Implemented interactions
    
    - Home Recent/Favourites/All filtering, six-row limit, conditional See all link,
      no-group and no-favourites states, date/greeting and bell callback.
    - Supplied balance summary, period menu, native annular chart with hit testing,
      selected-slice emphasis, outside/back dismissal and Open group callback.
    - Individual and bulk inline confirmation, pending/success/failure states,
      partial bulk failure and a five-second all-clear drain/collapse.
    - Global feed sections and the four documented filters. Needs you counts
      unresolved actionable reminders and failed-sync events independently of unread.
    - Inline manual settlement and retry controls whose outcomes follow the injected
      operation results. Missing services disable controls and explain availability.
    - Offline banner and pending/failed/synced feedback components render supplied
      state. No connectivity monitoring or automatic background retry is claimed.
    
    ## Design checks and limits
    
    The HTML templates and scripts were checked against the native implementation:
    16dp side padding, semantic colours, the existing typography scale, 24dp hero
    cards, 18dp payment/feed cards, group colours, Danish amounts, and inline actions.
    The added unread, retry-border and empty-illustration tokens match the prototype.
    Controls retain at least 44dp interaction areas. Chart segments also expose named
    accessibility actions, including tiny segments that are difficult to tap.
    
    The donut centre retains two decimals per the explicit style-guide requirement,
    whereas the HTML's `fmtShort` rounds it. Loading, missing-integration and operation
    failure states explain unavailable functionality rather than displaying fixtures.
    The standalone screens retain the reference's light semantic surfaces even in
    dark-mode previews. No alternative dark design was invented.
    
    No Android screenshots were rendered or compared. Pixel-perfect verification is
    not claimed. Popover positioning, font loading, narrow screens, large font scales
    and the final shell/inset integration require device/emulator review. The slice
    popover includes the reference information, triangular pointer and dismissal behavior.
    
    ## Verification
    
    The Gradle wrapper's `assembleDebug` and `test` commands were attempted but stopped
    before compilation: Gradle 9.5.0 needs downloading and the session denies network
    sockets. No wrapper build or wrapper test success is claimed.
    
    Supplementary verification uses locally cached Kotlin 2.2.10, its Compose compiler,
    cached AndroidX libraries and the installed Android SDK. It compiles the new main

    and logs are under ignored `build/person5-verification/`.
    
    All 28 unit tests passed in that supplementary harness. The unit tests cover calendar/DST boundaries, chart filtering and hit testing,
    group/feed filters, confirmations, duplicate taps, partial bulk failures,
    unavailable services, actual versus queued retry outcomes, account changes,
    changed obligations and preservation of the last supplied data after refresh
    failure. Compose instrumentation tests are included for callbacks, inline
    confirmation and the five-second collapse, but have not been executed.
    
    ## Phase 4 and remaining integration
    
    Room coordination, durable read/history state, WorkManager scheduling/backoff,
    transactional outbox writes, Firestore normalization/conflict handling, recovery
    notifications and actual offline availability must be implemented and verified
    with the database owner after separate approval. The existing database is not
    changed or supplemented here. Do not display â€œgroup notifiedâ€ without an actual
    notification/reminder delivery result.

    # Person 5: independent offline foundation
    
    ## Scope and activation boundary
    
    This stage adds independent scheduling/processing code, connectivity observation,
    and honest status presentation. It does not implement Firebase queue processing,
    write to any DAO, change the schema/version, introduce Room or another outbox,
    change MainActivity/navigation, or implement financial algorithms. No real
    processor or authenticated startup hook is registered. The debug sandbox's
    payments/retries remain explicitly simulated and are not connected to WorkManager.
    
    The design follows Android 2's StateFlow/lifecycle guidance, Android 4's repository
    boundary, Software Architecture Part 1's outbox/worker/feedback diagram (page 9),
    and the usability lecture's status/retry mechanisms (page 10). The team's design
    document page 5 defines NFR-K1â€“K3; the responsibility document page 2 explicitly
    names Room and WorkManager. Room remains a separate unresolved team deliverable.
    
    ## Dependencies and approved manifest scope
    
    The user explicitly approved the standard WorkManager dependencies and necessary
    merged components after the interrupted turn. WorkManager 2.12.0 is declared in
    the version catalog, with `androidx.work:work-runtime` as implementation and
    `androidx.work:work-testing` as androidTestImplementation. It is a stable release
    whose minimum SDK is 24, matching this project. CoroutineWorker is available in
    work-runtime; no extra KTX, experimental metrics, DI or notification dependency
    is added. Actual resolution with the configured AGP/Kotlin still needs a build.
    
    References: [WorkManager releases](https://developer.android.com/jetpack/androidx/releases/work)
    and [upstream runtime manifest](https://github.com/androidx/androidx/blob/androidx-main/work/work-runtime/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml).
    
    The implementation uses only bounded background work, never setForeground or
    expedited foreground execution. Main AndroidManifest.xml therefore contains
    removal markers for the unused FOREGROUND_SERVICE permission and
    SystemForegroundService component. The optional DUMP-protected DiagnosticsReceiver
    is also removed. These markers remove library entries; they do not add a custom
    permission, service, receiver, initializer or Application class. Future foreground
    work/diagnostics would require revisiting those explicit removals.
    
    The expected retained library entries are:
    
    | Permission/component | Purpose |
    |---|---|
    | ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE | Network constraints; already in the earlier merged debug manifest. |
    | WAKE_LOCK | WorkManager execution support; already in that manifest. |
    | RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED | Rescheduling persisted work after reboot. |
    | InitializationProvider + WorkManagerInitializer metadata | Standard library initialization, not registration of our processor. |
    | SystemJobService (BIND_JOB_SERVICE protected) | Android JobScheduler execution. |
    | ForceStopRunnable$BroadcastReceiver | WorkManager's internal force-stop bookkeeping. |
    | RescheduleReceiver | Restores scheduled work after boot. |
    
    INTERNET and Firebase/analytics components already belong to the existing app;
    they are not newly implemented synchronization endpoints. No POST_NOTIFICATIONS
    permission is introduced. WorkManager's internal scheduling storage and any
    transitive persistence libraries do not replace or supplement the financial
    database; no application Room database/entities/DAOs are introduced.
    
    The generated merged manifest inspected before the dependency addition is stale
    and contains no WorkManager entries. It is not evidence of the final merge.
    The final post-dependency manifest must be verified using processDebugMainManifest
    or Android Studio's Merged Manifest view after successful resolution. The
    task was attempted explicitly but failed resolving the missing WorkManager
    dependency in this environment. No final merged-manifest verification is claimed.
    
    ## Classes and data flow
    
    `SyncQueueProcessor.processNext(accountId)` is the only new owner-facing
    processing interface. It returns one of:
    
    | Result | Meaning |
    |---|---|
    | `Empty` | No eligible operation remains for this account; not proof that everything synchronized. |
    | `Acknowledged(accountId)` | One operation was remotely acknowledged and locally reconciled by its owner. |
    | `RetryLater` | A temporary failure; retain the mutation and its original queue row. |
    | `NeedsAttention` | A blocked/unsupported operation requires attention; retain it. |
    
    `SyncRunner` calls that interface sequentially under a process-wide coroutine
    mutex, shared even between different runner instances. This serializes the
    automatic and manual worker lanes in the current single-process app. Each run
    has a cooperative 30-second timeout and at most 20 acknowledged operations. The
    bound includes time waiting for the mutex. Exhausting a bound returns retry.
    Cancellation propagates and releases the lock; an unexpected exception fails
    closed as NeedsAttention. The processor must classify transient exceptions as
    RetryLater rather than relying on the runner to guess Firebase error semantics.
    
    The account is checked before starting, after obtaining the lock, before each
    operation and after its result. A mismatched acknowledgement is rejected. These
    checks cannot undo a remote side effect already performed by an incorrect owner
    implementation. Authentication/ownership must also be checked inside that
    implementation at dispatch and reconciliation, including logout/login during a
    suspension. A UID check alone does not distinguish two successive sessions for

    enum class SyncEntityType {
        USER,
        GROUP,
        EXPENSE,
        SETTLEMENT;
    
        companion object {
            fun fromValue(value: String?): SyncEntityType =
                entries.firstOrNull { it.name.equals(value, ignoreCase = true) } ?: EXPENSE
        }
    }
    
    enum class SyncAction {
        CREATE,
        UPDATE,
        DELETE;
    
        companion object {
            fun fromValue(value: String?): SyncAction =
                entries.firstOrNull { it.name.equals(value, ignoreCase = true) } ?: CREATE
        }
    }

    @Composable
    private fun GroupRow(group: DashboardGroup, state: HomeUiState.Success, onClick: () -> Unit) {
        val shownBalance = remember(state, group.group.id) {
            val balance = state.data.finances?.balancesByGroup?.get(group.group.id)?.takeIf {
                it.currency == "DKK" && it.userId == state.data.user.id
            }?.netBalanceCents
            val groupPayments = state.payments.filter { it.groupId == group.group.id }
            if (balance != null && balance < 0 && groupPayments.isNotEmpty()) {
                -state.unpaid.filter { it.groupId == group.group.id }.sumOf { it.transfer.amountCents }
            } else balance
        }
        Surface(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clickable(onClick = onClick),
            shape = AppShapes.ListCard,
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, AppColors.LineSoft),
            color = AppColors.White
        ) {
            Row(
                Modifier.padding(AppSpacing.Space12),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space12)
            ) {
                DashboardAvatar(group.group.name, AppColors.groupColorAt(group.colourIndex))
                Column(Modifier.weight(1f), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        Text(
                            group.group.name,
                            Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false),
                            style = AppTypography.ItemTitle,
                            maxLines = 1,
                            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                            color = AppColors.Ink900
                        )
                        if (group.isFavourite) DashboardSymbol(
                            DashboardIcon.Star,
                            Modifier.padding(start = AppSpacing.Space4).size(14.dp),
                            AppColors.StarGold,
                            "Favourite"
                        )
                    }
                    if (group.pendingExpenseCount > 0) {
                        Row(
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space4)
                        ) {
                            CircularProgressIndicator(Modifier.size(13.dp), color = AppColors.Amber800, strokeWidth = 1.5.dp)
                            Text(
                                "${group.pendingExpenseCount} expense${if (group.pendingExpenseCount == 1) "" else "s"} waiting to sync",
                                style = AppTypography.Caption,
                                color = AppColors.Amber700
                            )
                        }
                    } else Text(
                        "${group.group.members.size} members Â· Active ${relativeDate(group.lastActivityAt, state.data.nowMillis).lowercase()}",
                        style = AppTypography.Caption,
                        color = AppColors.Ink600
                    )
                }
                BalanceChip(shownBalance, Modifier.widthIn(max = 126.dp))
            }
        }
        fun listenToUserDocument(
            uid: String,
            fallbackEmail: String,
            fallbackName: String,
            onError: (String) -> Unit
        ): ListenerRegistration {
            return firestore.collection(USERS_COLLECTION)
                .document(uid)
                .addSnapshotListener { snapshot, error ->
                    if (error != null) {
                        onError(error.localizedMessage ?: "Firestore listener error")
                        return@addSnapshotListener
                    }
                    if (snapshot != null && snapshot.exists()) {
                        val remoteUser = snapshot.toUserDomain(
                            uid = uid,
                            fallbackEmail = fallbackEmail,
                            fallbackName = fallbackName
                        )
                        ioScope.launch {
                            userDao.upsertUser(UserEntity.fromDomain(remoteUser))
                        }
                    }
                }
        }

        fun observeAllGroups(): Flow<List<GroupEntity>> =
            database.observeTables(GroupsTable.TABLE_NAME, GroupMembersTable.TABLE_NAME).map {
                withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { getAllGroups() }
            }
    
        fun observeMembersForGroup(groupId: String): Flow<List<GroupMemberEntity>> =
            database.observeTables(GroupMembersTable.TABLE_NAME).map {
                withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { getMembersForGroup(groupId) }
            }
    
        fun upsertGroupWithMembers(group: GroupEntity, members: List<GroupMemberEntity>) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            db.beginTransaction()
            try {
                db.insertWithOnConflict(
                    GroupsTable.TABLE_NAME,
                    null,
                    group.toContentValues(),
                    SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_REPLACE
                )
                for (member in members) {
                    db.insertWithOnConflict(
                        GroupMembersTable.TABLE_NAME,
                        null,
                        member.toContentValues(),
                        SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_REPLACE
                    )
                }
                db.setTransactionSuccessful()
            } finally {
                db.endTransaction()
            }
            database.notifyTableChanged(GroupsTable.TABLE_NAME, GroupMembersTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        fun upsertGroup(group: GroupEntity) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            db.insertWithOnConflict(
                GroupsTable.TABLE_NAME,
                null,
                group.toContentValues(),
                SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_REPLACE
            )
            database.notifyTableChanged(GroupsTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }
    
        fun addMember(member: GroupMemberEntity) {
            val db = database.writableDatabase
            db.insertWithOnConflict(
                GroupMembersTable.TABLE_NAME,
                null,
                member.toContentValues(),
                SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_REPLACE
            )
            database.notifyTableChanged(GroupMembersTable.TABLE_NAME)
        }

            db.delete(

                "${GroupMembersTable.COL_GROUP_ID} = ? AND ${GroupMembersTable.COL_USER_ID} = ?",

    @Composable
    fun SyncStatusStrip(status: SyncStatus, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, automaticRetryAvailable: Boolean = false) {
        val failed = status == SyncStatus.FAILED
        val synced = status == SyncStatus.SYNCED
        Surface(
            modifier,
            color = if (synced) AppColors.Green100 else if (failed) AppColors.Red50 else AppColors.Amber100,
            shape = AppShapes.Chip
        ) {
            Text(
                if (synced) "Synced" else if (failed && automaticRetryAvailable) "Couldn't sync yet Â· retrying automatically"
                else if (failed) "Couldn't sync Â· needs attention" else "Saved on your phone Â· waiting to sync",
                Modifier.padding(horizontal = AppSpacing.Space12, vertical = AppSpacing.Space8),
                style = AppTypography.Label,
                color = if (synced) AppColors.Green700 else if (failed) AppColors.Red800 else AppColors.Amber800
            )
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    fun InlinePaymentActions(
        state: InlineActionState,
        amount: String,
        creditor: String,
        onAsk: () -> Unit,
        onCancel: () -> Unit,
        onConfirm: () -> Unit,
        modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
        enabled: Boolean = true,
        soft: Boolean = false
    ) {
        Column(modifier, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space8)) {
            when (state) {
                InlineActionState.Confirming -> Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space8)) {
                    DashboardButton("Cancel", onCancel, Modifier.weight(1f), AppColors.White, AppColors.Ink900, outlined = true)
                    DashboardButton("Confirm", onConfirm, Modifier.weight(1f), AppColors.Red700, AppColors.White)
                }
                InlineActionState.Working -> ActionStatus("Payingâ€¦", working = true)
                is InlineActionState.Done -> {
                    ActionStatus(when (state.syncStatus) {
                        SyncStatus.SYNCED -> "Paid Â· settled with $creditor"
                        SyncStatus.FAILED -> "Settlement recorded Â· sync needs attention"
                        null -> "Settlement recorded"
                        else -> "Settlement recorded Â· synchronization pending"
                    })
                    state.syncStatus?.takeIf { it != SyncStatus.SYNCED }?.let { SyncStatusStrip(it) }
                }
                else -> {
                    if (state is InlineActionState.Failed) {
                        Text(state.message, style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Amber800)
                    }
                    DashboardButton(
                        "Pay $amount", onAsk, Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        if (soft) AppColors.Red100 else AppColors.Red700,
                        if (soft) AppColors.Red700 else AppColors.White, enabled
                    )
                    if (!enabled) Text("Settlement service unavailable", style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                }
            }

    Non-functional Requirements
    Reliability (Quality Attribute, QA):
    •
    Fault Tolerance
    o If a request fails due to temporary network unavailability, the application must retry it in
    the background
    o Failed requests must not prevent the user from continuing to use the app
    •
    Offline Availability
    o Previously retrieved data must remain accessible when the device is offline
    •
    User feedback
    o The application must indicate whether a request is pending, successful or failed
    o The user must be notified when a previously failed request eventually succeeds in the
    background
    Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence:
    GenAI has become a well-established tool for software development and therefore its use is accepted.
    As engineers we must know when and how to use such tools therefore we expect you to state an
    example of the following for each of your GenAI use-cases:
    Use case: (e.g. UX, code-completion, library integration):
    Tool: (e.g. gemini, chatGPT, Claude)
    Chat history: (link if possible)
    Evaluation: (Description of how well the LLM carried out its task and to what extent you could use its
    replies)
    Look up alternative solutions yourselves (not using GenAI) - why did you end up using what solution?
    
    AI policy (shared constant)
    Allowed: any AI tool in any mode, autocomplete, chat, multimodal, or agentic (e.g., Claude Code,
    Cursor, GitHub Copilot agent mode, Gemini CLI), for any part of this project, provided use is disclosed.
    Undisclosed AI use is academic misconduct. Note the asymmetry: controlled disclosed AI use that is
    verified well can earn top marks; hidden use can cost you the course.
    Four standing rules apply whenever AI touches your project:
    1. Disclose in the AI dossier. Continue the log you started in the design document's Appendix A: one
    entry per significant interaction (tool, mode, task, prompt or link, verification, decision), plus the
    failure log, at least 3 entries per project documenting AI output that was wrong or off-spec and how
    you caught it.
    2. AI code enters main only through a pull request that carries tests, is reviewed by a teammate who
    did not generate it, and passes CI. 'The model wrote it and it ran' is not verification.
    3. Maintain an agent rules file. Your repository contains a CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md describing your
    conventions, architecture, and definition of done. Evolve it as you learn what your agents get wrong;
    its git history is evidence of engineering judgment.

     MVVM
    • Pattern that separates responsibilities into three layers:
    • View
    • ViewModel
    • Model
    • View
    • Displays the UI
    • Receives user input
    • Contains minimal business logic
    • ViewModel
    • Holds UI state
    • Contains presentation logic
    • Survives configuration changes
    • Model
    • Data and business logic
    • Database
    • Repository
    • This and other architectures are described in a later lecture
    
    PAGE 16
     Creating ViewModels
    • ViewModel for displaying a name
    • _name is mutable and private
    • MutableStateFlow holds a value that
    can be changed, and sends new value
    to observers
    • name is read-only and public
    • asStateFlow() creates read-only copy
    • _name can only be changed using the
    public function setName()
    
    PAGE 17
     Using ViewModels
    • ViewModel is passed to the screen that uses it
    • = viewModel() means that an instance is created if one is not passed
    • If multiple screens use the same VM, the same instance should be
    passed between them
    • collectAsStateWithLifeCycle() observes a StateFlow and converts it
    to Compose State
    • In this example, it
    becomes a String that
    can be displayed in
    the UI

     Navigation – Keeping State
    Some state needs to be shared across

     Component and connector viewpoint
    Elements: components with functional behaviour.  Relations: connectors for control and communication.  UML: object and interaction diagrams.

    connector defines the protocol, the ordering of
    operations, and the roles of the attached components.

    components are active objects; connectors are links with

    •

    degradation
    •
    Reintroduce: state
    resynchronization when the
    worker drains the outbox after
    reconnect
    •
    Prevent: transactions with an
    idempotent request id so a
    retry never creates a duplicate;
    removal from service after the

    sequenceDiagram
        participant UI as Compose UI / ViewModel
        participant Repo as OfflineFirstRepository
        participant Room as Local Room SQLite DB
        participant WM as WorkManager SyncWorker
        participant FS as Remote Cloud Firestore
    
        UI->>Repo: Create Expense / Settlement
        Repo->>Room: Insert entity (sync_status = PENDING_INSERT) & enqueue sync_queue
        Room-->>UI: Emit updated Flow immediately (non-blocking)
        Repo->>WM: Enqueue OneTimeWorkRequest (NetworkType.CONNECTED)
        WM->>Room: Read pending items from sync_queue
        WM->>FS: Write document to /groups/{groupId}/expenses/{id}
        alt Network Success
            FS-->>WM: ACK
            WM->>Room: Mark entity sync_status = SYNCED & remove from sync_queue
            Room-->>UI: Emit SYNCED status badge
        else Network Failure
            FS-->>WM: Exception / Timeout
            WM->>Room: Increment retry_count & set sync_status = FAILED (or retry backoff)
            Room-->>UI: Emit Pending/Failed indicator
        end

**The independent Person 5 implementation is verified, but production integration and end-to-end offline synchronization remain incomplete.** Phase 5 should begin with targeted presentation fixes and contract tests, then connect teammate services only when they are available and approved.

This review was read-only. I inspected the current code, generated test reports and debug merged manifest, alongside the relevant requirements, navigation model, Hi-Fi HTML/JavaScript, database documentation and lecture material. No files were modified.

**1. Current implementation and verification**

The generated reports confirm **49 JVM tests and 17 Android instrumentation tests passed**, with no failures, errors or skips. Your successful build and manual sandbox testing provide additional verification. I did not rerun those tasks during this review.

| Area | Implemented and verified | Remaining boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Home | Summary presentation, group filters, empty states, donut periods/popovers, individual/bulk confirmation and all-clear collapse | Real account-scoped financial/group data |
| Activity | Date sections, four filters, unread indicators, session mark-read and inline actions | Persistent history/read state and real reminders |
| Synchronization foundation | Unique scheduling, network constraints, backoff, bounded processing, serialization and account guards | Real queue processor and lifecycle activation |
| Connectivity/status UI | Lifecycle-aware connectivity observation; supplied pending, failure and recovery feedback | Authoritative metadata and durable recovery feedback |
| Debug sandbox | Interactive Home/Activity with isolated fixtures and labelled simulations | Intentionally separate from production |
| Local storage | Existing SQLite database, DAO flows and queue operations | Complete transactional offline-first repositories |

I inspected the **generated debug manifest**. It contains:

- `RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED`, network/wake-lock permissions.
- `WorkManagerInitializer`, `SystemJobService` and internal recovery receivers.
- No `FOREGROUND_SERVICE` permission, `SystemForegroundService` or diagnostics receiver.

Release manifest/APK verification remains a separate checklist item.

**2. What is disconnected or simulated**

The current checkout still has these integration gaps:

- **Production navigation:** `MainActivity.kt` routes between login, registration and the counter. The documented five-tab shell is not implemented in this checkout. Home/Activity are reached through the debug sandbox.
- **Person 4:** `MemberBalance`, `DebtTransfer` and settlement models exist, but I found no concrete balance calculator, settlement service or production `SettlementActions` implementation.
- **Firebase:** `AuthRepository` implements user authentication/profile/counter operations. Documented group, expense and settlement synchronization is not implemented.
- **Queue processing:** no real `SyncQueueProcessor` implementation exists, and `SyncWorkerFactory` is not installed in production.
- **Financial actions:** sandbox payment/retry outcomes are delayed simulations. They do not update a shared persisted ledger.
- **Activity:** fixtures supply events; there is no persistent event/reminder source. Read state is held in the Activity ViewModel.
- **Recovery:** restart scheduling is an available hook, not an activated or verified recovery lifecycle. Recovery text is supplied presentation data, not durable completion history.

Consequently, the successful tests establish the independent components’ behavior—not complete NFR-K1–K3 compliance.

**3. Findings to address before integration**

These are source-review findings, rather than failures reported from your emulator testing.

1. **Activity can incorrectly claim everything is synchronized.**  
   An empty “Needs you” filter displays “No payments due and everything is synced,” even when `SyncPresentation.pendingCount` is positive. An empty filtered feed does not establish either global condition. Use neutral wording unless an authoritative source confirms the all-clear state.

2. **Home group chips can understate an inconsistent supplied balance.**  
   `GroupRow` derives its displayed debt from outstanding transfers without applying the hero card’s consistency guard. For example, a supplied balance of −100 kr with only 50 kr of transfer instructions can display 50 kr in the row while the hero correctly reports unavailable information. Preserve the authoritative balance or show unavailable information until the snapshot is consistent.

3. **Pending settlement feedback needs subsequent acknowledgement reconciliation.**  
   A returned `Done(PENDING_INSERT)` is retained in action state. Home has no stable settlement reference through which to update that feedback, and Activity’s explicit source-synced override currently applies to sync-failure events. Agree on operation identity and reconcile later pending/failed/synced emissions.

4. **Retry failure reconciliation needs an additional regression test.**  
   If a scheduled retry remains represented by the same `FAILED` event status, an existing pending action can be retained and hide “Try now.” The source contract needs an observable attempt/status transition; the ViewModel must handle it correctly.

Additional integration requirements:

- Refresh `nowMillis` on resume/day changes so date sections and chart periods do not retain yesterday’s boundaries.
- Recoverable source failures must not permanently terminate local observation.
- Home’s unread bell and Activity’s read state need one shared authoritative source.
- Recovery feedback needs acknowledgement identity and eventual dismissal/consumption.
- A formal Android-versus-Hi-Fi screenshot comparison is still missing. Manual interaction verification does not establish pixel-perfect rendering.

**4. Shared architecture issues requiring teammate work**

The earlier database risks remain present:

- Entity writes and queue insertion are separate operations.
- Queue rows lack explicit account ownership/version information.
- Remote acknowledgement versus newer local edits is not defined.
- User snapshots are mapped to `SYNCED` without checking pending-write metadata.
- Parent upserts use `CONFLICT_REPLACE`; refreshes need tests proving related rows remain intact.
- Queue removal does not retain durable retry-completion history.
- Cache-refresh timestamps and financial activity history are unavailable.

These require the database/Firebase owner’s decisions and implementation. **I propose no independent changes to those files.**

The worker’s mutex prevents overlapping calls within the current process. It does not provide cross-device idempotency or cancel an already-dispatched Firebase write.

            val outstanding: List<OutstandingPayment> = data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().filter {

            }.distinctBy { it.id }

            val isWorking: Boolean = paymentStates.values.any { it == InlineActionState.Working }

    class HomeViewModel(
        source: Flow<HomeData>,
        private val settlements: SettlementActions? = null
    ) : ViewModel() {
        private val mutableState = MutableStateFlow<HomeUiState>(HomeUiState.Loading)
        val state = mutableState.asStateFlow()
        private var recording = false
    
        init {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    source.collect { data ->
                        val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success
                        mutableState.value = if (current == null || current.data.user.id != data.user.id) {
                            HomeUiState.Success(data, canSettle = settlements != null)
                        } else {
                            val unchangedIds = data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().filter { payment ->
                                current.data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().any { it == payment }
                            }.map { it.id }.toSet()
                            val recorded = current.recordedPayments.filterValues { payment ->
                                val next = data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().firstOrNull { it.id == payment.id }
                                next == null || next == payment
                            }
                            current.copy(
                                data = data,
                                sourceError = null,
                                confirmingAll = current.confirmingAll &&
                                    current.data.finances?.outstandingPayments == data.finances?.outstandingPayments,
                                paymentStates = current.paymentStates.filterKeys { it in unchangedIds || it in recorded },
                                recordedPayments = recorded
                            )
                        }
                    }
                } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                    throw error
                } catch (error: Exception) {
                    val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success
                    mutableState.value = current?.copy(sourceError = "Couldn't refresh. Showing the last dashboard.")
                    ?: HomeUiState.Error(error.message ?: "Couldn't load your dashboard")
                }
            }
        }
    
        private fun update(change: (HomeUiState.Success) -> HomeUiState.Success) {
            mutableState.update { if (it is HomeUiState.Success) change(it) else it }
        }
    
        fun selectFilter(filter: GroupFilter) = update { it.copy(filter = filter) }
        fun selectPeriod(period: SpendPeriod) = update { it.copy(period = period, selectedGroupId = null) }
        fun selectSlice(groupId: String?) = update { it.copy(selectedGroupId = groupId) }
        fun togglePayments() = update {
            it.copy(
                paymentsExpanded = !it.paymentsExpanded,
                confirmingAll = false,
                recordedPayments = if (it.paymentsExpanded) emptyMap() else it.recordedPayments
            )
        }
        fun closePayments() = update {
            it.copy(paymentsExpanded = false, confirmingAll = false, recordedPayments = emptyMap())
        }
    
        fun cancelPayment() = update {
            it.copy(
                confirmingAll = false,
                paymentStates = it.paymentStates.filterValues { value -> value != InlineActionState.Confirming }
            )
        }
    
        fun askPayment(id: String) {
            cancelPayment()
            update {
                if (!it.canSettle || !it.hasFinancialSummary || recording || it.unpaid.none { payment -> payment.id == id }) it
                else it.copy(paymentStates = it.paymentStates + (id to InlineActionState.Confirming))
            }
        }
    
        fun askAll() {
            cancelPayment()
            update { if (it.canSettle && it.hasFinancialSummary && !recording && it.unpaid.isNotEmpty()) it.copy(confirmingAll = true) else it }
        }
    
        fun confirmPayment(id: String) {
            val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return
            if (current.paymentStates[id] != InlineActionState.Confirming || recording) return
            record(current.unpaid.filter { it.id == id })
        }
    
        fun confirmAll() {
            val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return
            if (current.confirmingAll && !recording) record(current.unpaid)
        }
    
        private fun record(payments: List<OutstandingPayment>) {
            val actions = settlements ?: return
            val userId = (mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success)?.data?.user?.id ?: return
            recording = true
            update { it.copy(
                    confirmingAll = false,
                    paymentStates = it.paymentStates + payments.associate { p -> p.id to InlineActionState.Working }
            ) }
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    for (payment in payments) {
                        val latest = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return@launch
                        if (latest.data.user.id != userId) return@launch
                        val result = try {
                            check(latest.payments.any { it == payment }) { "This balance changed. Check the latest payment." }
                            InlineActionState.Done(actions.recordSettlement(payment))
                        } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                            throw error
                        } catch (error: Exception) {
                            InlineActionState.Failed(error.message ?: "Couldn't record this payment. Try again.")
                        }
                        update {
                            val next = it.outstanding.firstOrNull { current -> current.id == payment.id }
                            if (it.data.user.id == userId && (next == payment || (next == null && result is InlineActionState.Done))) {
                                it.copy(
                                    paymentStates = it.paymentStates + (payment.id to result),
                                    recordedPayments = if (result is InlineActionState.Done) {
                                        it.recordedPayments + (payment.id to payment)
                                    } else it.recordedPayments
                                )
                            } else it
                        }
                    }
                } finally {
                    recording = false
                }
            }
        }
    }

    sealed interface ActivityUiState {
        data object Loading : ActivityUiState
        data class Error(val message: String) : ActivityUiState
        data class Success(
            val data: ActivityData,
            val filter: ActivityFilter = ActivityFilter.All,
            val readIds: Set<String> = emptySet(),
            val actions: Map<String, InlineActionState> = emptyMap(),
            val canSettle: Boolean = false,
            val canRetry: Boolean = false,
            val sourceError: String? = null
        ) : ActivityUiState {
            val events: List<ActivityEvent> = data.events.orEmpty().distinctBy { it.id }
            val needsCount: Int = events.count { it.needsAction(data.userId, actionFor(it)) }
            val hasUnread: Boolean = events.any { it.unread && it.id !in readIds }
            fun actionFor(event: ActivityEvent): InlineActionState =
            if (event.type == ActivityType.SyncFailure && event.syncStatus == SyncStatus.SYNCED) InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.SYNCED)
            else actions[event.id] ?: InlineActionState.Idle
        }
    }
    
    class ActivityViewModel(
        source: Flow<ActivityData>,
        private val settlements: SettlementActions? = null,
        private val retries: SyncRetryActions? = null
    ) : ViewModel() {
        private val mutableState = MutableStateFlow<ActivityUiState>(ActivityUiState.Loading)
        val state = mutableState.asStateFlow()
        private val activeIds = mutableSetOf<String>()
    
        init {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    source.collect { data ->
                        val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success
                        mutableState.value = if (current == null || current.data.userId != data.userId) {
                            ActivityUiState.Success(data, canSettle = settlements != null, canRetry = retries != null)
                        } else {
                            val unchangedIds = data.events.orEmpty().filter { next ->
                                current.events.any {
                                    it.id == next.id && it.payment == next.payment &&
                                    (it.syncStatus == next.syncStatus || current.actions[next.id] == InlineActionState.Working)
                                }
                            }.map { it.id }.toSet()
                            current.copy(data = data, sourceError = null, actions = current.actions.filterKeys { it in unchangedIds })
                        }
                    }
                } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                    throw error
                } catch (error: Exception) {
                    val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success
                    mutableState.value = current?.copy(sourceError = "Couldn't refresh. Showing the last activity.")
                    ?: ActivityUiState.Error(error.message ?: "Couldn't load activity")
                }
            }
        }
    
        private fun update(change: (ActivityUiState.Success) -> ActivityUiState.Success) {
            mutableState.update { if (it is ActivityUiState.Success) change(it) else it }
        }
    
        fun selectFilter(filter: ActivityFilter) = update { it.copy(filter = filter) }
        fun markAllRead() = update { it.copy(readIds = it.readIds + it.events.map { event -> event.id }) }
    
        fun askPayment(id: String) = update {
            val event = it.events.firstOrNull { event -> event.id == id }
            if (event == null || !it.canSettle || !event.canPay(it.data.userId) || id in activeIds || it.actionFor(event) is InlineActionState.Done) it
            else it.copy(
                actions = it.actions.filterValues { value -> value != InlineActionState.Confirming } + (id to InlineActionState.Confirming),
                readIds = it.readIds + id
            )
        }
    
        fun cancelPayment() = update { it.copy(actions = it.actions.filterValues { value -> value != InlineActionState.Confirming }) }
    
        fun confirmPayment(id: String) {
            val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success ?: return
            val event = current.events.firstOrNull { it.id == id } ?: return
            val service = settlements ?: return
            if (current.actions[id] != InlineActionState.Confirming || !event.canPay(current.data.userId)) return
            runAction(event) { service.recordSettlement(event.payment!!) }
        }
    
        fun retry(id: String) {
            val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success ?: return
            val event = current.events.firstOrNull { it.id == id } ?: return
            val service = retries ?: return
            if (event.type != ActivityType.SyncFailure || !event.needsAction(current.data.userId, current.actionFor(event))) return
            runAction(event) {
                val status = service.retry(event)
                check(status != SyncStatus.FAILED) { "Couldn't sync yet. Try again." }
                status
            }
        }
    
        private fun runAction(event: ActivityEvent, action: suspend () -> SyncStatus) {
            if (!activeIds.add(event.id)) return
            val userId = (mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success)?.data?.userId ?: return
            update { it.copy(actions = it.actions + (event.id to InlineActionState.Working), readIds = it.readIds + event.id) }
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    val result = try {
                        InlineActionState.Done(action())
                    } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                        throw error
                    } catch (error: Exception) {
                        InlineActionState.Failed(error.message ?: "Couldn't complete this action. Try again.")
                    }
                    update {
                        if (it.data.userId == userId && it.events.any { current -> current.id == event.id && current.payment == event.payment }) {
                            it.copy(actions = it.actions + (event.id to result))
                        } else it
                    }
                } finally { activeIds.remove(event.id) }
            }
        }
    }
