    enum class ActivityType { ExpenseAdded, ExpenseChanged, Payment, Reminder, SyncFailure }
    enum class AmountDirection { Owed, Received, Settled, Neutral }
    enum class ActivityFilter(val label: String) { All("All"), NeedsYou("Needs you"), Expenses("Expenses"), Payments("Payments") }
    
    data class ActivityEvent(
        val id: String,
        val type: ActivityType,
        val actor: User?,
        val actorColourIndex: Int,
        val description: String,
        val group: DashboardGroup,
        val occurredAt: Long,
        val amountCents: Long? = null,
        val currency: String = "DKK",
        val direction: AmountDirection = AmountDirection.Neutral,
        val unread: Boolean = false,
        val payment: OutstandingPayment? = null,
        val syncStatus: SyncStatus? = null,
        val expenseTitle: String? = null
    )
    
    data class ActivityData(
        val userId: String,
        val events: List<ActivityEvent>? = null,
        val nowMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
        val sync: SyncPresentation = SyncPresentation()
    )
    
    fun interface SyncRetryActions {
        suspend fun retry(event: ActivityEvent): SyncStatus
    }
    
    fun ActivityEvent.canPay(userId: String): Boolean = type == ActivityType.Reminder && payment?.let {
        it.groupId == group.group.id && it.transfer.debtorId == userId &&
        it.transfer.currency == "DKK" && it.transfer.amountCents > 0
    } == true
    
    fun ActivityEvent.needsAction(userId: String, state: InlineActionState): Boolean = when {
        canPay(userId) -> state !is InlineActionState.Done
        type == ActivityType.SyncFailure -> syncStatus != SyncStatus.SYNCED &&
        !(state is InlineActionState.Done && state.syncStatus == SyncStatus.SYNCED)
        else -> false
    }
    
    fun filterActivities(
        events: List<ActivityEvent>,
        userId: String,
        filter: ActivityFilter,
        actions: Map<String, InlineActionState>
    ): List<ActivityEvent> = events.distinctBy { it.id }.filter {
        when (filter) {
            ActivityFilter.All -> true
            ActivityFilter.NeedsYou -> it.needsAction(userId, actions[it.id] ?: InlineActionState.Idle)
            ActivityFilter.Expenses -> it.type in listOf(
                ActivityType.ExpenseAdded,
                ActivityType.ExpenseChanged,
                ActivityType.SyncFailure
            )
            ActivityFilter.Payments -> it.type == ActivityType.Payment || it.type == ActivityType.Reminder
        }
    }.sortedByDescending { it.occurredAt }

    import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
    import kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.test.*
    import org.junit.After
    import org.junit.Assert.*
    import org.junit.Before
    import org.junit.Test
    
    @OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
    class HomeViewModelTest {
        private val dispatcher = UnconfinedTestDispatcher()
        private val payment = OutstandingPayment("p", "g", "Mads", 1, DebtTransfer("u", "m", 1234, "DKK"))
        private fun data() = HomeData(User("u", "u@test", "User"), listOf(DashboardGroup(Group("g", "Group", createdBy = "u"), 0)), FinancialSummary(mapOf("g" to MemberBalance("u", -1234, "DKK")), listOf(payment)))
        @Before fun setUp() = Dispatchers.setMain(dispatcher)
        @After fun tearDown() = Dispatchers.resetMain()
        private fun HomeViewModel.current() = state.value as HomeUiState.Success
    
        @Test fun confirmationDoesNotRecordUntilConfirmedAndDoubleTapIsIgnored() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            var calls = 0
            val result = CompletableDeferred<SyncStatus>()
            val vm = HomeViewModel(MutableStateFlow(data()), SettlementActions { calls++; result.await() })
            vm.askPayment("p")
            assertEquals(0, calls)
            vm.cancelPayment()
            vm.confirmPayment("p")
            assertEquals(0, calls)
            vm.askPayment("p")
            vm.confirmPayment("p")
            vm.confirmPayment("p")
            assertEquals(1, calls)
            assertEquals(InlineActionState.Working, vm.current().paymentStates["p"])
            result.complete(SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT)
            assertEquals(InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT), vm.current().paymentStates["p"])
            assertTrue(vm.current().unpaid.isEmpty())
        }
    
        @Test fun failedOperationKeepsDebtAndCanBeRetried() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            var calls = 0
            val vm = HomeViewModel(MutableStateFlow(data()), SettlementActions { calls++; if (calls == 1) error("Not saved") else SyncStatus.SYNCED })
            vm.askPayment("p"); vm.confirmPayment("p")
            assertTrue(vm.current().paymentStates["p"] is InlineActionState.Failed)
            assertEquals(1, vm.current().unpaid.size)
            vm.askPayment("p"); vm.confirmPayment("p")
            assertEquals(2, calls)
            assertTrue(vm.current().unpaid.isEmpty())
        }
    
        @Test fun missingServiceDoesNotPretendPaymentWorked() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val vm = HomeViewModel(MutableStateFlow(data()))
            vm.askAll(); vm.confirmAll(); vm.askPayment("p"); vm.confirmPayment("p")
            assertFalse(vm.current().canSettle)
            assertEquals(1, vm.current().unpaid.size)
            assertTrue(vm.current().paymentStates.isEmpty())
        }
    
        @Test fun payAllKeepsIndependentResultsWhenOneOperationFails() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val other = payment.copy(id = "p2", transfer = payment.transfer.copy(creditorId = "other"))
            val input = data().copy(finances = data().finances!!.copy(balancesByGroup = mapOf("g" to MemberBalance("u", -2468, "DKK")), outstandingPayments = listOf(payment, other)))
            val vm = HomeViewModel(MutableStateFlow(input), SettlementActions { if (it.id == "p2") error("Not saved") else SyncStatus.SYNCED })
            vm.askAll(); vm.confirmAll()
            assertTrue(vm.current().paymentStates["p"] is InlineActionState.Done)
            assertTrue(vm.current().paymentStates["p2"] is InlineActionState.Failed)
            assertEquals(listOf(other), vm.current().unpaid)
        }
    
        @Test fun cachedSnapshotCanRenderWithOfflineMarkerWithoutAnyRemoteCall() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val cached = data().copy(offlineSavedAt = 123L)
            val vm = HomeViewModel(MutableStateFlow(cached))
            assertEquals(cached, vm.current().data)
            assertEquals(123L, vm.current().data.offlineSavedAt)
        }
    
        @Test fun missingTransfersDoNotBecomeAllPaidUp() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val input = data().copy(finances = data().finances!!.copy(outstandingPayments = emptyList()))
            val vm = HomeViewModel(MutableStateFlow(input))
            assertFalse(vm.current().hasFinancialSummary)
        }
    
        @Test fun refreshFailureRetainsTheLastDeliveredDashboard() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val cached = data()
            val vm = HomeViewModel(flow { emit(cached); error("Offline") })
            assertEquals(cached, vm.current().data)
            assertNotNull(vm.current().sourceError)
        }
    
        @Test fun changedAmountDoesNotInheritSuccessfulStateOfOldPayment() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val response = CompletableDeferred<SyncStatus>()
            val source = MutableStateFlow(data())
            val vm = HomeViewModel(source, SettlementActions { response.await() })
            vm.askPayment("p"); vm.confirmPayment("p")
            val nextPayment = payment.copy(transfer = payment.transfer.copy(amountCents = 2000))
            source.value = data().copy(finances = FinancialSummary(mapOf("g" to MemberBalance("u", -2000, "DKK")), listOf(nextPayment)))
            response.complete(SyncStatus.SYNCED)
            assertEquals(listOf(nextPayment), vm.current().unpaid)
            assertFalse(vm.current().paymentStates["p"] is InlineActionState.Done)
        }
    
        @Test fun changedTotalCancelsPayAllConfirmation() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            var calls = 0
            val source = MutableStateFlow(data())
            val vm = HomeViewModel(source, SettlementActions { calls++; SyncStatus.SYNCED })
            vm.askAll()
            val next = payment.copy(transfer = payment.transfer.copy(amountCents = 2000))
            source.value = data().copy(finances = FinancialSummary(mapOf("g" to MemberBalance("u", -2000, "DKK")), listOf(next)))
            vm.confirmAll()
            assertFalse(vm.current().confirmingAll)
            assertEquals(0, calls)
        }
    
        @Test fun recordedCardSurvivesAnImmediateUpdatedBalanceSnapshot() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val source = MutableStateFlow(data())
            val vm = HomeViewModel(source, SettlementActions {
                source.value = data().copy(finances = FinancialSummary(mapOf("g" to MemberBalance("u", 0, "DKK")), emptyList()))
                SyncStatus.SYNCED
            })
            vm.togglePayments()
            vm.askPayment("p")
            vm.confirmPayment("p")
            assertTrue(vm.current().hasFinancialSummary)
            assertTrue(vm.current().unpaid.isEmpty())
            assertEquals(listOf(payment), vm.current().payments)
            assertEquals(InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.SYNCED), vm.current().paymentStates["p"])
            vm.closePayments()
            assertTrue(vm.current().payments.isEmpty())
        }
    }

    @OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
    class ActivityViewModelTest {
        private val dispatcher = UnconfinedTestDispatcher()
        private val group = DashboardGroup(Group("g", "Group", createdBy = "u"), 0)
        private val payment = OutstandingPayment("p", "g", "Mads", 1, DebtTransfer("u", "m", 1234, "DKK"))
        private val reminder = ActivityEvent("reminder", ActivityType.Reminder, User("m", "m@test", "Mads"), 1, "reminded you", group, 1, unread = true, payment = payment)
        private val failure = ActivityEvent("failure", ActivityType.SyncFailure, null, 0, "couldn't sync", group, 2, unread = true, syncStatus = SyncStatus.FAILED)
        private val expense = ActivityEvent("expense", ActivityType.ExpenseAdded, null, 0, "added an expense", group, 3, unread = true)
        private fun input() = ActivityData("u", listOf(reminder, failure, expense))
        private fun ActivityViewModel.current() = state.value as ActivityUiState.Success
        @Before fun setUp() = Dispatchers.setMain(dispatcher)
        @After fun tearDown() = Dispatchers.resetMain()
    
        @Test fun readStateIsIndependentOfNeedsYouAndAppliesAcrossFilters() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(MutableStateFlow(input()))
            vm.selectFilter(ActivityFilter.Payments)
            vm.markAllRead()
            assertFalse(vm.current().hasUnread)
            assertEquals(3, vm.current().readIds.size)
            assertEquals(2, vm.current().needsCount)
        }
    
        @Test fun retryOnlyShowsSyncedAfterActualSuccessfulResultAndIgnoresDoubleTap() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            var calls = 0
            val response = CompletableDeferred<SyncStatus>()
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(MutableStateFlow(input()), retries = SyncRetryActions { calls++; response.await() })
            vm.retry("failure"); vm.retry("failure")
            assertEquals(1, calls)
            assertEquals(InlineActionState.Working, vm.current().actionFor(failure))
            assertEquals(2, vm.current().needsCount)
            response.complete(SyncStatus.SYNCED)
            assertEquals(InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.SYNCED), vm.current().actionFor(failure))
            assertEquals(1, vm.current().needsCount)
        }
    
        @Test fun queueAcceptanceIsNotMisrepresentedAsSyncSuccess() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val source = MutableStateFlow(input())
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(source, retries = SyncRetryActions { SyncStatus.PENDING_UPDATE })
            vm.retry("failure")
            assertEquals(2, vm.current().needsCount)
            assertEquals(InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.PENDING_UPDATE), vm.current().actionFor(failure))
            val synced = failure.copy(syncStatus = SyncStatus.SYNCED)
            source.value = input().copy(events = listOf(reminder, synced, expense))
            assertEquals(1, vm.current().needsCount)
            assertEquals(InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.SYNCED), vm.current().actionFor(synced))
        }
    
        @Test fun retryFailureStaysActionableAndDoesNotHideFeed() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(MutableStateFlow(input()), retries = SyncRetryActions { error("No connection") })
            vm.retry("failure")
            assertTrue(vm.current().actionFor(failure) is InlineActionState.Failed)
            assertEquals(3, vm.current().events.size)
            assertEquals(2, vm.current().needsCount)
        }
    
        @Test fun paymentRequiresConfirmationAndCancellationMakesNoCall() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            var calls = 0
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(MutableStateFlow(input()), SettlementActions { calls++; SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT })
            vm.askPayment("reminder")
            assertEquals(0, calls)
            vm.cancelPayment(); vm.confirmPayment("reminder")
            assertEquals(0, calls)
            vm.askPayment("reminder"); vm.confirmPayment("reminder")
            assertEquals(1, calls)
            assertEquals(InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT), vm.current().actionFor(reminder))
            assertEquals(1, vm.current().needsCount)
        }
    
        @Test fun missingServicesLeaveActionsUnresolved() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(MutableStateFlow(input()))
            vm.askPayment("reminder"); vm.confirmPayment("reminder"); vm.retry("failure")
            assertEquals(2, vm.current().needsCount)
            assertTrue(vm.current().actions.isEmpty())
            assertFalse(vm.current().canRetry)
            assertFalse(vm.current().canSettle)
        }
    
        @Test fun accountChangeResetsSessionReadStateAndIgnoresOldCompletion() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val response = CompletableDeferred<SyncStatus>()
            val source = MutableStateFlow(input())
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(source, retries = SyncRetryActions { response.await() })
            vm.markAllRead(); vm.retry("failure")
            source.value = ActivityData("other", listOf(failure))
            response.complete(SyncStatus.SYNCED)
            assertTrue(vm.current().hasUnread)
            assertTrue(vm.current().readIds.isEmpty())
            assertTrue(vm.current().actions.isEmpty())
        }
    
        @Test fun changedPaymentIsNotSettledByAnOlderInFlightResult() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val response = CompletableDeferred<SyncStatus>()
            val source = MutableStateFlow(input())
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(source, SettlementActions { response.await() })
            vm.askPayment("reminder"); vm.confirmPayment("reminder")
            val changed = reminder.copy(payment = payment.copy(transfer = payment.transfer.copy(amountCents = 9999)))
            source.value = input().copy(events = listOf(changed))
            response.complete(SyncStatus.SYNCED)
            assertEquals(1, vm.current().needsCount)
            assertFalse(vm.current().actionFor(changed) is InlineActionState.Done)
        }
    
        @Test fun refreshFailureRetainsTheLastDeliveredEvents() = runTest(dispatcher) {
            val cached = input()
            val vm = ActivityViewModel(flow { emit(cached); error("Offline") })
            assertEquals(cached, vm.current().data)
            assertNotNull(vm.current().sourceError)
        }
    }

    @Composable
    fun BalanceChip(balanceCents: Long?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
        val colour = when {
            balanceCents == null -> AppColors.Ink600
            balanceCents < 0 -> AppColors.Red700
            balanceCents > 0 -> AppColors.Green700
            else -> AppColors.Ink600
        }
        val fill = when {
            balanceCents == null -> AppColors.Surface
            balanceCents < 0 -> AppColors.Red100
            balanceCents > 0 -> AppColors.Green100
            else -> AppColors.Surface
        }
        val text = when {
            balanceCents == null -> "Balance unavailable"
            balanceCents < 0 -> "You owe ${formatDanishAmountFromCents(-balanceCents, false)}"
            balanceCents > 0 -> "${formatDanishAmountFromCents(balanceCents, false, true)} to you"
            else -> "Settled"
        }
        Text(
            text,
            modifier.background(fill, AppShapes.Chip).padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 6.dp),
            style = AppTypography.Label,
            color = colour,
            maxLines = 2,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
        )
    }

    sealed interface HomeAction {
        data class Filter(val filter: GroupFilter) : HomeAction
        data class Period(val period: SpendPeriod) : HomeAction
        data class Slice(val groupId: String?) : HomeAction
        data class Ask(val paymentId: String) : HomeAction
        data class Confirm(val paymentId: String) : HomeAction
        data object TogglePayments : HomeAction
        data object ClosePayments : HomeAction
        data object Cancel : HomeAction
        data object AskAll : HomeAction
        data object ConfirmAll : HomeAction
    }
    
    @Composable
    fun HomeRoute(
        viewModel: HomeViewModel,
        onOpenActivity: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroups: () -> Unit,
        onCreateGroup: () -> Unit,
        onJoinGroup: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroup: (String) -> Unit,
        modifier: Modifier = Modifier
    ) {
        val state by viewModel.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
        val connection = rememberConnectionState()
        val shown = (state as? HomeUiState.Success)?.let {
            it.copy(data = it.data.copy(sync = it.data.sync.copy(connection = connection)))
        } ?: state
        HomeScreen(shown, { action ->
                when (action) {
                    is HomeAction.Filter -> viewModel.selectFilter(action.filter)
                    is HomeAction.Period -> viewModel.selectPeriod(action.period)
                    is HomeAction.Slice -> viewModel.selectSlice(action.groupId)
                    is HomeAction.Ask -> viewModel.askPayment(action.paymentId)
                    is HomeAction.Confirm -> viewModel.confirmPayment(action.paymentId)
                    HomeAction.TogglePayments -> viewModel.togglePayments()
                    HomeAction.ClosePayments -> viewModel.closePayments()
                    HomeAction.Cancel -> viewModel.cancelPayment()
                    HomeAction.AskAll -> viewModel.askAll()
                    HomeAction.ConfirmAll -> viewModel.confirmAll()
                }
            }, onOpenActivity, onOpenGroups, onCreateGroup, onJoinGroup, onOpenGroup, modifier)
    }

The empty-state and balance fixes are in place. Retry feedback can now follow the supplied sync-failure status without letting an older request result overwrite it. Home settlements and reminder payments still lack a stable link to a persisted settlement, so I won’t infer their acknowledgement from a zero balance, empty queue or matching amount. I’ll document that limit and test that pending feedback stays honest.

            emit(now)
            delay(60_000L - Math.floorMod(now, 60_000L))
        }

    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.dashboard
    
    import kotlinx.coroutines.async
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.take
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.toList
    import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
    import org.junit.Assert.*
    import org.junit.Test
    import java.util.Calendar
    
    class PresentationClockTest {
        @Test fun clockCrossesMidnightWithoutWaitingForANewDataSnapshot() = runTest {
            val initial = Calendar.getInstance().apply {
                clear(); set(2026, Calendar.NOVEMBER, 30, 23, 59, 59); set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 900)
            }.timeInMillis
            val values = async { presentationClock { initial + testScheduler.currentTime }.take(2).toList() }.await()
            assertEquals(initial + 100, values.last())
            assertEquals("Yesterday", activityDay(initial, values.last()))
            assertNotEquals(periodBounds(SpendPeriod.Month, values.first()), periodBounds(SpendPeriod.Month, values.last()))
        }
    
        @Test fun resumingCollectionReadsTheCurrentTimeImmediately() = runTest {
            var now = 100L
            val clock = presentationClock { now }
            assertEquals(100L, clock.first())
            now = 86400100L
            assertEquals(now, clock.first())
        }
    }

    # Phase 5B: independent Person 5 hardening
    
    ## Scope
    
    This stage hardens Home/Activity presentation and their existing read observation.
    SQLiteOpenHelper, DAOs, entities, schema/version, Firebase repositories, domain
    models, MainActivity/navigation and WorkManager activation remain unchanged.
    No new dependency, permission, database, operation ID or acknowledgement contract
    is introduced. The debug sandbox remains explicitly simulated.
    
    Phase 5A inspected the existing generated reports: 49 JVM and 17 instrumentation
    tests passed, with no failures/errors/skips. The user also verified the build and
    sandbox interactions in Android Studio. Those baseline results are distinct from
    the Phase 5B execution results recorded below.
    
    ## Changes
    
    ### Empty Activity filter
    
    The Needs-you empty state retains its layout/title but now says “No actions in
    this filter.” It does not claim that all debts are paid or all operations synced.
    A filtered event list cannot prove either condition. Supplied pending/failure
    strips remain visible above it. This deliberately qualifies the prototype's
    all-clear wording to satisfy NFR-K3 without inventing global completeness data.
    
    ### Group balances and confirmation
    
    Home group rows use `HomeUiState.Success.balanceForGroup`. When the financial
    snapshot is incomplete or its balances/transfers disagree, the rows show the
    existing neutral Balance unavailable chip, matching the hero's consistency guard.
    For a consistent snapshot, the existing local-recording presentation remains:
    confirmed recorded payments are removed from the displayed outstanding debt.
    This is presentation of supplied results, not a balance/settlement algorithm.
    
    Individual and bulk confirmation handlers recheck snapshot consistency before
    calling the injected settlement operation. A previously opened confirmation
    cannot bypass that check after an inconsistent refresh.
    
    ### Retry reconciliation
    
    For an existing SyncFailure event, its supplied SyncStatus is enough to render
    pending, failed and acknowledged states. Initial pending events no longer appear
    as idle failures. Later source emissions can move pending → failed, failed →
    pending and pending → synced without another UI action.
    
    A later persisted FAILED snapshot can replace local queue-accepted feedback with
    needs-attention feedback, even if its status value was already FAILED before
    scheduling. This does not identify a new retry attempt: it surfaces the latest
    available persisted failure and keeps Try now available. No attempt IDs, retry
    revisions or remote errors are fabricated.
    
    An explicit source failure/acknowledgement received while a scheduling request
    is suspended wins over that request's older result. Result application also
    checks the account, event identity/type and supplied payment. Queued retry cards
    retain Try now, so a missing further source emission cannot permanently remove
    the manual action. Existing duplicate-tap protection remains in the ViewModel;
    remote idempotency is still the owner's responsibility.
    
    ### Settlement reconciliation boundary
    
    The existing `SettlementActions` returns a SyncStatus but no persisted settlement
    reference. OutstandingPayment.id identifies an obligation, not a newly recorded
    settlement. There is no agreed link to the settlement IDs in paid-out history.
    Likewise, a reminder event's own sync metadata does not prove that its payment
    was synchronized.
    
    Therefore Home and reminder-payment feedback do not infer acknowledgement from
    a zero balance, an empty queue, a similar payment amount/person, a changed generic
    recovery message or a reminder's status. Pending settlement feedback remains
    pending until a reliable correlated result is available. A returned FAILED sync
    status still represents the operation's confirmed local recording and must not
    enable recording the same payment again.
    
    Person 4/database ownership is required to agree a stable settlement reference
    and authoritative correlated status updates. Background pending → synced/failed
    reconciliation for those particular settlement cards remains deferred. This stage
    implements the transitions only where the current event contract supplies the
    necessary information, rather than inventing a replacement contract.
    
    ### Time and recoverable reads
    
    `PresentationClock` is a small cancellable cold Flow. It emits the current time
    on subscription and at minute boundaries, including midnight/month/year changes.
    Home/Activity routes collect it with lifecycle awareness and project that time
    into their displayed snapshots. Resume obtains current time immediately. Cache
    timestamps, ledger timestamps and financial data are not modified. Stateless
    screens/previews retain injectable times for deterministic verification.
    
    Each ViewModel exposes `retryObservation`. It restarts only a failed read-source
    collection, never an active observation or a settlement/retry operation. Last
    delivered data, read state and compatible action state are retained; sourceError
    clears only after another data emission. Routes invoke it on resume and when
    connectivity becomes Online. There is no continuous retry loop or backend writer.
    Repeated failures remain visible and can be retried on the next lifecycle/network
    event, or explicitly through the same method.
    
    These source flows must be safe to collect again and represent reads. Their owner
    must not hide mutations in a read subscription. Account-scoped ViewModels and
    production lifecycle wiring remain Person 1's integration responsibility.
    
    ## Requirement and design review
    
    The relevant checks are NFR-K3/FE12 in the design document, inline S3-pay/S6-action
    behavior in the navigation model, and the Home/Activity templates/scripts in HiFi.
    The state flow and lifecycle approach follows Android 2's ViewModel/StateFlow
    material, Android 3's shared-state guidance and Android 4's repository boundary.
    The architecture/usability lectures distinguish observed persisted status from
    worker scheduling and feedback. No new architecture pattern is introduced.
    
    The component hierarchy, semantic colours, spacing, filters, chart interaction,
    inline confirmation and five-second all-clear interaction are retained. Changes
    are limited to truthful text/state handling and the existing retry control on a
    queued card. No pixel-perfect screenshot comparison is claimed in this stage.
    
    NFR-K1–K3 are still not claimed end-to-end. This stage supplies no real financial
    data source, transactional outbox writes, queue processor, persistent feed/read
    state, durable recovery history or background notification delivery. Room remains
    a separately unresolved team requirement; no Room implementation is introduced.
    
    ## Files
    
    Under `app/src/main/java/com/example/getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup/`:
    
    - New: `ui/dashboard/PresentationClock.kt`.
    - Modified: `ui/viewmodel/HomeViewModel.kt`, `ui/viewmodel/ActivityViewModel.kt`.
    - Modified: `ui/screens/home/HomeScreen.kt`, `ui/screens/activity/ActivityScreen.kt`.
    - Modified: `ui/components/SyncFeedback.kt` (lifecycle-aware presentation clock collection).
    
    Tests:
    
    - New: `app/src/test/java/com/example/getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup/ui/dashboard/PresentationClockTest.kt`.
    - Modified: `HomeViewModelTest.kt` and `ActivityViewModelTest.kt` in that directory.
    - Modified: `app/src/androidTest/java/com/example/getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup/ui/screens/SyncFeedbackTest.kt`.
    
    Documentation: this report, `person5_phase2_phase3.md`, and `ai_dossier_person5.md`.
    Earlier-phase uncommitted work is preserved. Generated verification artifacts
    remain in ignored build directories.
    
    ## Verification
    
    Final execution results will be recorded from the Phase 5B Gradle/test logs.
    
    New regressions cover inconsistent balances and confirmation, queued/failed local
    settlements without invented acknowledgements, retry state transitions and stale
    results, re-observation preserving read/action state without replaying writes,
    and current time on resume/midnight/month changes. New instrumentation cases cover
    the neutral empty filter, an inconsistent group chip, a still-actionable queued
    retry, and preventing duplicate recording after failed settlement sync.
    
    ## Android Studio verification and remaining owners
    
    Run assembleDebug and testDebugUnitTest, then connectedDebugAndroidTest with the
    emulator connected. The standard commands need no project configuration changes.
    In the existing debug sandbox, check filters, single/bulk confirm/cancel, queued
    and failed status, manual retry, and airplane-mode banners. The fixtures do not
    simulate a persisted failure/recovery stream; the new automated source-transition
    tests exercise that distinction. Navigating away/resuming refreshes presentation
    time and permits a failed read source to reconnect. No real synchronization should
    be registered or activated for these checks.
    
    Person 1 still owns shell integration and account scope. Person 4/database owners
    still owe stable settlement acknowledgement correlation, real financial flows,
    safe idempotent queue processing and durable history/feedback. Those shared
    contributions and production activation require separate approval.

    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.viewmodel
    
    import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
    import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.ui.dashboard.*
    import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
    import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
    import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
    
    sealed interface HomeUiState {
        data object Loading : HomeUiState
        data class Error(val message: String) : HomeUiState
        data class Success(
            val data: HomeData,
            val filter: GroupFilter = GroupFilter.Recent,
            val period: SpendPeriod = SpendPeriod.Month,
            val selectedGroupId: String? = null,
            val paymentsExpanded: Boolean = false,
            val confirmingAll: Boolean = false,
            val paymentStates: Map<String, InlineActionState> = emptyMap(),
            val recordedPayments: Map<String, OutstandingPayment> = emptyMap(),
            val canSettle: Boolean = false,
            val sourceError: String? = null
        ) : HomeUiState {
            val outstanding: List<OutstandingPayment> = data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().filter {
                it.transfer.debtorId == data.user.id && it.transfer.currency == "DKK" && it.transfer.amountCents > 0
            }.distinctBy { it.id }
            val payments: List<OutstandingPayment> = (outstanding + recordedPayments.values).distinctBy { it.id }
            val unpaid: List<OutstandingPayment> = outstanding.filter { paymentStates[it.id] !is InlineActionState.Done }
            val isWorking: Boolean = paymentStates.values.any { it == InlineActionState.Working }
            val oweCents: Long = unpaid.sumOf { it.transfer.amountCents }
            val owingGroupCount: Int = unpaid.map { it.groupId }.distinct().size
            val owedCents: Long = data.groups.sumOf { group ->
                data.finances?.balancesByGroup?.get(group.group.id)?.takeIf {
                    it.currency == "DKK" && it.userId == data.user.id
                }?.netBalanceCents?.coerceAtLeast(0L) ?: 0L
            }
            val hasFinancialSummary: Boolean = data.finances?.let { finances ->
                finances.outstandingPayments.all {
                    it.transfer.currency == "DKK" && it.transfer.debtorId == data.user.id &&
                    it.transfer.amountCents > 0 && data.groups.any { group -> group.group.id == it.groupId }
                } && data.groups.all { group ->
                    val balance = finances.balancesByGroup[group.group.id]
                    balance != null && balance.currency == "DKK" && balance.userId == data.user.id &&
                    outstanding.filter { it.groupId == group.group.id }.sumOf { it.transfer.amountCents } == maxOf(
                        0L,
                        -balance.netBalanceCents
                    )
                }
            } == true
    
            fun balanceForGroup(groupId: String): Long? {
                if (!hasFinancialSummary) return null
                val balance = data.finances?.balancesByGroup?.get(groupId)?.netBalanceCents ?: return null
                return if (balance < 0 && payments.any { it.groupId == groupId }) {
                    -unpaid.filter { it.groupId == groupId }.sumOf { it.transfer.amountCents }
                } else balance
            }
        }
    }
    
    class HomeViewModel(
        private val source: Flow<HomeData>,
        private val settlements: SettlementActions? = null
    ) : ViewModel() {
        private val mutableState = MutableStateFlow<HomeUiState>(HomeUiState.Loading)
        val state = mutableState.asStateFlow()
        private var recording = false
        private var observation: Job? = null
    
        init { observe() }
    
        fun retryObservation() {
            val current = mutableState.value
            if (observation?.isActive != true &&
                (current is HomeUiState.Error || current is HomeUiState.Success && current.sourceError != null)) observe()
        }
    
        private fun observe() {
            observation = viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    source.collect { data ->
                        val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success
                        mutableState.value = if (current == null || current.data.user.id != data.user.id) {
                            HomeUiState.Success(data, canSettle = settlements != null)
                        } else {
                            val unchangedIds = data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().filter { payment ->
                                current.data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().any { it == payment }
                            }.map { it.id }.toSet()
                            val recorded = current.recordedPayments.filterValues { payment ->
                                val next = data.finances?.outstandingPayments.orEmpty().firstOrNull { it.id == payment.id }
                                next == null || next == payment
                            }
                            current.copy(
                                data = data,
                                sourceError = null,
                                confirmingAll = current.confirmingAll &&
                                    current.data.finances?.outstandingPayments == data.finances?.outstandingPayments,
                                paymentStates = current.paymentStates.filterKeys { it in unchangedIds || it in recorded },
                                recordedPayments = recorded
                            )
                        }
                    }
                } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                    throw error
                } catch (error: Exception) {
                    val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success
                    mutableState.value = current?.copy(sourceError = "Couldn't refresh. Showing the last dashboard.")
                    ?: HomeUiState.Error(error.message ?: "Couldn't load your dashboard")
                }
            }
        }
    
        private fun update(change: (HomeUiState.Success) -> HomeUiState.Success) {
            mutableState.update { if (it is HomeUiState.Success) change(it) else it }
        }
    
        fun selectFilter(filter: GroupFilter) = update { it.copy(filter = filter) }
        fun selectPeriod(period: SpendPeriod) = update { it.copy(period = period, selectedGroupId = null) }
        fun selectSlice(groupId: String?) = update { it.copy(selectedGroupId = groupId) }
        fun togglePayments() = update {
            it.copy(
                paymentsExpanded = !it.paymentsExpanded,
                confirmingAll = false,
                recordedPayments = if (it.paymentsExpanded) emptyMap() else it.recordedPayments
            )
        }
        fun closePayments() = update {
            it.copy(paymentsExpanded = false, confirmingAll = false, recordedPayments = emptyMap())
        }
    
        fun cancelPayment() = update {
            it.copy(
                confirmingAll = false,
                paymentStates = it.paymentStates.filterValues { value -> value != InlineActionState.Confirming }
            )
        }
    
        fun askPayment(id: String) {
            cancelPayment()
            update {
                if (!it.canSettle || !it.hasFinancialSummary || recording || it.unpaid.none { payment -> payment.id == id }) it
                else it.copy(paymentStates = it.paymentStates + (id to InlineActionState.Confirming))
            }
        }
    
        fun askAll() {
            cancelPayment()
            update { if (it.canSettle && it.hasFinancialSummary && !recording && it.unpaid.isNotEmpty()) it.copy(confirmingAll = true) else it }
        }
    
        fun confirmPayment(id: String) {
            val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return
            if (current.paymentStates[id] != InlineActionState.Confirming || recording || !current.hasFinancialSummary) return
            record(current.unpaid.filter { it.id == id })
        }
    
        fun confirmAll() {
            val current = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return
            if (current.confirmingAll && !recording && current.hasFinancialSummary) record(current.unpaid)
        }
    
        private fun record(payments: List<OutstandingPayment>) {
            val actions = settlements ?: return
            val userId = (mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success)?.data?.user?.id ?: return
            recording = true
            update { it.copy(
                    confirmingAll = false,
                    paymentStates = it.paymentStates + payments.associate { p -> p.id to InlineActionState.Working }
            ) }
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    for (payment in payments) {
                        val latest = mutableState.value as? HomeUiState.Success ?: return@launch
                        if (latest.data.user.id != userId) return@launch
                        val result = try {
                            check(latest.payments.any { it == payment }) { "This balance changed. Check the latest payment." }
                            InlineActionState.Done(actions.recordSettlement(payment))
                        } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                            throw error
                        } catch (error: Exception) {
                            InlineActionState.Failed(error.message ?: "Couldn't record this payment. Try again.")
                        }
                        update {
                            val next = it.outstanding.firstOrNull { current -> current.id == payment.id }
                            if (it.data.user.id == userId && (next == payment || (next == null && result is InlineActionState.Done))) {
                                it.copy(
                                    paymentStates = it.paymentStates + (payment.id to result),
                                    recordedPayments = if (result is InlineActionState.Done) {
                                        it.recordedPayments + (payment.id to payment)
                                    } else it.recordedPayments
                                )
                            } else it
                        }
                    }
                } finally {
                    recording = false
                }
            }
        }
    }

    import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
    import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
    import com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.model.SyncStatus

    sealed interface ActivityUiState {
        data object Loading : ActivityUiState
        data class Error(val message: String) : ActivityUiState
        data class Success(
            val data: ActivityData,
            val filter: ActivityFilter = ActivityFilter.All,
            val readIds: Set<String> = emptySet(),
            val actions: Map<String, InlineActionState> = emptyMap(),
            val canSettle: Boolean = false,
            val canRetry: Boolean = false,
            val sourceError: String? = null
        ) : ActivityUiState {
            val events: List<ActivityEvent> = data.events.orEmpty().distinctBy { it.id }
            val needsCount: Int = events.count { it.needsAction(data.userId, actionFor(it)) }
            val hasUnread: Boolean = events.any { it.unread && it.id !in readIds }
            fun actionFor(event: ActivityEvent): InlineActionState {
                val action = actions[event.id] ?: InlineActionState.Idle
                if (event.type != ActivityType.SyncFailure) return action
                return when (event.syncStatus) {
                    SyncStatus.SYNCED -> InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.SYNCED)
                    SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT, SyncStatus.PENDING_UPDATE, SyncStatus.PENDING_DELETE ->
                        if (action == InlineActionState.Idle) InlineActionState.Done(event.syncStatus) else action
                    else -> action
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    class ActivityViewModel(
        private val source: Flow<ActivityData>,
        private val settlements: SettlementActions? = null,
        private val retries: SyncRetryActions? = null
    ) : ViewModel() {
        private val mutableState = MutableStateFlow<ActivityUiState>(ActivityUiState.Loading)
        val state = mutableState.asStateFlow()
        private val activeIds = mutableSetOf<String>()
        private var observation: Job? = null
    
        init { observe() }
    
        fun retryObservation() {
            val current = mutableState.value
            if (observation?.isActive != true &&
                (current is ActivityUiState.Error || current is ActivityUiState.Success && current.sourceError != null)) observe()
        }
    
        private fun observe() {
            observation = viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    source.collect { data ->
                        val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success
                        mutableState.value = if (current == null || current.data.userId != data.userId) {
                            ActivityUiState.Success(data, canSettle = settlements != null, canRetry = retries != null)
                        } else {
                            current.copy(data = data, sourceError = null, actions = reconcileActions(current, data))
                        }
                    }
                } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                    throw error
                } catch (error: Exception) {
                    val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success
                    mutableState.value = current?.copy(sourceError = "Couldn't refresh. Showing the last activity.")
                    ?: ActivityUiState.Error(error.message ?: "Couldn't load activity")
                }
            }
        }
    
        private fun reconcileActions(current: ActivityUiState.Success, data: ActivityData): Map<String, InlineActionState> =
            current.actions.mapNotNull { (id, action) ->
                val previous = current.events.firstOrNull { it.id == id }
                val next = data.events.orEmpty().firstOrNull { it.id == id }
                if (next == null || previous == null || previous.payment != next.payment || previous.type != next.type) null
                else id to when {
                    next.type == ActivityType.SyncFailure && next.syncStatus == SyncStatus.SYNCED ->
                        InlineActionState.Done(SyncStatus.SYNCED)
                    next.type == ActivityType.SyncFailure && next.syncStatus == SyncStatus.FAILED &&
                        (previous.syncStatus != SyncStatus.FAILED || action is InlineActionState.Done && action.syncStatus != SyncStatus.SYNCED) ->
                        InlineActionState.Failed("Couldn't sync yet. Try again.")
                    next.type == ActivityType.SyncFailure && action != InlineActionState.Working &&
                        next.syncStatus in listOf(SyncStatus.PENDING_INSERT, SyncStatus.PENDING_UPDATE, SyncStatus.PENDING_DELETE) ->
                        InlineActionState.Done(next.syncStatus)
                    else -> action
                }
            }.toMap()
    
        private fun update(change: (ActivityUiState.Success) -> ActivityUiState.Success) {
            mutableState.update { if (it is ActivityUiState.Success) change(it) else it }
        }
    
        fun selectFilter(filter: ActivityFilter) = update { it.copy(filter = filter) }
        fun markAllRead() = update { it.copy(readIds = it.readIds + it.events.map { event -> event.id }) }
    
        fun askPayment(id: String) = update {
            val event = it.events.firstOrNull { event -> event.id == id }
            if (event == null || !it.canSettle || !event.canPay(it.data.userId) || id in activeIds || it.actionFor(event) is InlineActionState.Done) it
            else it.copy(
                actions = it.actions.filterValues { value -> value != InlineActionState.Confirming } + (id to InlineActionState.Confirming),
                readIds = it.readIds + id
            )
        }
    
        fun cancelPayment() = update { it.copy(actions = it.actions.filterValues { value -> value != InlineActionState.Confirming }) }
    
        fun confirmPayment(id: String) {
            val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success ?: return
            val event = current.events.firstOrNull { it.id == id } ?: return
            val service = settlements ?: return
            if (current.actions[id] != InlineActionState.Confirming || !event.canPay(current.data.userId)) return
            runAction(event) { service.recordSettlement(event.payment!!) }
        }
    
        fun retry(id: String) {
            val current = mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success ?: return
            val event = current.events.firstOrNull { it.id == id } ?: return
            val service = retries ?: return
            if (event.type != ActivityType.SyncFailure || !event.needsAction(current.data.userId, current.actionFor(event))) return
            runAction(event) {
                val status = service.retry(event)
                check(status != SyncStatus.FAILED) { "Couldn't sync yet. Try again." }
                status
            }
        }
    
        private fun runAction(event: ActivityEvent, action: suspend () -> SyncStatus) {
            if (!activeIds.add(event.id)) return
            val userId = (mutableState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success)?.data?.userId ?: return
            update { it.copy(actions = it.actions + (event.id to InlineActionState.Working), readIds = it.readIds + event.id) }
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    val result = try {
                        InlineActionState.Done(action())
                    } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                        throw error
                    } catch (error: Exception) {
                        InlineActionState.Failed(error.message ?: "Couldn't complete this action. Try again.")
                    }
                    update {
                        if (it.data.userId == userId && it.actions[event.id] == InlineActionState.Working &&
                            it.events.any { current -> current.id == event.id && current.payment == event.payment && current.type == event.type }) {
                            it.copy(actions = it.actions + (event.id to result))
                        } else it
                    }
                } finally { activeIds.remove(event.id) }
            }
        }
    }

    fun presentationClock(nowMillis: () -> Long = System::currentTimeMillis): Flow<Long> = flow {
        while (true) {
            val now = nowMillis()
            emit(now)
            delay(60_000L - Math.floorMod(now, 60_000L))
        }
    }

        return state

        val connection: ConnectionState = ConnectionState.Unknown,
        val savedAt: Long? = null,
        val pendingCount: Int? = null,
        val failureMessage: String? = null,
        val acknowledgedRecovery: String? = null
    ) {
        init { require(pendingCount == null || pendingCount >= 0) }
        val hasFeedback: Boolean get() = connection == ConnectionState.Offline || (pendingCount ?: 0) > 0 ||
            failureMessage != null || acknowledgedRecovery != null
    }

    sealed interface HomeAction {
        data class Filter(val filter: GroupFilter) : HomeAction
        data class Period(val period: SpendPeriod) : HomeAction
        data class Slice(val groupId: String?) : HomeAction
        data class Ask(val paymentId: String) : HomeAction
        data class Confirm(val paymentId: String) : HomeAction
        data object TogglePayments : HomeAction
        data object ClosePayments : HomeAction
        data object Cancel : HomeAction
        data object AskAll : HomeAction
        data object ConfirmAll : HomeAction
    }
    
    @Composable
    fun HomeRoute(
        viewModel: HomeViewModel,
        onOpenActivity: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroups: () -> Unit,
        onCreateGroup: () -> Unit,
        onJoinGroup: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroup: (String) -> Unit,
        modifier: Modifier = Modifier
    ) {
        val state by viewModel.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
        val connection = rememberConnectionState()
        val now = rememberPresentationTime()
        LifecycleResumeEffect(viewModel) {
            viewModel.retryObservation()
            onPauseOrDispose { }
        }
        LaunchedEffect(connection, viewModel) {
            if (connection == ConnectionState.Online) viewModel.retryObservation()
        }
        val shown = (state as? HomeUiState.Success)?.let {
            it.copy(data = it.data.copy(nowMillis = now, sync = it.data.sync.copy(connection = connection)))
        } ?: state
        HomeScreen(shown, { action ->
                when (action) {
                    is HomeAction.Filter -> viewModel.selectFilter(action.filter)
                    is HomeAction.Period -> viewModel.selectPeriod(action.period)
                    is HomeAction.Slice -> viewModel.selectSlice(action.groupId)
                    is HomeAction.Ask -> viewModel.askPayment(action.paymentId)
                    is HomeAction.Confirm -> viewModel.confirmPayment(action.paymentId)
                    HomeAction.TogglePayments -> viewModel.togglePayments()
                    HomeAction.ClosePayments -> viewModel.closePayments()
                    HomeAction.Cancel -> viewModel.cancelPayment()
                    HomeAction.AskAll -> viewModel.askAll()
                    HomeAction.ConfirmAll -> viewModel.confirmAll()
                }
            }, onOpenActivity, onOpenGroups, onCreateGroup, onJoinGroup, onOpenGroup, modifier)
    }
    
    @Composable
    fun HomeScreen(
        state: HomeUiState,
        onAction: (HomeAction) -> Unit,
        onOpenActivity: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroups: () -> Unit,
        onCreateGroup: () -> Unit,
        onJoinGroup: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroup: (String) -> Unit,
        modifier: Modifier = Modifier
    ) {
        CompositionLocalProvider(LocalContentColor provides AppColors.Ink900) {
            when (state) {
                HomeUiState.Loading -> Box(
                    modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) { CircularProgressIndicator(color = AppColors.Green700) }
                is HomeUiState.Error -> Box(
                    modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(AppSpacing.Space16),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) { Text(state.message, style = AppTypography.Body, color = AppColors.Ink600) }
                is HomeUiState.Success -> HomeContent(
                    state,
                    onAction,
                    onOpenActivity,
                    onOpenGroups,
                    onCreateGroup,
                    onJoinGroup,
                    onOpenGroup,
                    modifier
                )
            }
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    private fun HomeContent(
        state: HomeUiState.Success,
        onAction: (HomeAction) -> Unit,
        onOpenActivity: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroups: () -> Unit,
        onCreateGroup: () -> Unit,
        onJoinGroup: () -> Unit,
        onOpenGroup: (String) -> Unit,
        modifier: Modifier
    ) {
        val data = state.data
        if (data.groups.isEmpty()) {
            EmptyHomeContent(state, onOpenActivity, onCreateGroup, onJoinGroup, modifier)
            return
        }
        val groups = remember(data.groups, state.filter) { filterGroups(data.groups, state.filter) }
        LazyColumn(
            modifier.fillMaxSize().background(AppColors.White),
            contentPadding = PaddingValues(
                start = AppSpacing.Space16,
                end = AppSpacing.Space16,
                top = AppSpacing.Space20,
                bottom = AppSpacing.Space24
            ),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space8)
        ) {
            item("header") { HomeHeader(data, onOpenActivity) }
            state.sourceError?.let { message ->
                item("source-error") {
                    Text(message, style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                }
            }
            if (data.displaySync.hasFeedback) item("sync-feedback") { SyncFeedback(data.displaySync) }
                item("summary") {
                    Row(
                        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(bottom = AppSpacing.Space12),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space12)
                    ) {
                        BalanceHero(state, { onAction(HomeAction.TogglePayments) }, Modifier.weight(1f))
                        Surface(
                            Modifier.weight(1f).heightIn(min = 212.dp),
                            shape = AppShapes.HeroCard,
                            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, AppColors.Line),
                            color = AppColors.White
                        ) {
                            PaidOutChart(
                                data,
                                state.period,
                                state.selectedGroupId,
                                { onAction(HomeAction.Period(it)) },
                                { onAction(HomeAction.Slice(it)) },
                                onOpenGroup,
                                Modifier.padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = AppSpacing.Space8)
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (state.paymentsExpanded && state.hasFinancialSummary) item("payments") { PaymentsDue(
                        state,
                        onAction,
                        Modifier.padding(bottom = AppSpacing.Space12)
                ) }
                item("group-heading") {
                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        Text("Your groups", Modifier.weight(1f), style = AppTypography.Section, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                        TextButton(onClick = onCreateGroup) { Text(
                                "New group",
                                style = AppTypography.ButtonInline,
                                color = AppColors.Green700
                        ) }
                    }
                }
                item("group-filter") {
                    Row(
                        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().background(AppColors.Surface, AppShapes.SegmentedBar).padding(AppSpacing.Space4),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space4)
                    ) {
                        GroupFilter.entries.forEach { filter ->
                            Surface(
                                Modifier.weight(1f),
                                shape = AppShapes.Chip,
                                color = if (state.filter == filter) AppColors.White else AppColors.Surface
                            ) {
                                TextButton(onClick = { onAction(HomeAction.Filter(filter)) }) {
                                    Text(
                                        filter.label,
                                        style = AppTypography.ButtonInline,
                                        color = if (state.filter == filter) AppColors.Ink900 else AppColors.Ink600
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                items(groups.take(6), key = { "group-${it.group.id}" }) { group ->
                    GroupRow(group, state, { onOpenGroup(group.group.id) })
                }
                if (groups.isEmpty()) item("no-favourites") {
                    Text(
                        "No favourites yet. Star a group to pin it here.",
                        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().background(AppColors.SurfaceSoft, AppShapes.ListCard).padding(AppSpacing.Space20),
                        style = AppTypography.Body,
                        color = AppColors.Ink600
                    )
                }
                if (groups.size > 6) item("see-all") {
                    DashboardButton(
                        "See all ${groups.size} groups â†’",
                        onOpenGroups,
                        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = AppTouchTargets.SecondaryButtonHeight),
                        AppColors.White,
                        AppColors.Green700,
                        outlined = true
                    )
                }
    
    @Composable
    private fun PaymentsDue(state: HomeUiState.Success, onAction: (HomeAction) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier) {
        val clear = state.unpaid.isEmpty()
        Surface(
            modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            color = if (clear) AppColors.Green50 else AppColors.Red50,
            shape = AppShapes.HeroCard,
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (clear) AppColors.Green200 else AppColors.Red200)
        ) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                if (clear) {
                    val progress = remember { Animatable(1f) }
                    val close by rememberUpdatedState(onAction)
                    LaunchedEffect(Unit) { progress.animateTo(0f, tween(5000)); close(HomeAction.ClosePayments) }
                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        Text("No payments due", Modifier.weight(1f), style = AppTypography.Section, color = AppColors.Green700)
                        IconButton(onClick = { onAction(HomeAction.ClosePayments) }) { DashboardSymbol(
                                DashboardIcon.Close,
                                description = "Close payments"
                        ) }
                    }
                    Text(
                        "You're all square with every group. We'll let you know when something new comes in.",
                        style = AppTypography.Caption,
                        color = AppColors.Ink600
                    )
                    LinearProgressIndicator(
                        progress = { progress.value },
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        color = AppColors.Green500,
                        trackColor = AppColors.Green100
                    )
                } else {
                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                            Text("Payments due", style = AppTypography.Subsection, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                            Text(
                                "${state.owingGroupCount} groups Â· ${formatDanishAmountFromCents(state.oweCents)}",
                                style = AppTypography.Caption,
                                color = AppColors.Red800
                            )
                        }
                        if (!state.confirmingAll) DashboardButton(
                            "Pay all",
                            { onAction(HomeAction.AskAll) },
                            container = AppColors.Red700,
                            content = AppColors.White,
                            enabled = state.canSettle && !state.isWorking
                        )
                    }
                    if (state.confirmingAll) {
                        Surface(color = AppColors.White, shape = AppShapes.BigButton) {
                            Column(Modifier.padding(AppSpacing.Space12), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                                Text(
                                    "Pay ${formatDanishAmountFromCents(state.oweCents)} to ${state.owingGroupCount} groups?",
                                    style = AppTypography.BodyStrong
                                )
                                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space8)) {
                                    DashboardButton(
                                        "Cancel",
                                        { onAction(HomeAction.Cancel) },
                                        Modifier.weight(1f),
                                        AppColors.White,
                                        AppColors.Ink900,
                                        outlined = true
                                    )
                                    DashboardButton(
                                        "Confirm",
                                        { onAction(HomeAction.ConfirmAll) },
                                        Modifier.weight(1f),
                                        AppColors.Red700,
                                        AppColors.White
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                state.payments.forEach { payment ->
                    val action = state.paymentStates[payment.id] ?: InlineActionState.Idle
                    if (!clear) {
                        val group = state.data.groups.firstOrNull { it.group.id == payment.groupId }
                        Surface(
                            color = if (action is InlineActionState.Done) AppColors.Green50 else AppColors.White,
                            shape = AppShapes.BigButton
                        ) {
                            Column(
                                Modifier.padding(AppSpacing.Space12),
                                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space12)
                            ) {
                                Row(
                                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space12)
                                ) {
                                    DashboardAvatar(group?.group?.name ?: "?", AppColors.groupColorAt(group?.colourIndex ?: 0))
                                    Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                                        Text(
                                            group?.group?.name ?: "Group unavailable",
                                            style = AppTypography.ItemTitle,
                                            color = AppColors.Ink900
                                        )
                                        Text(
                                            "To ${payment.creditorName} Â· Since ${relativeDate(payment.since, state.data.nowMillis).lowercase()}",
                                            style = AppTypography.Caption,
                                            color = AppColors.Ink600
                                        )
                                    }
                                    Text(
                                        formatDanishAmountFromCents(payment.transfer.amountCents),
                                        style = AppTypography.BodyStrong,
                                        color = if (action is InlineActionState.Done) AppColors.Green700 else AppColors.Red700
                                    )
                                }
                                InlinePaymentActions(
                                    action,
                                    formatDanishAmountFromCents(payment.transfer.amountCents),
                                    payment.creditorName,
                                    { onAction(HomeAction.Ask(payment.id)) },
                                    { onAction(HomeAction.Cancel) },
                                    { onAction(HomeAction.Confirm(payment.id)) },
                                    enabled = state.canSettle && state.hasFinancialSummary && (!state.isWorking || action == InlineActionState.Working),
                                    soft = true
                                )
                            }
                        }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    private fun GroupRow(group: DashboardGroup, state: HomeUiState.Success, onClick: () -> Unit) {
        val shownBalance = remember(state, group.group.id) {
            state.balanceForGroup(group.group.id)
        }
        Surface(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clickable(onClick = onClick),
            shape = AppShapes.ListCard,
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, AppColors.LineSoft),
            color = AppColors.White
        ) {
            Row(
                Modifier.padding(AppSpacing.Space12),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space12)
            ) {
                DashboardAvatar(group.group.name, AppColors.groupColorAt(group.colourIndex))
                Column(Modifier.weight(1f), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        Text(
                            group.group.name,
                            Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false),
                            style = AppTypography.ItemTitle,
                            maxLines = 1,
                            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                            color = AppColors.Ink900
                        )
                        if (group.isFavourite) DashboardSymbol(
                            DashboardIcon.Star,
                            Modifier.padding(start = AppSpacing.Space4).size(14.dp),
                            AppColors.StarGold,
                            "Favourite"
                        )
                    }
                    if (group.pendingExpenseCount > 0) {
                        Row(
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space4)
                        ) {
                            CircularProgressIndicator(Modifier.size(13.dp), color = AppColors.Amber800, strokeWidth = 1.5.dp)
                            Text(
                                "${group.pendingExpenseCount} expense${if (group.pendingExpenseCount == 1) "" else "s"} waiting to sync",
                                style = AppTypography.Caption,
                                color = AppColors.Amber700
                            )
                        }
                    } else Text(
                        "${group.group.members.size} members Â· Active ${relativeDate(group.lastActivityAt, state.data.nowMillis).lowercase()}",
                        style = AppTypography.Caption,
                        color = AppColors.Ink600
                    )
                }
                BalanceChip(shownBalance, Modifier.widthIn(max = 126.dp))
            }
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    private fun EmptyGroupIllustration(name: String) {
        Box(Modifier.size(200.dp, 160.dp)) {
            Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                drawCircle(AppColors.Green100, 46.dp.toPx(), Offset(66.dp.toPx(), 80.dp.toPx()))
                drawCircle(AppColors.Lavender50, 36.dp.toPx(), Offset(122.dp.toPx(), 54.dp.toPx()))
                drawCircle(AppColors.EmptyGroupPeach, 32.dp.toPx(), Offset(142.dp.toPx(), 112.dp.toPx()))
                drawCircle(AppColors.White, 20.dp.toPx(), Offset(66.dp.toPx(), 80.dp.toPx()))
                drawCircle(AppColors.Green300, 16.dp.toPx(), Offset(66.dp.toPx(), 80.dp.toPx()))
                val dashed = Stroke(2.dp.toPx(), pathEffect = PathEffect.dashPathEffect(floatArrayOf(4.dp.toPx(), 3.dp.toPx())))
                drawCircle(AppColors.White, 18.dp.toPx(), Offset(122.dp.toPx(), 54.dp.toPx()))
                drawCircle(AppColors.InviteLavender, 17.dp.toPx(), Offset(122.dp.toPx(), 54.dp.toPx()), style = dashed)
                drawCircle(AppColors.White, 18.dp.toPx(), Offset(142.dp.toPx(), 112.dp.toPx()))
                drawCircle(AppColors.InvitePeach, 17.dp.toPx(), Offset(142.dp.toPx(), 112.dp.toPx()), style = dashed)
            }
            Box(Modifier.offset(46.dp, 60.dp).size(40.dp), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                Text(name.take(1).uppercase(), style = AppTypography.ItemTitle, color = AppColors.Ink900)
            }
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    private fun HomeHeader(data: HomeData, onOpenActivity: () -> Unit) {
        Row(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(top = AppSpacing.Space8, bottom = AppSpacing.Space12),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                Text(dateText(data.nowMillis, "EEEE d MMMM"), style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                Text(
                    "Hi, ${data.user.displayName.substringBefore(' ')}",
                    style = AppTypography.ScreenTitle,
                    color = AppColors.Ink900
                )
            }
            Surface(shape = AppShapes.Circle, border = BorderStroke(1.dp, AppColors.Line), color = AppColors.White) {
                IconButton(onClick = onOpenActivity, modifier = Modifier.size(AppTouchTargets.MinTouchTarget)) {
                    Box {
                        DashboardSymbol(
                            DashboardIcon.Bell,
                            description = if (data.hasUnreadActivity) "Activity, unread notifications" else "Activity"
                        )
                        if (data.hasUnreadActivity) Box(Modifier.align(Alignment.TopEnd).size(8.dp).background(
                                AppColors.Green500,
                                AppShapes.Circle
                        ))
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    private fun EmptyHomeContent(
        state: HomeUiState.Success,
        onOpenActivity: () -> Unit,
        onCreateGroup: () -> Unit,
        onJoinGroup: () -> Unit,
        modifier: Modifier
    ) {
        val data = state.data
        Column(
            modifier.fillMaxSize().background(AppColors.White).padding(
                start = AppSpacing.Space16,
                end = AppSpacing.Space16,
                top = AppSpacing.Space20,
                bottom = AppSpacing.Space24
            )
        ) {
            HomeHeader(data, onOpenActivity)
            state.sourceError?.let { Text(it, style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600) }
            if (data.displaySync.hasFeedback) SyncFeedback(data.displaySync)
            Box(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                Column(
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(horizontal = AppSpacing.Space12),
                    horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space12)
                ) {
                    EmptyGroupIllustration(data.user.displayName)
                    Text("No groups yet", style = AppTypography.ScreenTitleLarge, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                    Text(
                        "Make a group for your flat, a trip or Friday bar. Add an expense and we'll keep track of who owes what.",
                        style = AppTypography.Body,
                        color = AppColors.Ink600,
                        textAlign = TextAlign.Center
                    )
                    DashboardButton(
                        "Create a group",
                        onCreateGroup,
                        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = AppTouchTargets.PrimaryButtonHeight),
                        AppColors.Green700,
                        AppColors.White
                    )
                    TextButton(onClick = onJoinGroup) { Text(
                            "Join with an invite link",
                            style = AppTypography.ButtonSecondary,
                            color = AppColors.Green700
                    ) }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    sealed interface ActivityAction {
        data class Filter(val filter: ActivityFilter) : ActivityAction
        data class Ask(val eventId: String) : ActivityAction
        data class Confirm(val eventId: String) : ActivityAction
        data class Retry(val eventId: String) : ActivityAction
        data object Cancel : ActivityAction
        data object MarkAllRead : ActivityAction
    }
    
    @Composable
    fun ActivityRoute(viewModel: ActivityViewModel, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
        val state by viewModel.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
        val connection = rememberConnectionState()
        val now = rememberPresentationTime()
        LifecycleResumeEffect(viewModel) {
            viewModel.retryObservation()
            onPauseOrDispose { }
        }
        LaunchedEffect(connection, viewModel) {
            if (connection == ConnectionState.Online) viewModel.retryObservation()
        }
        val shown = (state as? ActivityUiState.Success)?.let {
            it.copy(data = it.data.copy(nowMillis = now, sync = it.data.sync.copy(connection = connection)))
        } ?: state
        ActivityScreen(shown, { action ->
                when (action) {
                    is ActivityAction.Filter -> viewModel.selectFilter(action.filter)
                    is ActivityAction.Ask -> viewModel.askPayment(action.eventId)
                    is ActivityAction.Confirm -> viewModel.confirmPayment(action.eventId)
                    is ActivityAction.Retry -> viewModel.retry(action.eventId)
                    ActivityAction.Cancel -> viewModel.cancelPayment()
                    ActivityAction.MarkAllRead -> viewModel.markAllRead()
                }
            }, modifier)
    }
    
    @Composable
    fun ActivityScreen(state: ActivityUiState, onAction: (ActivityAction) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
        CompositionLocalProvider(LocalContentColor provides AppColors.Ink900) {
            when (state) {
                ActivityUiState.Loading -> Box(
                    modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) { CircularProgressIndicator(color = AppColors.Green700) }
                is ActivityUiState.Error -> Box(
                    modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(AppSpacing.Space16),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) { Text(state.message, style = AppTypography.Body, color = AppColors.Ink600) }
                is ActivityUiState.Success -> ActivityContent(state, onAction, modifier)
            }
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    private fun ActivityContent(state: ActivityUiState.Success, onAction: (ActivityAction) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier) {
        val shown = remember(
            state.data,
            state.filter,
            state.actions
        ) { filterActivities(state.events, state.data.userId, state.filter, state.actions) }
