    @Composable
    private fun ActivityCard(event: ActivityEvent, state: ActivityUiState.Success, onAction: (ActivityAction) -> Unit) {
        val action = state.actionFor(event)
        val unread = event.unread && event.id !in state.readIds
        val done = action is InlineActionState.Done && action.syncStatus == SyncStatus.SYNCED
        Surface(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), shape = AppShapes.BigButton,
            color = if (done) AppColors.Green50 else if (unread) AppColors.ActivityUnread else AppColors.White,
            border = BorderStroke(
                1.dp,
                if (done) AppColors.Green200 else if (unread) AppColors.ActivityUnreadBorder else AppColors.LineSoft
            )
        ) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(AppSpacing.Space12), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space12)) {
                    EventAvatar(event, state.data.userId, done)
                    Column(Modifier.weight(1f), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp)) {
                        val actor = if (event.actor?.id == state.data.userId) "You" else event.actor?.displayName ?: event.expenseTitle.orEmpty()
                        Text(buildAnnotatedString {
                                withStyle(SpanStyle(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)) { append(actor) }
                                if (actor.isNotEmpty()) append(" ")
                                append(if (event.type == ActivityType.SyncFailure && done) "synced" else event.description)
                            }, style = AppTypography.BodyStrong, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                            Box(Modifier.size(8.dp).background(AppColors.groupColorAt(event.group.colourIndex), AppShapes.Circle))
                            Text(
                                "${event.group.group.name} Â· ${if (activityDay(event.occurredAt, state.data.nowMillis) == "Earlier") dateText(event.occurredAt, "EEE d MMM") else dateText(event.occurredAt, "HH:mm")}",
                                style = AppTypography.Label,
                                color = AppColors.Ink600
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                        event.amountCents?.let { amount ->
                            val colour = when {
                                done || event.direction == AmountDirection.Received || event.direction == AmountDirection.Settled -> AppColors.Green700
                                event.direction == AmountDirection.Owed -> AppColors.Red700
                                else -> AppColors.Ink900
                            }
                            Text(
                                formatDanishAmountFromCents(
                                    amount,
                                    false,
                                    event.direction == AmountDirection.Received
                                ) + if (event.currency == "DKK") "" else " ${event.currency}",
                                style = AppTypography.ItemTitle,
                                color = colour
                            )
                        }
                        if (unread) Box(Modifier.size(8.dp).background(
                                AppColors.Green500,
                                AppShapes.Circle
                            ).semantics { contentDescription = "Unread" })
                    }
                }
                if (event.canPay(state.data.userId)) {
                    val payment = event.payment!!
                    InlinePaymentActions(
                        action,
                        formatDanishAmountFromCents(payment.transfer.amountCents),
                        payment.creditorName,
                        { onAction(ActivityAction.Ask(event.id)) },
                        { onAction(ActivityAction.Cancel) },
                        { onAction(ActivityAction.Confirm(event.id)) },
                        Modifier.padding(start = 56.dp),
                        enabled = state.canSettle
                    )
                }
                if (event.type == ActivityType.SyncFailure) Column(
                    Modifier.padding(start = 56.dp),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space8)
                ) {
                    when (action) {
                        InlineActionState.Working -> ActionStatus("Syncingâ€¦", working = true)
                        is InlineActionState.Done -> {
                            if (action.syncStatus == SyncStatus.SYNCED) ActionStatus("Synced")
                            else {
                                SyncStatusStrip(action.syncStatus ?: SyncStatus.PENDING_UPDATE)
                                DashboardButton("Try now", { onAction(ActivityAction.Retry(event.id)) },
                                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), AppColors.White, AppColors.Red800, state.canRetry,
                                    outlined = true, borderColour = AppColors.RetryBorder)
                            }
                        }
                        else -> {
                            if (action is InlineActionState.Failed) Text(
                                action.message,
                                style = AppTypography.Caption,
                                color = AppColors.Amber800
                            )
                            DashboardButton(
                                "Try now",
                                { onAction(ActivityAction.Retry(event.id)) },
                                Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                                AppColors.White,
                                AppColors.Red800,
                                state.canRetry,
                                outlined = true,
                                borderColour = AppColors.RetryBorder
                            )
                            if (!state.canRetry) Text(
                                "Sync service unavailable",
                                style = AppTypography.Caption,
                                color = AppColors.Ink600
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    @Composable
    private fun EventAvatar(event: ActivityEvent, userId: String, done: Boolean) {
        val failed = event.type == ActivityType.SyncFailure
        val colour = if (failed) { if (done) AppColors.Green100 else AppColors.Red50 } else if (event.actor?.id == userId) AppColors.Green300 else AppColors.groupColorAt(event.actorColourIndex)
        val badgeColour: Color = if (done) AppColors.Green700 else when (event.type) {
            ActivityType.Reminder, ActivityType.SyncFailure -> AppColors.Red700
            ActivityType.Payment -> AppColors.Green700
            ActivityType.ExpenseChanged -> AppColors.Ink600
            ActivityType.ExpenseAdded -> AppColors.Green500
        }
        val icon = if (done) DashboardIcon.Check else when (event.type) {
            ActivityType.Reminder -> DashboardIcon.Bell
            ActivityType.SyncFailure -> DashboardIcon.Warning
            ActivityType.Payment -> DashboardIcon.Check
            ActivityType.ExpenseChanged -> DashboardIcon.Edit
            ActivityType.ExpenseAdded -> DashboardIcon.Plus
        }
        Box(Modifier.size(44.dp)) {
            DashboardAvatar(if (failed) "" else event.actor?.displayName.orEmpty(), colour, round = true)
            Surface(
                Modifier.size(20.dp).align(Alignment.BottomEnd).offset(3.dp, 3.dp),
                color = badgeColour,
                shape = AppShapes.Circle,
                border = BorderStroke(2.dp, AppColors.White)
            ) {
                DashboardSymbol(icon, Modifier.padding(4.dp), colour = AppColors.White)
            }
        }
    }

    @Composable
    private fun BalanceHero(state: HomeUiState.Success, onToggle: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier) {
        val available = state.hasFinancialSummary
        val owes = state.oweCents
        val owed = state.owedCents
        val owing = available && owes > 0
        Surface(
            modifier.heightIn(min = 212.dp),
            shape = AppShapes.HeroCard,
            color = if (!available) AppColors.Surface else if (owing) AppColors.Red100 else AppColors.Green100
        ) {
            Column(
                Modifier.padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = AppSpacing.Space16),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space8)
            ) {
                if (!available) {
                    Text("Balance unavailable", style = AppTypography.Section, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                    Text("Waiting for balance information", style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                } else if (owing) {
                    Text("You owe", style = AppTypography.CaptionStrong, color = AppColors.Red800)
                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.Bottom, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space4)) {
                        Text(
                            formatDanishAmountFromCents(owes, false),
                            Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false),
                            style = AppTypography.Amount,
                            color = AppColors.Red700
                        )
                        Text("kr", style = AppTypography.ItemTitle, color = AppColors.Red700)
                    }
                    val count = state.owingGroupCount
                    Text("$count ${if (count == 1) "group" else "groups"}", style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Red800)
                    DashboardButton(
                        if (state.paymentsExpanded) "Hide âŒƒ" else "Pay now âŒ„",
                        onToggle,
                        Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        AppColors.Red700,
                        AppColors.White
                    )
                } else {
                    Box(
                        Modifier.size(44.dp).background(AppColors.White, AppShapes.Circle),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) { DashboardSymbol(DashboardIcon.Check, colour = AppColors.Green700) }
                    Text("All paid up", style = AppTypography.ScreenTitle, color = AppColors.Green700)
                    Text("You don't owe anyone right now. Nice work.", style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Green600)
                    Text(
                        "${formatDanishAmountFromCents(owed, includePlusSign = true)} owed to you",
                        style = AppTypography.CaptionStrong,
                        color = AppColors.Green700
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Composable
    fun PaidOutChart(
        data: HomeData,
        period: SpendPeriod,
        selectedGroupId: String?,
        onPeriod: (SpendPeriod) -> Unit,
        onSelect: (String?) -> Unit,
        onOpenGroup: (String) -> Unit,
        modifier: Modifier = Modifier
    ) {
        var menuOpen by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
        val slices = remember(data, period) { spendSlices(data, period) }
        val groups = remember(data.groups) { data.groups.associateBy { it.group.id } }
        val selected = slices.firstOrNull { it.groupId == selectedGroupId }
        val popoverOffset = with(LocalDensity.current) { 150.dp.roundToPx() }
        Column(modifier, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppSpacing.Space8)) {
            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                Text("Paid out", Modifier.weight(1f), style = AppTypography.CaptionStrong, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                Box {
                    TextButton(onClick = { menuOpen = true }, contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 4.dp)) {
                        Text(period.shortLabel, style = AppTypography.CaptionStrong, color = AppColors.Ink900)
                        DashboardSymbol(DashboardIcon.Chevron, Modifier.size(16.dp))
                    }
                    DropdownMenu(expanded = menuOpen, onDismissRequest = { menuOpen = false }, containerColor = AppColors.White) {
                        SpendPeriod.entries.forEach { item ->
                            DropdownMenuItem(
                                text = { Text(item.label, style = AppTypography.CaptionStrong) },
                                onClick = { menuOpen = false; onPeriod(item) }
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Box(Modifier.size(140.dp).align(Alignment.CenterHorizontally), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                Canvas(
                    Modifier.fillMaxSize().semantics {
                        contentDescription = if (data.paidOutPayments == null) "Paid out data unavailable" else "Paid out ${formatDanishAmountFromCents(slices.sumOf { it.amountCents })} ${period.caption}"
                        customActions = slices.map { slice ->
                            CustomAccessibilityAction("${groups[slice.groupId]?.group?.name}: ${formatDanishAmountFromCents(slice.amountCents)}") { onSelect(slice.groupId); true }
                        }
                    }.pointerInput(slices, selectedGroupId) {
                        detectTapGestures { position ->
                            val id = hitTestSlice(position.x / size.width, position.y / size.height, slices, selectedGroupId)
                            onSelect(if (id == selectedGroupId) null else id)
                        }
                    }
                ) {
                    if (slices.isEmpty()) {
                        drawCircle(AppColors.Surface, radius = size.width * 62f / 140f)
                        drawCircle(AppColors.White, radius = size.width * 40f / 140f)
                    }
                    slices.forEach { slice ->
                        val centre = size.width / 2f
                        val outer = size.width * (if (slice.groupId == selectedGroupId) 69f else 62f) / 140f
                        val inner = size.width * 40f / 140f
                        val gap = minOf(2f, slice.sweepDegrees / 3f)
                        val start = slice.startDegrees - 90f + gap / 2
                        val sweep = slice.sweepDegrees - gap
                        val path = Path().apply {
                            arcTo(Rect(centre - outer, centre - outer, centre + outer, centre + outer), start, sweep, true)
                            arcTo(Rect(centre - inner, centre - inner, centre + inner, centre + inner), start + sweep, -sweep, false)
                            close()
                        }
                        drawPath(
                            path,
                            AppColors.groupColorAt(groups.getValue(slice.groupId).colourIndex),
                            alpha = if (selected != null && slice.groupId != selectedGroupId) 0.45f else 1f
                        )
                    }
                }
                Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally, modifier = Modifier.width(80.dp)) {
                    Text(
                        if (data.paidOutPayments == null) "â€”" else formatDanishAmountFromCents(
                            slices.sumOf { it.amountCents },
                            false
                        ),
                        style = AppTypography.ItemTitle,
                        color = AppColors.Ink900
                    )
                    Text(
                        if (data.paidOutPayments == null) "Unavailable" else "kr ${period.caption}",
                        style = AppTypography.Tag,
                        color = AppColors.Ink600
                    )
                }
                if (selected != null) {
                    val group = groups.getValue(selected.groupId)
                    val pointerLeft = remember(selected) {
                        val middle = Math.toRadians((selected.startDegrees + selected.sweepDegrees / 2 - 90).toDouble())
                        (70 + 69 * kotlin.math.cos(middle) + 64 - 7).toFloat().coerceIn(18f, 172f)
                    }
                    Popup(
                        alignment = Alignment.TopEnd,
                        offset = IntOffset(0, popoverOffset),
                        onDismissRequest = { onSelect(null) },
                        properties = PopupProperties(focusable = true)
                    ) {
                        Box(Modifier.width(204.dp).padding(top = 7.dp)) {
                            Canvas(Modifier.offset(x = pointerLeft.dp, y = (-7).dp).size(14.dp, 7.dp)) {
                                drawPath(Path().apply {
                                    moveTo(0f, size.height)
                                    lineTo(size.width / 2, 0f)
                                    lineTo(size.width, size.height)
                                    close()
                                }, AppColors.White)
                            }
                        Surface(
                            Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            shape = AppShapes.ListCard,
                            color = AppColors.White,
                            shadowElevation = 12.dp
                        ) {
                            Column(Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                                    Box(Modifier.size(12.dp).background(AppColors.groupColorAt(group.colourIndex), AppShapes.Circle))
                                    Spacer(Modifier.width(AppSpacing.Space8))
                                    Text(group.group.name, Modifier.weight(1f), style = AppTypography.ItemTitle)
                                    IconButton(
                                        onClick = { onSelect(null) },
                                        modifier = Modifier.size(AppTouchTargets.MinTouchTarget)
                                    ) {
                                        DashboardSymbol(DashboardIcon.Close, description = "Close payment details")
                                    }
                                }
                                Text("Paid ${period.caption}", style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                                Text(formatDanishAmountFromCents(selected.amountCents), style = AppTypography.TopBarTitle)
                                Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().background(AppColors.SurfaceSoft, AppShapes.Chip).padding(10.dp)) {
                                    Text("Last payment", style = AppTypography.Caption, color = AppColors.Ink600)
                                    Text(
                                        "${formatDanishAmountFromCents(selected.lastPayment.settlement.amountCents)} to ${selected.lastPayment.creditorName} Â· ${relativeDate(selected.lastPayment.settlement.createdAt, data.nowMillis)}",
                                        style = AppTypography.CaptionStrong
                                    )
                                }
                                DashboardButton(
                                    "Open group â†’",
                                    { onSelect(null); onOpenGroup(group.group.id) },
                                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                                )
                            }
                        }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        val amountCents: Long,
        val lastPayment: PaidOutPayment,
        val startDegrees: Float,
        val sweepDegrees: Float
    )
    
    fun filterGroups(groups: List<DashboardGroup>, filter: GroupFilter): List<DashboardGroup> =
    when (filter) {
        GroupFilter.Recent -> groups.sortedByDescending { it.lastActivityAt }
        GroupFilter.Favourites -> groups.filter { it.isFavourite }.sortedByDescending { it.lastActivityAt }
        GroupFilter.All -> groups.sortedBy { it.group.name.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) }
    }
    
    fun periodBounds(
        period: SpendPeriod,
        nowMillis: Long,
        timeZone: TimeZone = TimeZone.getDefault()
    ): LongRange {
        val start = Calendar.getInstance(timeZone).apply {
            timeInMillis = nowMillis
            set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0)
            set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0)
            set(Calendar.SECOND, 0)
            set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0)
            when (period) {
                SpendPeriod.Today -> Unit
                SpendPeriod.Week -> add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, -((get(Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK) + 5) % 7))
                SpendPeriod.Month -> set(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1)
                SpendPeriod.Year -> { set(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR, 1) }
            }
        }
        val end = (start.clone() as Calendar).apply {
            when (period) {
                SpendPeriod.Today -> add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1)
                SpendPeriod.Week -> add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 7)
                SpendPeriod.Month -> add(Calendar.MONTH, 1)
                SpendPeriod.Year -> add(Calendar.YEAR, 1)
            }
        }
        return start.timeInMillis until end.timeInMillis
    }
    
    fun spendSlices(data: HomeData, period: SpendPeriod): List<SpendSlice> {
        val bounds = periodBounds(period, data.nowMillis)
        val groupIds = data.groups.map { it.group.id }.toSet()
        val payments = data.paidOutPayments.orEmpty().filter {
            val payment = it.settlement
            payment.debtorId == data.user.id && payment.currency == "DKK" &&
            payment.status == SettlementStatus.COMPLETED && payment.amountCents > 0 &&
            payment.groupId in groupIds && payment.createdAt in bounds && payment.createdAt <= data.nowMillis
        }.distinctBy { it.settlement.id }
        val byGroup = payments.groupBy { it.settlement.groupId }
        val total = payments.sumOf { it.settlement.amountCents }.toDouble()
        var start = 0f
        return byGroup.map { (id, entries) ->
            val amount = entries.sumOf { it.settlement.amountCents }
            val sweep = (amount / total * 360.0).toFloat()
            SpendSlice(id, amount, entries.maxBy { it.settlement.createdAt }, start, sweep).also { start += sweep }
        }
    }
    
    fun hitTestSlice(x: Float, y: Float, slices: List<SpendSlice>, selectedGroupId: String?): String? {
        val radius = hypot(x - 0.5f, y - 0.5f)
        val angle = ((Math.toDegrees(atan2((y - 0.5f).toDouble(), (x - 0.5f).toDouble())) + 450) % 360).toFloat()
        return slices.firstOrNull {
            val outer = if (it.groupId == selectedGroupId) 69f / 140f else 62f / 140f
            val halfGap = minOf(2f, it.sweepDegrees / 3f) / 2f
            radius in (40f / 140f)..outer && angle >= it.startDegrees + halfGap &&
            angle <= it.startDegrees + it.sweepDegrees - halfGap
        }?.groupId
    }
    
    fun dateText(millis: Long, pattern: String): String =
    SimpleDateFormat(pattern, Locale.ENGLISH).format(Date(millis))
    
    fun activityDay(millis: Long, nowMillis: Long): String {
        if (millis in periodBounds(SpendPeriod.Today, nowMillis)) return "Today"
        val yesterday = Calendar.getInstance().apply { timeInMillis = nowMillis; add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, -1) }
        return if (millis in periodBounds(SpendPeriod.Today, yesterday.timeInMillis)) "Yesterday" else "Earlier"
    }
    
    fun relativeDate(millis: Long, nowMillis: Long): String = when (val day = activityDay(millis, nowMillis)) {
        "Earlier" -> dateText(millis, "EEE d MMM")
        else -> day
    }

    enum class ScheduleResult { Pending, Unavailable, AccountChanged, Rejected }
    
    class SyncScheduler(private val workManager: WorkManager, private val runner: SyncRunner) {
        suspend fun scheduleAutomatic(accountId: String): ScheduleResult = schedule(accountId, manual = false)
        suspend fun scheduleManual(accountId: String): ScheduleResult = schedule(accountId, manual = true)
        suspend fun recoverAfterRestart(accountId: String): ScheduleResult = scheduleAutomatic(accountId)
    
        private suspend fun schedule(accountId: String, manual: Boolean): ScheduleResult {
            when (runner.readiness(accountId)) {
                SyncRunResult.Unavailable -> return ScheduleResult.Unavailable
                SyncRunResult.AccountChanged -> return ScheduleResult.AccountChanged
                else -> Unit
            }
            return try {
                runInterruptible(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    workManager.enqueueUniqueWork(workName(accountId, manual), ExistingWorkPolicy.KEEP, request(accountId))
                        .result.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                }
                ScheduleResult.Pending
            } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                throw error
            } catch (error: Exception) {
                ScheduleResult.Rejected
            }
        }
    
        companion object {
            fun workName(accountId: String, manual: Boolean = false): String {
                require(accountId.isNotBlank())
                val hash = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(accountId.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
                    .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
                return "person5-sync-${if (manual) "manual" else "automatic"}-$hash"
            }
    
            fun request(accountId: String): OneTimeWorkRequest {
                require(accountId.isNotBlank())
                return OneTimeWorkRequestBuilder<SyncWorker>()
                    .setInputData(workDataOf(SyncWorker.AccountKey to accountId))
                    .setConstraints(Constraints.Builder().setRequiredNetworkType(NetworkType.CONNECTED).build())
                    .setBackoffCriteria(BackoffPolicy.EXPONENTIAL, 10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                    .build()
            }
        }
    }

    class SyncWorker(
        context: Context,
        parameters: WorkerParameters,
        private val runner: SyncRunner
    ) : CoroutineWorker(context, parameters) {
        constructor(context: Context, parameters: WorkerParameters) : this(context, parameters, SyncRunner(null, { null }))
    
        override suspend fun doWork(): Result {
            val accountId = inputData.getString(AccountKey).orEmpty()
            val outcome = runner.run(accountId)
            return when (outcome) {
                SyncRunResult.Complete -> Result.success()
                SyncRunResult.Retry -> Result.retry()
                else -> Result.failure(workDataOf("reason" to outcome.name))
            }
        }
    
        companion object { const val AccountKey = "account_id" }
    }
    
    class SyncWorkerFactory(processor: SyncQueueProcessor?, currentAccount: () -> String?) : WorkerFactory() {
        val runner = SyncRunner(processor, currentAccount)
    
        override fun createWorker(context: Context, workerClassName: String, parameters: WorkerParameters): ListenableWorker? =
            if (workerClassName == SyncWorker::class.java.name) SyncWorker(context, parameters, runner) else null
    }

    enum class ConnectionState { Unknown, Online, Offline }
    
    class ConnectivityObserver(context: Context) {
        private val manager = context.applicationContext.getSystemService(ConnectivityManager::class.java)
    
        fun observe() = callbackFlow {
            if (manager == null) {
                trySend(ConnectionState.Unknown)
                awaitClose { }
                return@callbackFlow
            }
            fun publish() {
                val capabilities = try {
                    manager.getNetworkCapabilities(manager.activeNetwork)
                } catch (error: SecurityException) {
                    trySend(ConnectionState.Unknown)
                    return
                }
                trySend(if (capabilities?.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET) == true &&
                    capabilities.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_VALIDATED)) {
                    ConnectionState.Online
                } else ConnectionState.Offline)
            }
            val callback = object : ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback() {
                override fun onAvailable(network: Network) = publish()
                override fun onLost(network: Network) = publish()
                override fun onCapabilitiesChanged(network: Network, capabilities: NetworkCapabilities) = publish()
            }
            try {
                manager.registerDefaultNetworkCallback(callback)
                publish()
            } catch (error: SecurityException) {
                trySend(ConnectionState.Unknown)
                close()
                return@callbackFlow
            }
            awaitClose { manager.unregisterNetworkCallback(callback) }
        }.distinctUntilChanged()
    }

    fun interface SyncQueueProcessor {
        suspend fun processNext(accountId: String): SyncStep
    }
    
    sealed interface SyncStep {
        data object Empty : SyncStep
        data class Acknowledged(val accountId: String) : SyncStep
        data object RetryLater : SyncStep
        data object NeedsAttention : SyncStep
    }
    
    enum class SyncRunResult { Complete, Retry, Unavailable, AccountChanged, NeedsAttention }
    package com.example.getyourmoneyupnotyourfunnyup.data.sync
    
    import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
    import kotlinx.coroutines.TimeoutCancellationException
    import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
    import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
    import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeout
    import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
    import kotlinx.coroutines.ensureActive
    
    class SyncRunner(
        private val processor: SyncQueueProcessor?,
        private val currentAccount: () -> String?,
        private val timeoutMillis: Long = 30_000,
        private val maxOperations: Int = 20
    ) {
        init {
            require(timeoutMillis > 0 && maxOperations > 0)
        }
    
        fun readiness(accountId: String): SyncRunResult? = when {
            processor == null -> SyncRunResult.Unavailable
            accountId.isBlank() || currentAccount() != accountId -> SyncRunResult.AccountChanged
            else -> null
        }
    
        suspend fun run(accountId: String): SyncRunResult {
            readiness(accountId)?.let { return it }
            return try {
                withTimeout(timeoutMillis) {
                    processingLock.withLock {
                        repeat(maxOperations) {
                            if (currentAccount() != accountId) return@withLock SyncRunResult.AccountChanged
                            val step = processor!!.processNext(accountId)
                            if (currentAccount() != accountId) return@withLock SyncRunResult.AccountChanged
                            when (step) {
                                SyncStep.Empty -> return@withLock SyncRunResult.Complete
                                SyncStep.RetryLater -> return@withLock SyncRunResult.Retry
                                SyncStep.NeedsAttention -> return@withLock SyncRunResult.NeedsAttention
                                is SyncStep.Acknowledged -> if (step.accountId != accountId) {
                                    return@withLock SyncRunResult.NeedsAttention
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        SyncRunResult.Retry
                    }
                }
            } catch (error: TimeoutCancellationException) {
                currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
                SyncRunResult.Retry
            } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                throw error
            } catch (error: Exception) {
                SyncRunResult.NeedsAttention
            }
        }
    
        companion object {
            private val processingLock = Mutex()
        }
    }

    • S3, S3-pay & S3-slice: Home
    dashboard, donut chart,
    forfaldne betalinger• S6 &
    S6-action: Global aktivitetsfeed,
    filtre og quick-actions•
    Offline-arkitektur: Banner, sync

    Fælles Snitflader & Aftaler
    1.​ Datamodel (Fælles opstart): Lås jeres kerne-entiteter (User, Group, Expense,
    ExpenseItem, Split, Payment) før kodeskrivning.
    2.​ Scanner -> Beregning (Person 3 & 4): Aftal kontrakt/model for det udgifts-objekt, som
    scanneren afleverer til beregningsmodulet.
    3.​ Beregning -> Dashboard (Person 4 & 5): Aftal interface/repository-kald til at levere
    "You owe / You're owed" saldi til home feed og grafer.
    4.​ Data Sync -> Alle (Person 5 & resten): Repository-mønster så de øvrige primært kalder
    Room lokalt, mens synkronisering afvikles i baggrunden.
    
    
    
    REVIEW Documentation/Lectures/Software Architecture Part 1.pdf
    PAGE 9 Component and connector viewpoint
    Elements: components with functional behaviour.  Relations: connectors for control and communication.  UML: object and interaction diagrams.
    Components
    what part of the running system is doing what: a
    ViewModel instance, a repository, a worker, the backend
    Connectors
    how they talk: a StateFlow, a suspend call, SQL through
    a DAO, HTTPS with JSON, a push message. A
    connector defines the protocol, the ordering of
    operations, and the roles of the attached components.
    Mapping to UML
    components are active objects; connectors are links with
    messages; add a textual description of responsibilities
    Compose UI
    GroupScreen
    GroupViewModel

    ExpenseRepository

    suspend addExpense()
    SQL via DAO
    Outbox
    Room table of pending requests
    SyncWorker
    WorkManager, backoff, network constraint
    Backend API
    or Firebase / mock
    enqueue
    drain
    HTTPS, JSON
    notification “expense synced” back to the user
    Only the solid arrows cross a thread or a
    process boundary. The one from
    SyncWorker to the backend is the one that
    fails; everything about reliability sits around
    it.

    PAGE 12 Your architecture diagram for the report
    One page, one argument: this is how the design meets the reliability QA
    Do
    •
    say which view it is (usually component and connector, with
    the allocation boundary drawn as a dashed line around the
    phone)
    •
    name every element with the real class or module name
    from your repository
    •
    label every connector with its construct: StateFlow, suspend
    call, Room DAO, WorkManager, HTTPS
    •
    mark where the reliability tactics live: outbox, worker with
    backoff, feedback state in the ViewModel, notification
    •
    add a legend and a short paragraph: stimulus, response,
    which component responds, how you tested it
    Common mistakes
    •
    a diagram of the screens: that is the navigation model from
    the design document, not an architecture
    •
    boxes without arrows, or arrows without labels
    •
    a cloud called “Backend” and a box called “App”, nothing in
    between
    •
    a textbook MVVM picture that does not contain the words
    outbox, retry or backoff although the QA is reliability
    •
    a diagram that disagrees with the code; the examiner opens
    the repository

    REVIEW Documentation/Lectures/Andorid 2.pdf
    PAGE 14 MVVM
    • Pattern that separates responsibilities into three layers:
    • View
    • ViewModel
    • Model
    • View
    • Displays the UI
    • Receives user input
    • Contains minimal business logic
    • ViewModel
    • Holds UI state
    • Contains presentation logic
    • Survives configuration changes
    • Model
    • Data and business logic
    • Database
    • Repository
    • This and other architectures are described in a later lecture
    
    PAGE 16 Creating ViewModels
    • ViewModel for displaying a name
    • _name is mutable and private
    • MutableStateFlow holds a value that
    can be changed, and sends new value
    to observers
    • name is read-only and public
    • asStateFlow() creates read-only copy
    • _name can only be changed using the
    public function setName()
    
    PAGE 17 Using ViewModels
    • ViewModel is passed to the screen that uses it
    • = viewModel() means that an instance is created if one is not passed
    • If multiple screens use the same VM, the same instance should be
    passed between them
    • collectAsStateWithLifeCycle() observes a StateFlow and converts it
    to Compose State
    • In this example, it
    becomes a String that
    can be displayed in
    the UI

    PAGE 22 Cloud Firestore – Repository Pattern
    To access the database, we should introduce a
    Repository.
    The repository is responsible for:
    • Accessing and modifying data
    • Hiding database/API details from the
    ViewModel
    • Providing a single place for
    data-related operations
    ViewModel should not communicate directly
    with the database, but should instead use the
    repository as an intermediary

    # Person 5 integration handoff
    
    The independent Home/Activity UI and inactive offline foundation are ready for
    controlled team integration. They are not a completed production financial data
    path or an activated synchronization system. Keep preview/debug sources out of
    production wiring. No new dependency or architecture layer is needed to attach
    the existing entry points.
    
    ## Person 1: shell and account scope
    
    - Connect `HomeRoute` and `ActivityRoute` to the existing intended five-tab shell;
      the current MainActivity still routes authentication to Counter. Person 5 did
      not replace it.
    - Construct `HomeViewModel(Flow<HomeData>, SettlementActions?)` and
      `ActivityViewModel(Flow<ActivityData>, SettlementActions?, SyncRetryActions?)`
      through ordinary factories at the authenticated account scope. Pass the
      instances to the routes; destroy them on logout/account switch.
    - Supply Home's callbacks: `onOpenActivity`, `onOpenGroups`, `onCreateGroup`,
      `onJoinGroup`, and `onOpenGroup(groupId)`. Bell opens Activity; see-all opens
      Groups; a group row/donut callout opens that group. Confirmation stays inline.
    - The shell owns system insets and the bottom navigation area. Pass its padded
      modifier to each route. The routes already observe lifecycle, current time and
      connectivity. Data-source flows must be safe read subscriptions on reconnect.
    - Future WorkManager factory/configuration and authenticated startup/logout hooks
      require a separately approved shared initialization change. Do not initialize
      WorkManager twice or register a fake processor.
    
    ## Person 2: group presentation metadata
    
    Supply `DashboardGroup` values wrapping the existing Group plus:
    
    - Stable group ID and actual member list.
    - Chosen `colourIndex`, consistently used for group tile, chart and feed dot.
      Use the existing non-green/non-red palette.
    - Actual `isFavourite`, `lastActivityAt` and persisted pending-expense count.
    
    No group colour/favourite schema or persistence is introduced by Person 5.
    Coordinate their source with the database owner rather than inferring metadata
    from sample group names or assigning fictitious stored values.
    
    ## Person 4: financial results and manual recording
    
    - Supply `FinancialSummary`: balances keyed by every listed group, using the
      current user's existing MemberBalance, and OutstandingPayment values wrapping
      existing DebtTransfer. Current summary/chart support DKK without currency
      mixing. Outgoing transfers must match each negative group balance.
    - An `OutstandingPayment.id` identifies one stable obligation. Use it consistently
      across Home and reminders; do not reuse it for a changed obligation.
    - Implement `SettlementActions.recordSettlement(payment): SyncStatus`. Revalidate
      account, ownership, amount and current obligation inside the operation and make
      recording idempotent across screens/devices. It records a manual settlement;
      no money is transferred by these screens.
    - Return actual local-recording/sync status and emit updated financial snapshots.
      PENDING/FAILED sync can still mean the local settlement was recorded; do not
      throw as though nothing was saved and enable duplicate recording. Reconcile
      uncertain outcomes before allowing another recording.
    - Supply `PaidOutPayment(Settlement, creditorName)` history for the donut. The
      chart uses completed DKK manual settlements paid by the current user in the
      selected period, distinct from their separate cloud sync status.
    - Agree with the database owner on a stable persisted settlement reference and
      correlated status updates. The current status-only return cannot correlate a
      later background acknowledgement to an obligation. Do not infer the link from
      equal amounts, zero balances, reminder metadata or an empty queue.
    
    ## Database/Firebase owner: local sources, activity and processor
    
    - Supply account-scoped local `Flow<HomeData>` and `Flow<ActivityData>` (or inputs
      combined into those snapshots). UI reads must remain available from local data;
      do not replace them with direct remote-only screen reads.
    - `finances = null` / `paidOutPayments = null` means unavailable. An explicit empty
      value means a known empty result. `events = null` means history unavailable.
    - Supply actual event history, stable event IDs, unread state and shared bell/read
      information. Mark-all-read is currently session-only. Do not reconstruct edits
      or reminders as though they were recorded history from current ledger rows.
    - Populate optional `SyncPresentation` only with real counts, cache timestamps,
      failure information and acknowledged recovery feedback. Its defaults are
      neutral. Connectivity/WorkManager success is not a server acknowledgement.
    - Implement `SyncRetryActions.retry(event): SyncStatus` with an account-verified
      mapping to the real operation. Return a pending status for accepted scheduling;
      SYNCED requires acknowledgement. Emit subsequent statuses on the same supplied
      SyncFailure event. Never match a queue target by title/amount/group name alone.
    - Implement `SyncQueueProcessor.processNext(accountId): SyncStep` over the existing
      queue. Results are Empty, Acknowledged(accountId), RetryLater or NeedsAttention.
      Own atomic local/outbox writes, operation ownership, dependency ordering,
      payload validation, remote idempotency, acknowledgement reconciliation and
      retaining blocked writes. Do not clear a newer edit when an older one finishes.
    - Check authentication/session and ownership inside the processor at dispatch and
      commit. The runner's UID checks/mutex are additional guards, not authorization
      or cross-device idempotency. Cancellation may not cancel an SDK write already
      dispatched; uncertain acknowledgements need reconciliation.
    - Once approved, install `SyncWorkerFactory(processor, currentAccount)` before
      WorkManager initialization and build `SyncScheduler` with its exposed runner.
      Recreate dependencies after process restart. Connect automatic scheduling after
      transaction commit and authenticated recovery; handle the enqueue/crash and
      worker-finishing races. The hooks are not connected today.
    
    ## Before enabling production writes/uploads
    
    Keep optional services absent/disabled until their contracts are fulfilled. Agree
    on Room versus the existing SQLiteOpenHelper with its owner: the responsibility
    document explicitly names Room, and WorkManager's internal database does not
    satisfy that application deliverable.
    
    Verify real offline reads/writes, restart/reboot recovery, account switching,
    newer edits during upload, duplicate prevention after uncertain acknowledgement,
    and durable recovery feedback/notification preferences. NFR-K1–K3 remain
    incomplete until that data path is implemented and tested. Do not activate the
    processor merely because independent tests pass.
    
    Review findings and final build/release qualifications are in
    `person5_phase5.md` (Phase 5C section). Human review, clean lint and unresolved
    warning/design decisions remain part of the final project sign-off.
